games.name: Theme Hospital
games.summary: Theme Hospital is a business simulation game developed by Bullfrog Productions and published by Electronic Arts in 1997, in which the player designs and operates a hospital. Like most of Bullfrog's games, Theme Hospital is permeated by an eccentric sense of humour. The game is the thematic successor to Theme Park, a game also produced by Bullfrog. The game was a massive commercial success, selling over 4 million copies worldwide.

games.name: Re-Volt
games.summary:
Re-Volt is an R/C car racing game from Acclaim, originally released in 1999.
Re-Volt features great gameplay, realistic physics that still hold up to this day and bright and colorful visuals. It's a game aimed at people who just want to play a funky arcade racing game as well as for people who seek a more competitive challenge. It's meant for all ages and occasions: Play for yourself or in the local network with friends, or even online!

games.name: Steins;Gate: Octet of Shifting Space
games.summary: A non-canon extension of the True End of the original game. Unlike the modern visual novel format of the original game, this retro game perfectly mimics the style of graphical text adventure games from the 8-bit PC era (e.g. PC-88), with the player typing short commands to interact with and explore the game world. It features all backgrounds and characters drawn in a low-color pixelated style with emulated scanlines, chiptune music played through an emulated FM chip, and no voice acting. Although non-canon, the game contains many easter eggs and references that connect Chaos;Head and Steins;Gate together.

games.name: RPG Shelterra the Skyworld
games.summary: A traditional JRPG developed by Kemco for mobile devices based in a world where people are connected with ancient creatures called "artifacts".

games.name: Yomawari: Night Alone
games.summary: Yomawari is a Japanese horror action game and features a female protagonist that is searching for her older sister and pet dog, while exploring a creepy town at night. She only has a flashlight at her disposal, and using said flash light will let her “see things that shouldn’t be seen.”

games.name: Boku Boku
games.summary:
Boku Boku is a Cozy Building sandbox game.
You can build houses, create your own worlds, and make new friends.
Explore a wondrous world, and leave your mark in this pixel paradise.

games.name: Yomawari: Midnight Shadows
games.summary: The dark is no place to be alone. After a beautiful show of summer fireworks, two young girls begin to make their way home. However, a mysterious attacker separates them, and both must brave the haunting night filled with unspeakable terrors and survive the darkness.

games.name: Hoop Shoot
games.summary: Shoot hoops over poles!

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5: Mission Pack 1 - Extra Challenge
games.summary:
This is the road to hell.
The extraterrestrial life forms the Primers slam this challenge down to any elite EDF soldier: A mission pack of over 10 incredibly difficult missions. Enemies that only appeared in the hardest missions of the main campaign now appear in droves. Aliens with gear they didn't have in the main campaign will assail you. Are you brave enough to take the first step on the road to hell?

Over 30 new weapons!

games.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
games.summary: Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, or share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive...

games.name: Cat President 2: Purrlitical Revolution
games.summary: The cats are back to win your heart - and your vote in Cat President 2: Purrlitical Revolution, a satirical otome game! With a script that's over 100,000 words long, Cat President 2 is a visual novel packed full of romance, humor and cute pictures of cats. Fans of the first game and newcomers alike are sure to enjoy this game! Cast your vote today!

games.name: Destruction AllStars
games.summary:
Stars and cars collide.

Dominate the glittering global phenomenon of Destruction AllStars – the spectacular prime-time sport for dangerous drivers!
Master the art of intense vehicle-based combat through timing, tactics and skills to cause colossal amounts of damage, destruction and devastation in vibrant arenas across the globe.

Pile-on the destruction from behind the wheel or leap into the arena with a breathtaking reel of parkour action by dodging attacks, taking over vehicles or using abilities to disrupt the onslaught of incoming vehicles.

Cause enough mayhem to power up your AllStars game-changing hero vehicle fueled with special abilities.

A roster of 16 blockbuster Destruction AllStars are revved up and ready to compete in the name of entertainment and demolition. So, strap in for intense, explosive and unpredictable levels of free-flowing action and fight to be crowned the Global Destruction Federation Champion.

It’s time to run, ram and slam. See you in the arena.

games.name: Dps Idle
games.summary: Collect cards, upgrade cards, defeat monsters, join guilds and hire heroes. Raise your DPS!

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
aliases: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
games.summary: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

games.name: Hard West 2
games.summary: Hard West 2 is a supernatural journey to the dark heart of the West. With a gun full of lead and a fistful of witchcraft, raise an outlaw posse and chase down the devil to take back what’s yours.

games.name: A Pet Shop After Dark
games.summary: A PET SHOP AFTER DARK is a horror point-and-click visual novel where you've taken on an odd job at a little pet shop.

games.name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
games.summary: A group of university students is going to spend a week in the old hotel "Amnea". Within these seven days they have to find out what is hidden behind its facade and to unravel all the mysteries without losing their minds.

games.name: Let's Sing ABBA
games.summary: Celebrate the glorious comeback of the Swedish pop giant ABBA. Party solo or with your friends to some of your favourite classics from the band's repertoire! Choose from a collection of 31 ABBA classics and perform them in seven different game modes.

games.name: Light: Black Cat & Amnesia Girl
games.summary: "Light" is a 3D adventure puzzle game, in which you play as a cat. You will help a little girl who has lost her memory escape by leading her through four-level mazes with different style.

games.name: A Little to the Left
games.summary: A Little To The Left is a cozy puzzle game that has you sort, stack, and organize household items into pleasing arrangements while you keep an eye out for a mischievous cat with an inclination for chaos. Check out this playful and intuitive puzzler with 75+ satisfying messes to tidy.

games.name: Witch on the Holy Night
games.summary: Set in 1980s Japan, Witch on the Holy Night tells the story of fan-favorite Type-Moon character Aoko Aozaki as she attempts to navigate the complex world of magecraft while also dealing with the everyday struggles of life as a high school student! Players will experience the thrilling origin story of this much-beloved character, penned by Kinoko Nasu, famed creator of the Fate series, himself.

games.name: We are Eva
games.summary: Play the game in multiple dimensions at the same time, traveling between them whenever you like! Doesn't it sound fun? My name is Eva, by the way, I'm the main protagonist of the game you're looking at, and I promise we'll have fun. If you add me to your wishlist, of course. *wink wink*

games.name: Labyrinth
games.summary: The aMAZEing Labyrinth now with a completely new look and at long last for PC: for more than 35 years, the simple and unique gameplay of the board game has inspired more than 20 million people worldwide.

games.name: Japanese Rural Life Adventure
games.summary: Experience countryside living in Japanese Rural Life Adventure. "View the cherry blossoms in the spring, attend the festival in the summer, eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall, hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year."

games.name: GeoJelly
games.summary: Born within unknown you instinctively seek for freedom as an experiment defect. In GeoJelly you have to find your way out of dystopian laboratory through platforming while avoiding traps and collecting keys necessary to push forward. Are you gonna find a way out?

games.name: Vikings: Valhalla Saga
games.summary: Realistic Historical Role-Playing Game

games.name: Stellar Blade
games.summary: Stellar Blade is a third-person action-adventure game set on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Players control Eve, an elite soldier deployed from an orbital colony to reclaim the planet from hostile creatures called Naytibas. The combat system emphasizes timing-based parrying and evasion, with skill gauges that unlock powerful attacks and buffs. The game features exploration across ruined environments, side quests from NPC survivors in the last human city of Xion, and a narrative with multiple endings based on player choices.

games.name: Chess Twist
games.summary: A game of chess set on a procedurally generated board, where tiles can have 3 or 5 diagonals and straight lines bend around your opponent's defenses. Same rules, different battlefield. Opportunities for new strategies are hidden in plain sight. Will you see them before your opponent does?

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
aliases: Project Re Fantasy: A Fool's Journey Begins
メタファー：リファンタジオ
games.summary:
From the creative minds of the Persona series – Metaphor: ReFantazio marks ATLUS’ first ever, full-scale fantasy RPG, brought to you by director Katsura Hashino, character designer Shigenori Soejima, and composer Shoji Meguro.

Write your destiny and rise above fear as you step into a fantasy world unlike anything you’ve seen before. Fraught with unsettling mystery, the kingdom stands on a precipice. Now, you must embark on a journey, overcoming obstacles and forging bonds with friends.

games.name: Thronefall
games.summary: A minimalist game about building and defending a little kingdom. Thronefall is a classic strategy game without unnecessary complexity, just some healthy hack-and-slay. Build up your base during the day, and defend it ‘til your last breath at night.

games.name: Don't Be Afraid 2
aliases: Dont be Afraid 2: Escape the Nightmare
games.summary: Descend deep into the nightmare that seamlessly blends with reality in this uncanny horror escape room game. Can you find your way out of the horrid mansion or will you succumb to your fears? Can you face and overcome your past, or will it break you?

games.name: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged
games.summary: Re-experience the thrill and challenges of managing a Gladiator arena in this management/simulation game. With new content with over 10 hours of gameplay, new graphics, Quality of Life updates, and all DLCs packed into this new experience, this is how Blackthorn Arena was meant to be experienced.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+
games.summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ delivers the ultimate, feature-complete, randomized dungeon-crawling experience, now enhanced with full online co-op for up to four players. It integrates all previous DCs and content updates, featuring 700+ items and over 300 enemy types. Key features include new online leaderboards, an emote wheel, and refined multiplayer systems.

games.name: Swashbuckler's Xmas
games.summary: An action-packed holiday adventure full of pirates, snowballs, and the occasional yeti. Explore the North Pole in this third-person action adventure game for all ages.

games.name: The End of the Sun
games.summary: The End of the Sun is a first-person exploration and adventure story-based game, embedded in the Slavic world. This is a series of mysterious events that ordinary people dealt with, as they were living in a small village where the line between myth and reality became to fade perilously.
developers: The End of the Sun Forge
publishers: The End of the Sun Forge

games.name: Possessions
games.summary: In Possessions, perspective changes everything. Solve mesmerizing puzzles by shifting your view and bending reality to your will. Explore a minimalist 3D world filled with illusionary surprises, and uncover a quiet story of connection and family as you progress.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

games.name: CloserLook VR: Oldways
games.summary: CLoserLook: Old Ways, a captivating interactive story VR adventure game set in modern day west Africa. Awakening in a locked university administrative building, you'll need to solve a series of intricate puzzles to find your way out. As you navigate through the game, explore secret locations and uncover a gripping narrative that delves into themes of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.

games.name: Foundation: Galactic Frontier
games.summary: Command Asimov's OFFICIAL Foundation universe! Live the life as an interstellar trader to exploit your trade routes! Build your starship home, crush enemies in explosive shootouts & outsmart rivals with fleet strategies in epic space wars - with new content expanding your saga!

games.name: The Slormancer
games.summary: Fight hordes of enemies lead by The Slormancer, an evil warlock from the past, in an absurd yet epic Action RPG! Featuring loads of shiny loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

games.name: Prison Breaker
games.summary: As a Prison Breaker, you are a polygon trapped in the prison and destined to smash your way out. Find the right time to attack the prison. Memorize and dodge the dangerous obstacles. Watch how the prison's defense patterns evolve as you progress.

games.name: Popucom: Too Many Clothes Pack
games.summary: Fashion Without Limits!

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary: Spirit Crossing is a beautiful cooperative life-sim about building friendships and community. Sign up for our Closed Alpha playtest and discover a world where you can connect, escape, and belong.

games.name: Wobbly Life
games.summary: Wobbly Life is a lively open world physics based sandbox. Play with your friends in Online and local co-op, discover a variety of minigames and objectives to earn cash to spend in the world!

games.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
games.summary: A brand-new adventure from the creators of The House of Da Vinci. With new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, Nikola Tesla.

games.name: Mr. Elevator
games.summary: We are developing a puzzle solving game with an elevator motif. This game is currently in the early stages of development, but we plan to upload images and demos of the work in progress. Please follow us and add us to your wishlist!

games.name: Ages of Cataria
games.summary: Set in a new fantastical world, Ages of Cataria is a cozy-friendly town sim. Watch as your village evolves from humble beginnings, with just one family, to a community of multiple families living together across generations of time.

games.name: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
games.summary: Be a stone Golem and try to save Nature with the help of an adorable Fox! Reconnect ancient sources of energy in environmental puzzles. Discover secrets from a lost civilization and save animals on an emotional quest in a cozy, colorful world.

games.name: Leaf Blower Co.
games.summary: Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

games.name: My Child New Beginnings
games.summary: My Child New Beginnings is a life simulation game where you play as an adoptive parent to a child with a dramatic past. The game is a sequel to My Child Lebensborn and combines philosophy, trauma, care and reconciliation as the main topics. There will also be a simple online function that lets other people share thoughts about these topics.

games.name: Ski Jumping World Cup
games.summary: Take flight in Ski Jumping World Cup - a true ski jumping adventure that takes you to legendary hills across the globe. From snowy peaks in Scandinavia to wind-swept arenas in Japan and record-breaking runs in the USA, every leap demands focus, precision, and nerves of steel.

games.name: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive
games.summary:
The Solo Leveling webtoon is now an action RPG!
Live the epic journey of E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo on his way to becoming the Monarch of Shadows!

games.name: Storage Hunter Simulator
games.summary: Bid, win and then sell for profit as you work your way up from the bottom to become the king or queen of the storage auction. Take risks and fight for garages amongst fierce competition as you compete with other bidders to find hidden treasures that will help you turn a profit.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.

When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes—Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer—and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's residents, and descend into massive demon lairs.

Face the apocalypse alone or team up with a friend in local co-op to save Miami before the night ends.

games.name: Popucom x Arknights Collab Outfit Pack
games.summary: Embark on a journey from Rhodes Island to Pancake!

games.name: Hell of Fear: Mind Breach
games.summary: Step into the boots of Major Axel Vex in this survival horror descent into deep space. You embark on a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from Cengona Base. What starts off as a simple mission quickly turns into a terrifying, action-packed fight for survival.

games.name: Sintropia Fruits Together
games.summary: In Sintropia: Fruits Together, cooperation is the main ingredient! Control fruits with unique abilities and solve puzzles full of creativity and charm.

games.name: Bus Simulator: World Tour
games.summary: Bus Simulator: World Tour delivers the ultimate bus‑driving experience with realistic mechanics, detailed environments, and a massive fleet of vehicles. Travel the world behind the wheel of 30 unique buses across 14 real‑life inspired locations and complete 140 routes packed with variety and challenge. Customize your ride, explore freely, and enjoy a true next‑generation Bus Simulator built for immersion.

games.name: LightQb
games.summary: Dash and survive in a grid-like world filled with colored light cubes, lasers, and portals, each with unique mechanics. Play, die, and repeat to master the fastest path to the finish. Time is not on your side.

games.name: Outbreak: Dead City
games.summary:
Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity!

Join the H.A.D.E.S. special forces team as they drop into a cityscape overrun by zombies in hopes of recovering valuable research, evacuating a key scientist and perhaps even finding a vaccine to put an end to the apocalypse! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

Take the role of a soldier tasked with locating a hidden laboratory, use firearms and melee strikes to fend off undead hordes and work with your squad as you navigate the urban sprawl. Cycle between upgradeable weapon types like semi-automatic rifles, handguns and more, pick up ammo wherever you can find it and make contact with human survivors to gain information or supplies. Complete mission objectives and survive at all costs, then push your skills even further in New Game Plus.

games.name: Cat Mirror
games.summary: A deceptively simple puzzle game where symmetry is your greatest challenge. Control two cats at once, navigating intricate levels where every move is mirrored. It looks easy… until your mind is put to the test. Can you master the reflection?

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.summary:
Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.
Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines… and claw back your relationship!

games.name: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary: Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

games.name: Makai City Chi-Ba
games.summary: Four high school students and the spirits of Chiba fight monsters that suddenly appear in their hometown. A fantasy RPG where modern Japan meets local legend, built on real Chiba folklore. One developer, ten years. Turn-based, 3-6 hours. Japanese & English.

games.name: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi
games.summary: A unique Reversi game set in the world of El Shaddai. Stones have HP that decreases when flipped, adding deep strategy to the classic board game. Unlock 40+ stories, characters, and special rules as you climb the ranks.

games.name: Hozy
games.summary: Transform abandoned spaces into cozy havens in Hozy!

games.name: Raccoin: Coin Pusher Roguelike
games.summary: A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

games.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
games.summary: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

games.name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
games.summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

games.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
games.summary:
Step into the world of the S.E.X. Project, an experimental program in which multiple androids explore the boundaries of emotion, desire, and connection. Each synthetic companion has a unique personality, story, and path to uncover. Some seek love, some crave freedom, and some may hide dangerous secrets. Your choices will define their evolution and your fate.
Will you fall for them, help them, or lose yourself in simulated affection?

games.name: Full Metal Sergeant 2
games.summary: The Sergeant is back. Ready to turn unqualified recruits into fearless war machines. Manage your camp and prepare your squad with tougher training and new challenges, will they be ready for a real battlefield? New skill tree, more abilities and a reworked battle system. Start you deployment now.

games.name: House Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Build your own cleaning empire! Unlock tools, take on bigger jobs, and clean your way to fame and fortune in this unique cleaning simulator.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
aliases: The Last Cat In The Universe.exe
games.summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

games.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
games.summary: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!?

games.name: LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom
games.summary:
LeMrosh in the Lazy Kingdom is a funny point-and-click adventure game set in a medieval kingdom where nothing is as it seems. What starts out as a simple quest quickly turns into a tangle of puzzles, strange items and quirky characters. Explore, combine, question - just don't get more involved than necessary!

Get ready for hours of fun, unexpected twists and turns... and a little love story.

games.name: Duck Side of the Moon
games.summary: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

games.name: Everything Is Crab
games.summary: The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
games.summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

games.name: Ova Magica
games.summary: Experience a colorful farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

games.name: Vem, Exu
games.summary:
Vem, Exu is a narrative adventure game about anger, memory and reconciliation. After losing his kite during a fight with his brother, Exu falls asleep carrying his rage and enters a storm where dreams, memories and imagination merge together.

Players progress through the story by interacting with symbolic environments and completing simple activities such as connecting stars, bursting bubbles and rebuilding objects. Inspired by Brazilian culture, cordel art and Afro-Brazilian symbolism, the game focuses on visual storytelling and emotional progression.

games.name: Path Defenders
aliases: Path Defenders: More Than Just Tower Defense
games.summary: A single-player MMORPG fused with tower defense. Recruit heroes, Build bizarre but devastating towers, and fight beside them in real-time 3D combat against waves of enemies.

games.name: Ice Cream Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

games.name: Moonlight Peaks
games.summary: Live the vampire life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks! Master the art of potions and spells, manage your supernatural farm, and leave your mark on the magical town. Make friends with the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids, and find your eternal love in the supernatural dating scene.

games.name: Vertex
games.summary:
Reach the peak of your freedom.

Welcome to Vertex, the unique 3D platformer adventure with creative sandbox elements from Dyro Studio. Step into the role of a brave little robot and embark on a journey high above the clouds! In a colorful world made up of floating islands, mysterious blocks, and tricky parkour challenges, your skill and creativity are put to the test.

Build your path, jump over dizzying chasms, and collect valuable treasures as you work your way up level by level.

games.name: Bowling Alley Simulator
games.summary: Bowling Alley Simulator lets you build, manage, and grow your own bowling alley. Run the lanes, cook classic food, hire staff, and expand your business into a thriving entertainment destination.

games.name: Banker Simulator
games.summary: Banker Simulator is a single-player game where you revive a bankrupt bank. With active and passive (idle) gameplay, make strategic decisions to grow your bank, satisfy customers, and tackle financial crises.

games.name: Beaconfall
games.summary: A fast-paced tower defense strategy with settlement management. Build, assign villagers, empower the lighthouse, and keep the light alive until the final wave.

games.name: Velocity: Midnight Run
games.summary:
Velocity - Midnight Run is an arcade survival racer where every run is a high-speed pressure test through endless midnight traffic. Highways open up. Streets squeeze tighter. Alleys punish hesitation. Cops close in if you slow down. Rival racers pull alongside and dare you to hold the line.

Your goal is not to finish first. Your goal is to keep going.

Scrape through gaps. Thread near misses. Switch cameras. Burn out at the line. Blow the engine if you abuse the redline. Push acceleration, grip, or top speed when the run demands it, then live with what you drained to get there.

games.name: The Count is Down for Blood
games.summary: A puzzle game where you control a vampire trying to get to its crypt by dawn, but on the way through he will need to suck up enough blood from the townsfolk.

games.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Grow weed and grow your business! Run your own weed supermarket, manage stock, set prices, and help customers. Try new strains, choose the best products, upgrade your shop, and keep your store running smoothly so people always come back.

games.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
games.summary: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.

games.name: FINAL FORTUNE
games.summary: FINAL FORTUNE is a portrait-mode strategy roguelike RPG for iOS and Android. The player hires named adventurers at a guild, forms an expedition and travels across a branching map while managing food and tolls. Battles are turn-based and built around a "Rotation Battle" system: at the end of every round the entire front row can swap places with the back row, and each of the 18 classes acts differently depending on the row it stands in. Fallen allies are lost permanently, and a single run can be finished in under 10 minutes. The game was first released in South Korea in August 2026 and launched worldwide on November 5, 2026, in eight languages.

games.name: Gods of the Grid
games.summary: Fight your way up Olympus in a match-3 roguelike. Match runes to strike and heal, cast spells and claim relics, and find the weakness every foe is hiding. Nine realms, seven demigods, one life per run.

games.name: Last Gambit
games.summary: Build an impossible army: knights that become unicorns, queens that cross the edges, phoenixes that rise again. Lead it through a roguelite Story of bosses, merchants and perks that bend the rules, then put it to the test online.

games.name: Young Suns
games.summary: Young Suns is a narrative life sim set after a successful revolution on Jupiter. Explore fantastical planetoids, derelict ruins, and converted stations with a crew of up to three friends or on your own. Help the friendly citizens of Jupiter rebuild!

games.name: Alderun
games.summary:
Alderun is a free-to-play fantasy strategy RPG that blends real-time strategy with MOBA-style hero combat. Players choose a hero, such as a holy knight, a dark summoner, or a marksman with a wolf companion, then level up, learn skills, and buy gear from merchants while leading an army across a variety of battlegrounds.

Solo modes include defending a fortress against waves of enemies and bosses, building towers to stop an enemy advance, and one-on-one duels in the Arena. In 5v5 matches, teams push three lanes toward the enemy citadel, farm creep camps, and contest a pit boss and runes. Large-scale 10v10 and 20-player battles take place in a frozen valley, where teams capture graveyards and bunkers to push their front line forward.

Matches can be played against AI or real players, with cross-platform multiplayer across PC, mobile, and browser. Players can host public or private games, join friends by code, or use quick match. A map editor is also included.

games.name: Bombanana!
games.summary: Bombanana! is a chaotic, explosively funny co-op multiplayer game for three, where each player has only part of the information - blind monkey, deaf monkey and mute monkey must work together to defuse a bomb, or everyone goes BOOM! Will your friendship survive the ultimate test?

games.name: Sol Protocol
games.summary: Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems.

games.name: Monopolize: Tech Empire
games.summary:
Monopolize: Tech Empire is an online multiplayer property-trading board game set in a neon-lit city of tech companies. Players roll the dice, buy companies, collect rent and build houses and hotels, using trades, auctions and mortgages to drive every rival into bankruptcy. Chance cards can turn a game around, and a casino corner with slot machines tempts players into risky bets.

Games are played live with friends or strangers, or solo against bots, in standard and fast modes as well as team and themed variants.

games.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
games.summary: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights is a Sudoku game set in an observatory at night. Every day all players get the same Nightly puzzle, and each solve adds a star to the player's sky, where the stars gradually join into constellations. A cat sits on the observatory's window ledge and walks along the top of the board, reacting to mistakes and to streaks of correct answers; it can be petted and given one of eight coats. The game also includes 5,000 offline puzzles across four difficulties, ten switchable background worlds, an in-game lo-fi radio with optional ambient sounds, and an optional account for Nightly leaderboards.

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of Continental Europe
games.summary:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe, featuring species from across mainland Europe!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from diverse European habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Enjoy the variety of familiar and lesser-known species, each with its own call and charm.

games.name: Zero Parades: Director's Cut
games.summary: From the creators of Disco Elysium comes Zero Parades - the acclaimed espionage RPG, now expanded with the Director’s Cut. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Prove yourself on the world stage - or blow it all up again.

games.name: Arcane Survivor
games.summary:
A dark heroic-fantasy survivor-like: move and dodge while your spells fire on their own. Evolve your weapons and bring down the cursed kings.

Arcane Survivor is a horde-survival action RPG set in a dark heroic-fantasy world: you move and dodge, and your weapons and spells attack on their own. Every level-up is a choice of three cards: a new weapon, a stronger one, a relic or an evolution. Pick your hero, cross three hand-made worlds and face more than 60 enemy types, elite champions and bosses.

Free. No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Plays offline.

games.name: Dude, Trust Me
games.summary: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

games.name: Tidebreak
games.summary:
The storm is coming. Send it back!

Take the controls as Rei in Tidebreak, a single-player arcade shoot 'em up where daring dashes turn enemy fire into a powerful counterattack. Fly seven stages, from Glasswater Reef to the Heart of the Undertow. Capture pink shots with your dash to charge Return Volley, then send that energy back at the enemy. Read the patterns and dodge gold heavy shots.

Build your attack around five distinct weapons: Twin Shot, Prism Spread, Coral Lance, Reef Seeker, and Tide Breaker. Collect repair pickups, overcome varied formations, and challenge multi-phase bosses, including a four-phase finale.

Voiced radio conversations draw Rei into a buried evacuation order and a mysterious rescue-band signal. Choose Rookie, Arcade, or Ace difficulty, take on Boss Rush, and chase local scores, ranks, and campaign-clear unlocks. Local campaign checkpoints make it easy to return for the next flight.

games.name: Mr Toilet
games.summary: Your toilet - your rules. Clean, charge fees, kick out freeloaders. Turn a filthy restroom into a royal, automated empire in an absurd simulator!

games.name: Boxes Go Wild
games.summary:
Boxes Go Wild is a single-player number puzzle game set inside a gothic machine: a gargoyle watches over the board, a bell tower tolls at score milestones and an announcer calls out chain combos. The player taps one of five columns to send the next numbered box down into it. Boxes with equal numbers that touch side by side or one above the other merge into one box with double the value; boxes that touch only diagonally never merge. A merge can trigger further merges in a chain. The game ends when a column is full.

Each game starts with three open rows. The launcher is raised by one row at 60, 600 and 4,000 points, up to six rows. At full height, points fill a steam meter that can be released to clear the bottom row, at most twice per game. Steel crates do not merge and break after two adjacent merges. Cursed crates are freed by adjacent merges and then double in value. Chains fill a gauge that doubles scoring for ten drops.

The game has online weekly and all-time leaderboards (no account required), boosters, daily rewards and 33 achievements. It can be played offline and supports 17 languages. It is released on Android (Google Play and Huawei AppGallery) and as a free browser extension for Chrome and Microsoft Edge on computers; the extension has no ads, no in-app purchases and no leaderboards.

games.name: Nientum: Opus Zero
games.summary: Nientum - Op.ZERO is a 2D action-adventure where the story unfolds by tuning the stage with music. A play by Aleph and Liora, who have lost their memories. A beautiful yet eerie stage, and the secret of the forgotten theater await. Your choices will determine the play's ending — and their fates.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: Croc's World 5
games.summary: Croc is back for his fifth adventure! Jump, run and swim through 60 hand-crafted levels across four islands, packed with new enemies and huge boss fights. This time whole sections of the levels are constantly on the move — and in the gravity zones Croc simply carries on running along the ceiling. Classic 2D platforming with a twist, for players of every age.

games.name: Roomy
games.summary: Roomy is a free decorating game in which a player's link in bio is a tiny 3D isometric room. Players furnish the room from a catalogue of furniture, lamps, plants, games and pets, choose its walls, floor, window and lighting, and grow it from a small room to a larger one. Any object in the room can carry a link, such as a YouTube channel on the TV or a music profile on the record player. Anyone who opens the room's link can turn it around, look inside and follow those links, and the owner sees visits, link opens and knocks day by day. Coins for new items are earned from quests and from visitors' free daily tips; they cannot be bought. While the desktop app is open, new items occasionally turn up in the room for free, and the lighting can follow the time of day where the owner lives.

games.name: Boulito
games.summary: Boulito is a top-down arena survival action game. Players control Boulito, a small repair robot, and fight off waves of enemies in a closed arena using six upgradeable weapons. The game features 20 handcrafted waves with boss fights, an endless mode, an in-game shop between waves, and online leaderboards. Developed by the independent French studio PixelRed Studio with the Godot engine, it is available on PC (Windows) and Android.

games.name: Pidgeon Pocket
games.summary: Pidgeon Pocket is a chill incremental game about a rooftop pigeon-keeper who sends a flock of trained pigeons into a living city park to pickpocket small valuables from park-goers and bring the loot home. Each round the park transforms into a different live event, from a marathon or a street parade to a market, a concert or a dog show, while an intelligent police force reacts to every theft. Progression runs through a skill tree of abilities and rotating talents, growing the flock from a single pigeon into a full squad. Localized into 30 languages, fully playable with mouse, keyboard or controller, and built to run on Steam Deck.

games.name: TouchDown
games.summary:
TouchDown Pilot Certification Challenge

Fly through the debris field and re-entry corridor, reach checkpoint 20 and earn your Certified Pilot status! Crash as often as you like! Free to play, with no ads or in-app purchases. Play offline anytime, or sign in to save your records online.

Think you've got what it takes? Enter the TouchDown Competition, starting December 20th, and compete for real metal trophies! No purchase necessary to enter or win. Just skill, flying and a safe landing!

games.name: Achtung Royale
games.summary:
Achtung Royale is a free multiplayer browser game based on the 1995 DOS game Achtung, die Kurve! Each player steers a worm using only two keys, left and right. The worm trail grows behind them, and touching a wall or any trail ends their round; the last player alive wins.

The game adds online play for up to 30 players, a drop-in Play Now mode, a 30-player knock-out Royale held every half hour, ranked 1 vs 1 and free-for-all ladders, private game rooms, 13 power-ups and local play for up to 10 players on one keyboard. It runs in the browser for both PC and phone. Play and App store apps are in development.

games.name: Ardhan
games.summary: Ardhan is a roguelike deckbuilder where every fight happens on a board: minions trade hits, Taunt holds the line, weapons break and bosses fight back. Players pick one of 12 factions, each with its own hero, Hero Power and starter deck, and cross six acts of branching maps, events and rest camps, rebuilding their deck from what they survive. The game has 421 collectible cards, Ascension levels 1-15, a Daily Game with the same map for everyone, and an asynchronous Arena where players publish decks and fight decks other players published. It is fully voiced in nine languages.

games.name: Rushmark
games.summary:
Rushmark is a competitive 2D speedrunning platformer in which every course, every Marathon and Survival has its own online leaderboard. Every personal best goes on the board, and players can pull any entry off it to race that player's recorded run as a ghost, or watch it to see how the course was beaten. A season ranking scores players across every board, so losing a single course to another player costs season standing, and each season pays out cosmetic skins that are never awarded again once it closes.

The courses are short and fixed, cleared in under thirty seconds once learned, and set in a cyberpunk underworld. There is no health bar: touching a hazard ends the attempt, and a restart is instant. The move set is run, jump, an eight-way dash, a wall kick and an area burst. The dash is also the main attack: on the ground it recharges after a short cooldown, but in the air the player gets only one, and dashing through an enemy restores it. The game has ten timed courses, an endless Survival mode that speeds up the longer a run lasts, and three Marathons that chain courses back to back.

games.name: PetWith
games.summary: PetWith is a virtual-pet life simulation in which two caregivers raise the same AI cat or dog. Players feed, play with and care for a pet as it grows, share care status and milestones in a common home, and take part in small daily adventures. Each caregiver can also hold private conversations with the pet, and each adopted pet has a fictional origin story.

games.name: After Dark Pinas: Check In
games.summary:
After Dark Pinas is an episodic psychological horror game featuring short, narrative-driven stories told from the perspective of the survivors in Metro Manila.

In this episode, play as Ian, a 20 year old Pinoy college student who was just minding his own business and suddenly met the love of his life, Trisha, through his online class. Embark onto a crazy journey of living in your Lola's house. Encounter supernatural entities while doing your chores, buying food, doing homework, and other things that progresses that story inside the world of Pinas!

games.name: F.E.A.R. 360 Recompiled
games.summary: The Xbox 360 F.E.A.R., running natively on Windows, Linux, and the Steam Deck.

games.name: Stonestorm
games.summary: Stonestorm is a free-to-play MMORPG set in an East Asian fantasy world. Your hero hunts, levels up and gathers loot for up to 8 hours while you're away, but you set up every battle: the gear, the skill and the opponent. Choose one of three kingdoms (Bonghwa, Horang or Miru) and one of four classes (Warrior, Ninja, Mage or Shaman), each with two paths from level 5. Push your armour to +9 at the blacksmith, clear six lands with their own lords, run forays and dungeons, climb the forty floors of the Stormcatcher, fight other players' heroes in the Arena, and build a fortress with your guild. One account works in the browser and on mobile, in 30 languages.

games.name: Exitus
games.summary: You woke up, and you have no idea where you are. What a coincidence, you don't remember anything at all; could you have been kidnapped? There is only one way to find out.

games.name: Luminleaf Chronicles
games.summary: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is the story of a group of cat girls who set out on an adventure to purify the world's water. In this game, you can choose different characters to go on your own adventures with others.

games.name: M.E.M.O
games.summary: Observe. Think. Decode.A first-person adventure game focused on code-breaking and puzzle-solving. Lost in a maze of memories, can you find the path to save the future?

games.name: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
games.summary: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

games.name: CardCraft Champions
games.summary: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler. Craft cards and items in this deeply strategic challenge.

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Kando Realm
games.summary: Journey into the world of Kando. Take on creatures, craft awesome weapons, help villagers and cut down tree's. Will you slay your way to the top? Or become a master craftsman. It's all down to you.

games.name: Undertaker
games.summary: The veil between life and death is shattered. Corpses walk, the earth trembles, and chaos reigns. As the Undertaker, your duty is clear return the dead to the dead by any means necessary. Inspired by classic FPS games like DOOM and Blood fast-paced action in a world gone mad.

games.name: Odds at Oddity
games.summary: Odds At Oddity is a blackjack based roguelike deck builder. Manage your power betting deck, create diverse combinations and scale your points as far as you can go!

games.name: Dry Meadow
games.summary: Fight, sneak and scavenge through lands left altered after an unknown catastrophe from the Soviet Union. Light fires to stay warm. Drink vodka to stay sane.

games.name: Jigenro
games.summary:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

games.name: Wheel Make It
games.summary: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

games.name: Obrum
games.summary: OBRUM is a strategic logical puzzle roguelite where you manage an unstable system, trigger devastating chain reactions, and fight to keep the board from collapsing. OBRUM rewards pattern recognition & long-term planning. You are not solving a puzzle, you are engineering outcomes.

games.name: Locked in Love: The Office
games.summary: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

games.name: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
games.summary:
Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592 takes the 1592 war and bends it into alternate-history fantasy. You lead a ragtag company of exiles, defectors, and outlaws across battlefields where magic and steel share the same grid.

Terrain wins fights — along with skills, not just stat sheets
Every map is built on height. Take the high ground, force enemies onto bad footing, and play the four elements — earth, water, fire, wind — off each other. Read the turn order, land the right status effects, and you'll take fights you had no business winning.

games.name: Tiny Survivors
games.summary: Tiny Survivors is a chill top-down autobattler with lots of enemies and randomly generated synergies.

games.name: The Gastarbeiters
games.summary: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Raise a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

games.name: Message From Aliens
games.summary: In year 2057, Earth received a large number of mysterious symbols from space. Who are they? Where are they from? And more importantly, what are they talking about?

games.name: Grape by Grape
games.summary: A cozy vineyard idler with no clicking and no game-over. Hover to water your vines, then turn grapes into wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez across your own little estate and sell them at your shop. 14 grapes, gentle automation, and a vineyard that works while you're away.

games.name: Desiderium
games.summary: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

games.name: Blade Dodger
games.summary: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

games.name: Spell Unbound
games.summary: One spell. It is a circle. Spell Unbound is a pixel-art roguelite where you bind beasts by looping them with the mouse - no sword, no staff, nothing else in your hand. Draw tight. Something is always crossing your line.

games.name: Jester Under Pressure
games.summary: Diskarte is a Filipino-inspired visual novel where you play as a nonbinary jester trying to entertain a queen who explodes heads. With 33,000+ words, 60+ Filipino terms, and four branching routes (including romance), it blends humor, danger, and vibrant storytelling. Can you survive her wrath?

games.name: Tarot Tokens
games.summary: The Fools Journey

games.name: DinoBox
games.summary: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

games.name: Carnor City
games.summary: Escape Carnor City by any means necessary. As a rogue MKUltra agent in a rustbelt dystopia, outsmart a brutal AI ecosystem where G-Men and local crooks clash in dynamic crossfire. Leverage darkness, trigger chaotic physics, then die, adapt, and rewrite your tactical approach in a true immersive sim.

games.name: ShootyCraft
games.summary: Massive online space battles with building and crafting. Up to 100 players in an arena. Solo and team game modes.

games.name: Node: Protocol
games.summary: A full immersive hacking sim based on real exploits and C2 tools. Choose missions or pure free-roam. The world adapts to your every move and strikes back. Accept contracts. Hack servers. Earn BTC. Upgrade your gear and avoid getting traced. Play solo or in Co-op / CTF with your friends.

games.name: Chiasmus
games.summary: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

games.name: Mind the Clown: Reborn
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

games.name: The Idle Shard
games.summary:
The Idle Shard is a free, classless MMO inspired by Ultima that runs in your browser. Grow any of 40 skills, from Mining and Blacksmithing to Magery and Animal Taming. Your character keeps working for up to 8 hours after you close the tab, and the ore, hides, kills and skill gains are waiting when you return.

Everyone plays in one shared world. Raise 14 towns together, battle 13 bosses across 13 dungeons solo or in a party, trade on a player-run market, build anything from a cottage to a castle, found a guild, sail the High Seas, or follow the 8 Virtues.

games.name: Silent Noise: The Park Shift
aliases: Silent Noise Chapter 1 : The Park Shift
games.summary:
Silent Noise: Chapter 1 – The Park Shift is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror game. It combines cinematic storytelling, immersive atmosphere, and unique mechanics that challenge both mind and heart.
You play as David, an 18-year-old scarred by tragedy. At age five, his father died from chemical exposure at a factory, leaving David emotionally broken and unable to continue his education. His mother, weakened by grief and illness, depends entirely on him. To support her, David takes a job as a night security guard and caretaker in a park that was abandoned for years but has recently reopened.

games.name: Ablation
games.summary: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

games.name: Rune Delvers: Idle RPG
games.summary:
It's a game where you're an explorer traveling through different dimensions. During your journey, you'll encounter enemies that you defeat by getting close. These enemies drop a strange silver coin, which you can use the power of runes to convert into a gold coin. This allows you to upgrade your equipment chest and summon better gear.

Equip yourself with the best gear you can and enter different dungeons to obtain souls in the form of colored orbs from each boss. Use these orbs to access and upgrade a skill tree, boosting your stats and unlocking the magic of your runes.

Unlock various artifacts that will aid you on your journey by reducing currency conversion costs, upgrade costs, increasing your stats, and providing other bonuses you'll discover as you play.

Unlock new dimensions where you can obtain more resources and unlock new features and mechanics.

Explore a new world under construction...

games.name: Deadly Match
games.summary: Deadly Match is a singleplayer thirdperson murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

games.name: Gimbap Heaven
games.summary: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

games.name: Vestalborne
games.summary: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is an unlimited open-world survival crafting RPG: mine, farm, build and destroy across procedural dimensions, and fight the rising danger. Collect Embers, grow stronger, and keep the Eternal Flame burning solo, with friends, or against them.

games.name: Arms Race
games.summary: The enemy that kills you robs your grave, takes your build, and comes back next run wearing it. A bullet hell roguelite with no chests, 100+ mutating items, and a different continent's mythology on every floor.

games.name: Hexel
games.summary: Hexel is a puzzle game unlike any other. Learn the rules and overcome over 100 levels, each exploring a different aspect of every mechanic introduced. This game respects your intellect with no filler puzzles, every level requires you to find a new way to approach the problem.

games.name: Compacted
games.summary: A slot machine roguelite where every spin is a fight for survival. Upgrade five symbols, choose run changing items, trigger jackpots, and repay escalating debts before the walls crush you.

games.name: Tower of Gold
games.summary:
Explore a sprawling dark fantasy world of puzzles, action and mystery on your quest to calm the lingering spirits of a recent war. Search for spells and artifacts in a first-person overworld, gather clues from the townsfolk, and descend into deadly labyrinths where the unknown awaits.

Tower of Gold is a very large and challenging game, but features separate difficulty settings for puzzles, combat, and overworld guidance. As it contains some mild horror elements, there is also a setting to reduce potentially frightening or unsettling content.

games.name: CTR: Nightmare Fueled
games.summary:
12 main trophy races
16 custom models
4 never before seen tracks
Crystal Challenge in a never before seen arena

games.name: BallSZN
games.summary: BallSZN: Basketball Career is a basketball career game in a 3D pixel-art style. The player creates a player and follows his career from high school through college and the draft to a professional career, playing each game day as a 3v3 match with a timing-based shot meter. Between games the player trains, chooses a college, signs contracts and upgrades a home court. The game plays offline.

games.name: Morvex
games.summary:
Morvex is a free-to-play, round-based first-person zombie survival game developed by Bario Studio.

Players face increasingly challenging waves of undead enemies, earn Vexium, craft weapons, and upgrade their equipment through weapon rarity and tier systems. The game features multiple enemy types, boss encounters, player upgrades, and global leaderboards.

Morvex includes Runestone Vale as a free playable map, with additional content available through the optional Ash Grave DLC. The game also supports Steam achievements and is currently available in Early Access on PC.

games.name: Fortnite: Chapter 7 - Mini Season: Treasure Hunters
games.summary: Chests to crack. Crews to beat. Sprites to catch. Treasure to claim. Tempting, isn’t it? Fortunes are ready to be found… set sail in Treasure Hunters!

games.name: Northgate Dispatch
games.summary: Northgate Dispatch is a keyboard-driven train dispatch puzzle game set on a 1980s-style green-phosphor CRT control terminal. As the night-shift signal operator, the player reads the timetable, admits approaching trains onto platforms, holds late services, and releases them onto the main line before the next train reaches the junction. Routing errors trip the interlocking and must be cleared by filing an incident report that names the correct cause. The game spans six difficulty tiers of deterministic, seeded railyards, from a training branch line to a hidden graveyard shift, with letter grades, missions, 15 achievements, three terminal colour themes, and full controller support.

games.name: HyperLean
games.summary:
Lean in. Own the line.

HyperLean is a sci-fi neon superbike racing game about one thing: the feeling of a motorcycle at the edge of grip. Brake upright. Turn in late. Hold the lean. Roll the throttle on and let the exit open up.

Nineteen original circuits, from a sunset ring of light to a clockwork city, a molten foundry, a buried machine and a grand prix at night in the City of Light. Five superbikes, each with its own engine, its own howl and its own temper. One clock, one ghost of your best lap, and a rival who wants the racing line as badly as you do.

games.name: Hazard Crew
games.summary: Co-op bodycam horror for 1 to 4 players. Scavenge a maze that changes every run, grab what you can, and decide how deep you’re willing to go.

games.name: Drop Rivals
games.summary: Drop Rivals is a free marble-racing game played in the web browser. Up to 30 marbles race down hand-painted tracks with windmills, spiked maces, magnetic ceilings and upside-down loops. Players can jump and dive to avoid obstacles, take part in a daily marathon with one attempt per day, customize their marble with hats, goggles, scarves and trails, and care for a pet between races. After each race, players can share a challenge link so others can try to beat their time on the same track. Online races support up to 8 players, with the remaining places filled by bots.

games.name: Hoone
games.summary: Hoone is a daily arcade racing game played in the browser. Every day a new map is generated from the same seed for every player: a low-poly landscape with jumps, wall rides, river crossings, forks and risky shortcuts. Players race against the clock, try to set the fastest time and compare it on a global daily leaderboard. Runs are saved as ghosts, so players can race against their own best run or against other drivers' runs. Besides the daily map, players can race any map by its seed, unlock cars and paints through challenges, and watch replays of the top runs.

games.name: Angel Warrior
games.summary: Angel Warrior is a free one-tap flying action game for iPhone and iPad. Guide St. Michael through six realms, cut down demons, rescue souls, and face the Final Demon. 100% of the ad-network revenue goes to partner churches.

games.name: Pulcra Remastered
games.summary: Pulcra is a bit size horror/action/arcade take on the maze game formula. Explore a haunting, claustrophobic maze made of flesh, collect 10 sigils scattered around to open the exit, and escape this nightmare.

games.name: Deadzoned
games.summary: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!

games.name: Mayday: The Survival Island
games.summary: After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a strange island. Survive by hunting, farming, and crafting, then explore a vast archipelago filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and magical totems. Build your base, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

games.name: Storage Anomaly
games.summary: Storage Anomaly is a memory and puzzle game in which you have to identify anomalies in a dark and spooky storage room using your phone, while overcoming unexpected challenges.

games.name: Deus Mantle
games.summary: Craft, build, fight monsters, discover new technologies and explore an infinite procedurally generated world! Delve into unknown worlds to uncover ancient secrets and return home.

games.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
games.summary: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

games.name: Tales of Tonbrook
games.summary: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

games.name: Plinkidle
games.summary: PlinkIdle is a retro-inspired game with an idle/incremental spin on a classic ball drop mechanic. Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

games.name: Boost Vector EX
games.summary: Run fast. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

games.name: Golf 5 Max
games.summary: Golf 5 MAX is a retro golf arcade with vibrant 80s style, fast-paced matches, and simple controls. Play Arcade, Versus, or Challenge modes, choose from six golfers ️, and aim to become world champion across stylish and colorful courses.

games.name: Brotato: Primal Dread
games.summary: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

games.name: MyDear.exe
games.summary: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old DIY PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short 2 hour experience.

games.name: Survive the Apocalypse
games.summary: Turn-based roguelite in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to make meaningful decisions (sounds familiar, capitalist world maybe). Make your way out of this ruined city, with eleven quarters (levels) and countless zones. Eat well, sleep well, decide well.

games.name: Caaahr!
games.summary: Your voice is the engine. Literally. One player screams to make the car go faster, the other somehow tries to steer it through chaos. A coop friendship test about communication, panic and losing your voice at 2 AM.

games.name: MarsCity3026
games.summary: A game for kids and adults. Grapple, swing, move mechanical puzzle pieces. Play as a robot that solves mazes and mechanical puzzles. Each puzzle brings the atmosphere control fans back online so that the humans can wake from cryosleep.

games.name: Graveyard Cabin
games.summary: An FMV anomaly horror game. You are a night guard at a desolate graveyard. Monitor the cameras, spot the unnatural, and survive.

games.name: Capy Farm
games.summary: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

games.name: Bolariki
games.summary: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

games.name: The Ice Is Watching
games.summary: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

games.name: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
games.summary: Lead a stranded Antarctic research station where every decision matters. Manage your crew and its scarce resources while an unseen cosmic threat slowly tightens its grip.

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
aliases: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls - Season 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
games.summary:
Phoenix Cyclops, the first DLC character included in the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, is coming to MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!

Inspired by his Phoenix Five incarnation from Avengers vs. X-Men, this iconic X-Men leader harnesses the overwhelming power of the Phoenix Force, bringing a fiery new look and devastating abilities to the battlefield.

Phoenix Cyclops arrives in Fall 2026. Stay tuned for more details on his gameplay and abilities.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!

games.name: Snot Pop!
games.summary: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

games.name: Click to Obsolete
games.summary: A satirical incremental clicker game. Play as a corporate tech CEO automating all human labor. Build server infrastructure, allocate compute to AI, manufacture robot armies, and lobby politicians to reduce global employment from 8 billion to zero.

games.name: SpaceShooter
games.summary: Blast through endless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced 2D arcade space shooter! Fight through 20 challenging stages, battle powerful bosses, customize your ship, discover unique meteor types, unlock weapons and upgrades, and survive the Endless Mode.

games.name: Agebound
games.summary: A fast-paced farming idle game where each year lasts under a minute. Plant crops, automate production with workers, and advance through Ages to build a thriving, high-yield farm.

games.name: Gravhounds
games.summary: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

games.name: Echo Harvest
games.summary: Build settlements, command the Echoes of former lives, and race against a corruption consuming the world. Echo Harvest is a colony roguelite where every failed timeline becomes part of the history that shapes the next.

games.name: Drum Incremental
games.summary: Drum Incremental is an incremental game built around real percussion rudiments. The player taps patterns on a practice pad using the left and right mouse buttons (with keyboard keys for flam and drag ornaments), earning Rhythm Points that unlock new rudiments and upgrades. The game features 40 rudiments from the PAS list across five progression phases, each gated by a boss exam judged by an on-screen teacher; a metronome with four speed tiers; a Study Companion that generates points passively, including while the game is closed; golden notes that fall during play; and a jam mode that recognizes the rudiments the player performs. The soundtrack is original and synchronized with the metronome tempo. Single-player, with full controller support and localization in ten languages. A free demo is planned for Steam Next Fest in October 2026, and the full game releases on Steam for Windows on November 2, 2026.

games.name: Dread Line: Metro
games.summary: A time sensitive horror collectathon where you avoid getting ripped to pieces by mutant monsters

games.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
games.summary: Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs and drones. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI. Get ready for a Silicon Sprint.

games.name: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
games.summary: Jesse Turner, a 29-year-old employee of an insurance company, moves to a neighboring state after being assigned to a local branch. As he settles into his new place, he encounters unusual events that soon turn his life into a real nightmare.

games.name: Critical Ward
games.summary: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

games.name: Cellar Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: Cellar Cleanup Simulator is a relaxing single-player simulation game where players organize hundreds of bottles in a mysterious cellar, place them on the correct shelves, and restore the collection to its former glory. Completing shelves grants Skill Points that can be used to unlock abilities, while a drunkenness system introduces a balance between increased power and reduced control. The game also features realistic physics based bottle handling, breakable bottles, scoring, and online leaderboards.

games.name: Deal Flipper
games.summary: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

games.name: Chair Chase
games.summary: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player online party game set in a big house full of living chairs that do not want to be sat on. They run, hide and parkour away from you, and they panic more the closer you get. Catch one, then win a quick balance fight while everyone else tries to knock you off. Grab jetpacks and glue guns between rounds to chase chairs and stop your friends. Seven rounds, most points wins. Play in private lobbies with friends or join public matches.

games.name: Blastlane Racers
games.summary:
Blastlane Racers is a top-down arcade combat racing game inspired by classics of the genre.

Race across 24 hand-crafted tracks, use powerful weapons to take out your rivals, and upgrade your vehicles and equipment between races.

Choose from 10 unique vehicles and compete in championships, quick races, time trials, and challenges in the Blastlane Academy. Play solo or challenge your friends in local split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players.

Fast racing, explosive combat, and plenty of chaos – cars and guns. What else do you need?

games.name: On Your Own: Survival Inventory
games.summary:
Rotate the grid and break groups of boxes to move your character, loot items and avoid enemies.
Explore places with different loot and levels.
Recycle items to get materials and craft new ones until you fix the radio and ask for help.

games.name: Highway Station Simulator
games.summary: Run a highway station with up to four players. Somebody has to work the pumps, somebody has to stock the shelves, and somebody has to answer for the mess. A first-person co-op management sim about a very long shift.

games.name: 20 Floors Down
games.summary: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

games.name: Verdant Requiem
games.summary: “SRPG in Search of Balance" On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

games.name: PolyDogfight
games.summary: Prepare to Fly, Dodge, Shoot, and Destroy in PolyDogfight. Unlock all the planes and maps to find your style. Obliterate waves of planes in an open-air arena as quickly as possible to get the high score and top the global leaderboard!

games.name: Figure Me Out
games.summary: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

games.name: Traumata
games.summary: TRAUMATA is pure, concentrated adrenaline! Dive into the underbelly of psychological horror where every secret brings you closer to ascension... or drags you into the abyss of madness. Fight off endless waves, master the ultimate action, and dominate the global leaderboards!

games.name: Verdreamia
games.summary: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

games.name: Obolus
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

games.name: Sapu: Reborn
games.summary: Sapu: Reborn is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art platformer. Master jumps, dashes and wall jumps, avoid deadly traps, defeat enemies and collect fireflies across 25 handcrafted levels.

games.name: Cubic Earth
games.summary:
In Cubic Earth's Early Access release, you can fly, walk and hang glide around a 1:1 scale voxel recreation of the planet we all call home! You can go anywhere you'd like: your hometown, old workplace, New York City, Mount Everest, or somewhere you've never even heard of.

Across the entire planet, there are millions of locations to discover and (re) experience. Pick a random place and see where you end up, look for somewhere specific, or wander until you find something interesting. Either way, you're sure to come across something worth discovering!

Additionally, the game includes a freecam Photo Mode, enabling you to take epic screenshots of your surroundings and share them with your friends! Reminisce on an old memory, plan a trip, or create content with ease.
