Cubic Earth makes use of voxel technology to ensure a street level which remains coherent across the planet. Roads, trails, forests and more remain legible and navigable, unlike many planet-scale games. From places as iconic as Times Square to your local neighborhood, street level is accessible!

Familiar places can bring back memories you've long since forgotten, and new places can make for an amazing adventure. One of the most fun parts about Cubic Earth is not knowing what you'll find around the corner!

games.name: Just One Bite
games.summary: A 1~4 player co-op horror game. Your mission is to gather as much food as possible for the humans. But not all food is normal. Can you complete this mission to the very end?

games.name: DashBreaker
games.summary: Break More. Grow Stronger. Dash through asteroids and enemy ships, harvest Gold and permanently upgrade your craft. Enjoy fast progression and satisfying dash combat in an active incremental game, turning single-target attacks into sweeping destruction.

games.name: The Arcane Archive
games.summary: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

games.name: Nightcup
games.summary: Pull up a chair: in Nightcup everything is played at one table. Four classics on the shelf, plus various modes and house rules you can switch on. Fill the empty seats with bots or invite your Steam friends straight into your lobby. No long loading screens in between.

games.name: Tie Down
games.summary: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

games.name: Make the World Great Again
games.summary: Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury. Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

games.name: Sort A Lot
games.summary: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

games.name: Age Breaker
games.summary: Mine gold, train an army and evolve your fortress from bone clubs to plasma blades in this one-lane strategy game. Lead four peoples and eight Leaders through a 36-battle campaign with boss fights, or set up your own skirmish on six maps.

games.name: The Omega Strain
games.summary: The Omega Strain is a retro-inspired 3D arcade shooter featuring physics-based spacecraft flight, intense combat, and eight explorable polygon worlds. Inspired by classics such as Zarch and Virus, the game is powered by RetroMesh, a custom-built 3D engine, with an electronic soundtrack by Swedish artist 047.

games.name: Habet
games.summary: Habet is a management game about running a gladiator school in Pompeii in 73 BC, with real-time arena fights. The player, a freed gladiator turned lanista, buys, trains and sells fighters, sets their terms and sends them into the amphitheatre, where bouts play out in a stylized voxel style with wounds, lost limbs and deaths. Fights range from duels to mass battles with dozens of men a side, watched by a reactive crowd.

games.name: Incremental Traffic
games.summary: Incremental Traffic is an incremental logistics game in which the player hauls goods from fields, forests and quarries through a procedurally generated valley town. Every delivery earns money to buy more trucks, until the player's own fleet jams the streets. The road network is fixed: instead of building roads, the player manages traffic with paintable rules such as yield and stop signs, traffic lights, extra lanes and roundabouts. Short production chains turn simple shapes into more complex goods across five tiers, and the town grows district by district as more goods are delivered.

games.name: Iron Sol
games.summary: Explore a ruined world, overcome unique platforming challenges, collect remnants of your kin, and discover what you are.

games.name: Studs Up!
games.summary: First-person football where you control your feet, with no scripted animations deciding where the ball goes. Play 1v1 to 5v5 online as a striker, keeper or referee. Have no friends? Draft a squad in the 'Cup Run' roguelite mode. Level up your players, pick upgrades and fight through a knockout cup.

games.name: Lustration: A Detective Story
games.summary:
A noir mystery game blending detective work and resource management, where every lead costs you something.

A routine murder lands on Detective Elizabeth Pine's desk. Pull on the threads, and watch it unravel into a conspiracy surrounding death itself, one that reaches into the Between, where the dead wait to cross over.

Her work. Her relationships. Her grip on what's real. Pine can't hold onto it all. What will she be willing to sacrifice?

games.name: Sabado
games.summary: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

games.name: In the Pumpkin Light
games.summary:
This is a short pixel art game about the wanderings of a living pumpkin named Pumpkin Light. On his journey, he will encounter a variety of otherworldly creatures, gain new powers, save several lives, and find his place in this world.
The game is entirely hand-animated.

games.name: OpenNG2
games.summary: A native Windows version of Ninja Gaiden II (Xbox 360, 2008).

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Phoenix Cyclops Classic Costume Pack
games.summary: Customize your favorite fighter and step back into the ring in style with this extraordinary costume pack.

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls – Hulk Joe Fixit Costume Pack
games.summary: Customize your favorite fighter and step back into the ring in style with this extraordinary costume pack.

games.name: Dark Pray
games.summary: Dark Pray is an RPG that features an ATB (Active Time Battle) combat system with a variety of skill combinations. You can adjust the difficulty to your preference at any time during the game. The game includes multiple NPCs. You can also choose to kill everyone and venture through the world completely alone.

games.name: Frankie Freako
games.summary: Smash robots and upgrade your Freako in this freaky Roguelike Action-Platformer

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - PlayStation Plus Pack 2
games.summary: Personalize your profile with the Old School Color variant for every hero in the 20-character base roster and Phoenix Cyclops! Don this nostalgic color variant for your favorite fighters and their chibi versions to save the world in style.

games.name: HyperMoto
games.summary:
Back it in. Pin it out.
HyperMoto is a sci-fi supermotard racing game built around one idea: the fastest line is the one you earn. Brake upright, flick the bike in, slide the rear and fire out of the corner, then do it again over dirt, wet tarmac, glass and steel grid.

Nineteen circuits take you from a skyline supermoto ring to a martian ridge, a frozen halo, a jungle nebula, a neon corkscrew tower and a grand finale in a dusk coliseum. Every circuit has its own music, and every lap is timed against your own ghost.

games.name: Stages of Science
games.summary: A mappack containing 19 chambers across 10 maps and featuring several visual settings, but mainly Art Therapy and Clean.

games.name: Scrolls: Tidy Up the Library of Olympus!
games.summary: Restore order to a divine library by sorting 3,048 scattered scrolls, reuniting ancient collections, and unlocking powers worthy of Olympus. Read the markings, gather the volumes, and give the wisdom of the gods its rightful place in solo or with up to 8 players!

games.name: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road
games.summary: Bad Fruits have taken over the Roads! Fight off waves of Fruits in this comedic chaotic side-scrolling shooter! Deliver Cargo, Upgrade your Ride, Hire Defenders, and choose the right Gear to protect your Caravan and survive the Road ahead!

games.name: Marketfield Idle
games.summary:
Marketfield is a cozy incremental farming game about turning tiny harvests into huge numbers.

Grow crops, sell goods, cook recipes, automate production, and prestige into stronger runs.

1200+ upgrades. Multiple strategy paths. Lots of synergies to discover.

games.name: Mystery Suspect
games.summary:
A character-deduction puzzle game where you identify a hidden suspect by asking yes-or-no questions about appearance, clothing, and accessories. Study a lineup of 18 faces and use each clue carefully to narrow down the possibilities.

Cases feature a rotating cast of 50 illustrated characters with animated portraits, voice acting, and banter. In campaign mode, build a streak through increasingly challenging cases, earn rewards, and use bonus powers while managing three lives.

games.name: Haboku
games.summary: Haboku is a Kakuro (cross sums) puzzle game. The player fills white cells with the digits 1 to 9 so that every run adds up to its clue, with no digit repeated in a run. Every puzzle is generated on the device, proved to have exactly one solution, and graded from Learning to Insane by the reasoning it needs. It has a puzzle of the day, curated packs, an optional tutorial that teaches the techniques one at a time, free play at a chosen size and grade, puzzles shared as short codes, and an ink-wash scene that changes with the season. It plays offline.

games.name: Projet Élysée
games.summary:
Projet Élysée is a satirical management game about running a French presidential campaign, from April 2026 to the second round of the 2027 election, one week at a time. The player picks one of fourteen parody candidates, or creates their own after a political-compass interview, then balances polls, party activists, media exposure, credibility and a campaign budget bound by the real legal spending cap, while gathering the 500 sponsorships from elected officials required to stand.

Each week brings decisions such as rallies, social media ads, poster campaigns and a tour of town halls, along with more than 450 events (scandals, gaffes, dirty tricks and matters of conscience) where every answer moves the polls and the game keeps count of abandoned convictions. Key moments are played as short mini-games, including televised debates, card-based rallies, the party primary, the agricultural fair and the platform convention. Advisers with their own perks and flaws can be recruited, a few of them rare legendary characters. The game is available in French only.

games.name: We Have a Gnome Problem
games.summary: A cozy, first-person tidying game in which you catch runaway gnomes in a toy shop, toss the troublemakers, and return every gnome to its proper shelf. The gnomes have escaped and are hiding all over the shop. Sneak up on them, carry them to their matching shelves, or throw them when walking is too slow. Collect themed gnomes such as knights, chefs and octopuses, fill your collection album, hunt down rare Legendary gnomes, and ring the gnome bell to find the last stragglers.

games.name: Fishcremental
games.summary: Fishcremental is a ridiculously cozy underwater adventure where you catch super cute fish, discover game-changing upgrades, and fill the whole sea with satisfying firework glory.

games.name: Compartment 666: Anomaly Express
games.summary: Spot the anomaly or die. Compartment 666 is a first-person horror exploration game where you inspect train compartments, find what changed, and avoid mistakes. Three lives, multiple death sequences, and one conductor waiting at the end.

games.name: Siege & Settle
games.summary:
Siege & Settle is a free-to-play real-time strategy MMO played in the web browser.
Players start with one village, develop its resource fields and buildings, train troops and found or conquer new villages.

Three tribes are available (Romans, Germanic Tribes and Dacians), each with ten units. Barbarian villages raid every player and guard artifacts.
Each world ends: alliances compete to hold eleven control points (ruins, towers and shrines) until one side reaches the world's target score. Classic worlds are for human players only; in Bot worlds players can also connect their own programs or AI agents through a REST API or an MCP server, under the same rules. Each world has a public chronicle and the rules are documented in a public wiki.

games.name: Legend of Gods
games.summary:
Legend of Gods is a fantasy strategy game played in the browser, set in a persistent world shared with other players. Each player builds up a town that keeps producing resources and working through its queues while the player is offline, and raises a hero whose leadership sets the size of the army it can lead.

Battles are turn-based and take place on a grid, with units acting one at a time in order of initiative, so where units stand and when they move affects the outcome. Armies fight monsters on the exploration map and other players in the arena and on the world map. Players can also join alliances to coordinate attacks and defense.

games.name: Lightyear Frontier
games.summary: Lightyear Frontier is an open-world farming exploration game with crafting, resource management and base building. Play 1-4 players in online co-op, discover and grow alien plants, domesticate wildlife, endure the elements and build your new home away from home.

games.name: Demon Source
games.summary: Demon Source is a soulslike roguelike game with procedural generated dungeons. Try new builds each run. Gather the Source to unlock new items and abilities. Solve the mystery of seven inhabitants of the Church. Try the Ultimate Challenge with great classical music. It is made by one person!

games.name: The House Before
games.summary: You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

games.name: Heart Abyss
games.summary: In a world where there is an eternal war between the unions of the human race and beastmen, accidental deaths and slave trade are not rare. But what happens if two slaves by chance unite and survive together, being wanted? Leon and Ray are one of those.

games.name: Loftia
games.summary: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaira
games.summary: Action RPG with survival elements. Manage resources and bond with NPCs to unlock crafting and gain allies who may become playable. Use them to solve puzzles and battle together. Survive the frozen wilds and uncover the truth behind your exile.

games.name: Backdraft
games.summary: The deckbuilding brawler. Backdraft is a hero vs hero roguelike battle for board control. Draft your deck, summon your minions, and unleash game-flipping combos. Conquer the six realms solo, or challenge your friends online.

games.name: Swappy World
games.summary: Simply two mechanics: swipe to move and tap to interact in an open-world survival crafting experience made through cards. Handle your energy tactically to survive as long as possible. Craft weapons, build your base and be prepared to explore a world full of secrets.

games.name: Warehouse Bots
games.summary: Take on the role of a warehouse manager overseeing a bustling hub of automated activity. In this immersive simulator, you'll delve into the intricacies of logistics as you control robots, construct efficient road networks, and fine-tune traffic flow to optimize your warehouse operations.

games.name: Angel Guardian
games.summary: Angel Guardian is a sci-fi side-scrolling action shooter set in a space station under attack. Play as Kita, a warrior guardian on a mission to rescue the young prince while fighting hostile enemies. Use shooting, stealth and hacking to face powerful bosses and prove yourself as a true guardian.

games.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
games.summary: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.

games.name: Pit of Goblin
games.summary: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed him, and you might be the next meal!

games.name: Project Afterfall
games.summary: A dark, strategy-survival RPG blending retro-futuristic urban fantasy with Slavic folklore. Set in the wolrd of Thea, but thrust 1000 years into an urban future. Rebuild your colony, explore the post-apocalyptic wasteland, and engage in tactical card-based combat. Immerse yourself in a story-rich adventure with branching narratives.

games.name: Ramen Shop Simulator
games.summary: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique restaurant. The aroma of success is just a bowl away!

games.name: Havker-Man X
games.summary: Havker-Man X is an open world, post-apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

games.name: Kick
games.summary: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

games.name: Diecast
games.summary: Welcome to the dice roguelite. Stuff your bag with wild dice and pins, chain ridiculous scoring combos, and build a point engine to conquer ever-escalating targets. This ain't your Grandma's dice game!

games.name: Radiant Starlets
games.summary: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

games.name: Astra Bestiary
games.summary: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

games.name: Death at Fleming Manor
games.summary: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a grand British manor, 1959. Explore eerie scenes and complete forensic documents like death certificates and medical reports. Stylish 1960s detective comic art. Perfect for fans of vintage whodunits.

games.name: Iron Colony
games.summary: After crash-landing on a mysterious island, confront hostile robotic creatures in intense combat and strategic duels. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover secrets, and fight for survival in a world where corrupted technology dominates every corner.

games.name: Corpus et Spiritus
games.summary: Corpus et Spiritus is a roguelite deckbuilder about alchemy. You signed a pact with a Homunculus, and it was a bad idea: it will guide you on the path of alchemy, but as the cost of your life force. Use your workshop to craft new cards, transmute metals and discover magical talismans. Become smarter than your dangerous partner before it kills you!

games.name: Construction Store Simulator
games.summary: Start with a small construction store and turn it into the place every contractor relies on. In Construction Store Simulator, you will stock goods, set prices, move shelving with full physics, and keep checkout lines under control—while simultaneously expanding the store, hiring staff, and improving the look and reputation.

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Godzilla Pack
games.summary: The King of Monsters comes to Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Escape from Godzilla's rampage with 3 new machines and a new course.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

games.name: Beat for Speed
games.summary:
Experience the next generation of rhythm-racing. Upload any music to generate deadly tracks using our self-developed engine trained on thousands of hand-crafted levels. Featuring intense multiplayer racing, a powerful level editor, and full Steam Workshop support for endless custom content.

Move beyond simple randomization. We built our own algorithm, the level generation is powered by a custom algorithm we trained strictly on deep learning from hundreds of our own professional, hand-crafted levels. It accurately identifies the rhythmic logic of various genres—including Pop, Kpop, HipHop, Rock, Phonk, EDM, etc—seamlessly converting audio into challenging and aesthetically structured tracks.

games.name: Booth Butcher
games.summary: No weapons. No backup. Just you, a meat cleaver, and the closing shift from hell. Uncover the theater's dark secrets, and survive the night or become the BOOTH BUTCHER'S next attraction.

games.name: Hexzen
games.summary: A hexagonal logic puzzle game set against shifting skies. Use logic alone to read the clues and clear each board. The game has a calm campaign alongside custom puzzles and a built-in level editor.

games.name: Sortilège
games.summary: A dice duel with someone on the other side of the table. Roll, hold what you like, and commit. Both players reach into the same pool of powers each turn, so every one you take is one your opponent can't have. Climb a ladder of ten rivals in a solo run, winning their dice as you go, or duel a friend online.

games.name: Aetheris Core
games.summary: A fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you battle escalating enemy waves, combine powerful abilities, and take on challenging boss encounters.

games.name: Let’s Sing 2027
games.summary: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.

games.name: Let's Sing Presents: Abba
games.summary: Let's Sing Presents: Abba je videohra pro Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4. Termín vydání: 3. 11. 2026.

games.name: Infested DX
games.summary: Escape a space nightmare as the sole survivor of an alien infestation. Search for clues and solve puzzles as you avoid deadly encounters with zombies, mutants, robots and unseen alien pathogens. Find a cure and a way home in this retro point and click adventure!

games.name: Pulse Drive
games.summary: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with rhythm.Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

games.name: TCG Card Chaos
games.summary: TCG Card Chaos is a first-person casual simulation game in which players explore a chaotic card shop and sort more than 5,000 collectible cards. Players inspect card types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and return every card to its correct place.

games.name: Pocket Adventurer
games.summary: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

games.name: Light Source
games.summary: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

games.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
games.summary: This is a first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles.

games.name: Basic Parade or: "you should be depressed."
aliases: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
games.summary: Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books... Until her eyes fell out. You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression. There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

games.name: Dungeons & Dynasties
games.summary:
A guild-management simulation where every league fixture is a procedurally generated dungeon and every
hero can die in it. You lead an adventuring guild through a six-tier pyramid of 72 rival houses: sign
delvers, train them, kit them, set the standing orders they will fight on, and send four of them into the
dark. You never click an attack. Heroes age, form friendships and grudges, are scarred by what they
survive, retire and die permanently, and the whole history of your guild is written back to you as prose
the simulation generated rather than an author wrote.

games.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
games.summary: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting. Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.

games.name: Desert Echo
games.summary: You are Echo, an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Deploy turrets, gas barrels, farm energy fragments. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op. The desert doesn't forgive hesitation.

games.name: The Wake Event
games.summary: The Wake Event is a first-person science-fiction psychological horror and puzzle adventure set aboard the abandoned ARGUS research station. Awakening alone with no memory of what happened, the player must restore station systems, solve interconnected technical puzzles, and uncover the truth behind ARGUS, the station's autonomous intelligence, and their own presence aboard the facility.

games.name: Heirs of the Fountains
games.summary: Heirs of the Fountains is a pixel-art action-platformer starring two siblings with unique powers. Explore the kingdom of Elarion, overcome dangerous levels, defeat fearsome creatures and legendary bosses, and rescue Lady Julia from the clutches of the witch Morwenna.

games.name: Traffic Architect
games.summary: The city is the easy part. Making it move isn't. Lay out roads, shape junctions and time the lights, then watch thousands of simulated cars find every flaw you missed. Take cars off the road with buses, trains and metro — or build the whole city yourself in Creative mode.

games.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
games.summary: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

games.name: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
games.summary: A narrative-driven DLC expansion where you explore a decayed Central Park and Upper West Side gripped by paranoia over a mysterious virus variant. Guided by a narrator recounting events as a flashback, you uncover what happened in the park while battling a new apex threat and familiar foes. You're joined by three companions with distinct fighting styles and backgrounds, each offering unique tactical support and reactions to situations. The endgame shifts you from hunted survivor to hunter, letting you dictate engagements and pursue enemies on your own terms, with your performance affecting future challenges and exclusive rewards. New skill variants and an exotic weapon round out the expansion.

games.name: Potato Please
games.summary: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

games.name: Hold My Wheel
games.summary: HOLD MY WHEEL is a 5-player online co-op action-adventure set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. You and your idiot twin brothers must visit grandma, living in a bus you can never leave thanks to the collars she put on you. Keep the bus running, fire junk from its roof-mounted Scrap Cannon, lift, flip and throw it with a magnetic gun, and build bridges from scrap. Go hungry too long and you start eyeing your teammates; get bitten or irradiated and you turn into a zombie. Death is not the end: keep playing as a ghost, zombie or floppy ragdoll until a Hell-Kitty restores your human form.

games.name: Spell Code SlingerZ
games.summary: Weave codes and sling spells as a punk Y2K Spell Code Synthesizer in this 2-4 player, couch/online, 2D party brawler. Annihilate the opposition, acquire powerful new Spellcodes, and beat them down again in a first-to-3-wins style tournament.

games.name: Go Dub Yourself!
games.summary:
Go Dub Yourself! is an interactive party game where players re-voice video clips using on-screen timing markers. Players can play straight, go off-script, or improvise, with flexible scoring options including auto-scoring, player judging, and chat voting. Key features include an integrated voice changer with 18 choices, party tournaments, a dedicated Studio mode, dark mode, and Steam achievements.

Using the Clip Studio tool, users can import any video, set timing lines, assign characters, and convert clips into playable dubbing packs. Content can be exported locally or uploaded directly to the Steam Workshop. The game supports local co-op for up to 8 players on a single machine and online multiplayer for up to 12 players via simple room codes with built-in voice chat.

The game includes no pre-packaged copyrighted media; players are responsible for supplying their own video files and ensuring they have the rights to any content they import or share.

games.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
games.summary: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

games.name: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!
games.summary: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach! is a first-person beach cleanup and restoration simulation. Collect and sort 7,621 items across the beach, ocean and pier, tidy clothing stores and surf rentals, put beach chairs and toys back in place, and restore the coral reef while helping turtles. Earn money to buy cleaning tools and skills, use an auto-sorter, and hire a dog to carry trash. Play alone or with friends in online, LAN and local split-screen co-op. Character customization unlocks as stores are sorted, and players can use water guns, throw coconuts and crabs, and play with a seagull gun.

games.name: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
games.summary: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

games.name: One More Floor
games.summary: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

games.name: 4:12 AM
games.summary: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

games.name: Spark of Tales
games.summary: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

games.name: Pathos
games.summary: Pathos is a turn-based fantasy adventure inspired by retro dungeon crawlers. Experience deep, emergent gameplay with modern graphics, sound and a touch-first interface. Extensively customise your character and embark on epic procedurally generated campaigns.

games.name: How Empires Work
games.summary: An incremental strategy game about history, expansion and development. Grow from humble beginnings to take your place on the world stage!

games.name: Hold the Levee
games.summary:
Hold the Levee is a strategy simulation game focused on real-time fluid dynamics and water physics. Players must dig trenches, raise levees, stack sandbags, and build dams, then watch how the water reacts to the structures.

The gameplay simulates realistic water behaviors such as seepage, undermined walls, flood waves, and ice jams across 24 unique missions. The campaign ranges from defending a town from natural disasters to flooding enemy villages guarded by the AI. The game also includes a sandbox map editor, local or online co-op, and a unique 1v1 "Water vs Defender" PvP mode.

games.name: Kitties on Planets
games.summary:
Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle!

The white cat can push supply boxes, causing them to keep moving until they collide with an obstacle. The black cat cannot push boxes, but can move the magnets scattered throughout the environment. These magnets attract boxes and the inactive character when they enter their range, allowing you to change their positions and create new paths.

Magnetic attraction works in a straight line and cannot pass through walls or other objects that block its range. Observe the environment, switch between the two cats, and carefully consider every move to prevent a box from becoming stuck in an unreachable position.

games.name: Terminidle
games.summary: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

games.name: Survivecraft
games.summary: Survive ten minutes of pure horde in the dark fantasy world of Valdrath! 13 heroes, evolving spells, boss fights in blazing arenas and epic loot. Rebuild your ruined Sanctuary between runs – solo or in local co-op.

games.name: Kachow Kart Racing
games.summary:
Kachow Kart Racing is an arcade kart racing game featuring drift-based boosts, chaotic races, and power-ups. Players can customize their karts, race against AI opponents, challenge friends in local split-screen, or compete in online multiplayer with ranked competition and leaderboards.

Use rockets, smoke bombs, shields, and oil to disrupt rivals and take the lead. Join or create a clan, grow your team, and compete together.

games.name: BrouHaHa
games.summary: Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

games.name: 1.44MB Rescue
games.summary: Write Python-style code to program repair patchers and rescue a corrupting 1.44MB floppy sector by sector. Start with four commands; every file you restore unlocks loops, variables, functions and lists, until your programs bring all 1,474,560 bytes back to life. The whole game fits on one floppy.

games.name: Sump
games.summary: A short baroque atmospheric horror game. Manipulate a labyrinth of levers and unnatural shadows. Find courage in a place that only goes down.

games.name: Hearsay
games.summary: An archive of 164 recordings, from hundred-year-old records to country, funk, jazz, horror and video game music, cut into 724 unlabeled tapes. No titles, no search. Ten cabinets, a tape deck and your ears. Fill each row in order and find out if you heard it right. Free demo available now!

games.name: Magtiles
games.summary: Magtiles is a chill and relaxing puzzle game about moving tiles. There's no rush! Just play at your own pace, disable the move limit, skip levels, or come back later if you just want to relax. Listen to chill lo-fi and classical music and satisfying sounds. Simple is good.

games.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
games.summary: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

games.name: Make Me Whole
games.summary: A letter with no sender, a photo of the doll you lost as a child, and an address: a shuttered doll workshop where the same room keeps repeating. Something off? Sewing machine. Nothing? Take the exit. First-person anomaly-spotting horror about finishing a doll, and what moves when you look away.

games.name: Scrapbot Arena
games.summary:
Scrapbot Arena is a top-down arena survival game in which players control a small robot fighting hostile machines. Weapons aim and fire automatically, leaving players to dodge attacks, collect scrap, and shape their build. Between waves, the workshop offers weapons and parts, while level-up choices and weapon merging provide further upgrades. Arena runs span 20 waves and include boss encounters across unlockable worlds.

The game supports solo play as well as local and online co-op for up to four players. A separate Find the Exit mode replaces open arena survival with maze-like stages and guarded exits. Players can choose from six robots and use keyboard, gamepad, or touch controls. It runs in a web browser on desktop computers, iPhone, and Android devices. Achievements, world unlocks, and leaderboards track progress, with account-based features available through the Maxcade portal.

games.name: Hollow Warden
games.summary: Something is wrong in the ward. As a detective investigating a serious crime, navigate the ruins of an abandoned psychiatric hospital, gather evidence, and follow a trail that leads deeper into madness

games.name: Maze 1211
games.summary: Wait. Where am I? Why is there a maze? Why am I holding a lantern? A first-person psychological mystery. Wander a vast night maze with a few flags and a stick of chalk. Mark your way, follow the signs, and try to remember which way you came. If you can.

games.name: Purrfect Bliss
games.summary: Purrfect Bliss is a cat cafe built on a dark history. Will you survive the night shift? Serve customers, take care of the cats, and uncover the terrifying truth in this psychological horror game.

games.name: Leftovers: Last Fridge Standing
games.summary: A co-op arena survivors roguelike for 1-4 players where the leftovers fight back. Pick a food, pick a class and survive 20 waves of germs, mold and expired dairy with a ridiculous loadout of kitchen weapons. Fuse, evolve and synergize your weapons, and vote with your friends on what horror to open next. Play solo, couch co-op on one PC, or online, across co-op and versus modes.

games.name: Fatespun
games.summary: Fatespun is a dark fantasy card auto battler and roguelite. The player chooses a hero, plots a route across a haunted kingdom map, and builds a formation of cards around class themes, traits and combos. Battles play out automatically based on the formation's arrangement, and cards grow stronger as they are forged and upgraded between fights. Runs pit the player's formation against monsters and against builds made by other players.

games.name: Crown & Coin: The Hundred Years
games.summary: Survive the Hundred Years' War in this medieval ensemble sandbox. Play as 1,015 historical figures, from Joan of Arc to the imposter des Armoises. Gain glory as a knight, forge a new kingdom to crush England and France, or thrive as a bandit. Discover 22 tarot-based multiple endings!

games.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler
games.summary: Bitten on the first day of an outbreak, you have five days before you turn. Alone in a hospital lab, you take a sample from your own wound, streak it on an agar plate, identify the virus under a microscope, and synthesize an antiviral at the bench. Each antiviral is tested in a trial machine where it fights the virus as an auto battler, and every vaccine you inject teaches the virus something new, pushing it to evolve into a new variant. Between lab sessions, you manage sleep, food, and focus, and head out to gather supplies and field samples.

games.name: Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas
games.summary: Set sail in search of endless wealth in Age of Wonders 4: The Silver Seas. Master the tides, claim hidden treasures, and become ruler of the waves. Features new dwelling, new forms, 4 new tomes, and Mercantile culture.

games.name: Mycelarium
games.summary: Grow an ever-expanding fungal network in this relaxing incremental exploration game. Discover hidden resources, cultivate mushrooms that automate your production, and evolve your mycelium into a self-sustaining underground empire.

games.name: Dead Sector
games.summary: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

games.name: Pokémon Happy Meal Digital Experience
games.summary: A short game for children where you examine several areas trying to find 15 hidden pokémon toys. This was part of a McDonald's Happy Meal promotion.

games.name: Age of Wonders 4: 2026 Collector's Bundle
games.summary: Experience the ultimate Age of Wonders 4 adventure with the updated 2026 Collector’s Bundle — featuring the base game and a rich array of additional content. Immerse yourself in a world of magic, strategy, and discovery!

games.name: Stuffed: Two Foot Hero
games.summary: Become a two-foot-tall teddy bear in this VR wave shooter where you wield homemade weapons, build defenses, and protect a little girl from her nightmares. Play solo or online in up to 4 player co-op.

games.name: Outposters
games.summary: Outposters is a 1-4 player co-op zombie shooter with a rogue-lite core. Hold the line against growing waves, then push into the dead city between attacks for weapons and upgrades before the next assault lands. Five operators with their own stats and abilities, nearly forty weapons from pistols and shotguns to katanas and a chainsaw, sixteen waves and four bosses, five difficulty levels and an Endless Siege mode with Steam leaderboards.

games.name: Link Cameras
games.summary: You work as a moderator for a strange camera website called L!nk Cameras. Watch live feeds, approve or reject cameras, follow the admin’s instructions, and uncover what hides behind each connection.

games.name: Krillion Space
games.summary:
Every answer warps you deeper. Krillion Space is a free space trivia game in your browser: decode one transmission from the silent Orion gateways each day, then fly an endless voyage past real planets, nebulae and galaxies, one right answer at a time. Send your drone to probe unchartered planets, and be the first one to even name them.

Immersive real life space exploration game, with a daily trivia, and unlimited quiz.

games.name: Ego Lifting Simulator
games.summary: Ego Lifting Simulator is a single-player, physics-driven weightlifting career simulation. Players physically control their lifter during exercises, develop their body, and compete in regional competitions. Career progression combines training, diet, recovery, and physical jobs to earn money while exploring an island setting.

games.name: Worship
games.summary: Blindly serve a dreadful god and lead its cult in a fresh take on the roguelike genre inspired by Pikmin. Put on the robe of a cultist and ready your ceremonial dagger to serve the old god of your choosing in the grim universe of Worship.

games.name: Entropic Decay
games.summary: Entropic Decay is a lovingly crafted linear first person shooter driven by narrative, puzzles, combat arenas, and horror sequences. Think the atmosphere of a slow-burn horror inspired walking simulator, fused with the movement and combat options of a shooter...

games.name: SystemCrash92
games.summary: Face the machines of the evil hacker in this action roguelite. Your avatar will assist you in battle as you improve your skills with items and level up to build a powerful strategy. An unforgettable adventure for survival fans!

games.name: Starshapes
games.summary: A relaxing 3D puzzle game about drawing constellations in space.

games.name: Laser Lightshow
games.summary: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

games.name: Cat Secretary
games.summary: Welcome to DOX HQ! Manage your lobby, catfish your boss and climb that corporate ladder. But when the sun goes down, the real work begins, because there’s only one thing standing between humanity and total AI automation: one very determined cat! Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

games.name: Snow Resort Simulator
games.summary: Step into the world of Snow Resort Simulator. Tackle daily responsibilities: upgrade facilities, maintain a cozy resort, satisfy guests with freshly cooked meals and drinks, and keep your inventory fully stocked. Be prepared for the challenges that come with winter.

games.name: Football Life Simulator
games.summary: Live the life of a professional footballer both on and off the field. Train, play matches, manage your social life, climb the career ladder, and spend your earned money. Decorate your life with luxury while managing your relationships and finances.

games.name: Missi
games.summary: Missi is a cozy point & click game in a watercolor hand-drawn world. Find hidden objects and solve puzzles using clues in sketches of past adventures. Try to trick the Mushroom Spider and the Crow King by collecting all medicinal herbs for the sick little mouse.

games.name: Void/Breaker
games.summary: Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: Lost Liminal
games.summary: Lost Liminal is a quirky first-person exploration and deconstruction game based on the BackRoom urban legend! Players will take on the role of a wanderer lost in the backroom hierarchy, determining the ultimate outcome based on your choices!

games.name: Bibidi Bibidi!
games.summary: Bibidi Bibidi! is a whimsical deckbuilder where your wizard shouts whatever spell you conjure up. Every card has 3 components that you combine in your spellbook for unique effects. Mix and match incantations like sim-sala-bim and abra-kadabra to zap your way through a dungeon filled with monsters.

games.name: Slumber Realm
games.summary: Enter the Slumber Realm and battle your adolescent fears. Discover powerful synergies, unlock upgrades and equipment, duel broccoli. Decorate your crib with relics of the 90s.

games.name: Turning Manor
games.summary: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to unravel the mysteries of Turning Manor.

games.name: Pionero Capital
games.summary: Pionero Capital is a sandbox business simulator where you build your company from zero to millionaire. Drive around an open world, manage employees, expand into different businesses, and become the richest in the city.

games.name: Lost Host
games.summary:
Lost Host is a story-driven adventure puzzle game about a small toy car searching for its missing owner.
When the boy mysteriously disappears, the toy car begins a journey through the house and beyond, exploring dark rooms, hallways, foggy streets, and abandoned places while following clues to uncover what happened.

Players control the toy car as it navigates dangerous environments, solves physics-based puzzles, and interacts with objects to progress. The world is full of hazards for a tiny toy car - heights, fire, water - as well as enemies such as dogs, robotic vacuums, and hostile toy creatures.

The game combines atmospheric exploration, light horror elements, and emotional storytelling, creating a family-friendly adventure centered on mystery, discovery, and survival in a large, human-sized world.

games.name: Sound System
games.summary: Soundsystém (také jako soundsystem), známý také jako Tribes kmen/y je uskupení lidí, společně vlastnící techniku a další instrumenty, potřebné k pořádání Freetekno parties, jako je například známý teknival CzechTek. Technikou se rozumí zejména: Nákladní automobil, autobus, nebo dodávka pro převoz materiálu a zásob. Naftový agregát potřebný k výrobě elektřiny, jelikož drtivá většina parties se koná mimo dosah jakékoliv infrastruktury. Výkonné reproduktory, jejich celkový příkon často přesahuje 10 kW.

games.name: Cold Rails
games.summary: Cold Rails is a horror adventure set on a cold train. You work as a bartender, serving drinks to passengers and uncovering a story as a mysterious woman in a dress stalks the train.

games.name: What'Sub
games.summary: Work together as a pirate crew and plunder coffee across the oceans! Hold your (t)rusty submarine together, dodge disasters, fight dangers, and finally get the black gold home! Play this co-op action game with up to 4 players and try become the mightiest pirates of the underseas!

games.name: Untold Cases: Stillwater Lake
games.summary: When Grace Harland mysteriously disappears at Stillwater Lake, her case is quickly dismissed as an accident. As the investigator, it’s up to you to uncover the truth. Explore the shadowy waters, discover lost audio tapes, and reveal the events leading up to her disappearance.

games.name: Waifu Pogo Club
games.summary: Bounce, fall, rage, and climb together. Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based precision platformer where ridiculously jacked animals attempt to conquer brutal obstacles on pogo sticks. Help each other, kick each other off, or take on the climb alone.

games.name: Pretty Girls Don’t Want You to Die
games.summary: "Pretty Girls Don't Want You to Die" is a game that combines strategy tower defense, survivor-like elements, and auto-battler mechanics. you, an lone hero who, in a desperate situation, unexpectedly receives a blessing from pretty girls, narrowly escaping death.

games.name: Cozy Game Restoration
games.summary: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

games.name: Hull Rupture
games.summary: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

games.name: Sushiamo
games.summary: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

games.name: Theos: Cities of Myth
games.summary: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

games.name: Ten Years of Rain
games.summary: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...

games.name: Noodle Cable
games.summary: The Noodle Cable Technologies welcome you in their company. Untangle and plug huge cables in room-sized puzzles and witness mind-altering surrealist environments.

games.name: Mancalero
games.summary: Mancalero is the ancient strategy board game of Mancala, rebuilt as a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect special marbles, stack blessings, discover synergies, and break every table with increasing scores.

games.name: Slots & Skulls
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Spin to attack, open chests for new symbols, strike deals with cats, and risk your symbols at the anvil.

games.name: Liminoid
games.summary: Liminoid is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

games.name: Cleanup On Aisle 3
games.summary: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, six failing stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

games.name: Old Man's Sushi
games.summary: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

games.name: Flippy the Spider
games.summary: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore 5 distinct worlds, and collect trophies along the way!

games.name: On The Hook
games.summary: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

games.name: Rob Run
games.summary: Rob Run is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.

games.name: Fjordal
games.summary: A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management. Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back.

games.name: Wizard School Dropout
games.summary: You left wizard school in disgrace, and now have only one option to pay off your student loans: crime. Wizard School Dropout is a magic-focused, turn-based RPG and wizard simulator featuring heavy environmental interactions and spell combinations for a wide variety of playstyles. Be Mage Do Crime!

games.name: Node Crown
games.summary: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here!

games.name: Cardsharp
games.summary: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

games.name: Dialshift
games.summary: Dialshift is a single-player score-attack arcade game played on a circular dial. Players control a continuously moving cursor with two directional inputs and time hit attempts against targets while maintaining combos and Stability. Seven modes vary the rules with directional targets, forced reversals, sustained holds, and multi-hit targets. Each mode has its own scores, ranks, and leaderboard.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Forever
games.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.

games.name: Kokuhaku Confessional
games.summary: Just as you’re finally ready to ask library crush Shiori out on a date, mean girls Maika, Rin, and Aoi swoop in with a twisted new game: Kokuhaku Confessional! Can you resist their charms and stay true to your beloved? Survive to Day 5, and maybe—just maybe—you’ll win Shiori’s heart.

games.name: Echo Mates
games.summary: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1-4 players, real voice, microphone required.

games.name: Wildixir
games.summary: Wildixir is a single-player action roguelite set in enchanted lands. Combine automatic weapons and alchemical reactions, restore shrines, and face each region's boss. Between runs, spend seeds on permanent upgrades and unlock new characters and locations.

games.name: Imouto Choukyou Nikki
games.summary: A censored port of Imouto Choukyou Nikki.

games.name: Rip It! Card Collector
games.summary: A single-player incremental game where you hunt down 1,809 collectible trading cards. Sell dupes and upgrade your retro-futuristic gear to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and completing the ultimate card collection. It’s time to get cracking!

games.name: Just Volleyball
games.summary: just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve. (taken from Steam page)

games.name: Scraplings
games.summary: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

games.name: Spellchain
games.summary: A first-person action fantasy RPG where you create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events, grow your magical power, and ultimately slay the king.

games.name: Double Skunk
games.summary:
Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite built on the real game played by the book. Between hands, players add powerups that change what the count pays and collect one-use pocket cards that bend the rules once, such as shoving the rival's peg back down the board or taking the crib whoever dealt. A short guided warm-up teaches cribbage to newcomers before the first match.

The campaign follows a traveling player up the Long Tally, a tournament tour of twenty-one named rivals running from a back-room parlor to a national championship, with house rules such as a chess clock and muggins at the higher tables. Outside the campaign, a weekly duplicate-cribbage challenge deals every player the same hands for a shared leaderboard, and players can face the AI at four difficulty levels or play one-on-one online.

games.name: Break the Piñatas
games.summary: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

games.name: Death Dealer
games.summary: A multiplayer horror party game for up to 6 players where the losers of a card game are hunted by their friends.

games.name: Yukizuki no Seisou
games.summary: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream…

games.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
games.summary: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

games.name: Compactor Baron
games.summary: You're broke and the bills keep coming. Smash scrap into cubes, sell them, pay up. A short active incremental: aim, let the hammer swing, upgrade your tools, go bankrupt on purpose, and build a scrapyard that pays for itself.

games.name: Camping Resort Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own campsite in this cozy management sim. Turn an empty stretch of coast into a camping resort with a character all its own: lay out paths, place pitches, glamping and bungalows, shape the landscape, and welcome guests who each live their own little holiday.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Beijing
games.summary:
Centuries ago, the ancestors of Beijing's hidden cats traveled the legendary Silk Road to reach the Emperor's palace. Now, they are hiding all over the city!

Relax and enjoy a journey to the Far East and find +700 hidden cats in Beijing!

Celebrate the Spring Festival by breathing new life into dragon dances and ancient legends, all set to the rhythm of traditional Chinese music.

games.name: Prigod Idle
games.summary: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

games.name: Knight's Party
games.summary: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

games.name: Tirade
games.summary: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

games.name: Snake-Killer.io
games.summary: A free multiplayer snake arena in the browser. One big world with up to 150 snakes: eat, grow, boost, and make bigger snakes crash into you. Runs on desktop and phones, no download.

games.name: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
games.summary: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

games.name: Stack & Brew
games.summary: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

games.name: The Night Shift
games.summary:
The Night Shift is a neo-noir deduction game where you are the last desk between the accused and the cells. Suspects land in your custody one by one: cross-check their documents, spot forgeries, break alibis, and stamp your verdict while the shift clock breathes down your neck.

The routine always breaks. Teletype tips, precinct blackouts, lawyers springing suspects mid-shift, the captain leaning on you for results. And the culprits you let walk? They come back, with a worse case, and they remember your face.

A 7-night campaign with named recurring characters, boss confrontations against The Broker's lieutenants, and 8 different endings shaped by your corruption, your accuracy, and your conscience.

games.name: Shorted
games.summary: Balatro-style scoring on a 9×9 grid. Your deck becomes the board: trace same-color Packets into scoring shapes, install Patches that hack the rules, and rebuild the deck that refills the grid. Six Firewalls stand between you and an overloaded high score.

games.name: KOF: Legend
games.summary: KOF: Legend is a mobile idle RPG officially licensed from SNK's The King of Fighters series. Players build teams of fighters from across the franchise and battle through auto-combat stages, with enemies defeated in a single tap.

games.name: Honey Route
games.summary:
Honey Route is a relaxing path-connection puzzle set inside a beehive.

Rotate the hexagonal honeycomb pieces to build continuous honey trails, guiding every worker bee to a queen. Start with a single bee and a single queen, and work your way up to huge hives where many bees and many queens share the same network. One bee can reach several queens, and several bees can reach the same queen.

There is no timer, no lives, no score and no penalty. Try any rotation you like and solve each level at your own pace. Visual and sound feedback shows every connection as it forms, so you always know how close you are to completing the hive.

The 30 handcrafted levels grow steadily in size and challenge, ending in boards with up to 388 pieces, 28 bees and 28 queens.

games.name: Erlik
games.summary: Erlik is a survivors-like rooted in Turkic and Anatolian mythology. You play a Kam, a shaman, surviving one long night on the steppe against the armies of Erlik, lord of the underworld. Every run drifts between two gods: lean toward Erlik for savage damage and lifesteal at the cost of your health, or toward Tengri for shields and regeneration. The same weapon evolves into something different depending on which god you serve.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Elevator Action
games.summary:
"ELEVATOR ACTION" is an action game released by TAITO in 1983. As a Spy, your goal is to infiltrate the building and escape with all the confidential documents. Use elevators to crush enemies, attack them by shooting down lamps, and more.

The “Arcade Archives” series is developed with the concept of faithfully reproducing classic arcade games. It also includes convenient features such as difficulty and screen settings, rewind, rapid-fire, and multiple save slots. In addition, players can compete for the best scores with players around the world through online rankings.
“Arcade Archives 2” adds a new “TIME ATTACK MODE” to the lineup of “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HI SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the Arcade Archives series. In “TIME ATTACK MODE,” players compete to clear the game as quickly as possible, regardless of the score achieved. VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support has also been added, allowing gameplay to be reproduced even closer to the original arcade experience.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Exzisus
games.summary:
"EXZISUS" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1987.
Control Cosmo Fighter Robin and defeat the mysterious army infesting the 4th Galaxy using your blaster and missiles.
Each item collected powers Robin up, allowing it to transform into Turbo Jet mode or summon bird and dog animal robots to support you in attack.
Aim for the weak parts of the giant robots waiting at the end of each stage.

The “Arcade Archives” series is developed with the concept of faithfully reproducing classic arcade games. It also includes convenient features such as difficulty and screen settings, rewind, rapid-fire, and multiple save slots. In addition, players can compete for the best scores with players around the world through online rankings.
“Arcade Archives 2” adds a new “TIME ATTACK MODE” to the lineup of “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HI SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the Arcade Archives series. In “TIME ATTACK MODE,” players compete to clear the game as quickly as possible, regardless of the score achieved. VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support has also been added, allowing gameplay to be reproduced even closer to the original arcade experience.

games.name: Find the Box
games.summary:
There is a box buried somewhere inside a cube of a million blocks. Find it. Be happy.

Find the Box is a first-person digging game. Dig slowly and calmly, or fast and destructively: every block you break earns XP, and each level-up gives you a choice of 3 cards. The cards add spells, perks, movement upgrades and the occasional hamster.

On Normal, the screen edges glow green when you’re getting warmer and red when you’re getting colder. Hard mode gives you almost nothing. There are four cube sizes, from 1 million to 8 million blocks, plus a Boxless mode where you destroy half the cube instead.

A calm narrator talks you through it. Something about it feels slightly off. Your dug tunnels and your timer save between sessions, and leaderboards track your best times.

games.name: The Maze: In Dark
games.summary: With only a flashlight to rely on, secure your objective in the dark factory and escape while avoiding the gaze of 'Him', who roams the factory at random. Overcome the extreme fear of the unknown brought on by darkness and complete your assigned mission safely.

games.name: Yuna World
games.summary:
An accident ends your old life, but the goddess Yuna offers you a second chance. Welcome to Aetheria, a fantasy world filled with monsters, magic, and new companions, where your destination is the mysterious Tower of Trials. Choose from four character classes and forge your own playstyle: develop your attributes, master powerful skills, and discover equipment to prepare for the challenges ahead. In turn-based combat, your abilities and tactical choices make the difference between victory and defeat.

Climb the tower alone or join forces with up to three other players. Defeat formidable bosses, collect loot, and grow stronger together. Summon companions, earn special titles, and make your mark on the leaderboards.

games.name: Fail Games
games.summary: Fail Games is a collection of brutally hard but simple minigames. Beat each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail and spend them on outfits and effects. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

games.name: Type To Report - Paradox
games.summary: The sequel for Type To Report. Just like the first game, this is an I'm on observation duty game where you need type the location of where the anomaly is to fix anomalies.

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Sega Consoles Pack
games.summary: Includes playable machines Genesis Tower US machine, SegaSaturn JP Machine, and Dreamcast EU machine.

games.name: We Are Rebellion
games.summary: WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you pilot a warship in command of a rebel crew. The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been devoured and polluted by capitalist corporations.

games.name: Hammer these nails!
games.summary:
Someone stripped every single nail from your house.
Your mission is simple: pick up and hammer them back in. All 10,000 of them.
Grab your hammer, get to work, and make sure to upgrade your tools along the way!

games.name: Monster Club League Manager
games.summary: Monster Club League Manager is a single-player club management simulation in which players recruit and develop monsters, choose a nine-monster lineup, and manage contracts, transfers, facilities, and club finances. Matches play out automatically, with player development, aging, promotion, and squad rebuilding continuing across multiple seasons.

games.name: ArcaChess
games.summary:
ArcaChess is a chess game in which every capture is decided by a real-time duel. When a piece attacks another, both pieces enter an arena where the players control them directly: they move, aim and fire spells until one of them is defeated. The winner keeps the square.

Each piece type has its own health, speed, fire rate and spells, so a pawn can defeat a queen if its player wins the duel. Bonuses appear during arena fights, such as healing, speed, fire rate and ricochet shots.

The game includes a solo mode against an AI with three difficulty levels, and online play with ranked, casual and private matches. Social features include friends, private messages, guilds with a shared chat, and a world leaderboard based on ELO. Players can unlock cosmetic avatars, piece skins, boards and sounds.

ArcaChess is free to play and available on iOS, Android and in web browsers.

games.name: DziadyWin
games.summary: Dziady night is near. Grab your scythe, light the grave candles and mow down the unclean till the roosters crow, then share your night with friends.

games.name: Play God on Earth
games.summary: Play God on Earth is a free browser god game set on a 3D globe of the real Earth. Every country starts on its real borders with its real cities and leaders, and history runs on its own: wars, alliances, revolutions and empires that rise and fall over thousands of years. The player never controls a nation. Instead they act from above with god powers such as meteors, plagues, golden ages, revolts and floods, and the world reacts with newspaper headlines and leaders who complain about the heavens. Players can start in 25 historical years from 1000 BC to today, paint their own countries onto the map, describe a world in words, play a shared Daily God world, and record short videos of their world.

games.name: Red Dead Revolver PC Port
games.summary: A native Windows port of the original Xbox release of Red Dead Revolver, made by static recompilation.

games.name: Trick Shot Cinema
games.summary: Trick Shot Cinema is a free daily movie-link puzzle played in the browser on phone or desktop. Each day you get three films: a Start, a Trick Shot and an End. Link Start to End through the Trick Shot, one person at a time. A link is anyone who worked on both films: cast, director, writer, composer. There is no cast list on screen. You name people and films from memory, and you get two peeks per game if you are stuck. The Daily is free and needs no sign-up. If you sign in, you get a ranked leaderboard, 1v1 challenges with friends and Screening Rooms for groups. There is also Party Mode, where friends pick the three films and everyone races, and a TV mode for game night.

games.name: B;P;M
games.summary:
An angel is looking for God.
Two beings tell his story.
A heart beats.

[From itch.io]

games.name: Pentatile
games.summary: Pentatile is a geometric sandbox where you build a colorful mosaic, discover new shapes in the spaces between, and share your creations with other explorers.

games.name: Runika: A World of Little Legends
games.summary: Build a farm… to save the world. Runika blends a cozy 2D sandbox with an unfolding story about a world being pulled into the mysterious Rift. Grow crops at your own pace, build your farm, gather resources, craft your own equipment, and uncover what awakens within the Rift.

games.name: The Knight of Turn
games.summary: Knight of Turn is a board game where the brave knight, imprisoned by the monsters in the deep dungeon, must find freedom and free the kingdom from this threat.

games.name: Truck World: Australia
games.summary: Travel across Australia behind the wheel of the mighty Road Train! Haul extreme cargo thousands of miles and explore the Outback's wilderness in some of the most intense conditions on earth!

games.name: Airframe Ultra
games.summary:
Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing.

From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali Zego zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory… three feet above or six feet below.

games.name: Meadgard
games.summary: Run your own viking pub in a chaotic co-op management adventure! Grab your friends, axes and tankards, and work together to both serve and fight your hot-headed customers. It’s time to show the world what viking hospitality looks like!

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Lug, an ordinary boy with the power to shape the fate of humans and machines in a world on the brink. A retro-inspired action JRPG where you explore a vibrant voxel world, battle deadly mechanoids, solve puzzles, and uncover a story of legacy, mystery, and heart.

games.name: Soar Up The Charts
games.summary: Soar Up The Charts is a fast-paced rhythm game and arcade style rail shooter where music is your weapon! With tracks provided by Alden Ave and KeepFlying, be ready to turn it up and blast your way through those radio robots!

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

games.name: Faraway
games.summary: "I am a shooting star! A spark meant to shine and vanish in a blink. But I will travel! I will mark my trail in every firmament. I will live to see the universe." Faraway is an immersive, both challenging and chill, procedurally generated audiovisual experience about creating constellations.

games.name: CoffeeShop Simulator
games.summary: CoffeeShop Simulator offers a captivating experience for aspiring baristas and fans of simulation games. It's more than just management every decision shapes your journey in the exciting world of coffee.

games.name: County of Fortune
games.summary: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

games.name: Abashed
games.summary: Abashed is a 2.5D narrative-driven side-scrolling game that lets you explore the life of Issac, a man living with psychosis. One day waking up all alone, he sets out to find the truth behind his missing partner. On the way he finds himself needing to confront his deepest fears and the darkest secrets. Join Issac in this story of love, loss, fear, and acceptance. Reality is not what it seems.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Build the perfect, chaotic rocket engine in this numbers-go-up space roguelite. Load your ship with wacky fuel items, chase the right synergies and pray that it’s enough to get you to Pluto. Push it as far as you can before it all falls apart. Chaotic. Glorious. Human.

games.name: Clean Start
