games.summary: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

games.name: Chronicles of Veldoria
games.summary: Chronicles of Veldoria is an epic tactical RPG where you’ll meet new allies, convince monsters to join you, do monster fusion, craft items, learn & upgrade skills, and gather strength to battle the malignant forces of an ancient evil, Ogre Muk, to save the majestic land of Veldoria!

games.name: Psycho-Sleuth
games.summary: Psycho-Sleuth is a mystery game where cognitive disorders distort the rules of murder. 13 players, each with a strange condition — like “no lying,” “no left side,” or “no faces” — are trapped in a deadly game. These disorders are contagious, and the killer hides behind abnormal logic.

games.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
games.summary: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

games.name: StandOff
games.summary: A stylized third-person action RPG where you fight waves of enemies, gather loot, upgrade gear, and unlock powerful abilities through fast, responsive combat.

games.name: In Full Bloom
games.summary: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

games.name: 100 Cafe Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

games.name: Tantalus
games.summary: A turn-based RPG about a pair of demons fighting to overthrow an unjust regime. Battle through the crumbling remains of Hell, God's forgotten penal colony, on a quest to find the Apple of Enlightenment and bring justice to the wrongly damned.

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.summary: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

games.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
aliases: 蒼藍魔導士露娜　～天才魔導士與傳奇魔導士～
苍蓝魔导士露娜　～天才魔导士与传奇魔导士～
games.summary: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

games.name: Rise of Chi
games.summary: When Chi finds her eggs are stolen by sneaky snakes, she is forced to leave everything behind. A brave journey that begins with a personal mission and escalates into something far bigger. Guided by unlikely allies and haunted by self-doubt, Chi must face enemies far greater than she imagined.

games.name: Underkeep
games.summary: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear and descend into the depths of the Underkeep to uncover what lies hidden below.

games.name: Mupo
games.summary: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come—stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

games.name: Carry the Pack Rack
games.summary: One car, two drivers! Team up where one steers and the other pedals. Navigate obstacles without dropping the package. Play solo or join friends via local and online multiplayer co-op. Can you coordinate your moves to deliver safely or will you crash in chaos?

games.name: Traders Life Simulator
games.summary: Master the Art of Trade. Buy, Trade, Win! Don't just run a shop, dominate the market! The key is finding the right product at the right price. Buy cheap and wait for the right moment!

games.name: Pix Football Manager
games.summary: PIX Football Manager is a nostalgic, casual football management simulator focused on scouting. Set your tactics, find hidden gems, and improve your facilities as you build a dynasty. With no visible player stats, you must spot talent yourself. Grab your clipboard, the game starts now.

games.name: Lines We Draw
games.summary: Lines We Draw is a 3D isometric narrative strategy game set at a tense Cold War border. Inspect documents, interrogate travelers, and manage a shifting checkpoint between rival states. Your stamp decides fates: Will you be a hero of the people, or a tool of the regime?

games.name: FED Chairman
games.summary: Lead the U.S. economy: adjust rates, deploy QE/QT, and balance inflation with employment in this macro-strategy sim.

games.name: Imperial Kingdoms
games.summary: Expand your kingdom: Gather resources and transport them to your capital city to produce the materials you need to expand your army and conquer new regions. Research new technologies to improve your economy and army. Use your troops wisely to outmanoeuvre your enemies.

games.name: Build a Bot
games.summary: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Payday: Aces High
games.summary: Mask up as one of The Aces, an elite group of heisters with access to bleeding-edge tech, black-market toys, and weapons no sane dealer would list. Framed by business titan Warren Jupiter and thrown in jail, the time has come for you to hit him where it hurts: banks, museums—hell, even his so-called “untouchable” penthouse.

games.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
games.summary: Welcome to a place where the sun is guaranteed and money is basically part of the beachwear. In this cozy first-person simulation, you start out at Miami Beach, sell, invest, optimize, and make the cash register ring – because in the end, only one thing counts: Cash is King.

games.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
games.summary: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

games.name: Alteredblood+
games.summary: A blood-soaking movement-FPS platformer where you splatter walls and floors with your foe’s blood. Stand in that blood to [alter] yourself and your weapons. Soak up blood to replenish and keep fighting. Mother created you to stop them. Beckon our extinction.

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Starlit World
games.summary: The heart of the universe is shattered! Join Bo and Kikki to rescue Starlits across mysterious worlds. Master 20 suits to explore and fight. Rebuild your home in this cozy adventure. Save the universe with heart!

games.name: Till Death Rolls Us Apart
games.summary: Face grotesque monsters in a dark, hand-drawn dice-building roguelike. Collect strange dice, stack modifiers, and build combinations that keep you alive through an endless series of turn-based duels.

games.name: Letterally
games.summary: Letterally is a deck-building roguelike where you craft words and your deck of letter tiles. Build powerful synergies, collect game-breaking items, and outsmart rule-bending bosses in this turn-based strategic word game.

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Bros of Bench
games.summary: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

games.name: Dictatorship Simulator
games.summary: Some people call it a democracy; you: an opportunity. Manipulate a political simulation by playing cards, find the cracks in the system, and turn a perfectly fine democracy into your very own dictatorship.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly 160-day tournament against rival Domini.

games.name: Ship Happens
games.summary: You and your best mates have embarked upon a noble, but extremely dangerous mission. Spacecrafts throughout the galaxy are calling for help - can your crew take the controls and guide them to safety away from ravenous, ever-expanding black holes?

games.name: The Bull of Heaven
games.summary: In a city near the mountains the bull of heaven is unleashed, tearing a wound in the world. A vivid action-rhythm game split across eleven intense levels.

games.name: Voxotron
games.summary: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit. Pilot a spaceship around a spinning cosmic cylinder. No brakes. Thread impossible patterns and find the hyperfocus your brain was built for. Short runs. Instant death. Easy to learn, with insane skill ceiling. Pure flow state.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
aliases: Zelda no Densetsu Toki no Ocarina
games.summary: The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.
series: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

games.name: Blood of Rations
games.summary: Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter set in 1944 occupied Europe. Deploy alone into solo PvPvE raids, scavenge what the dead left behind, and extract alive — or lose everything you carried in. No minimap, all-diegetic audio, a grid inventory where every slot is a decision, and an 8-second extraction window. Between raids you rebuild the underground bunker you call home.

games.name: Manala: Equinox War
games.summary:
Manala: Equinox War is a LARP world where you build your combat deck and fight other players. Pick up your foam sword, put on your wizard hat and let's go kill the bad guys.

Depending on your point of view, that's either the person in the orc mask or the dwarf with a glued-on beard. The player characters are modeled on real LARPers' costumes.

If you're losing badly, you can always cheat. Just ignore the rules for a bit and be prepared to live with the shame.

games.name: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

games.name: Caleria
games.summary:
Caleria is a 2D top-down open-world medieval RPG focused on exploration, discovery, and player-driven adventure. Set within the mysterious Grimward Kingdom, players can explore diverse regions, interact with unique characters, complete quests, uncover hidden secrets, and face dangerous creatures.

Key features include open-world exploration, multiple character roles, quest and trading systems, survival mechanics, combat, and a world filled with hidden discoveries.

games.name: Plucked
games.summary: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

games.name: Ablahshikar
games.summary: Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

games.name: Feed Me More Brains
games.summary: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

games.name: Build & Putt
games.summary: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

games.name: Card Slay
games.summary: The poker roguelike where the House fights back. Chase the flush, sweat the last discard, then slam it down and watch the damage hit: red suits strike, black suits shield. The monsters read your hand, call your ranks and cheat, so stack your ritual deck, out-cheat them, and slay your fate.

games.name: Manic Miner
games.summary: Manic Miner je plošinová počítačová hra vytvořená Matthew Smithem v roce 1983 původně pro ZX Spectrum. Úkolem hráče je vyvést horníka Willyho z 20 jeskyní obsazených příšerami. Postava může pouze chodit do stran a skákat. Hra se původně měla jmenovat Miner 49'er a původní myšlenka hry nepocházela přímo Matthewa Smithe, ale od jeho partnera ve společnosti Software Projects Alana Matona.

games.name: Just A Dice Game
games.summary: A relaxing dice rolling roguelike about chasing score targets and trying to break the game. Build up your collection of dice while buying upgrades, relics and other powerups to build wild synergies and laugh in the face of RNG.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

games.name: Ashen Legacy
games.summary: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

games.name: False Myth 2
games.summary: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

games.name: AJ's Anomaly
games.summary: First-person anomaly horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer investigating her gallery the night before a big exhibition. After months of exhausting work and a series of troubled business relationships, she may be starting to lose her mind.

games.name: Swarm Harvest
games.summary:
Congratulations, you're hired!
Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

games.name: TerraLounge
games.summary:
Players decorate and spend time in a terrarium, and play match-3 puzzles to earn currency to use in the terrarium. This currency is used to buy toys, decorations, music, and floors.

The game features 3 game modes: Endless, with procedurally generated boards; Story, hand-crafted levels across 5 worlds; Terrarium, where players decorate and spend time with slimes.

The intent of the game is to be a second screen, fish tank kind of game, where it exists with the player as a companion, but not draw attention to itself.

games.name: Blue Check
games.summary:
Blue Check is an experimental psychological horror.

Experience the life of a young woman who has just moved into a new apartment. Explore her everyday life through her computer. Play minigames, read the latest news, shop for new items to decorate your home, and, most importantly, chat with your friends!

Powered by AI-driven text generation, NPCs respond dynamically to your messages, making every conversation feel like a real chat. Enjoy the freedom of talking to characters who react to what you say... while it lasts...

But there's more to the girl's life than meets the eye. A dark secret lies beneath the surface, waiting to be uncovered.

Will you discover the truth?

games.name: Dust & Diamonds
games.summary: Humans are extinct, and Goblins proudly stand at the top of the food chain! Take over a mine, expand your surface base, and automate logistics. Manage workers, trade, avoid cave-ins and lava, and above all – try to endure your father's constant grumbling!

games.name: Pre-Warp Age
games.summary: A meditative turn-based strategy about settling space, from the first flight to the invention of the warp drive. Assign workers, research technologies and mine resources in randomly generated star systems without enemies or time limits.

games.name: Dark Alley
games.summary: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

games.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
games.summary: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

games.name: Asteris
games.summary: Asteris is a dark fantasy action roguelite for one to four players, with equipment and progression retained between runs. Its four classes offer 33 active skills that can be modified with runes and completion moves, alongside passive skills and eligible rune-free True Name Awakening paths. Players coordinate tank, damage and healing roles across five stages and a six-boss dungeon. Divine fragments allow transformations into five gods, and coordinated divine ultimates trigger Divine Resonance.

games.name: Soulstack
games.summary: Idle card RPG on a table. Drag cards onto each other to do literally everything. 200+ weapon recipes (only ~40 are worth keeping), 140 pet evolutions, 12 prestige classes. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

games.name: Scrolls of Alexandria: Tidy up the Lost Library
games.summary: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, reading the colour of 21 real ancient alphabets. Every cat guards one and won't let go until you pet it! Eat a golden apple for optional magic, or take a quiet afternoon in the stacks :)

games.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
games.summary: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

games.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Costs
games.summary: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

games.name: Gildoria: Organize a Dragon's Hoard
games.summary: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

games.name: The Goddess Told Me: Steal That Loaf of Bread
games.summary: A fantasy adventure about a five-millimetre ant sent by the goddess Kona to steal a seventy-two-centimetre loaf of bread. Players navigate a world built around differences of scale, crumbs and narrow passages.

games.name: Rules of the Inn
games.summary: A Japanese horror-mystery. In an inn room at the edge of the afterlife, you follow a rule added nightly and judge what slips in; by morning, open the ledger for the truth. The rules never lie, but some nights something not in them arrives disguised as something that is. Obey, or doubt? Mouse only.

games.name: Last Inspection
games.summary: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

games.name: Derail
games.summary: Derail is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with you holy camera to escape the loop.

games.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
games.summary: A 14 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

games.name: Zone L.O.S.T.
games.summary: Your body is your weakness. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

games.name: Continuum
games.summary: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

games.name: Phone Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

games.name: Drain the Galaxy
games.summary: Thousands of space dwarves vs. one planet. The planet loses. Land, strip it bare in short runs with pickaxes, lasers and missiles, haul the loot home and grow a huge upgrade tree. You can't lose. You can only get richer

games.name: Italian Street Food Simulator
games.summary: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

games.name: Spice Pound
games.summary: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

games.name: Gambapets
games.summary: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

games.name: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles
games.summary: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles is a real-time strategy game about conquering medieval islands. Grow your kingdom, raise armies, capture regions, and command entire forces. Plan your expansion, reinforce key positions, and choose the right moment to strike.

games.name: Binary Proof
games.summary: Test Specialist Aaron Blonde finds himself in the midst of uncanny and strange events during a routine workday. In this facility where the boundaries of logic are pushed, he must use every detail of his environment to his advantage and overcome the obstacles to escape as soon as possible.

games.name: A Little Faraway
games.summary: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

games.name: Prehistoric Pit
games.summary: Prehistoric Pit is a bullet heaven roguelite with voxel graphics. The player controls one of nine dinosaurs in an arena that fills with waves of Ice Age mammals, while weapons fire automatically. Between waves the player picks upgrades, limited to four weapon slots per run. Every weapon evolves into a second form at level 30 with its matching relic. A run lasts about 30 minutes across volcanic stages. Each dinosaur has its own exclusive starting weapon, active ability and passive; eight of them are unlocked through in-run challenges.

games.name: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
games.summary:
Out of the highly successful Don Bradman simulation series comes Don Bradman Cricket JR, the hard-hitting arcade cricket game. Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot, smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

Complete the Bradman Challenge Round and you'll unlock Sir Donald Bradman himself as the captain of the Australian side, along with the Bradman vs Water Tank Mini Game. Easy to pick up…impossible to put down.

games.name: Bigger Bang
games.summary: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

games.name: Not in My House
games.summary: A 1v4 home-invasion party game. The Thief shrinks the family and sucks them into his gun while he robs the house. The Residents set silly traps, kick him flat and call the police before he banks $5,000. Then the lights go out: flashlights against night vision.

games.name: Mono Chameleon
games.summary: Mono Chameleon is an online hide-and-seek game for 2 to 10 players, drawn in four dithered shades of olive and cream. Hiders sample colors from walls and floors with an eyedropper and paint their own bodies with brushes, down to the thin mortar lines between bricks, to blend into the scenery. Seekers search in first person with no radar, relying on their eyes, a five-shot catch-gun and a whistle that sounds late in each round. The game has five modes (Normal, Infection, Double, Tag and Prop Hunt), and bots fill empty slots.

games.name: Grim Guild
aliases: グリムギルド～冒険者ギルド経営～
games.summary: A management game about sending other people into danger. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: write each contract (the pay, how plainly the danger is written, whether they may turn back), never see the fight, read the report, and count who comes back at the door. Monsters, grief, trust and ale. A year ends at the old quarry and is bound into a book. Optional asynchronous shared towns of up to 100 halls over Steam.

games.name: Blindsight
games.summary: Your voice lets you see. It also lets them find you. BLINDSIGHT is a co-op horror game for 1 to 4 players about hauling loot through the dark and knowing when to shut up. Bring friends. Preferably ones who can handle five seconds of silence.

games.name: Manus Sors
games.summary: A puzzle and mystical horror game in which Grandma's cozy house hides dark family secrets. Explore every room, solve the puzzles, and stay alert: every detail counts here!

games.name: Escape: The Cabin
games.summary: Trapped, alone, and hunted by a captor who knows your past. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover the truth, and escape before the cabin breaks you. With 70+ randomised puzzles and solutions, every nightmare changes as you fight to get back to your family.

games.name: Eventlocation Simulator
games.summary:
Build your own club. Run the night. Deal with the chaos.
Turn an empty venue into a thriving nightlife destination. Design your interiors, install lighting and sound systems, hire staff, stock the bar, serve drinks, and organize everything from club nights and concerts to poker tournaments, bot fights, and boxing events.
Outside your doors, explore a strange city filled with eccentric characters, side jobs, minigames, and secrets. Earn money, make questionable decisions, and try to keep your business—and yourself—in one piece.

games.name: Type Me Home
games.summary: A platformer controlled by typing commands.

games.name: Afterpub
games.summary: Grandpas in wheelchairs, a pub full of games and a mountain to race over. Bet on the chaos, throw everything you grab, and play with friends online in Mountain Run, 1v1 Duels and many party games.

games.name: Dungeon Munchies 2
games.summary: Who in their right mind would even WANT to eat cosmic monsters? Find out in this side-scrollin', action-fightin', level-grindin', treasure-lootin', dungeon-munchin' grubapalooza!

games.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
games.summary: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

games.name: Wretched
games.summary: Wretched is a turn-based tactical game focused on strategic positioning, skill combinations and devastating attacks. Play as an ancient being of immense power. Move into range, kick enemies away and slip behind others. Chain your skills and make every turn count.

games.name: Wrong Mine
games.summary: Wrong Mine is a cooperative multiplayer game where a team of space miners explores dark underground caves, collects valuable resources, and works together to repair their excavator and escape. Watch out for the relentless alien spider lurking in the depths! Outsmart it using electric traps, help your teammates or betray them to steal their loot and see how much you can bring back alive.

games.name: OneBody Together
games.summary: OneBody Together is a cooperative party game in which 3 to 10 players on a team share control of a single character. Each player claims a different role that controls part of the character's actions, and the team must coordinate for the body to move and fight as one. Two teams compete across several modes: a timed PvP Arena, a Parkour race to the finish line, and Keg Delivery, where teams carry a keg to the opposing team's base. Matches are played online with friends through Steam lobbies.

games.name: Hijura Scarlet Gear
games.summary: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

games.name: Neon Rhythm Plus
games.summary: Every song is a boss fight in this hand-drawn dual-screen rhythm game. Time your moves to the beat of the music, or make your own custom tracks.

games.name: Phuy
games.summary:
Phuy is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players set in a mysterious museum filled with dangerous creatures, unusual puzzles, and interactive environments.

Players must explore the museum, collect six valuable objects, and escape while avoiding monsters and overcoming environmental challenges. The game features proximity voice chat, physics-based interactions, cooperative puzzles, and the ability to carry, throw, and revive teammates.

Each expedition combines exploration, survival, and unpredictable situations as players work together to make it out alive.

games.name: Helsinki Online
games.summary: Helsinki Online is a cosy multiplayer life sim set in a 1:1 recreation of real Helsinki. Walk, cycle, drive, ride the trams and the metro, or turn into a goose and fly over the city. Find a flat in any apartment building and furnish it, take on odd jobs and adventures, meet other players and explore the whole city together, right in your web browser.

games.name: Rinha de Waifus
games.summary: Build a team of cute waifus, put them exactly where you want and then let them fight. You don't control a single thing once the battle starts, so a win means your setup was right, but a loss means you get to stare at the wreckage and figure out why.

games.name: Math Duck+
games.summary: Math Duck+ is a puzzle‑platformer where you must collect the correct numbered blocks to complete each equation while avoiding hazards and racing against the clock. Solve all the equations to reveal the key, then grab it and reach the exit before time runs out.

games.name: WORKS: Motorsport Factory
games.summary: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive.

games.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Dawn of the Delta
games.summary: Discover Aegyptus, build cities in its river delta, and use the floods to your advantage. If you can handle the local raider and get along with the new rival governor, this province offers many opportunities!

games.name: Hide No More
games.summary: Hide No More is a sound-driven Blindfold Hide and Seek game,Supports up to 8 players online. Blindfolded Hunters can sense their surroundings within just 5 meters, but sound can lead them to their targets. Hiders must use distance and the environment to evade capture.

games.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
games.summary: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

games.name: The Smiling Flesh
games.summary: Steal the treasure. Stay quiet. Escape a hunter that anticipates your next move. The Smiling Flesh is a first-person survival horror game where you solve the mansion's puzzles, hide from its twisted owner, and evade a creature that can cut off your escape.

games.name: GeForce 8800 GTX: 20 Years of a Legend
games.summary:
Celebrate 20 years of a GeForce legend and rediscover the thrill of unboxing a new GPU. Created by Dylan Browne, this experience revisits 2006 with cutting-edge GeForce RTX technology.

Step into a 2006-era PC gaming room, unbox the GeForce 8800 GTX, inspect it up close, and install it in an era-accurate PC tower. Explore nods to GeForce history and hidden easter eggs as DLSS 4.5 with Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction, path tracing, and Mega Geometry bring the nostalgic setting to life. From holding the card to the glow of the monitor, rediscover a moment in PC gaming history - or experience it for the first time!

games.name: Wing Commander: 35th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Wing Commander defined the space combat genre upon its release in 1990. Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

games.name: Wing Commander II: Vengeance of the Kilrathi - 35th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Wing Commander II pushed the boundaries for storytelling in games upon its release in 1991. Now celebrated in this special 35th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

games.name: Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger - 30th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger is one of the most iconic games of the 1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

games.name: Wing Commander IV: The Price of Freedom - 30th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Wing Commander IV: The Price of Freedom is one of the most iconic games of the 1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

games.name: Wing Commander Prophecy: 30th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Wing Commander: Prophecy includes the base game plus the amazing Secret Ops episodes. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated Wing Commander community.

games.name: Privateer 2: The Darkening - 30th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Privateer 2: The Darkening is a definitive example of PC gaming expression during the mid-1990s. Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored in collaboration with the dedicated community.

games.name: Road Rash: 30th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Road Rash, the franchise which defined the combat racing genre, returns in the first ever digital version of the game. This 30th Anniversary Edition includes a fully relicensed soundtrack, higher resolution cinematics, up to 60 FPS gameplay, and more.

games.name: Neuroflip
games.summary: Neuroflip is a roguelike memory card game. A run crosses three acts, each a path of battles, elite fights, merchants and treasures that ends in a boss: the Scribe (Jack), the Lady (Queen) and the King. In every stage the player flips cards to find matching pairs before time runs out. Mismatching a card that has never been seen is free, but failing to match a card whose partner has already been seen costs a life. Consecutive matches build a combo that multiplies the score, and cards come in rarities that raise their value. Bosses and elites change the rules of the stage: the Scribe swaps cards around, the Lady veils the table and the King has three crowns to break. Bombs, ghosts, jokers and treasure chests are shuffled into the grid. Between stages the player earns active skills, played by dragging them onto the board, and passive relics, and can buy more from merchants. The game has three difficulty levels, a second deck with its own bosses (the Creatures Deck) unlocked after the first win, a local leaderboard, controller support and 21 languages.

games.name: Pet Human
games.summary: Your livestock have human faces. Your customers have animal heads. Run a cursed farm, fulfil unsettling orders, and keep $300 by 5 AM. Buy weapons from a sinister merchant and uncover what waits beneath the farm in this first-person horror game.

games.name: Performance Review: Survivor
games.summary: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. This office roguelite throws hordes of coworkers and AI managers at you — snowball office supplies into a screen-clearing build and outlast 30 brutal years of reviews, debt, and firings. Clock in. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

games.name: The Wrong Shift
games.summary: A chaotic co-op warehouse game where you and your friends unload deliveries, drive forklifts and pack orders while everything goes wrong. Fight off robbers, deal with workplace disasters and keep orders moving through unexpected chaos. Just another shift.

games.name: False Feed
games.summary: False Feed is a single-player deduction puzzle game in which players compare four surveillance recordings of the same event and identify the one that contradicts the other three. Players can pause, rewind, jump to specific times, and advance second by second or frame by frame. The game contains 18 recordings across six work sites, with no time limit.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Title Update 1.8.0
games.summary: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Title Update 1.8.0 is a free update. It introduces New Game+, letting players restart the story while keeping their progression, with increasing difficulty in later playthroughs. The update also adds Mithril as a new upgrade resource, expands equipment upgrade levels, and introduces an optional progression mode. Additional features include an equipment and rune storage system in Ravensthorpe, expanded Rune Forge functionality, and a new outfit based on Naoe from Assassin's Creed Shadows. The update also includes combat balancing adjustments and visual enhancements for PlayStation 5 Pro.

games.name: Crops & Coops
games.summary: Build a small island farm alone or in online co-op with up to three friends. Grow crops, fish and automate your farm in a relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

games.name: Truck World: Australia - Paint Jobs Pack 1
aliases: Truck World: Australia - Paint Jobs Pack №1
games.summary: Expand your customization options with 12 additional paint jobs for your truck.

games.name: You'll Be Mined
games.summary: You're lost in a dungeon. An incremental crawler built around minesweeper: clear fields, collect modifiers, buy multipliers, and push tiny numbers to absurd heights. The place is full of skeletons, and some of them would rather you never made it out…

games.name: CEO: Chief Extermination Officer
games.summary:
An asymmetric virtual reality party game set in a fast food factory overrun by vermin. One player wears the headset as a greedy executive working the assembly line alone, catching ingredients off a conveyor, building plates to match incoming orders, and fending off pests with bare hands, swatters, bug spray, zappers, and traps. The other players join on Android phones as rats, cockroaches, ants, spiders, flies, or wasps, each with its own way of moving and causing trouble, and set out to steal, spoil, or knock away the food and sabotage the factory's machinery.

Rounds are short, and the headset changes hands between them so that each player takes a turn on both sides. Points earned as the executive and as a pest add up to one running total, and the highest score at the end of the match wins.

games.name: BAS: Instagib
games.summary: BAS: Instagib is a fast multiplayer arena shooter in the classic mould: everyone carries the same railgun and every hit is an instant kill. Quake-style movement with strafe jumps and bunny hops, deathmatch and team deathmatch, leaderboards and seasons – right in your browser.

games.name: Legends of Rock
games.summary: Start as a broke musician. Build your rock band, master songwriting, rehearsals, and gigs, and juggle a day job to pay the bills. Shop for records, instruments, and groceries, recruit bandmates, and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.

games.name: Astrokicker
games.summary: Mixing old and new, Astrokicker is inspired by classic shootemups going back to the 80s, with a few twists. The player gets to fly in any direction, and using a combination of skill and strategy, takes out the starbases controlling warpfields.

games.name: Saloon Simulator
games.summary: An abandoned Saloon is waiting for you to restore its former glory. Find out that managing a saloon isn't just about creating drinks and meals. Clean up, organize, and choose the right friends - all to become the most recognizable business in the Wild West!

games.name: Zed Zone
games.summary: A great catastrophe has come, and you, who are on duty, crash and trapped in a Zed Zone. There are zombies and monsters everywhere, In order to escape, by collecting materials, upgrading skills, building shelters, defeating zombie waves and mysterious mechs, chasing a glimmer of hope.

games.name: Annum Crossroads
games.summary: Navigate a vast wilderness, battling countless enemies with the goal of liberating a desperate civilization from tyranny.

games.name: Dungeons & Furries
games.summary: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

games.name: Psychotrons
aliases: The Amazing Universe of the Psychotrons
The Amazing Universe of the Psychotrons.exe
games.summary: Adventure 2D, retro but not pixel art, you are Agent Plotkin and you wander in O'Psy Town to collect the lost neurons of a mad professor overhauled by its own obsessions. He called those PSYCHOTRONS! Jabby and nervous entities of the subconscious.

games.name: PianoGlow
games.summary:
Multiplayer piano visualizer (QWERTY & Midi inputs supported). Customizable themes. Render video & audio from within the app!

The virtual piano can be played either with your computer keyboard or a real piano. With multiplayer mode, you can play duets or as part of a band, or take turns!

games.name: Gear Up Einstein!
games.summary: A strategic roguelite auto-battler for 1-3 players. Travel through time, recruit historical figures, and gear them up with badass equipment for ridiculous combos. Master tactical missions solo or with friends. Ready to save the world?

games.name: Homepage
games.summary: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

games.name: Spark Quest
games.summary: Get ready for a race against the clock where you'll control a team of bulbs with unique abilities! In each level, you'll help these fragile bulbs overcome obstacles, rescue their companions, and finally light up in their sockets before time runs out.

games.name: Hero Slayers
games.summary: Hero Slayers is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG. You must shape the fate of Lucy, who finds herself trapped in a crisis from which there's no easy escape due to a single misstep. Even if you fail, make different choices next time—so that you may reach a better ending.

games.name: Number Machine
games.summary: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

games.name: Amber of The End
games.summary: Amber of The End is a strategic card-based RPG. Dong Yue, about to start his second year of university, finds himself trapped in a time loop and reliving this unusual autumn.Meet intriguing friends, build unique card decks, defeat strong enemies, and find the truth hidden at the end of this autumn.
developers: SUAN JIANG GUO Network Technology Co., LTD
publishers: SUAN JIANG GUO Network Technology Co., LTD

games.name: Motorcycle Ride: Infinity
games.summary: Cruise on an endless highway with light traffic and no turns. Motorcycle Ride: Infinity is all about freedom, flow, and the joy of riding—without stress or objectives.

games.name: Grave of Voices
games.summary:
This is a first-person survival horror game focused on atmosphere, exploration, and tension. You’ll search for clues, solve environmental puzzles, and scavenge resources to survive. There is no signal and your phone is useless. Every step forward could reveal something vital or something hunting you.

Hide when you can. Fight when you must. Explore the catacombs in order to escape this messed up place. But the deeper you go the more your brain becomes messed up.

Will you escape… or end up as just another set of bones beneath the city?

games.name: A Dogs Dream
games.summary: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

games.name: The Rusted
games.summary: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. THE RUSTED is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

games.name: Gem Beasts
games.summary: Gem beasts is a creature collector, rogue-lite, where you become the leader of your own crystal clan. Fight and collect other creatures to play as, and explore different build combinations between their abilities.

games.name: Eye of Syn
games.summary: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

games.name: NebulArena
games.summary:
Nebularena immerses you in futuristic PvP battles on space platforms, completely automated through your strategy. You will create the ultimate ship that will confront the constructions of other players in deathmatches where anything goes...

Build, customize, and unleash your ultimate space platform in NebulArena, a fast-paced, fully automated PvP arena where strategy, design, and destruction collide!

games.name: Grégoire Lefèbvre Investigations: The Vow of Hate
games.summary: Step into a fully voice-acted French detective story — uncover a dark mystery as Grégoire Lefèbvre in a gripping point & click narrative adventure.

games.name: Low Earth Orbit Adventures
games.summary: Low Earth Orbit Adventures is a relaxing space sim set in the near future where the space around Earth has become a frontier of science, commerce and diplomacy. Retrieve the Hubble, rescue astronauts, assemble space stations and many other missions in this realistic but friendly adventure.

games.name: Involuntary Fighting Simulator
games.summary:
An absurd, unique, and simple auto battler that is full of over the top violence and silliness. You will manage, equip and train your volunteers to compete at the highest level!

Unlock, purchase and customize your volunteers with over 50 items that have randomized values using the color system everyone loves! Weapons will range from the standard sword and maces to power tools and adult toys. Plenty of purely cosmetic items are available to get those volunteers looking just right!

games.name: Lost Media Agency
games.summary: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

games.name: Flashes of Chaos
games.summary: A fast-paced roguelike top-down shooter about building brutal guns. Collect ammunition cards, add modifiers, and load them into your weapon of choice to create your own unique experience of pure, adrenaline-fueled destruction.

games.name: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
games.summary: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

games.name: Campfire Harmony
games.summary: An adorable fox lives on your desktop, reacting to your typing to keep a campfire burning. Earn coins, upgrade, and decorate a lakeside camp in a transparent overlay. Cozy, zero-stress companion for work or study.

games.name: Degenerate Star
games.summary: Degenerate Star is a surreal sci-fi horror visual novel set on a warped space ship.

games.name: Hitchhiking to Hell
games.summary: A hitchhiking journey through empty roads where every car could be your salvation… or your end. Walk through desolate places and encounter bizarre strangers along the way. Talk, decide, and survive unpredictable encounters as rumors of a roadside killer spread. While travelling towards the unknown.

games.name: The Resonance Initiative
games.summary: In this open-world factory sandbox you need to harness unique power waveforms to run your machines. Use everything as fuel, from plant life to fallen enemies. Explore the world to uncover new foes and resources to exploit as your empire grows.

games.name: Crystalyn
games.summary: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

games.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

games.name: Kuizu! Batounea!
games.summary: This is a visual novel game in which players answer quizzes to progress through the story. One of the game's key features is the unique commentary provided by the characters for most of the quiz questions.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

games.name: Pith
games.summary: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

games.name: Chocolate Parade
games.summary: A heavy-weapon battle between the mightiest sweets! "Chocolate Parade" is a crazy roguelike action game where you roll sweets and unleash heavy weapons! Players (solo or co-op) can create their own parade and compete for coins on a boss-rush battlefield!

games.name: Mr. "Bargain Expert"
games.summary: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

games.name: Leviathan: Rhino
games.summary: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

games.name: Boneyard Bounce!
games.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

games.name: It's About Pirates
games.summary: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

games.name: Find The Needle
games.summary: Your a pleasant farmer that dropped a bag of needles into a haystack, now your goal is to find the needle. Incremental game where you build multiple Satisfactory style structures and create real production lines to construct the biggest hay processing and needle finding factory possible.

games.name: Ubai Ending
games.summary: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

games.name: American Gold Rush
games.summary: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

games.name: High Voltage
games.summary: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

games.name: Grimoire of Blanks
games.summary: Grimoire of Blanks is a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder for 1 - 4 players. Players build spells during combat by filling blanks on cards with collected words, combining effects, modifiers and conditions. It features single-player and online co-op, with multiple playable mage classes and procedurally structured runs.

games.name: Zero to South
games.summary: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South. Pick up passengers, trade items, and survive the journey.

games.name: Siege of Akanor
games.summary: Siege of Akanor is a third-person medieval tower defense game in which players prepare a castle's defenses, command troops, and fight directly on the battlefield. Between waves, players can deploy and upgrade defenses before joining the battle with melee and ranged weapons. The game features a single-player campaign, cooperative multiplayer, progression systems, multiple enemy types, siege weapons, and fantasy elements including dragons.

games.name: Cozy Corner Cafe
games.summary: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

games.name: Relicta In Memoriam
games.summary: Relicta In Memoriam is a 2.5D pixel-art noir detective game. Explore the secrets of a world where supernatural phenomena threaten human life. Encounter and battle folklore creatures in intense turn-based combat, gather clues, and solve puzzles to unravel dark mysteries.

games.name: Priestess’s Delusions
games.summary: ﻿She turned my summer into a mystical tale — a delusion that melts away like snow the moment I close my eyes.

games.name: Mark My Spell
games.summary: Mark My Spell is a gesture-driven action roguelite about drawing glyphs, typing commands, and building wild spell synergies against a relentless ghost horde.

games.name: The Archive Project
games.summary: The Archive Project is an idle card collection game where you open booster packs, discover rare variants, grow your collection, and build your city. Create powerful combinations and uncover the mysteries hidden within the Archives.

games.name: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
games.summary: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

games.name: Football Academy Simulator
games.summary: Football Academy Simulator is a single player sports and management simulation where players build and run their own football academy. Create personalized training programs, develop players across five core attributes, manage equipment and facilities, operate a sports store, and build a squad from the academy’s best talents to compete in the Fantasy League.

games.name: Mystic Fog Maze
games.summary: A casual puzzle game where the player navigates through endless mazes surrounded by a mysterious fog.

games.name: Sora: Oasis Treasures
games.summary:
Embark on a breathtaking journey through the jungle skies in Sora - Oasis Treasures. Play as a vibrant parrot and soar across tropical islands, dense canopies, waterfalls, and ancient ruins. Your goal is simple yet meaningful: stay close to your flock as you all travel across the wild, untouched archipelago.

Each of the handcrafted levels features 40–60 sky markers guiding your path as your flock leads the way. Fly through wind boosts to gain speed, discover hidden shortcuts, and enjoy the feeling of freedom as you glide above treetops and turquoise waters. The world is full of life and color, rewarding you with beautiful vistas and relaxing moments of harmony in flight.
Though the skies are peaceful, you must stay alert—fall too far behind, and you risk losing the flock. Crashes don’t punish you harshly; you simply return to the most recent waypoint and continue your journey. The focus is on enjoying the adventure, soaking in the serene atmosphere, and experiencing the thrill of flying together.

With smooth controls, gentle pacing, and vibrant flocks that vary in speed each run, every flight feels fresh. Whether you're racing through the breeze or drifting lazily over a jungle river, Sora - Oasis Treasures offers a warm, relaxing escape into tropical skies where unity and exploration take center stage

games.name: Trap Testers
games.summary: Traps Testers is a co-op physics-based deathrun game where you're the one placing the traps! Compete against your friends to reach the finish line first, and try to kill them along the way.

games.name: Tank Mates
games.summary: Tank Mates is a chaotic physics-based co-op platformer where one or two players share a single tank to tackle a brutal military obstacle course. Coordinate, survive deadly obstacles, and try not to destroy your friendship.

games.name: Hidden Cat Islands
games.summary: Hidden Cat Islands is a relaxing 3D exploration game where you search for hidden cats across uniquely themed islands. Move your camera freely, use helpful hints, discover interactive objects, and find hidden photos along the way!

games.name: Akgwi Slash
games.summary: Endless hordes of ghosts swarming in. Become a Joseon exorcist, ride the 'Geogugoe,' and shout, 'Sleep the vengeful spirits. Slay the evil spirits!'

games.name: Crowns of Medieval Europe
games.summary: Lead one of ten medieval kingdoms in this turn-based grand strategy game. Expand your territory, develop your economy, strengthen your army, and shape the future of Europe through diplomacy, war, and strategic decisions.

games.name: Fish With Friends
games.summary: Fish With Friends is a cozy online fishing world for 1–8 players. Relax solo or fish with friends, chase records, compete in comps, build your collection, and cause harmless chaos with goofy physics, wild boat rides, playful fights, and fishing rod pranks.

games.name: Metro Anomaly
games.summary: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

games.name: CrazyFood
games.summary: Cook in the back of a food truck while a friend drifts through the city at full speed. Grill, chop, stack, and deliver on foot before your customers lose patience. Chaotic online co-op for 2–4 players, or team up for 4v4 Versus.

games.name: Sky Strike Overdrive
games.summary: Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

games.name: Pixel Miner
games.summary: Descend into endless layers of resource-rich caves, mine valuable ore, expand your operation with autonomous drones, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades to push how deep you can go in this minimalistic pixel-art idle/incremental indie game

games.name: Terraform Co: Factory and City
games.summary: One pod, one core, and an unsurveyed plot on a green world. Clear the ground, trap native grazers, mine metal and rock, and belt it all into a factory — then build the city that buys what you make. Fill contracts, climb the S&G-15 index, and keep the raiders off your core.

games.name: Toy Battles
games.summary: Build a squad of toys, stack buffs, and chain game-breaking combos in this roguelite auto battler. Unlock something new each run, endless synergies awaits — break the game!

games.name: Worjong
games.summary: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words. Play against the CPU or online with up to four players.

games.name: Chaotic Virus
games.summary: Fight to survive by controlling a cell in this top-down action roguelite. Destroy waves of viruses, gain experience, evolve through transformations, and create powerful combinations of active and passive abilities.

games.name: The Christmas Bakeshop
games.summary: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

games.name: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
games.summary: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

games.name: Anomaly Express
games.summary: Anomaly Express is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror aboard a winter train. Spot anomalies, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the supernatural force behind this endless journey.

games.name: Mojo Is Loved
games.summary: Mojo is about to crashout because he's 25 and isn't a world famous musician yet... Tragic! So he makes it everyone else's problem with a new song. His friends love it. They support him unconditionally... Sorry, unconditionally?

games.name: Disk-Y
games.summary: Show Yuu—a transfer student struggling with psychological issues—around the school and become a source of emotional support for her. This is a minimalist retro visual novel featuring elements of psychological horror.

games.name: Dome: Become Thyself
games.summary: Dome: Become Thyself is a simulation roguelite where the players can learn the language of emotions, explore the infinite procedurally generated world, speak to other versions of yourself, and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

games.name: Dragon's Crown Pro PC
games.summary: Dragon's Crown Pro, Vanillaware's PS4 side-scrolling beat 'em up, running natively on Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck.

games.name: Nutshot Simulator
games.summary: Throw things at people. Aim low. Nutshot Simulator is a physics comedy set in Kumquat Cove, a perfectly ordinary town with a doctor's office, a church, a frat house and a moon base. Every hit gets a slow-motion replay, the town has a life of its own, and if you can see them, you can hit them.

games.name: Silver Service
games.summary: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

games.name: My Lovely Nurse
games.summary: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

games.name: Paint the World
games.summary: A casual, first-person painting simulator with multiplayer, timelapse, and unlockable colors, tools and worlds!

games.name: Feeding Gooble
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

games.name: First Line
games.summary: A retro office mystery about tech support, deadlines, and a floor that doesn't exist. It's 2001, and you're the L1 helpdesk tech at a corporation running on an OS from another era. Close tickets against the clock. Mind your tone. Don't ask about Floor 7.

games.name: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
games.summary:
Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a single-player action roguelite built around an incremental power curve. The knight's corrupted sword drains his own health for as long as he stays in a level, so the health bar doubles as the level timer and there is no separate countdown; upgrading maximum health buys survivability and time in the same purchase.

Attacks fire automatically as a 360-degree pulse, leaving positioning as the only moment-to-moment decision, and every kill shortens the player's ability cooldowns. Death is the progression system rather than the fail state: banked gold and the permanent skill tree both survive it, so each run funds the next. Five biomes end in boss fights, and an elemental infusion system lets the player commit to fire, frost or lightning — or to the corruption itself, which is stronger and changes the ending.

games.name: Pawn Shop Days
games.summary: Run a pawnshop: inspect goods, haggle with unusual visitors, repair your finds and sell them on. Spot fakes, decide whose story to trust and invest your profits in the shop. Between questionable deals, take a moment to pet the kitten.

games.name: Carry On Together
games.summary: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

games.name: Ubai 0
games.summary:
A visual novel following Gen, the founder of Ubai, and his recounting of the events leading up to Ubai's creation together with his partners Keiji and Shizune.

One day on a shift together with Gen, Ryousuke suddenly wondered about the origins of Ubai. Upon popping the question to Gen, all Ryousuke got was the usual cold shoulder. However, Gen suddenly found himself feeling nostalgic as he recalled the events leading up to him creating Ubai together with his partners Keiji and Shizune.

games.name: Arcane Whispers: The Last Stand
games.summary: Step into the role of Zephon, the last Guardian, in this third-person action-adventure. Harness the powers of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, carefully managing each element as you battle elemental foes, solve puzzles, and explore a shattered world of floating islands.

games.name: Dingcade
games.summary: Dingcade is a 3D arcade pinball game in which players launch marbles across peg-filled cabinets and follow their paths to the landing slots. Different machines use distinct controls and scoring rules, while cosmetics and progression customize the arcade experience.

games.name: Punch the Walls
games.summary: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig deeper through harder rock, and find out what the prisoners before you left behind.

games.name: Blackbox
games.summary: BLACKBOX blends poker strategy with market trading in a high-stakes simulation. Build powerful hands, make calculated trades, and manage risk as every card combination influences your profits and losses. Chase big gains—but one decision can change everything.

games.name: Ammo Dump
games.summary: A short and dense first-person incremental shooter about one cube. Shoot it until it breaks and a bigger one slams down from the sky. Grab rounds from the ammo piles, chase bullseyes and gold cubes, and grow a skill tree from one pistol to lightning storms, turrets, meteors and a sun.

games.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor
games.summary: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

games.name: Gym Tidy Up
games.summary: Who's going to clean up that gym chaos? You, of course! In Gym Tidy Up, put the scattered dumbbells, yoga mats, and boxing gloves back where they belong. Memorize the spots for the heavy plates and make the place spotless. Remember, not everyone can lift heavy, but everyone should keep the gym clean!

games.name: Tiny Pet Salon
games.summary: A small first-person pet grooming game. Muddy pets line up outside your salon. Wash them, dry them, brush them, clip their nails and pick out a bow or a party hat. Hand them back and they rate your work. You can even keep the salon open in a corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: No One to See: Pinebark Camp
games.summary:
A short first-person psychological horror game told through Ethan’s account of a two-day camping trip in the Pinebark woods. Drive to the campsite, build a fire, cook, fish, talk with people you meet, and make choices as an unsettling presence closes in.

With a VHS-inspired look, phone messages, and microphone-based moments that react to sounds around you, the game turns silence into a part of the experience.

games.name: Goninkan
games.summary: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

games.name: Artificial Ambition
games.summary: Artificial Ambition is a real-time management simulation about building and running an artificial intelligence company. Players hire researchers, buy GPUs, train AI models, develop commercial products, and compete with rival firms while managing finances and board expectations.

games.name: Anime Shop Sort Together
games.summary: Tidy up a chaotic Akihabara anime figure shop in first-person online co-op for 1–4 players! Grab stacks of boxed figures, find the right shelf, toss them into place and unlock team skills. Every figure in its place. Together.

games.name: Noa and the Bandits' Den
games.summary: Noa and the Bandits' Den is a sneaking game where you need to find the exit without being discovered by thieves.

games.name: The Box Project
games.summary: A short first-person experimental comedy game. A voice believes modern players have become worse, and he has designed a simple test to prove it. Your task: supervise a box and prove you are a good player.

games.name: Anomia: Listening Post K-7
games.summary: Anomia - 1977. Process signals and survive the harsh nights in your new spacious work unit, somewhere up North. Something isn't quite right in the snow, and strange messages are stashed throughout your room. Play through a 10 day story or play with friends online to survive as long as you can.

games.name: Case Opened
games.summary: Roguelike-style game that opens up with your own collection. Open cases, roll wears for all weapons, get their unique skin, and beat the appraisal value in 24 levels. Collect Adhesives to use in your Master Key and have and retain all weapons that you collect through the game. No cash transactions.

games.name: Legacybound
games.summary: Legacybound is a traditional roguelike RPG with turn-based combat where your death becomes a legacy for future heroes. Choose your class and combine powerful items and skills to create countless unique builds as you explore a procedurally generated world filled with danger.

games.name: Nocturne Island
games.summary:
Nocturne Island is a set of four small daily puzzles played on a pixel-art island at night. A new set appears every day, and every player gets the same one, so results can be compared with everyone else who played that day. Each puzzle is opened from a building on the island map and is scored out of 100.

RANGE is a number trivia quiz answered with ranges instead of single numbers: a narrower range that still contains the answer scores more, and a miss scores nothing. In TANDEM, every arrow move pushes two pieces at once across a walled grid, and full points need the shortest route. CARGO is a packing puzzle about fitting fixed-shape pieces into a ship's hold, and in BLOOM six water pumps have to be set so that each flower bed gets exactly the water it needs.

games.name: Rogue Braver
games.summary: A Classic Turn-Based Roguelike RPG with Procedurally Generated Dungeons

games.name: This Floor Is Mine
games.summary: An unfolding apocalypse will challenge your decision making as you try to keep the residents of the third floor happy and alive. Will they succumb to infighting? Or will you maintain the humanity of this small community?

games.name: CatVac
games.summary: Catvac is a cozy 3D cat-collecting adventure. Daze wild cats, vacuum them up with your Catvac 3000, and use their abilities to open new areas on your way to rescue your catnapped cat Bubba. Over fifty cats to find, casino, amusement park, and so much more to explore!

games.name: Pixross Remastered
games.summary: Pixross Remastered is an overhaul of the original game aimed at making Pixross a better game overall. There are more improvements, refinements, and smaller additions for you to discover.

games.name: Just a Piece
games.summary:
Just a Piece is a relaxing puzzle game about finding the right place for every piece.

Explore 50 handcrafted puzzles across 10 charming environments, each with its own atmosphere and music. Match geometric shapes, rotate and flip pieces, and discover how different combinations fit together to complete each board. With simple controls, a cozy atmosphere, and no need to rush, Just a Piece offers a peaceful puzzle-solving experience for players who enjoy taking their time.

games.name: The Fox Exorcist Wanted to Be Respected.
games.summary: Bank balance: ₩1,400 (about $1). Kicked out of his family for never once destroying a yokai, failed fox exorcist Yeon Harang comes home to find a succubus — ranked #4,444 in the demon world — collapsed on his couch. An odd cohabitation rom-com that starts with night shifts and split chores.

games.name: The Hole
games.summary: The Hole is a cooperative horror game for one to four players. After an accident at a Soviet research institute, a living hole has opened beneath the complex. Players are liquidators sent down into it to bring back anomalous samples, old documents and everyday objects from the abandoned basements and lower levels. The layout of the Hole is different on every descent and changes while no one is looking. Each creature follows its own rule: one hunts by sound, one cannot be looked at, one comes for light, and one imitates members of the crew. Players talk through proximity voice chat and a radio, map the levels, carry heavy cargo together and rescue fallen teammates. Finds are turned in at the base to buy equipment and unlock research; experience points unlock personal items for the liquidator's suit.

games.name: Chicken Invaders Collection
games.summary:
For the first time ever, the complete collection of the Chicken Invaders saga. Contains episodes 1-5 and all associated seasonal editions.

New in collection
- Remastered graphics. Now presented in glorious 16:9 widescreen, supporting resolutions up to 4K. Each wave, cutscene, and menu has been individually reviewed and tweaked to account for the new aspect ratio and screen dimensions.
- Improved weapons. The weapon roster has been reworked and rebalanced. Weapons are equally effective and more fun to use than ever before.
- New spacecraft fleet. Fly one of four unique spacecraft, each one fully customizable.
- Built-in seasonal content. Your progress (career stats, unlockables, mission progress) is now unified across all seasons.
- New engine. More modern, more options, more visual effects, better customization of controls.

games.name: Word Solitaire: Spell Cards
games.summary: Word Solitaire: Spell Cards is a single-player word puzzle game played with letter cards. Players spell words of 3 to 8 letters using the top cards of face-up piles, removing those cards to reveal the ones beneath. Two set-aside slots hold cards for later use, and clearing every pile and slot completes a deal. The game features daily puzzles, unlimited undo, multiple language-specific word lists, and accessibility settings, with no timer or lives. The iOS version includes over 200 deals, while the browser version offers the first 50 deals and a separate daily puzzle.

games.name: Direlands: Extraction
games.summary:
Direlands: Extraction blends the chase of a looter shooter, the tension of extraction gameplay, and the depth of classic fantasy RPGs.

The Direlands are a fractured world, torn apart by ancient magical forces. Travel between distant realms is only possible through powerful portal networks, allowing adventurers to brave forgotten ruins, cursed wildernesses, and lost civilizations in search of treasure and power.

But every journey carries risk. Gather valuable loot, uncover ancient secrets, and grow stronger with each expedition—but make it back alive. Death in the Direlands means losing everything you carried with you, leaving only your hard-earned knowledge and experience behind.

games.name: Fast Lap Racing
games.summary: Take street cars to the track and race against the clock. Upgrade your car's performance and set faster lap times. Chase the perfect lap and fight for positions on the global leaderboards.

games.name: Demon Fish Dead Ahead
games.summary:
A retro-inspired turn-based RPG about exploring hellish seas and cataloging demon fish. Navigate four worlds, battle 40 enemy types, and use captured fish and battle experience to track discoveries and grow stronger.
