With 8-bit visuals, chiptune music, simple combat choices, and an overworld map, the game is designed for easy pick-up-and-play sessions.

games.name: Ritual: House Sitting
games.summary: A young woman named Nina accepts a house-sitting job recommended by a friend, tempted by the unusually generous pay. But is the house really as ordinary as it seems?

games.name: Purr Diem
games.summary: PURR DIEM is a first-person atmospheric horror game where you work shifts at a cyberpunk facility, trading credits and humanity for cybernetic upgrades to earn enough to save someone you love. Manage your quota, explore what's left behind, and decide what you're willing to give up.

games.name: Jewelry Keeper
games.summary: Sort 3,100 pieces of jewelry scattered throughout an elegant shop. Open each box, read its number, and place every ring, watch, necklace and more in its exact marked spot. Unlock helpful skills at your own pace—or race the clock.

games.name: Below the Stone
games.summary: Below the Stone is a pixel-art roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.name: Undead Development 2
games.summary: Your resources are your surroundings. Break down, drag, and nail together furniture to safeguard your home. Explore other regions to restock supplies and weapons. Construct wild defenses by nailing together unlikely objects. Fight against the hordes with online co-op in or out of VR.

games.name: SG Racing
games.summary: SG Racing is a fast, funny pixel-art kart racer set on floating isometric tracks. Race five oddball drivers, master tight corners, nail boost tiles, use ridiculous power-ups, chase perfect lap times, and fight for the championship across increasingly wild worlds.

games.name: Coin Operated Carnage
games.summary: Coin Operated Carnage is a single-player rogue-like complemented by a unique tactical fight mode. Maneuver up to three lovable heroes at a time through tile-based adventures composed of hundreds of unique unlockable game elements interacting with each other.

games.name: Terralysia
games.summary: In the vibrant realm of Terralysia lurk relentless enemies. Brace yourself for grueling missions, endless onslaughts, and formidable bosses in this third-person roguelike. Use the right strategy and spells to survive a bit longer, but be warned, as you grow in strength, so do your enemies.

games.name: Vanakatu
games.summary: A surreal story-driven game that uses puzzle-solving, turn based battling, and open world navigation to help Van Cat track down his evil uncle and put an end to his nefarious plans!

games.name: Dig
games.summary: Dig, discover, and compete in this multiplayer digging adventure! Unearth rare treasures, sell your findings, upgrade your gear, and uncover hidden secrets beneath the surface. Who will dig the deepest?

games.name: Cursed Profit
games.summary: A co-op horror game for up to 5 players where stealing more loot makes the world deadlier. Meet your quota, manage your greed, and escape before the curse takes you.

games.name: Noir Total: Deadly Party
games.summary: Noir Total is a 2D local multiplayer PvP shooter set in darkened arenas. Sneak through total darkness using your controller's vibrations, track down your enemies, collect bonuses and set traps to stay one step ahead of your opponents in fast-paced, competitive matches for up to 4 players.

games.name: Zhúlù Hàn Mò
aliases: Striving for supremacy in the Three Kingdoms
games.summary: Zhúlù Hàn Mò invites you to the exciting and transformative Three Kingdoms era at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty, where you can embark on a journey to dominate the world and unify the Central Plains with unprecedented freedom, depth and historical authenticity.

games.name: Blobby and the Milkshake
games.summary: An octopus stole your milkshake. Why? Who knows! Ride robot crabs, fly fire hydrants, sled in bathtubs, and fight power-hungry pirate clams in this goofy, open-ended 2D platformer. Explore dozens of levels, branch your path, and do whatever it takes to get your drink back.

games.name: Vinland 1000
games.summary:
A choice-driven management and narrative strategy game about leading a Norse colony in Vinland. You are handed one event at a time, each with a small set of choices, and every decision shapes the colony’s future.

Manage food, shelter, defense, popularity, and the fragile relationships that hold your settlement together. Guide your family and influence your heir, whose choices and ambitions may determine the legacy you leave behind.

Navigate the political climate between your colony and the native peoples of Vinland. At the same time, watch your colony’s faith slowly change as the old Norse gods contend with Christianity, whether through Rome, Constantinople, or the traditions your people refuse to abandon.

Across 50 in-game years, your choices shape not only whether the colony survives, but what kind of society it becomes... and what you leave behind.

games.name: Dub Party
games.summary: Dub Party is a party game where players replace every voice in a video with their own. Import a clip or pick a community scene, claim the roles, record each line, then watch the finished dub together. Play solo, pass one mic around the couch, or invite up to seven friends online.

games.name: Ballshit 2D
games.summary: Eggy, an otaku, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cute girl?! Ballshit 2D reimagines the original live-action story as a 2D visual novel. Follow Eggy through campus life, friendships, awkward romance, and absurd surprises, with new 2D art, CGs, and the original voice acting.

games.name: Spellk
games.summary: Spell a word. Smash an enemy. Turn random letters into attacks and stack strange items into ridiculous builds. Make rare letters hit harder or long words pay off in this turn-based word-combat roguelite, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: Rotaliate
games.summary: A very simplistic fast paced puzzle game. Single player modes compete for most efficient or fastest time where multiplayer modes fight to be the first to clear their color from the board. Elo style ranking and more play modes coming eventually!

games.name: Tiny Havoc
games.summary: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.

games.name: 3 Estrellas
games.summary: Top-down arcade football for the whole crew. Up to 6 players on one couch, or online with friends over Steam. Tournaments, football-tennis, penalties, minigames and legendary moments to fire up the match. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Grab a controller and score!

games.name: Losers Club
games.summary: Losers Club is a multiplayer trivia game for you and your friends. Pick a question pack, test your knowledge, race to answer first, and compete for the top spot. Create your own quizzes, customize the rules, and turn any game night into a battle of brains.

games.name: Mox Nox
games.summary: Become the last Reaper in a dark fantasy action RPG built around brutal swordplay and supernatural power. Perfect your parries, turn dodges into counters, summon phantoms and tear through the alliance hunting your bloodline. Claim their souls. Grow stronger. Reclaim your birthright.

games.name: Table of Truth
games.summary: What do your friends really think of you? Vote on the funny ‘pros and cons’ questions in this chaotic party game. Guess what the majority thinks and bag the points. Will you leave the table as the group’s brains or as a walking disaster?

games.name: GomokuZero
games.summary: A five-in-a-row board game with an engine that explains itself: every move comes with the shape it built, the threat it answered and the alternatives it weighed. Learn from ten lessons and 1,680 proven puzzles, review your games move by move, and play ranked online or entirely offline.

games.name: Thập Tuyệt Trận
aliases: Thập Tuyệt Trận Mobile và PC
games.summary: Thập Tuyệt Trận is a 2.5D massively multiplayer online role-playing game set in a world of Asian mythology, featuring magical artifacts (pháp bảo) and divine beasts (Thần Thú). The game is playable on Android, iOS and PC, with one shared account, shared character data and shared servers across all platforms. Published in Vietnam by VIOPLAY.

games.name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
games.summary: The Saurian Alliance is threatened by The Theropod Empire. That's scary. Our heroes, a ragtag group of dinosaurs from all walks of life (and one that is definitely not a Corgi-Iguanodon hybrid), must band together to fight back against the dark side of The Moon(tm).

games.name: The Belonging
games.summary:
Solve puzzles, pick up key items, and navigate the hallways where she stalks you. Be careful with your flashlight, it may reveal your position.

You haven't heard from your busy wife in a while. You visit the Walker family's house, it's where she works. You wish you never knew what she was working with.

It's lurking on the basement floor. It's sensitive to light. Hide in the dark.

games.name: Pirate Skulls and Sails
games.summary: Grab your crew and sail into chaos! Man the cannons, patch the hull and survive the Ghost Ship's volleys in a wild 1-4 player pirate co-op. Host with one click, friends join through Steam. No servers. No accounts.

games.name: The Backrooms: Liminalphobia
games.summary: Liminalphobia is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game set in The Backrooms. A man named James is lost, leaving behind notes as the only guide to finding him. Explore the liminal levels, manage your resources, solve puzzles and avoid the entities throughout the levels.

games.name: MultiScope Air Traffic Control
games.summary: Take control of the skies. MultiScope Air Traffic Control is a realistic approach radar simulator where you vector arrivals, sequence approaches and keep them separated from your departures. Use your own voice or the input panels, with pilot readbacks over simulated VHF radio.

games.name: Yehangchuan
games.summary: 深夜的小巷，她从电台里走到了你面前，从那一刻起声音不再只是声音，它染上了温度，也变得更加沉重。你开始重新审视自己，他人，以及这座县城里被遗忘的烟火与孤独。这是一个关于倾听与理解的漫长航行，在无边的黑暗中，你与她一同探索，寻找那道或许并不存在的光。

games.name: Rent Out Together
games.summary: Design your dream home, start a rental business with friends and see how your plans change when the guests arrive.

games.name: Iron Thumbs
games.summary: Iron Thumbs is a collection of 70+ party games played in a web browser on a shared screen, such as a smart TV, a laptop or a projector, with the players' phones as controllers. Players scan a QR code on the big screen and play by tapping, tilting, swiping, shaking or drawing on their phone, depending on the game. The games include races, sports, drawing, quizzes, reflex duels and brawls, with rounds of one to two minutes for 2 to 8 players, and bots fill the empty seats if needed. No app, account or console is needed, and it is free to play.

games.name: Bleach: Soul Resurrección PC Recomp
games.summary: A static recompilation of Bleach: Soul Resurrección (PS3) for Windows.

games.name: Raise
games.summary: Rise from the grave in a compact third-person soulslike. Battle undead and bosses, level up your character and master timed arena challenges. Every hit taken costs time; every parry improves your score. Refine your runs and compete on Steam leaderboards.

games.name: ToonSouls Maker
games.summary: Create, play, and share your own chaotic 2D platforming levels! Inspired by classic cartoons, powered by your creativity, and fueled by one simple truth: My game is good. The algorithm just ignores me.

games.name: Yāo Xiān Dòngfǔ
games.summary: Seek out gifted cultivators, subdue them, form a powerful squad, and lead them to fight with monsters to obtain top-tier weapons and items. There are also rich outfits for dressing up. Abundant buildings and foliages are available for you to create your own private garden.

games.name: Prerolled
games.summary:
Pack boxes of pre-rolled dice and sell them to silly clients with funky requests in this roguelike-puzzle mix up.
Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice around them, so combo dice together, overcharge shamelessly and maybe you'll be able to cover the rent this week!

games.name: Garden of Being
games.summary: Garden of Being is a handmade oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

games.name: Company Tycoon
games.summary: A cyberpunk-styled business simulation and tycoon game where players build, scale, and manage their own tech empire.

games.name: On Love, On Monsters
games.summary: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

games.name: Corposlop
games.summary: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvesting resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make advanced factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out the limited land you have.

games.name: Kebab Dynasty
games.summary: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

games.name: Romul
games.summary: Romul is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

games.name: Console Repair Simulator
games.summary: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

games.name: Arcane Architect
games.summary: Become a master mage in Arcane Architect, a tactical first-person VR Tower Defense! Construct unique towers from three customizable sections, brew powerful potions, and personally crush menacing bosses with your combat staff.

games.name: EVO RNG
games.summary: EVO RNG is a slot machine god simulator: Choose creatures, press spin, and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge, and evolve on its own. Collect creatures, chase paylines, food chains, and mythical beings.

games.name: Hamstr Protocol
games.summary: Build a hamster-powered bio-mining operation from the ground up. Assemble rigs by hand, manage heat, feed your runners, and keep production moving. Start in a garage, optimize every part of your operation, and scale into a full-scale industrial operation.

games.name: Kabzda
games.summary:
Kabzda is a Ukrainian online multiplayer economic strategy and board game inspired by classic property-trading mechanics. Set in a modern Ukrainian business universe, players compete across a 40-tile board featuring 28 Ukrainian companies divided into 10 economic sectors - ranging from coffee shops, postal logistics, and retail networks to fintech banks, AI startups, energy grids, and sea ports.

The game features live timed property auctions, smart trade contracts between players, 32 Ukrainian event cards ("Digital Push UA" and "Unity Fund"), a 2v2 Alliance team mode with shared monopolies, and voiced AI opponents (Pan Lev, Lesia, and Taras) with three difficulty levels. Playable directly in modern web browsers on desktop and mobile devices.

games.name: After All, I Never Realised
games.summary: Explore the past and present, and uncover everything that happened during those seasons.

games.name: Signs of Life
games.summary: Signs of Life is a sci-fi survival sandbox platformer with a combination of procedurally generated and hand-crafted content. You'll explore mysterious locations, Mine blocks for resources, and meet strange (and some familiar) creatures, some of which don't even want to kill you and eat your corpse. Along the way, you'll be able to craft armor, weapons, gadgets and more to assist you in surviving in an inhospitable environment.

games.name: Zap Blastum
games.summary: Become Zap - dreamer, fighter, and maybe just the hero the galaxy needs! Robots have invaded your planet, and they don't even see you as a threat. Beat the odds and SAVE THE GALAXY in this mouse-only cover shooter!

games.name: Last Chickenburg
games.summary: This is a fresh and action-packed sandbox game. Collect resources, make equipment, hone combat skills, occupy enemy bases, and master the map!

games.name: Kingslayers
games.summary:
Kingslayers is a free-to-play Roguelite featuring both turn-based and real-time strategy elements. Select your team and choose your skills, then jump into a run to see what broken builds you can create!

Once you get your bearings, you can conquer ever-increasing ascension difficulties in single-player mode or enter multiplayer and try to climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Singleplayer- Relax and Enjoy the ride

Theory craft and min-max to your hearts content in this chill mode. See how high you can go in the ascension ranks or just create some cool unique builds. How about a build where you constantly have a Dragon die to make use of its on-death true damage dealing fireball passive? Or one where each shot from the archer fires 30 arrows? There's thousands of builds waiting for you to explore.

Multiplayer- A turn based game where speed and reaction time actually matters.

The multiplayer is designed for fast-paced, chaotic action. You and your opponent will traverse an identical run and meet at different stages to showcase your builds and outwit each other. This isn't your regular turn-based strategy - speed, quick decisions, and quick reactions are going to play a major part in you climbing to the top of the rankings.

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

games.name: The Great Sassanelli
aliases: The Great Sassanelli – An Interactive Novel
games.summary: As war breaks out all around you on a scale never seen before, you, ringmaster dilettante, must keep the circus afloat. Travel, entertain, and keep the troupe’s spirits up on your way to find a mythical safe haven to last out the storm in this beautifully illustrated, text-based narrative adventure.

games.name: Territorial Hissing
games.summary: Territorial Hissing is a 2D sidescroller adventure about bringing down a corrupt corporation in an otherwise bright and colorful land. Something smells fishy. Save your home in this comedy adventure!

games.name: SuperNatural Market: Sell or Die
games.summary: Run a supernatural supermarket for zombies, vampires, werewolves, and cyborgs. Stock your shelves, grow your business, gamble at the bar, hire muscle, and sabotage rival stores. But be ready when they strike back. Explore the strange neighborhood, uncover its dark secrets, and remember: sell or die.

games.name: One Fenix Down
games.summary: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

games.name: Isekai Survivors
games.summary: Isekai survivors is an Action roguelite with RPG elements and addictive gameplay loop, cute stylized art style and attractive heroines with unique playstyles to choose from. Collect items, complete quests, upgrade your stats and learn new powerful spells to dominate the battlefield.

games.name: HitTube
games.summary: HitTube is an open-world roguelike looter shooter, play solo or in 2–4 player co-op! You're a post-apocalyptic streamer who fights for donations while streaming your survival. Shoot, loot, trade and use magical cards to gain superpowers in a procedurally generated world!

games.name: Ballardo
games.summary: A strategic twist on classic pool games! Merge skillful billiards gameplay with roguelike mechanics to conquer increasingly challenging stages. Customize your playstyle with unique stickers, relics, and items to create a one-of-a-kind billiard experience.

games.name: Cardalaxy
games.summary: Cardalaxy is a card upgrading game with 4X inspiration and 5+ different victories.

games.name: Dreadmoor
games.summary: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.summary: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

games.name: Casualties: Unknown
games.summary: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

games.name: Toadled: Eating Frenzy
games.summary: Grow from a tiny tadpole to cosmic menace in Toadled: Eating Frenzy, the frantic single-stick roguelike. Test your reflexes and make smart choices as you upgrade through hundreds of new mutation combos, fight bosses, and become the universe!

games.name: Pixel Pegz
games.summary: A vibrant arcade game inspired by pachinko and coin droppers. Launch balls, hit pegs to fill your energy bar, unlock new characters by collecting cards, and create combos in colorful pixel art levels with custom level editing and endless replayability.

games.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
games.summary: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

games.name: Vena
games.summary: Roguelike deckbuilder meets hex-tile city builder! Build a resource engine to survive the center’s rising demands. Place producers, converters, and combo-rich tiles. Roll dice to shop, pick perks, and chase wildly different builds every run.

games.name: 1999Tokoyo Building
games.summary: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... Did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

games.name: Tricolo
games.summary: The puzzle size is limited to 9 squares. Tricolo is a 2D grid puzzle where you move pieces on the board to the goal. Its defining feature is that every puzzle is only 3×3 in size. The sophisticated puzzle rules and various gimmicks demand deep thought within a limited space.

games.name: Abracademia
games.summary: Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play. Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.summary: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

games.name: Cats Hidden in Advent Calendar
games.summary: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advents calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this cute HOG by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cats game creator!

games.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
games.summary: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

games.name: The Gardener
games.summary: Solve tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

games.name: Alterum
games.summary: Social deduction horror game with voice recognition, full of betrayal and dark rituals. Awaken in a cult of restless souls: spells spoken aloud summon powers - or doom. Alliances or deceit: can you distinguish truth when a word is a curse?

games.name: Kimbap Heaven Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Korean restaurant in Kimbap Heaven Simulator. Dive into a realistic cooking experience—wash, blanch, and roll your way to success. Satisfy customers with delicious recipes, manage your finances, and expand your business to build a culinary empire.

games.name: Boss in Diapers
games.summary: Boss in Diapers is a party game set in a chaotic daycare! Defeat your rivals to sit on the Boss Chair. Create your little troublemaker and battle with 2–4 players to rule the daycare.

games.name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
games.summary: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! To please them and uncover their secrets, take control of captive creatures, explore Demigod Islands and solve 50+ mindbending puzzle rooms by... killing yourselves. In this puzzle platformer, death is the goal and it can take many shapes and forms.

games.name: Voody Hex
games.summary: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - Your only way to survive is to dodge.

games.name: Takeover 2
games.summary: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

games.name: The Cubiw Dungeon
games.summary: A roguelike where a cube shoots to more cubes.

games.name: Fraga
games.summary: You are a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest. Survive in this procedurally generated, turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by Galician mythology. Upgrade your gear, adapt your strategy and remember: something is always lurking in the shadows.

games.name: Hell Wait
games.summary: Hell Wait is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

games.name: Flowers to Honey
games.summary: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

games.name: Revenant Survivors
aliases: レヴェナント・サバイバーズ
games.summary: Revenant Survivors is an action roguelite survival game where players defeat bosses, steal their powers, and create different skill combinations to survive waves of enemies. The game features boss-derived progression, attribute-based combat, and replayable runs with varied builds.

games.name: Runback
games.summary: Fight, upgrade, and fight again! Runback is an online roguelite party fighter where the phrase ‘best-of-five’ takes on a whole new meaning. Spend points between fights to evolve your character, turn the tide, or simply cement your dominance over your friends!

games.name: Greedy
games.summary: A raccoon co-op horror extraction game. Infiltrate procedural ruins, loot everything and extract the relic. Mammon, the Greed Demon, is watching… Stay away from his curse!

games.name: Pick a Boo
games.summary: Pick a Boo is an online co-op action game where you use magnetic powers to stick furniture together and haul it out.

games.name: Kevin's In Trouble
games.summary: Kevin’s In Trouble is a top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven where you'll battle through unrelenting waves of enemies while building a deck of powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!

games.name: The Inspector
games.summary: a Train has been infected with mysterious anomalies. G.O.A.B has secretly hired you to inspect the train. It's your job to find the anomalies and terminate them.

games.name: Grimdelve
games.summary: Grimdelve is a role playing game where the last of humanity dwells underground. Guide two souls through a dying world and decide who they become. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Become charming manipulators or complete disasters.

games.name: Fablery
games.summary: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

games.name: Hantu and Hunted
games.summary: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

games.name: Progress98
games.summary: A retro incremental idle desktop companion all about making progress on the side and at your own pace.

games.name: Wild Hive
games.summary: Build your hive and survive in this roguelike bee colony sim. Hatch worker bees, forage nectar, and get the best price for your honey on the hyper-realistic market. Keep the hive climate in check and fight off wasp raids, or watch your colony collapse. Master the hive and build your honey empire.

games.name: GoGeez
games.summary: GoGeez is a psychological idle horror game about rotting alone in your room, getting addicted to cute little chibi creatures, and ignoring the increasingly horrifying world outside your screen

games.name: Ho Ho Ho Sokoban
games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Borbs
games.summary: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

games.name: Capy of Gods
games.summary: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

games.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
games.summary: Experience the oddly satisfying world of laser hair removal! Zap through thick beards, manage your customers' pain levels, and build your hairy empire. Will you run a 5-star luxury salon or a house of screams?

games.name: Mini Mart Survivors
games.summary: SHIFT24 is a mysterious convenience store chain. As night deepens, strange customers swarm endlessly. Ramen, snacks, and coffee become weapons. Fight them off, and clues hidden in branches worldwide begin to emerge. Follow the clues and pay down your debt to uncover the truth behind SHIFT24.

games.name: Blindfold: Hide and Seek
games.summary:
Blindfold: Hide and Seek is an asymmetric online hide-and-seek game where one blindfolded seeker hunts several fugitives. Instead of relying on vision, the seeker tracks players through footsteps, echoes, and other environmental sounds, turning every tiny noise into a clue.
Fugitives can move around freely, but every movement and decision carries risk—sprint to escape faster, stay quiet to reduce your chances of being found, or use the environment to deceive the seeker. What starts as simple hide-and-seek becomes a tense psychological battle of sound, timing, and mind games.

games.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
games.summary: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

games.name: Project Tomorrow
games.summary: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

games.name: Plum
games.summary: Plum is a short (about 1h) contemplative 3D collectathon, where you play as a plum, rolling and bouncing your way through a colorful world, searching for your way home. Your journey will take you through lands, caves, snowy mountains and more. Each area with ghost plums to meet, each with a story to tell.

games.name: The Big Suck
games.summary: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Destroy fields, cars and buildings, gather wreck to grow, and spend the payday on upgrades in a huge skill tree. Past a certain size the storm stops being weather and picks its catastrophe — fire, flood, winter, or the void — while the county answers with fire crews, bomb squads, tanks and jets.

games.name: Go Next!
games.summary: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

games.name: PeeVPee
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

games.name: Another Card Game
games.summary: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

games.name: StateOS: The Political Sandbox
games.summary: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.

games.name: Seferia Matrix
games.summary: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

games.name: Sword of the Demiurge
games.summary: You have been bestowed the 'Sword of the Demiurge' and the authority to sever the bonds of soul and flesh. Make haste for your appointed time has arrived. Defeat your foes, collect their souls, and manifest your authority, until the myriads fall before you in a single moment.

games.name: Safari-TV
games.summary: Open a safari agency with friends and turn every trip into a vlog episode. Assemble a physics-driven safari truck, drive tourists across an open world, and choose peaceful tours or dangerous, high-paying routes. Smuggle contraband, film every disaster, and repair your safari truck.

games.name: Neon One-Man Army
games.summary: High-speed neon action! Swing with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne. Shoot while flying, chain movement and combat, and feel the rush of unstoppable momentum. Choose powerful cards, unlock skill chests, and master your movement to become an unstoppable force.

games.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
games.summary: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

games.name: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
games.summary:
Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn is a first-person organizing game set in a two-story medieval armory with 50 rooms. Players collect scattered weapons and place them in their assigned racks and displays. Completing rooms awards skill points that unlock abilities to help locate and organize weapons.

The game supports single-player and online multiplayer for up to four players, with cooperative and competitive modes. There is no countdown to failure; dawn arrives when the final piece is in place.

games.name: Supercar Collection Together
games.summary: Manage your own diecast store with friends! In this 1-4 player collection game, open surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together.

games.name: Evenicle: Next Fragment Medica
games.summary: In a world where human civilization is threatened by monsters, only the rare few individuals who wield forbidden skills dare challenge them. However, these brave warriors have to face an even more dangerous hazard... The Hero Syndrome. Only a young doctor can hope to cure the disease in this JRPG!

games.name: Against Heroes
games.summary:
Against Heroes is a strategy auto-battler in which players take the role of a Demon Lord defending against invading heroes.

Players recruit and deploy troops, manage resources, and choose which heroes to eliminate. Heroes grow stronger over time, and the game ends in defeat if a hero reaches the maximum level.

Players can unlock upgrades, develop strategies, and face increasingly challenging heroes as they progress through the game.

games.name: Gnart's Escape
games.summary: To escape the maze, you must survive turn-based combats in which cards will activate your weapons, and they will perform according to dice rolls. Gnart's Escape is a Deck-building Roguelike RPG.

games.name: Kreabordis
games.summary: Kreabordis is a laid-back strategy and puzzle game. Place creatures cleverly on the game board so that you score the most points at the end of a round. You can either play against the challengers and inhabitants of Kreabordis or test your skills in the Puzzle Mode. Forward thinking and tactical play are essential to mastering Kreabordis.

games.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
games.summary: A turn-based tactical RPG with deep build crafting, fully customizable equipment, massive dungeon exploration, unique handcrafted bosses, town building, romance, character questlines, and 100+ hours of loot-driven progression.

games.name: Renegades
games.summary: Renegades is a party RPG with deckbuilding combat: lead five hunted heroes, each with unique mechanics and their own deck, choose three for each fight, and survive a kingdom coming apart through tactical, story-driven battles.

games.name: Cards of Bellum
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder of strategy, dice, and luck. Master suit-based combat, turn defeat into glorious victory with a roll of the dice, and recruit unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights. Build your deck, storm the capital, and claim the throne

games.name: Waifu Curator
games.summary: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying collectible scale figures. Collect, organize, and build the perfect exhibition!

games.name: Shin'ai Rewritten
games.summary: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.

games.name: Tainted Tide
games.summary: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.

games.name: Menthal
games.summary: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

games.name: ExoFlora: First Seeds
games.summary: A cozy sci-fi farming sim. Run a greenhouse on an alien world: grow strange plants, discover reactions between neighbors (fire, frost, crystal and light), breed and name your own hybrids, survive seasons and pest swarms, and restore a dying valley through a campaign. Includes a Relaxed mode where plants never die.

games.name: What the Buck?!
games.summary: What the Buck?! is an incremental game about destroying money. Swipe a credit card through an ATM, bills land on a table, and the breaker shreds them for money. Electric bills arc to the bills next to them, explosive bills blow up the stack around them, and burning bills set their neighbours on fire. Over 240 upgrades are spread across upgrade panels, a skill tree and a prestige tree. Ending a shift turns the money destroyed into Prestige Points for permanent upgrades, so the next shift starts stronger. Mr. Buck, the player's boss, calls in with instructions and opinions.

games.name: Shademarch
games.summary: An async PvP autobattler. Build four heroes from 21 classes, draft the skills and items that change how they fight, then watch them battle other players' teams. Progress through the March, or climb the ranks on an even playing field in the Arena.

games.name: Oboro no Ichi
games.summary: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

games.name: Da Bridge Troll
games.summary: A roguelike survival sim where you rule your bridge as a cunning or ravenous troll. Eat, toll, and spare travelers to balance hunger, greed, and favor as you choose whether to become a feared predator… or a worshiped guardian of the bridge.

games.name: Duck Your Friends
games.summary: An online party shooter for 2 to 8 friends. Shooters try to snipe the Duckers while they try to reach the safe haven at the end. Revenge is guaranteed as roles rotate every round!

games.name: Zen House: Zed Zero Simulator
games.summary:
Welcome to Zen House: Zed Zero Simulator, a revolutionary masterpiece of doing absolutely nothing while feeling deeply philosophical about it.

Leave your fast-paced life behind and step into a surreal, unchanging landscape where your only companion is a lonely house under a dreamy sky. There are no complex controls, no enemies, and no stress—just you, the house, and the void.

games.name: I Walk Among Zombies Vol. 1
games.summary: Yuusuke awakens in a world where zombies have overrun civilization, but finds that the zombies don't attack him. How will Yuusuke take advantage of his new situation, and what will he discover? Enjoy this kinetic visual novel's twist on the classic zombie survival genre.

games.name: Backlog Dungeon
games.summary: Backlog Dungeon is an asynchronous co-op dungeon crawler, where your real-life gaming activity powers your party's actions. Team up with your guild to deal damage, protect your allies, and work together to overcome the monsters and challenges ahead.

games.name: Rec:Rewind
games.summary: Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him. Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

games.name: Melioristic Egalitarian Artist 1: Help! All of Art Is Trapped Until It Can Be Properly Defined!
games.summary:
In the world of Melioristic Egalitarian Artist all of art and every artist with it has been trapped within an infinitely looping dimension that harshly melds together all of art together, the artists trapped in here have one way to free themself and art with them, agree on a definition for art.

Unfortunately for the artists none of them can agree on a definition, some say only their type of artform counts, others say it cannot be defined, and others exclude certain types of art from the conversation.

The main character of this game is Sami, she believes that all art is valuable and if all the artists come together that can work together to save art so Sami decides to open a gallery in order to have a place where all the artists can gather and apricate all the forms of art.

To achieve her goal she must navigate art dimension to gather funds and locate art for the museum while avoiding discarded artworks and used up supplies that line the dimension's floors.

games.name: Your Suffering is Important To Us
aliases: Your Suffering Is Important to Us
games.summary: Run a corporate office in Hell. Hire, customize, and assign imployees, reject petty sinners, automate absurd punishments, and climb the infernal corporate ladder in this comedic incremental management game.

games.name: Blast Off!
games.summary: Blast Off! is an endless arcade climb for iPhone. Launch a rocket from the pad and fly as high as you can, steering by tilting the phone or dragging a finger. Touch anything and the flight is over. The climb runs from birds and hot-air balloons, past airliners and satellites, through meteor showers and an alien blockade into deep space, where asteroid belts, ion storms, black holes and alien armadas keep changing. Collect fuel orbs to keep the engine running, chain close calls for combos, fire a laser at rocks and alien fighters once in space, unlock 15 rockets and their paint jobs, and climb the Game Center distance leaderboard.

games.name: The Staring Man
games.summary: A first-person horror game set in a Japanese convenience store. You work the night shift alone. Across the street, a man stands staring at you every night. As you encounter inexplicable events, you investigate the mystery of a former employee who disappeared.

games.name: Ludo Fighters: Battle Board
games.summary: Ludo Fighters: Battle Board is a battle take on the classic board game Ludo for Android and iOS. Players roll the dice to deploy and race squads of cartoon soldiers around the board; landing on an enemy starts a short cartoon gun fight instead of a simple capture. Matches support 2 to 6 squads on 4-house or 6-house boards across six battlefields, with optional rules such as landmines, killstreaks, bounty, supply drops, chaos cards and 2 v 2 Squad Wars. Modes include play against Lumi AI, pass and play on one device, and online matches with quick battles and private rooms.

games.name: Yuha's Nightmares
games.summary: This is a simulation game about the nightmares that our main character Yuha suffers from. You will explore the surrealistic world that is full of unexpected events. The deeper part of Yuha's consciousness is depicted through the flip side of the 3D world.

games.name: Midwest 90: Rapid City
games.summary: Midwest 90: Rapid City is a single player, narrative focused survival- tycoon PC game, where the player Builds and Protects their restaurant that serves Monster Meat Dishes.

games.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
games.summary: We've all asked ourselves, "What happens when we die? Is there life after death? Is there a soul? What happens to it when we die? " Move beyond the veil of life and death in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a supernatural neo-classical top-down shooter!

games.name: Memento Dawn
games.summary: A colorful puzzle game that follows a lost child on a journey to search for her memories and helps her through the darkness by controlling light and shadow.

games.name: Tax-Force
games.summary: Hunt down tax-evading mutant billionaires and reinvest in society in this narrative Action Rogue-lite meets Political Sim.

games.name: Profiler Files: New Orleans
games.summary:
A narrative investigation game with a unique atmosphere, blending the spirit of Ace Attorney with the psychological tension of Criminal Minds.
Become a young FBI agent newly assigned to the field in the heart of New Orleans. In Profiler Files—a narrative investigation game with strong psychological elements—your choices, your instincts, and your analytical skills shape every case. Your decisions influence how the story unfolds, the fate of the characters… and the final outcome.

games.name: Annihilated
games.summary: Annihilated is a story-driven roguelite about a long walk home with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

games.name: Cosmic Holes Junior
games.summary: Imagine an alien Sudoku where the numbers are elements. Figure out which element to place on the grid, where, and when!? In order to maintain balance, each element must harmonize with the others. “Aliens don't play Sudoku—they play COSMIC HOLES!” For adults and children.

games.name: Stock: Retail investors
games.summary: Master a simulated economy and stock market as an investor. Manage assets, debt, and risks to strategize investments amidst market fluctuations. Achieve success through smart risk-taking and financial planning.

games.name: Stormforge
games.summary: Stormforge is an open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. You are Stormforged, with the ability to brave and harness power from magical storms. Explore, fight, forage, craft, build, and defeat bosses in this epic, fantasy game. Survive the Storms and thrive!

games.name: Nocturnal II
games.summary: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

games.name: Dashoot: Abya's Adventure
games.summary: Shoot to move in a hardcore precision platformer. As ABYA, a robot from ruins, use your floating cannon to trigger mechanisms, flip platforms, and launch through a post-human world guided by AI Deus. Every shot counts; one mistake resets. Uncover the truth.

games.name: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
games.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Ascension: The Immortal Alchemist
games.summary:
Ascension follows the trials and tribulations of an Immortal Alchemist and his quest throughout time to transmute humans in to gods. Players descend into an ancient labyrinth where their souls are tested by cosmic forces to challenge the limitations of their mortality. Do you have what it takes?

Ascension is a modern resurrection of the classic 3D Action Adventure Genre - Inspired by the legendary writings of Hermes Trismegistus - a figure who rose to prominence in the mystery schools of Hellenistic Egypt & Greece, and whose timeless teachings are as relevant today; as they were when they were written.

Action-adventure, puzzle, platforming, atmospheric, difficult, speedrunner, escape room, maze

games.name: One More Plate
games.summary: One More Plate is a physics-based quirky funny game. Here, you'll serve food on ANYTHING but proper plates! Keep your balance, aim carefully, and then you will be rewarded with…… One More Plate!

games.name: Pocket Legend
games.summary: In Pocket Legend, a roguelike deck-builder, you control a hero transported to a world of legendary weapons. Strategically arrange items in your inventory to defeat enemies with unique attack patterns. Customize your setup, unlock powerful cards, and uncover the fate of the dark forces.

games.name: Shadey's Quest
games.summary: Shadey’s Quest is an autobattler roguelike featuring character building. Shadey is a monster who wants to be a hero, but the only thing he is good at is eating. Guide him through a rich fantasy world, feed and equip him, and help him defeat the fearsome King of Shadows!

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary: A disappearance in a secluded mountain. A village hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

games.name: Shock
games.summary: In SHOCK, you play as a disabled war veteran, hunted by a cybernetic creature. With only a wheelchair for mobility, use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape. Survive the horror and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

games.name: Unboxing: 1-Bit Paradox
games.summary: UNBOXING is a puzzle-platformer where death is your key. Die, revive, and solve tricky puzzles using your companion box to return back to life. Will you find the cause of this endless cycle? Will you break free?

games.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Iceland
games.summary: Explore the Land of Fire and Ice! Iceland stands apart as one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth, an incredibly unique landscape with completely unmatched rugged nature. Now, you have the chance to experience it all from a truly unique perspective - behind the wheel of your truck.

games.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
games.summary: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets. Pick pallets up, put them down, the only limit is your imagination!

games.name: Abomination Ops
games.summary: A strange action-packed sci-fi visual novel with elements of horror and comedy. Brought to you by the Dynamic Solutions Megacorporation (a member of the Dynamic Holdings Group).

games.name: Gemion Function
games.summary: Chaotic 2v2 action where all 4 players clash at the exact same time! Master the frame-perfect parry mechanic and equip one of 6 powerful Gems to alter your team's playstyle. Play with 3 friends in smooth online matches powered by GGPO rollback netcode.

games.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
games.summary: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

games.name: Astrobarian
games.summary: Astrobarian is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.

games.name: The Last Keeper
games.summary: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

games.name: Icy Tower
games.summary: The legendary jumping game is back! Join Harold the Homeboy and friends as they jump up the Icy Tower. Make combo jumps to build up massive scores. How high can you get?

games.name: Deiity
games.summary: A dungeon crawler about working smart, not hard. As a fallen god, climb a buried Antarctic temple to use humanities own weapons to destroy the earth. Use magic abilities to manipulate physics, enemies, and the environment as you fight man-made biological creations. The temple's secrets await.

games.name: Elixir of Moonglow
games.summary: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

games.name: Secrets of Suburbia
games.summary: Investigate a disappearance in a quiet American suburb in 1997—or ignore it entirely. Spend the night browsing the internet, playing video games, and chatting with your friends in this first-person mystery-horror experience.

games.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
games.summary:
A first person horror puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity. Solve cryptic puzzles with logic and careful observation while dreaming in different rooms of a mysterious house in the woods. Completing a dream-puzzle makes the dream real in the house.

The game is inspired by Myst, Blue Prince, The Witness, The House of Leaves, Twin Peaks Season 3, liminal space games such as Pools and Limscape, anomaly horror games such as The Exit 8 and Cabin Factory as well the metafictional rabbit holes of games such as Fez, Braid, Tunic, and Animal Well.

games.name: Growth: Automate & Collect
games.summary: Growth is a cozy farming automation game where you turn a small farm into a growing production network. Plant crops, collect resources, process items, connect machines with conveyors, complete orders, and explore the world with your loyal dog by your side.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.summary: Become the embodiment of bullet hell in Warhammer Survivors, a fast-paced roguelite survivors game. Play as characters from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar universes, collect and evolve iconic weapons and destroy endless swarms of enemies.

games.name: Xploit.Zero
games.summary: Xploit.Zero is an Augmented Reality experience that transforms your space into a virtual battlefield. You are a human firewall — place turrets to slow down swarms of DDoS viruses and use your own body to destroy airborne Malworms. Your NeuroGate has been hacked, and a digital breach has opened inside your room. Defend it at all costs, or you’ll lose connection with reality and be trapped in the Matrix forever.

games.name: Fragments
games.summary: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

games.name: Avalon Jewels 3: Collector's Edition
games.summary: Restore the magic of Avalon in a fantasy Match-3 adventure! Battle the Shadow King's minions across 250 handcrafted levels, explore enchanted realms, master magical powers, and choose between Relaxed or Puzzle Mode as you save the kingdom from darkness.

games.name: Brew & Dash
games.summary: Jump, duck, accelerate, and run to test your reflexes by dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gaining new powers, and going even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps.

games.name: Agromatic
games.summary: Automated farming sim where specialized workers handle all tasks while you focus on strategic decisions. Design efficient layouts, manage supply chains across zones, and optimize your growing operation.

games.name: Ash Hills: Descent
games.summary: An atmospheric first-person horror where you play as a forest ranger investigating a series of bloody events. Search for clues, monitor the perimeter through surveillance cameras, and keep your shotgun at the ready: an unfathomable horror lurks in the nocturnal gloom…

games.name: After the Wane
games.summary: Retracing the footsteps of a mother she never knew, Lena's trying to make it as a dancer in the city. Caught in a quarrel between dance companies, dealing with love and heartbreak and the challenges of young adulthood, she must also cope with the voice in her head commenting on everything she does.

games.name: Peace Dice
games.summary: The post-apocalypse. When some are trying to survive in a new world, others join the detective agency "Peace Dice", which searches for evidence of mutants. Go on a raid and don't come back empty-handed!

games.name: Oh Puck!
games.summary: Compete in the first ever curling party game! Slide, punch, and sabotage your friends in chaotic matches filled with special items. Outplay, outsmart, and out-slide your rivals in the ultimate frozen showdown!

games.name: Among Paws
games.summary: “Who stole the fish? Guess wrong and the thief feasts, guess right and you grow your belly!” A cozy yet suspicious 4–8 player party game where sneaky cats steal fish at night and accuse each other in the morning.

games.name: Patience Balls
games.summary: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

games.name: Hyperlane Highway
games.summary:
Hyperlane Highway is a VR roguelike arcade shooter where your body is the controller. You physically lean to surf a hoverboard through neon faster-than-light transit tunnels. No thumbstick needed, no motion sickness, nothing between your intention and the lane. Kill enemies, build combo, go faster. Die, come back stronger.

You are a Way Rider: a sponsored celebrity operative clearing rogue AI constructs from the galaxy's collapsed FTL network. Every run is a live broadcast. Every death is a media event. Between runs you spend Sponsorship Credits on permanent upgrades in your Ship Hub, ensuring the next ride starts stronger.

Strategic depth comes from a deep roguelike build system. Dual-wield energy weapons and shape each run using 40+ randomised Sponsor Mod cards, stacking synergies like chain lightning, explosive rounds and shield reflection. Mid-run slow-motion Pitstops let you buy, sell or recycle upgrades via rival corporate faction vendors before re-entering the chaos. Killing enemies builds a heat combo that physically increases your travel speed. Skill directly controls pace, rewarding aggression without punishing casual play.

games.name: Boxroom
games.summary: Boxroom is a builder/designer sim giving you the space to put a stamp on your Steam library. After setting up your room and preferred shelving arrangement, the game will boot your ACTUAL steam library onto the shelves - giving you space to arrange, curate and explore your collection as you see fit

games.name: Torawase: The Girl in the Mirror
aliases: TORAWASE ～被囚禁的偽妃夢寐以求的幸福～
TORAWASE ～被囚禁的伪妃梦寐以求的幸福～
TO･RA･WA･SE ～囚われの偽妃が夢みる初夜～
TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
games.summary: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

games.name: Rally Shift
games.summary: Rally Shift is a first person stealth rallying racing game. Where you are tasked to control a rally car that is having a bomb, that you need to escort to safety as fast as possible. Use any driving techniques necessary to reach the end FAST.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths and Ashes
games.summary: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

games.name: Booster Pack Heroes
games.summary: A short incremental game about opening booster packs and surviving monster hordes. Discover rare heroes, upgrade their power, cast powerful spells and climb through ever harder chapters.

games.name: Sectron
games.summary: Sci-fi turn-based strategy on procedurally generated planetoids. Expand your base, deploy and upgrade units, negotiate alliances, and conquer each unique world. Simple rules, deep tactics. Easy to learn, hard to master.

games.name: Stack & Sus
games.summary: Stack & Sus is a physics-based social deduction party game where 3-6 players stack one giant burger. The Staff work together to complete the dish, while hidden Spies try to topple it without blowing their cover. Was that placement really an accident? Team up, stack up, and find the Spy!

games.name: AI Apocalypse
games.summary: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Fight the AI apocalypse with melee, magic, or rifle — 3 weapon classes, 9 build paths, 120+ cards. Every run is a new tactical puzzle of stance, distance, and deck synergy.

games.name: Thieves and Gold
games.summary: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

games.name: Bros Survivors
games.summary: Two players, one body, absolute chaos. Survive enemy hordes in this co-op Survivors-like. Merge with a friend into a giant mech: one controls horizontal movement, the other vertical. Will you coordinate or die trying?

games.name: Gobs & Gears
games.summary: Reconstruct a Gob factory lost in the Fog. Route resources, put the Gobs to work, and build the BIG BOOM. The Gob King wants his bomb and he wants it NOW!

games.name: Oort Protocol: Perihelion
games.summary: Command 4 operators in a hardcore tactical roguelike set in 2476. No tutorials. No hand-holding. Decipher a system-wide conspiracy through ASCII tactical combat and deep terminal interrogation. Every choice persists.

games.name: Anomalous Veil
games.summary: Anomalous Veil is a psychological horror experience that can be completed in 30–90 minutes and features branching endings.

games.name: Spaceborn Awakening
games.summary: Spaceborn: Awakening is a narrative-driven roguelite bullet-heaven where you step into the role of a legendary space crew, answering a mysterious distress signal. Eliminate hordes of the Voss Praetor’s corrupted army, awaken your true potential, become a Spaceborn - decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: Cornerfall
games.summary: A text-based idle RPG that lives in the corner of your desktop. Build your character, send them into cursed lands, and check back to find new loot, defeated bosses, and higher tiers unlocked. All without lifting a finger.

games.name: About Frontlines
games.summary: A turn-based strategy game built on total freedom. Design your own maps, forge your own units, and set your own rules of war. Build and play every era you can imagine. Quick, tense, tactical battles against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

games.name: Never Sort By Color
games.summary: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

games.name: First Light
games.summary: A story-rich arcade brick-breaker. Break through the Fog to restore a family's century of memories — 132 fully voiced levels, four generations, one old machine that refuses to forget. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

games.name: Syncline
games.summary: In structural geology, a syncline is a fold with younger layers closer to the center of the structure, whereas an anticline is the inverse of a syncline. A synclinorium (plural synclinoriums or synclinoria) is a large syncline with superimposed smaller folds. Synclines are typically a downward fold (synform), termed a synformal syncline (i.e. a trough), but synclines that point upwards can be found when strata have been overturned and folded (an antiformal syncline).

games.name: Procession Engine
games.summary: A real-time tug-of-war roguelike deck builder. Your buildings spawn your army. Your cards, blueprints, and imbues decide what that army becomes. Place buildings in your yard, work the belt, and push two lanes until one stronghold falls.

games.name: Rebirth TD
games.summary: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

games.name: Rulebound
games.summary: Trapped between reality and the Void, your only escape is a strange disc-merging game on an old CRT TV. Bounce discs and stack upgrades to forge 3 Golden Discs. Strange entities are watching, and breaking the rules is a death sentence.

games.name: Carve The Cave Together
games.summary: Dig a cave with a friend, one cell at a time. Throw balls into solid rock in zero gravity and they never stop, so the more cave you open the further everything flies. Mine ore, feed the machine, unlock a roster of balls that each dig differently.

games.name: The Yard: Escape from Prison
games.summary: The Yard : Escape From Prison is an online co-op prison escape for up to 6 players. Follow the daily routine to avoid suspicion while crafting tools and planning your breakout under the guards' noses. Upgrade your stats and experience a tense atmosphere where you can cooperate to escape or compete to see who leaves first.

games.name: Pray Your God!
games.summary:
Pray Your God! is a retro-styled comedy game about founding a cult and guessing numbers.

The player names a cult, recruits a flock and then prays: they pick a number from one to a hundred, and an Inquisitor picks one after them, with a die that does not cheat.
A wrong guess costs a follower and earns a fresh piece of paperwork; a correct one triggers one of 16 endings, each with its own animation, its own obituary and its own achievement, assigned at random. Runs last two to four minutes.

The whole game is played through a text interface drawn in a Commodore-era palette.

games.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Fog of War
games.summary: Fog of War is a DLC for the Diplomacy is Not an Option. In the new story campaign, you’ll build cities, conquer strongholds, and defend against waves of enemy hordes in epic battles. Continue the story of the Ironbrow dynasty and help the young Prince save the long-suffering Samreignia.

games.name: Piggy Monte
games.summary: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

games.name: Dustbloom
games.summary: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build a massive mobile base, automate your production, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

games.name: Starlight Cove
games.summary: Make some lemonade and set sail in this cozy fishing incremental game. Catch weird fish across colorful locations, upgrade your gear, rebuild Starlight Cove back to its former glory, and defeat the evil shark that stole your grandfather's greatest treasure years ago.

games.name: The Sea Is Our Stage
games.summary: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

games.name: Warpack
games.summary: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

games.name: Cubic Color Confusion
games.summary: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?

games.name: Hotdog Killer
games.summary: A serial killer nicknamed "The Hotdog Killer" is suffocating victims on the streets. Recruited by an FBI agent, you must run your late-night hotdog cart and closely observe suspicious customer behavior to identify the murderer before he strikes again.

games.name: Drawmi: Card Shop
games.summary: Drawmi: Card Shop is an immersive simulator where you and your friends can draw all the cards you sell and run a thriving card shop together.

games.name: Geo Bobs
games.summary: Guess the item from a single picture! GeoBobs is a multiplayer party game where you study visual clues, place your guess on the map, and see who finds the item. Roads, landscapes, and pure instinct can all lead you to the answer. Challenge your friends and see who's a better detective!

games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
games.summary: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

games.name: Too Hot to Hold
games.summary: Grab the Ember and RUN! Too Hot to Hold is an up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

games.name: Clogwork
games.summary: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

games.name: Carom Crashers
games.summary: Bank shots beat direct hits — x1.5 off one wall, x2 off two. A 4-player party shooter where you read angles like billiards. Couch party: plug in a pad, press A; friends join free via Remote Play Together. Full bot matches, online quick match, 12 weapons, 6 arenas, mutators.

games.name: It Thinks!
games.summary: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

games.name: Rude Supermarket Simulator
games.summary: Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment. Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1-4 players.

games.name: Vinculum
games.summary: Do the math and survive the aftermath. An easy-to-learn card battler: pull off math combos, get stuck in a fraction, stack functions until the numbers go absurd, break the enemy lines, try not to divide by zero. Real, modern, correct math. But when math isn't enough, resort to more arcane means...

games.name: FailRooms
games.summary: Failrooms is a first-person exploration game that parodies liminal spaces. Delve into photorealistic environments where the terror of the unknown collides with the most incompetent architecture imaginable. Can you survive this dimensional prank without losing your mind?

games.name: The Last Zeppelin
games.summary: A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through biplanes, pterosaurs and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.

games.name: No More Ground
games.summary: No More Ground is a 3D action game where you use your parkour skills to climb, climb, and climb again to reach the top. You start in a city, jump across rooftops, and climb through structures suspended in the sky. One wrong move can send you back down, so every jump counts and making it to the top feels even better. Wall run, swing from bars, and use all your parkour skills to make your way through the course.

games.name: Rense
games.summary: A fast roguelite FPS. Make your build from level-up power choices and chest items, and fight through three maps of hostile drones. The longer a run goes, the stronger they get. Die, unlock more, come back stronger.

games.name: Edge of the Blade
games.summary: Edge of the Blade is a roguelite grand-strategy autobattler where you choose one of three factions and fight over the ruined land of Cheonggu. Set weekly war objectives, capture strongholds, deploy your army, and shape the flow of battle through your choices.

games.name: Dead March: Dark Lord Rising
games.summary: Dark Lord! The Dead March has begun. Raise an army of Hell, attack and plunder settlements for resources. Grow your Dark Power, unlock new abilities, and upgrade your forces to conquer the capital of the human kingdom. Satan will judge your every battle.

games.name: Football Manager 27
games.summary: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in FM27, as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a richer footballing world to explore.

games.name: Towers of Babble
games.summary: Towers of Babble is a tower defense game where you play words to create towers with powerful synergies.

games.name: The Adventures of Tango Rio
games.summary:
A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

Tango Rio hasn’t seen his father in two years—not since he left with his uncle on “a journey that would change the world.” Or so he claimed. Then, silence.

The only clue: the name of a Polynesian archipelago... and the feeling that this time, the escape is different.

What awaits him? Tropical legends, strange rituals, time travel, dark prophecies, and a bunch of totally crazy characters.

games.name: Powder Park
games.summary: Every other resort builder stops at the blueprint. Powder Park doesn't. Shape the mountain, design your runs, then drop in and ride them yourself in third person. A new experience from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

games.name: Protocell
games.summary: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

games.name: Marvel Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
games.summary:
Marvel Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are joining the fight against Annihilus!

Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom head to Marvel Cosmic Invasion for an intergalactic adventure that will see them face off against the fearsome Annihilation Wave!

The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt!

games.name: TaskFall
games.summary:
TaskFall is a chaotic physics-based co-op game for up to four players. Players have to work together to complete dangerous missions in various hand crafted levels where unpredictable disasters, enemies, destructible environments, and your own teammates can turn every mission into a disaster.

Each run throws you into a combination of tasks, locations, and unexpected hazards, making every run unique. Explore, improvise, use your equipment, and try to survive long enough to complete your objectives and extract safely. Earn money to purchase items and upgrades, then take on increasingly challenging missions.

games.name: Last Chance: Birth
