games.summary: Enter the magic school of Academia! Last Chance: Birth is the mix of a narrative game and casual puzzles, where your performance impacts how the story is told. Solve puzzles to cast spells, to craft potions, to enchant artifacts and more!

games.name: Calmaria: Wild Growth
games.summary: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

games.name: Hamster Wheel Isekai
games.summary: Hamster Wheel Isekai combines incremental progression with role-playing mechanics. Players power a wheel, change gears and time shifts to build speed and advance.

games.name: Ashen Swarm
games.summary: Ashen Swarm is a single-player gothic arena roguelite in which abilities are based on the seven deadly sins. Players combine skills during each run and choose between keeping an Oath or gaining powers through Corruption. Decisions in recurring narrative events grant lasting artifacts. A gathering court culminates in a battle against the Collegium.

games.name: Cats Love Cakes
games.summary: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

games.name: Axis Fall
games.summary: Fallock is a very relaxing top-down puzzle game where knowledge and discovery are key. Explore a minimalist maze, fall to reach new areas, and collect every number.

games.name: One More Adventure
games.summary: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds. It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s. Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.
A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

games.name: SableSyn Protocol
games.summary: Engage enemy fleets in turn-based tactical battles on an 8 X 5 grid. Command your half of the battlefield as you manage upgrades and limited resources. Success depends on choosing the right tradeoffs at the right moment to eliminate a menacing threat. No grinding, just strategy and conspiracy.

games.name: Project: Autumn
games.summary: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.

games.name: Rigged
games.summary:
RIGGED is a free browser party game for friends, streamers and their chat. It borrows the poker table, but it plays more like a social deduction game than a card game.

Every round, the dealer is allowed to cheat. Players can secretly rig hands, sabotage each other and bluff their way through, and anyone can "Call the Cheat" to expose them. Get it right and the cheater gets MUCKED. Get it wrong and the table lets you hear about it.

On the Streamer Table, chat joins the streamer's game and tries to rig their hands live while the streamer tries to catch them. Every stream turns into a battle between the host and their community.

games.name: Amusement Factory
games.summary:
Amusement Factory is a cozy theme park builder with a bright, stylized look.

You start with an empty field, a bus stop and a bank balance, and you lay out everything else: roads, queues, rides, shops, arcades, and a lake with boats running laps of a route you painted yourself. Guests arrive by the busload with their own energy, hunger, thirst and patience, and their mood is blended from everything the park does to them, so a filthy path costs you as surely as a broken ride does.
Play the ten campaign locations in order, each with its own land, budget, wage bill and goals, or take free play and build for the pleasure of it.

games.name: Grazed: Incremental Arcade
games.summary: Grazed is an incremental arcade game where every kill means getting within range of death. Push your kill combo high enough to ignite absurd powers and chase the highest score. Every run earns upgrades, so you always come back deadlier.

games.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
games.summary: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

games.name: Swarmed
games.summary: SWARMED is a fast-paced arena roguelite where you dual wield guns, mix ammo types, dodge hostile swarms, and stack upgrades into ridiculous builds. Survive all bosses in 15 minute runs, then keep going in Endless Mode.

games.name: Nick vs. the Brick of Ick from space
games.summary: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: 2in1
games.summary: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

games.name: Drawmi: Terraform Sim
games.summary: An alien planet terraforming sim where you can draw all of the plants, animals, and bugs that you use to make a thriving ecosystem.

games.name: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas
games.summary: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. Are you willing to help Santa this year?

games.name: Expiration
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror strategy where diabetes becomes a deadly table duel. Balance blood sugar with insulin, manage your supplies, and defeat Doctor Dealer to claim the cure.

games.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
games.summary: An idle breaker where you can't miss. Buy and upgrade orbs. Smash skeletons. Go deeper. The orbs bounce on their own: no aiming required, and no way to lose. Click if you want to help — or don't.

games.name: Dying Patience
games.summary: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

games.name: Flopball
games.summary: Flopball is a physics-based football party game for up to 6 players online. Players compete in team-based matches, combining passing and shooting with slide tackles, punches and ragdoll collisions. Power-ups and arena-specific hazards can change the course of a match. The game features extensive character customisation, adjustable match settings, a shared locker-room lobby and offline play against bots.

games.name: The Guestbook of the Otherworld
games.summary: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.

games.name: WildBonds
games.summary: Play as a little fox and help the forest animals find what they've lost! Each request hides three items in random spots, and a mischievous fox may run off with one. Dash through the woods, beat your best time, and climb the global leaderboard in this charming 3D exploration time-attack game.

games.name: Apawcalypse: Gang War
games.summary: The world has fallen. Animals have risen and evolved intelligence. Build your deck, fortify your hideout, position your army, then watch your animal gang battle automatically through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic war.

games.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
games.summary: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

games.name: Table Game World CCFolia
aliases: テーブルゲームワールド CCFOLIA
games.summary:
A virtual tabletop for playing TRPGs, board games, and murder mysteries online with up to eight people. Use digital cards, pieces, dice, and maps while players set their own rules and decide how each game unfolds.

Nintendo Switch 2 features include GameChat, handheld play, and GameShare, letting a group play together with one copy of the software. Additional compatible games and scenarios are planned.

games.name: Raccoin: Chaos Max Edition
games.summary:
A chaotic coin-pusher roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins and items to trigger powerful combos.

The Chaos Max Edition introduces new playable characters, each with themed coins and a distinct playstyle. It also features 150 coins, 150 power-up items, coin plating to enhance effects, endless runs, and eight difficulty levels.

games.name: Parley
games.summary: A 20-minute medieval free-for-all for 2–8 friends. Lead your army as a hero, raise your Castle, launch yourself from your own Mangonel and talk your way into alliances with proximity voice — then betray them. The last Castle standing wins.

games.name: Hold My Cargo
games.summary: Hold My Cargo is a first-person space-smuggling and trading simulation. Players buy goods at planetary markets, carry physical crates aboard a ship and sell cargo at other ports. Contraband can be concealed in ship stashes, while customs inspections involve declarations, bluffs and bribes. Trading profits can be used to acquire larger ships and install modules.

games.name: Project Hole
games.summary: A cosy digging game set in a British back garden. Shovel, pick and drill through turf, clay and rock, sell every load, upgrade your tools and build ladders, belts and lifts as you dig hundreds of metres down to unearth treasures, crystal caves, lava and a buried secrets. Dig alone or with friends.

games.name: Worst Class Ever
games.summary: 1 Teacher vs 5 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 6-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.

games.name: Speed King
games.summary: Chaotic Racing matches for up to 4 players through silly levels, with anything you can imagine: pigs, kaijus, wheelchairs, and so on. Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

games.name: Moonbow Idle: Dark Fantasy Auto Battler
games.summary: A dark fantasy idle auto battler. A red-hooded archer with a silver moon bow holds the road against a horde that never runs out, and you decide what she becomes: gold upgrades, level-up perks, an Arsenal of fire, frost, chain lightning and more.

games.name: Helix Ark
games.summary: Adam has crash-landed on an alien world with Eve, a human restoration device. Rebuild civilization from a single human, develop cities, and combine technology with cultures unlocked through alien diplomacy to fuel explosive population growth in this sci-fi incremental simulation.

games.name: Captain Coco: Treasure Island
games.summary: A level-based puzzle game in which players push coconuts across tropical island environments to open treasure chests. Coconuts slide until obstructed and transfer momentum upon colliding with one another, while breakable ground introduces additional obstacles and opportunities for manipulating their movement. Across 30 increasingly complex levels, players must plan sequences of moves and exploit environmental mechanics to solve each puzzle.

games.name: Northmen
games.summary:
Northmen is a real-time strategy game with pause, set in the Viking Age from AD 793. The player leads a Norse war chief, a small band of warriors and eight settlers on a map of the real world. Gameplay combines raiding and besieging monasteries and towns, with options to sack, conquer, take captive or burn them, building settlements from a longhouse to a jarl's hall, and developing trade by road and sea.

The game includes 38 historical peoples, holy places of nine faiths, 24 wonders, diplomacy with pacts and vassals, and an Endgame mode based on Ragnarök. It is single-player, uses pixel-art graphics and supports 21 languages.

games.name: Echoes of Absence
games.summary: A short, atmospheric narrative-driven psychological horror game where you'll explore different environments and relive fragments of your past. Solve a few puzzles and uncover a truth some would rather forget in a story with multiple endings.

games.name: After All Is Abraded: A Study on Disappearing Completely
games.summary: Explore surreal, fractured spaces, recover traces of someone who disappeared, and piece together a story of disappearance in a first-person psychological horror game. Episode 1 of a planned trilogy, made by a solo developer.

games.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
games.summary: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

games.name: Record of '99
games.summary:
Alice de Misery got a job.

Dense audio-visual layering inspired both by sound novels, and homaging to the PC-98 Era of visual novels.

games.name: Imperial Grace
games.summary: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

games.name: Animal Zone
games.summary: Animal zone is a fast and furious one-shot one-kill 2D shooter game. Make headshots, tear your opponents to pieces, and stay alive to take your place in the food chain! Face off against your friends and other players in this brutal animal world.

games.name: Mythfall
games.summary: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg.

games.name: Reality Drift
games.summary: Reality Drift is a strategic roguelike racing game. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades, cards and relics, and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

games.name: The Vast White
games.summary: Explore an old mountain at your pace in this openworld snowboarding adventure. Uncover hidden paths, experience dynamic weather, and explore stunning landscapes as you ride. Every path holds new secrets.

games.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
games.summary: Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In this single-player interactive spy novel, you play as his greatest adversaries - can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the VICTOR go the spoils!

games.name: Castillon
games.summary:
Defend your Kingdom

As a renoun wizard you lay claim to a new land and build your castle! But beware, for demon invaders roam the wilds. Grow your kingdom during the day then fight off waves of enemies at night!

Castillon is a bite sized strategy game about building and defending your growing castle realm.

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary: Lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies in this unique action-packed roguelike!

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: A Snail's Tale
games.summary: A retro jRPG with a twist. Have you heard the one about the million dollars and the immortal snail? A Snail's Tale will let you play out the story and answer the question once and for all - can he be stopped?

games.name: The Red Cathedral
games.summary: The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.

games.name: Monomoon
games.summary: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: Twilight Requiem
games.summary: Embark on a Dark Fantasy odyssey in Twilight Requiem, an action RPG blending heart-pounding combat and mystical exploration. Wield cosmic powers, master fluid combos inspired by Kingdom Hearts 2 Final Mix, and traverse haunting realms through enigmatic portals.

games.name: Cow Online World
games.summary: Design your own animal self and meet other creatures in this colourful MMO! Graze with your friends and level skills like Basket Weaving, Trivia, Kindness, and more in a world that humans have left behind.

games.name: White Whisper
games.summary: An unknown signal. A silent ship. Only traces of the crew and empty corridors remain on the Sentinel. As Elara Wynn, you investigate what happened—and why the last transmission was a desperate distress call from the depths of space...

games.name: Buzzopolis: Hive Incremental
games.summary: An incremental roguelite colony sim about bees, mutations, and controlled chaos. Experiment with management, crafting, research, and upgrades. When mutations spiral out of control — collapse the hive, keep progress, and start fresh. Every run unlocks new strategies and a buzz of unpredictable fun.

games.name: Doomed Crew
games.summary: Co-op Horror for 1-4 players. Dive into a brutal corporate environment, complete deadly objectives for your promised freedom. Trust nothing.

games.name: Springs, Eternal
games.summary: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

games.name: Market Moe
games.summary: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

games.name: Limit Shoot
games.summary: The vertical scroll type Shoot em Ups Game. The player-controlled fighter jet have the durable and can't be shot down in one hit. You will fight through the total of 5 stages, attacking enemies with missiles and lasers, blocking enemy bullets with shields.

games.name: Watch Eye
games.summary: Victoria just wanted to take a shortcut through the usual parking garage in order to get home... she just didn’t expect to find an untold danger there.

games.name: Peglotto!
games.summary: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

games.name: Void Reaver
games.summary: Inventory management meets bullet heaven. In this sci-fi roguelite, your backpack determines your fate. Master the art of item layout to create game-breaking synergies and turn a humble arsenal into a screen-clearing storm of destruction. Collect 300+ items and annihilate the Void.

games.name: The Maker Way
games.summary: Build creative machines, rovers, drones or robots. Use them to gather resources, discover new machine parts, source energy, construct bases and battle enemy factions in a physics-based open world.

games.name: VoidReaver
games.summary: Void Reaver is a fast-paced survival roguelite built around explosive power progression and high-intensity combat. Set across corrupted biomes overrun by relentless enemy waves, the game challenges players to survive escalating chaos while crafting increasingly devastating builds.

games.name: Forged: Reconquest
games.summary: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: Wall World Strategy
games.summary: Build and lead a colony on the surface of an endless Wall. Manage resources and your people, develop new technologies, defend against relentless zyrex attacks, and send robo-spiders on risky expeditions. Keep the colony from collapsing – in Wall World, it's easy to fall.

games.name: Near Mint
games.summary: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Apotheosis Engine
games.summary: An accident causes a lost space probe to become self aware. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game. Grow from a piece of engineering into a galactic superdeity by navigating an alien OS.

games.name: Tears Apart
games.summary: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built around consecutive dash attacks called Tear. Upgrade each one of them to create devastating combat cycles, and defeat creatures of the Void.

games.name: Crown's Trial
games.summary: Crown's Trial is a fantasy souls-like boss rush where you step into a different world with each battle, fighting against legendary heroes from across time.

games.name: Bottled by Bears
games.summary: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

games.name: Amen: The Quiet Exodus
games.summary: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For the child enters the world with the veil upon its face, yet its soul wanders lone in the heavens where God is not. Why then does she not hasten to the place that was prepared for her? Seek the truth in our visual novel.

games.name: Dream Riders
games.summary: Dream Riders is a fast-paced 2.5D auto runner driving sim set in a hand-drawn dreampop pixel world.

games.name: Tape Man
games.summary: "Tape Man" is a puzzle platformer packed with hidden mechanics for you to discover. Throw your measuring tape to explore a vast maze of puzzles. Your measure tapes work as a platform, an obstacle, and many other things—it's for you to find out!

games.name: Hill-Z
games.summary: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

games.name: Mining Away!
games.summary: Mining Away! is a short incremental game in which you mine ores, collect resources, progress through the vast skill tree, and unlock powerful pickaxes!

games.name: John Gleep
games.summary: John Gleep is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

games.name: Gas N Cars
games.summary: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

games.name: That Bomb Game
games.summary: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

games.name: Catalyst Core
games.summary: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

games.name: Irreverence
games.summary: Irreverence is a fast paced top down shooter. Run, shoot, and dive into intense combat with a variety of strange foes in this quirky hotline miami like.

games.name: Working95
games.summary: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

games.name: You're Alive, Phil
games.summary:
You're Alive, Phil, is an indie minimalist 3D puzzle game about coming to terms with your place in an indifferent universe. Help Phil navigate his sudden and unexpected existence through oodles of levels and distinct puzzle mechanics, all while listening to his story unfold.

Featuring a minimalist aesthetic, an atmospheric soundtrack, and a casual-friendly control scheme, You're Alive, Phil allows players to stretch their minds without stressing their minds.

games.name: Farm & Feast
games.summary: Grow fresh ingredients and run your own little restaurant. Enjoy a peaceful day that stretches from the field to the table. Plan a fresh menu for a delightful day, keep your pantry full, and make your customers happy. Earn your own money and build your little world step by step.

games.name: Armory Keeper
games.summary: Restore order to a massive armory. Find and sort over 1,500 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the facility, placing every item on its correct rack. As you organize the armory, unlock abilities that help you sort faster and more efficiently.

games.name: Ghost Express
games.summary: "Ghost Express" is a 2D storage-organizing puzzle game about Spooky, a ghost who's too cute to scare anyone. Pack each shop's goods one by one into the box grid, then deliver them to the apartment nearby. As goods pile up and boxes fill, can Spooky complete the challenge?

games.name: Audiospeed
games.summary: AudioSpeed is an audio game centred on high-speed races between spaceships. Totally accessible for blind players. In the far future, pilots race not cars, but starships on a number of orbital tracks.

games.name: Scape
games.summary: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

games.name: Pull My Finger
games.summary: Face against up to 4 different players, your friends or bots. Take turns deciding which finger you are willing to pull, and see the outcome of your choices. Use the different items to get an advantage on your opponents. The best strategy comes out on top. 3 lives. 10 Choices. Your Move...

games.name: Toy Chute: A Sorting Game
games.summary: Float through zero gravity, grab thousands of adorable toys, and launch them into the right chutes to get everything organized. Hit Combo Rings along the way to play musical notes, chain your shots together, and create your own zero-G melody. Wigi Wigi...

games.name: Hold the Dawn
games.summary: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

games.name: Headshot Holdout
games.summary: Headshot Holdout is a retro styled co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way across a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold on a quest to rescue DEATH itself.

games.name: Corridors
games.summary: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.

games.name: Thronefall: Craaghelm
games.summary: Conquer the mountain in Craaghelm, the first expansion for Thronefall.

games.name: Journey TD
games.summary:
Journey TD is a single-player tower defense game with roguelite progression and pixel art graphics. In each run, players draft towers from six elements – Fire, Ice, Storm, Darkness, Poison and the unlockable Astral element – and place them on procedurally generated maps, where the towers form the maze the enemies have to walk through. A builder character walks across the map and constructs every tower. Three identical towers can be merged into a higher rank, and power-up cards drafted during the run strengthen towers and elements. At fixed waves, a DPS arena tests the damage output of the current build.

The game offers three modes (150 waves, 300 waves and endless) and six difficulty levels. Between runs, progress carries over through builder equipment, skill trees, power runes, unlockable skins, achievements and a collection album of tower cards. Runs are ranked on Steam leaderboards. The game is available in English and German at the moment.

games.name: Dungeoneers Idle
games.summary: An endless idle RPG with no level cap and no finish line. Build a party of heroes, hunt and craft the gear that makes them stronger, then let them fight and loot through procedurally generated dungeons on their own, or jump in and play any hero yourself.

games.name: My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
aliases: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
games.summary: My Cat Scattered Games is a cozy single-player organizing simulator. Put 5,798 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine!

games.name: Potions Galore
games.summary: Potions Galore is a cozy sorting game where you organize 2500+ potion bottles in their respective shelves. Read about every unique set in the Potion Encyclopedia, deduce the correct placement and tidy up the mess you made when your sorting ritual failed!

games.name: The Ramen Bar
games.summary: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

games.name: Grab Your Deck
games.summary: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

games.name: Lost Hope
games.summary: Lost Hope is a short, First person Atmospheric walking simulator set in the distant future, in the deep space, a lone man tries to survive and get a cure for mankind.

games.name: The Cozy Funemployment
games.summary: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

games.name: Magical Ascent
games.summary: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

games.name: Lilifel
games.summary: High roll your way through an everchanging dungeon in this roguelike, turn-based dungeon crawler. Fight enemies using your elemental runes to conjure powerful spells. Synergize your elements as you loot items that combo with just about everything. Ever Low roll? Just SLAM your way out of it!

games.name: The Great 48
games.summary: A game featuring 48 micro games and various modes of play, with local leaderboards.

games.name: The Citadel Project
games.summary: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite survival-horror elements, inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

games.name: Just Up: 2D Platformer
games.summary: Only Up: 2D Platformer is a vertical platformer where the goal is to reach the top. Jump and dash across platforms as you climb higher. Discover new places, explore changing environments, leave the atmosphere behind, and find out what awaits you at the top...

games.name: Shroomy Garden
games.summary: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.

games.name: 3D Bumper Billiards
games.summary: Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

games.name: 99Day Survival Guide
games.summary: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

games.name: Starliners
games.summary: From Earth to the Moon and beyond, build colonies, develop industries, and manage supply chains in this incremental logistics game. Harness the resources of the Solar System to build an ark and carry humanity to other stars.

games.name: Skygrid Courier
games.summary:
Taxi passengers across a cyberpunk cityscape with speed and precision!

Soar through neon-lit skies delivering passengers to their destinations as you pilot a taxi ship with speed and precision! Skygrid Courier is a physics-based action puzzler that requires you to manage the momentum of your craft to avoid obstacles and safely reach targets around single-screen cityscapes. Pick up passengers one at a time and fly to the landing pad of their color-coded destinations including clinics, clubs, hotels and labs.

Plan your route with quick-thinking strategy so you don’t run out of power for your ship and watch your shields! If you collide with objects or fly through hazards, a rough landing could cut your trip short! Choose from the task-based Mission mode to earn rewards, Arcade mode to race against the clock or Versus mode to compete in local multiplayer. Check your Hangar for unlockables as you progress, including alternate ships. Can you master the busy skyways of a neon-lit future, or will you crash and burn?

games.name: Assassination Contracts
games.summary: Assassination Contracts is an action game where you fight through enemy-filled locations, reach powerful bosses, and eliminate your targets. Battle across three unique environments, defeat enemies standing in your way, and complete all assassination contracts.

games.name: Tattie Bogle
games.summary: Tattie Bogle is a roguelite action-strategy game for 1-4 players, played solo or in online co-op. A Tomte, a gnome from Scandinavian folklore, brings a farmer's scarecrow to life, and the player defends the farm's crops from waves of pests across four shifts of the day - deer and rabbits at dawn, bears in the afternoon, and ghouls and mushroom goblins at night. Players fight with garden tools and a fear ability, build trenches, lures, stinging nettles and spook stones during waves, and leave notes that tell the farmer which seeds and tools to buy. Crops left in the field are sold to keep the farm running, while crops the scarecrow harvests become crafting materials. Buried folklore relics grant powers with drawbacks. When the farm is overrun the run resets, and advancement points buy permanent upgrades.

games.name: Luna Star Rancher
games.summary: Explore. Progress. Build. Take care of Luna, raise creatures, and bring your inventions to life! Earn XP, grow your ranch, build your rocket, take on bosses, and uncover the secrets of unknown worlds.

games.name: Neverness to Everness: Once Upon a Glitched Call
games.summary: Version 1.5 of Neverness to Everness, which includes: • New Characters: Elyms and Exe • New Main Story Chapter • New events and game modes • ...and more!

games.name: Honkai: Star Rail - Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars
games.summary: Version 4.7 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes: • New character: Aeon ★ Aha • New Trailblaze Mission: "Now, Lay Laughter to All Stars" • New events • ...and more!

games.name: Pack It Up!
games.summary: Pack your products in this active incremental game and ship countless orders to your clients. Pay your debt to your supplier before time runs out and earn your freedom.

games.name: Love, Death & My Daughter
games.summary: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free game that combines a virtual desktop interface with narrative storytelling. you will repair a memory program within an old software system, gradually recover memories from the past, and come to understand the love a mother left behind in a new light.

games.name: No Love No Money
games.summary: Love or Money? Or destroy them both? No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution. Or maybe not.

games.name: Military Base Tidy Up
games.summary: A relaxing first-person sim about tidying up a forgotten military underground base. Shelve ammo crates, weapons, drones and gear, unlock new sectors and level up your skills – solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. No timers, no pressure.

games.name: Treasure Hunt Dungeon
games.summary: A free adventure idle single-player hero game where you defeat enemies, collect treasures, challenge dungeon bosses, enhance equipment, and forge your own combat style. With hundreds of talents to choose from, Please note that it is entirely in Chinese and not in English

games.name: Taimanin Asagi 2
games.summary: Taimanin Asagi, the legendary anti-demon ninja, returns in the second installment of this classic visual novel series! Asagi and Sakura head to Tokyo Kingdom, a lawless district overrun with demons and criminals, to determine the whereabouts of their fellow Taimanin who have gone missing in action.

games.name: The Last Room
games.summary:
The Last Room is a browser-based psychological horror adventure and puzzle game.

Players explore a mysterious house filled with hidden clues, unsettling whispers, abandoned rooms, and interconnected puzzles. A voice can whisper the player's chosen name, while a mysterious pursuer threatens them during their exploration.

Players must collect evidence, solve puzzles, investigate the secrets of Romina and Silas, and make decisions that lead to different endings.

The game features German and English language options, atmospheric audio, exploration, and multiple endings.

games.name: Property Flipper Tycoon
games.summary: A business simulation game about buying, renovating and reselling houses. Start as a tradesperson with a van, some tools and a little money, take on jobs, buy cheap properties, renovate them room by room and sell or rent them out to build a property empire. Real cities from Amsterdam to Tokyo with district-specific markets, rival firms, weekly news that moves prices, staff to hire, and local or imported materials.

games.name: Escape the Flood!
games.summary: A co-op survival crafting game for 1 to 10 players. The sea is rising and your island is going under. Chop down trees, craft a boat with your friends and steer it out to the open sea. Stay in the water too long, and the sharks will find you.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Shot Rider
games.summary:
"SHOT RIDER" is a racing game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1985.
Drive your bike as the protagonist and crash into enemy riders to take them down as you race toward the finish line.
There are junctions along the stage where the route splits, allowing you to enjoy a variety of courses such as the highway, rocky, and snow courses depending on your choice.
Watch out for cars and obstacles, as crashing into them will significantly reduce your fuel.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Rezon
games.summary:
"REZON" is a shooter released by ALLUMER in 1991.
Set on Earth during an extraterrestrial invasion, players take control of an SR-91 fighter ship equipped with a VAWS (Variable Armor & Weapon System) and take on the invaders.
Pick up items and equip Arms, a key feature that gives you the ability to attack behind you or block enemy shots when used well.

games.name: Phantom Gear
games.summary: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

games.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story
games.summary: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.

games.name: Noble Fates
games.summary: A 3D Fantasy Kingdom Sim driven by intelligent characters with a rich simulation of opinions and memories. Build, Craft, Farm, Mine, Hunt, Defend, and more! Command from the sky or take control in third person as your story goes where the people, your actions, and their reactions take it.

games.name: Keepsake County
games.summary:
Burglarize hideous farmhouses in the middle of nowhere and get outta dodge.

You have moments before the cops arrive to rob a procedurally-generated house that you've never seen before. If you're caught, residents will call the police even sooner... or take the law into their own hands.

Loot wacky cartoon houses from the safety of your home! Lockpick, cut the power, tie up residents, and steal everything that isn't nailed down.

Park your car out of sight to avoid detection, or at the front door for a quick getaway. Crank your handbrake to drift back onto the highway!

Don't get too cozy: houses take on a different configuration every round, with new themes, layouts, and hauls for you to get acquainted with.

These hand-drawn residents may not be the smartest, but they aren’t dumb. Denizens hear noises, see lockpicked doors, notice large stolen items, and will call the police - or hunt you themselves.

Enter wherever, and leave whenever: Climb in through the basement, or take a trampoline straight to the roof! Get the midnight bonus for leaving early, or evade the cops for more loot.

Level up your gear from the Town Hub between runs with perks - lockpick faster, delay the cops’ arrival, or unlock special tools!

games.name: Iron Frontier
games.summary: Roguelike card strategy game. Establish your base and fight against hordes of enemies. Experiment with units, buildings and upgrades. Find the best tactics to overcome the onslaught!

games.name: Fat Goblins
games.summary: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & weapons, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

games.name: 10 Second Mixtape
games.summary: Make mini music with other players

games.name: Flexible Frosty
games.summary: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

games.name: Blood Sword
games.summary: An ancient evil returns. A sword lost to legend. A party bound by fate. Forge your legacy in a story-rich RPG of turn-based combat and branching choices, inspired by the classic Blood Sword saga.

games.name: Sitter
games.summary: Investigating the mysterious death of his grandmother, a detective breaks into her home to discover the truth, but the dwelling begins to play tricks on him. The space breaks, fears become flesh, and there is still no way out. Every step, every new room, every cycle is a chance to go mad.

games.name: Kleks Academy
games.summary: A magical platformer where you draw your own solutions! Explore fairytale worlds, solve puzzles with creativity, and uncover secrets in the Kleks Academy.

games.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Coaches
games.summary: Trade cargo for passengers in a whole new ETS2 journey! Take a seat behind the wheel – not of a truck, but of a coach. The Coaches DLC brings a new dimension to the ETS2 experience by introducing scheduled passenger transport across Europe.

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

games.name: Deadboot
games.summary: DEADBOOT is a fast-paced retro roguelike FPS. Blast through randomized levels, scavenge weapons and upgrades along the way, and see how far you can make it in this neon death zone.

games.name: Explosiovania
games.summary: After descending into a broken underworld, you are forced to learn new ways to traverse the harsh areas of hell. Rocket-jump using fireballs and master an ever growing moveset. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary: Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and grab bizarre ingredients to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

games.name: Main Sequence
games.summary: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.

games.name: Motorcycle for Sale Simulator
games.summary: Buy, fix, customize, and sell motorcycles. Start with old bikes, restore every part, test ride, and grow your own dealership. Take risks, make smart deals, and become the best in town!

games.name: Static Signal
games.summary: Static Signal is an open world 'action' horror game. Venture through your old office building and even reality as a malicious entity plans to reshape the world into a nightmare, but you can stop it before it's too late. Will you waste your time away, or will you save everyone from extinction?

games.name: Lanternwood
games.summary: Build your ideal party, master skill combinations, and conquer battles in this fantasy PvE autobattler adventure.

games.name: Against the Horde
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards, and use powerful items on a unique battlefield that favours battlefield movement and card play. Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

games.name: Broken Horror Anthology
games.summary: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

games.name: Deadhold
games.summary: Deadhold is a roguelite zombie survival/strategy game where your choices impact who lives and who dies. Rescue survivors, scavenge resources, fortify your base, and protect your community against stress, infection, and zombies! Can you find a sense of normalcy in this cruel new world?

games.name: Pelikeeper
games.summary: Pelikeeper is a cozy tower defense & base building strategy game where you play as the last pelican in a world swallowed by a shadowy fog. Build up and defend the settlement around your lighthouse, rescue lost animal neighbors, and return constellations to the cosmos.

games.name: Rolls and Dungeons
games.summary: An incremental game about casinos and dungeons! Assemble a team of debtor-heroes, clear dungeons, hoard chips, and spin the slot machine in combat to defeat monsters and bosses. Level up your luck, hunt for loot and artifacts, unlock new dungeon levels – the ultimate jackpot awaits at the very end!

games.name: Vitavania
games.summary: The most vibrant Metroidvania about a catgirl! Sandbox elements, divinity, and mysticism!

games.name: On the Train
games.summary: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, your only sanctuary is a moving train. Build it into a powerful fortress, gather resources, and survive relentless challenges. Play solo or CO-OP, defend against zombie attacks, endure harsh survival conditions, and face this perilous journey together.

games.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
games.summary: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

games.name: Lost Zion
games.summary: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

games.name: Ophelia´s Paradise
games.summary: Mystical Horde-Survivor. You are the hero who defends paradise against hordes of adversaries. On your journey, you will unleash legendary powers in a mystical world and discover unique items.

games.name: Corridor 13
games.summary:
Corridor 13 is a first-person psychological anomaly horror game set inside an endless, abandoned school corridor. Players awaken as a young girl trapped in a looping hallway where every detail may be a warning, every sound may signal danger, and every wrong decision sends them back or kill them.

To escape, players must carefully observe their surroundings and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. If everything appears normal, they move on. If something is wrong, they must retreat. Reaching Corridor 13 requires twelve correct decisions in a row — but as the loop progresses, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous.

Unlike traditional “spot the difference” horror games, Corridor 13 introduces hostile paranormal encounters, environmental traps, chase sequences, unsettling audio cues, and escalating supernatural events. Whispering children, flickering fluorescent lights, flooded rooms, mirror-based anomalies, and humanoid figures lurking in the darkness turn the familiar school setting into a place where memory and perception can no longer be trusted.

Built in Godot by a solo developer from Germany, Corridor 13 is designed for fans of psychological horror, liminal spaces, anomaly games, Backrooms-style atmosphere, and tense first-person horror experiences. The game features 40+ planned anomalies, randomized progression-based anomaly pools, and Endless and Hardcore modes.

games.name: Epic Balls Smashing
games.summary: Create a deadly spinning war machine, merge chips, forge fusion weapons, and dominate a chaotic physics-based autobattler arena.

games.name: InCowMental
games.summary: InCowMental is a cute and absurd incremental game where you build a dairy empire from a small countryside field. Milk your cows, grow your wheat, age your cheese, set out to conquer the world and boost your production with mini-games.

games.name: Gendo The Gatherer
games.summary: A cozy life sim where you forage, cook and serve your way through Gendo's journey navigating an abundant, ever changing landscape. After long days of gathering goodies, return to your cozy home to prepare, cook and serve your dishes to the local townsfolk. Join Gendo in his life in the countryside.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: Moomin Midsummer Madness
games.summary: Midsummer is right around the corner in Moominvalley, when a sudden flood sets the Moomins adrift! Join Tove Jansson’s beloved Moominfamily and friends on an adventure of mirth and mischief aboard a mysterious floating theatre.

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.summary: Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.

games.name: Foursavent
games.summary: From cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, from modern-day suburbs to the 1950s, each map delivers its own story, time period, and different gameplay mechanics. No two worlds play the same every map is a different universe, a different time, a different reality.

games.name: PlanetOrbit
games.summary: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.

games.name: Pig King
games.summary: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.

games.name: The Totemist
games.summary: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

games.name: Below The Blades
games.summary: A manual climbing horror game set on an offshore wind turbine during a storm.

games.name: Echo 9
games.summary: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

games.name: 500 Finger Fillet
games.summary: 500 FINGER FILLET is a horror roguelite about being handcuffed to a hand-stabbing machine that won't unlock itself until you've stabbed your hand 500 times. With 20 minutes on the clock, what lengths are you willing to go to to escape? Will you make it out with all your fingers, or will you bleed out on the table?

games.name: A.S.S. (Amazing Slot Survivor)
games.summary: Spin the slot machine. If luck is on your side, your power explodes. Level up fast, collect items, and build your loadout. Hunt down “Spawners” that endlessly create monsters, survive the bullet hell, and clear stages. Overwhelm enemies with insane growth driven by luck and choice.

games.name: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
games.summary: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

games.name: Splatchinko
games.summary: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic roguelike pachinko in pixel art! Launch your EYES across hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

games.name: ChromaFlow
games.summary: Build a color-powered factory. Extract red, green, and blue, transport them across networks of conveyor belts, and blend them to create an expanding spectrum. Fulfill the demands of the Chroma Core, unlock technology, and optimize every production line.

games.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
games.summary: Build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management game where no two winters are the same. Paint trails onto real mountains, connect lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

games.name: Hordia
games.summary: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

games.name: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
games.summary: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York underworld of crime. Collect protection money, trade, and expand your criminal empire while leading your crew in brutal tactical combat. Rule the city with cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

games.name: Find Kittens 12: Pirates
games.summary: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary: Give Oatchi commands using your voice and put your Dandori skills to the test in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy.

games.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
games.summary: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

games.name: Square Colosseum: Cell B201
games.summary: A gladiator deck-building strategy game where your gladiators may die, but Cell B201 lives on. Fight in the arena, improve your inherited prison cell, and leave a legacy for future generations.

games.name: Hit or Die
games.summary: Four players, one table, the number 21. Draw, stand, or bluff. Whoever ends the round furthest from the target gets the mallet, the anvil, or the revolver. Cheat with scissors, dice and a syringe you keep in your own drawer. Chips are your health. Last one breathing wins.

games.name: Desktop Plinko
games.summary: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio: Etrian Odyssey Class Costumes (7) & Battle BGM Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 2 Seven Sisters High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 3 Gekkoukan High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 4 Golden Yasogami High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 5 Shujin Academy School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona St. Hermelin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei IV Samurai Garb (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei V Jouin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Princessfall
games.summary: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.

games.name: Carmilla: Crimson Moon
games.summary: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

games.name: Procedure Zero
games.summary: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information and take over the prison before they come for you.

games.name: Ball x Pit: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Beyond The Blight
games.summary: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

games.name: Shadow Mist Idle
games.summary: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.

games.name: Undersea Post Office Sim
games.summary: Run the last post office on the seabed. Weigh every parcel, price it to the exact stamp, catch the forgeries, and pack the day's mail into a fish-shaped cargo hold that has to hang level. Four weeks. Four rent days. One desk between you and eviction.

games.name: Everyone's Tier List!
games.summary: Everyone's Tier List! is an online party game for friends. Each round, players are given a theme and a set of words, and rank the words into tiers. Players then try to guess how the featured player ranked them. The game supports online multiplayer via Steam lobbies, a streamer mode, and custom word lists created by players.

games.name: Tick & Tired
games.summary: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

games.name: The Miner's Routine
games.summary: A cozy pixel-art game about a miner sent to a remote island by order of the King. Mine resources, restore an abandoned mine, upgrade your tools, hire workers, and venture deeper underground to discover what lies beneath the mountain.

games.name: The Lifeline
games.summary: To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it? Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

games.name: Get Rammed
games.summary: Get Rammed is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!

games.name: PocoDoro
games.summary: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives in a little handheld device on your desktop, next to whatever you're working on. Hatch a squishy slime, poke it, stretch it and throw it so it splats against the walls. Feed it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It grows up in real time, even while you're away.

games.name: Fakin It XL
games.summary: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

games.name: Franchise Hockey Manager 13
games.summary: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of new additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup.

games.name: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
games.summary: In a single night, your father's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Brewing the best drinks and retake the town... or, you know, kneecap the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

games.name: Not My Dad
games.summary: Dad is acting strange, and maybe you're the only one who noticed. Meet Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game where evil may be lurking inside your own home.

games.name: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
games.summary: A brutal 2.5D ninja action game built by a solo developer. Fast combat, precision platforming, and intense boss fights inspired by classic hardcore ninja games.

games.name: Wizzy the Wood
games.summary: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

games.name: Bar Owner Simulator
games.summary: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

games.name: Bottle Flip Inc
games.summary: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

games.name: Terrahold
games.summary:
Terrahold is a strategy sandbox about building and defending a colony on a living procedural planet. Starting with a teleporter and a single drone, the player explores the world, establishes resource outposts, expands a shared power grid, and develops the colony toward the energy output required to open a permanent tunnel home.
The planet reacts to the colony's expansion through spreading alien vegetation, hostile creatures, eggs, spores, and other environmental threats rather than conventional scripted attack waves. Players can use autonomous robots, defensive structures, force fields, bridges, radar, and terraforming to reshape terrain, protect infrastructure, and expand into hostile territory.

games.name: Caramel Creek
games.summary: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design. Grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, meet three neighbours with lives of their own - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

games.name: All Eyes on Me
games.summary: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

games.name: Whiskers of Yesterday
games.summary: You're a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.

games.name: Tidyspell
games.summary: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

games.name: Spin Tactics
games.summary: Spin Tactics is a roguelike engine-builder set inside a slot machine. Each spin fills the board with coloured symbols, and connecting three or more of the same colour makes a combo. Gems change a symbol's colour, timing or effect for the rest of the run. Over 100 Companions can be equipped in eight slots, and their order matters, since some boost or copy the Companion next to them. Unwanted Companions, symbols and Gems can be sold in the Black Hole for gold. Each encounter has a score goal and a limited number of Actions, and bosses work against the player. Between runs, credits unlock Chips and Portals that change the starting hero. Runs take 30 to 60 minutes and end on an online leaderboard. There is no real-money gambling and no microtransactions.

games.name: Dreadmiles
games.summary: Combine weapon modules, destroy obstacles and spread fire in this claymation rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, take on missions and giant bosses, and head back to your truck before the Seep closes in.

games.name: Snow Worries!
games.summary: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.

games.name: King Dies Rich
games.summary: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

games.name: One More Lawn
games.summary: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 players.

games.name: Vizier
games.summary: The king holds the power — but the words are yours. Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

games.name: Voxmons
games.summary:
Voxmons is a creature-collecting action RPG in which the collection does the fighting. Creatures hatched from eggs are equipped into a squad that orbits the player in rings, choosing its own targets and attacking while the player explores. The route runs across four worlds of floating islands - forest, snow, lava and graveyard - linked by bridges and sealed portals, each world ending in a boss, and each island holding its own hatch station with its own egg pool and its own published odds.

187 creatures are spread across seven rarities, each with rarer Large and Huge variants that hit harder and stand taller, and a permanent archive grants lasting bonuses for every species registered in it. Further systems open as the player advances: fusing duplicates into higher tiers, overclocking the rarest creatures, sending reserve creatures on timed expeditions, and leaving the squad to farm while the player is away. It is free to play, with no ads, no currency packs and one optional VIP membership. The artwork was created with generative AI; the game does not generate content with AI while it is played.

games.name: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz
games.summary: Mad Dvizhuha: Benzovoz is an online 1v1 multiplayer game in a PS1-inspired low-poly style. One player is a granny with a shotgun driving a fuel tanker across a bridge, fending off attacks with a smoke screen and an electronic jammer. The other player pilots an FPV kamikaze drone and tries to stop the tanker from reaching its destination. Players swap roles every round, while random weather and match modifiers change every run. The game supports keyboard and mouse, gamepads and real FPV radio controllers, and can also be played solo against bots.

games.name: Supermarket: Tidy Up!
games.summary: Tidy up 4970 products your cat knocked off the shelves!

games.name: Auto Battle Buddies
games.summary: A cozy puppet-show auto battler where you accessorize your heroes with unique gear, build powerful teams, and battle other performers on the grand stage. Customize your puppets, climb the ranks, and create the ultimate Battle Buddies squad.

games.name: Refund Me TD 2
games.summary: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

games.name: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up
games.summary: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up is a first-person tidying game set in a two-storey board game shop. 3,816 boxes (318 parody board games, twelve copies each) lie scattered around the shop, and the player carries them in stacks and puts each game on its category's shelves. A section is complete when it holds all twelve copies of one game. Shelving boxes and completing sections earns XP, which gives skill points to spend on skills such as revealing loose copies of a game, pulling nearby copies to the player, filling a shelf at once and sorting the carried stack. The 15 categories are spread over the main shop floor, a loft, a greenhouse, a horror room and a detective's office. There are no timers and the game can be saved at any time.

games.name: E.G.O. Software Suite
games.summary: Superego Inc. presents the E.G.O. Software Suite: personal applications powered by state-of-the-art inter-universal technology powered by the SUPER Framework. Browse the Universe Wide Web with our flagship Tempest browser or communicate with people across realities.

games.name: Sonic Panic
games.summary: Sonic Panic is a 15-player multiplayer game of sound, stealth and deception. Survive up to 3 blind Bosses that hunt through sonic waves, uncover up to 3 hidden Imposters, and vote out anyone you don’t trust.

games.name: Toll Idle
games.summary: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

games.name: Deskpot
games.summary: A mini idle-farming game the size of one pot. Each keystroke turns into water for your little plant. Put it anywhere on your screen, harvest plants and upgrade your pot. While you're busy with other things, your hard work will bear fruit!

games.name: Love in Summer
games.summary: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

games.name: Upshot
games.summary: Every hit splits them. Every split makes it worse. UPSHOT is a 1–4 player arena shooter where bouncing balls keep breaking into smaller, faster ones. Clear room after room against the clock, open mystery gift boxes and take down a giant boss every fifth room, solo or in co-op.

games.name: The Coin Keeper: Tidy Up!
games.summary: One dragon sneeze. 6,000 mixed-up coins. Your holiday cancelled. Explore a fantasy museum, inspect coins and find their rightful places in this first-person sorting game. Unlock skills and magical powers to turn a glorious mess into a perfectly organised collection.

games.name: Hidden Squirrels
games.summary:
Get ready for a charming hidden-object adventure in Hidden Squirrels! Explore beautifully detailed black-and-white scenes and search for adorable squirrels hiding in every corner. Look closely, zoom in on the smallest details, and uncover all the sneaky little critters waiting to be found. Every discovery brings you one step closer to transforming the entire illustration into a colorful work of art!

Each environment is packed with tiny details, amusing scenes, and little stories waiting to be discovered. As you find the hidden squirrels in different areas, entire sections of the map burst into vivid color! Watch buildings, streets, and other parts of the scenery come to life as you complete each section. Keep your eyes open, because you might even spot special appearances by characters from other games by the studio!

games.name: Derelikt
games.summary: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

games.name: Overhours
games.summary: Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a fictional agency facing an invasion of soul-eating monsters. Work the night owl shift and face the hordes with a variety of traps and special abilities!

games.name: Green Again
games.summary: Green Again is a relaxing colony simulation game. Help a tribe of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots. Build, decorate, and expand your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and return the land to its former green state!

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries
games.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time.

games.name: Menes: The Chainbreaker
games.summary: Embark on a perilous journey as Menes, an angel with no memory, sent to free a mysterious prisoner from a forgotten realm. Uncover dark secrets, face relentless enemies, and shape the fate of a universe on the brink of collapse. A platformer adventure awaits, with very similar vibes to Soul Reaver .

games.name: UnderMire
games.summary: UnderMire is a 1-4 player first person co-op roguelite adventure where you descend into a magical, ever-changing bunker to confront the dark forces that lie within. Battle fear-fueled monsters, SMUSH everyday junk into magical weapons, master evolving tools, complete tasks from a cantankerous spirit cat, and survive the chaos alone or with your friends using proximity voice chat.

games.name: Netherwake
games.summary: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.

games.name: Referee Life Simulator 2026
games.summary: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

games.name: Drawquarium
games.summary: Draw your own fish and unlock new ways to decorate your aquarium. If you feed them well, they will gain a metallic shimmer as they age. Will you be the one to raise a golden fish in this relaxing sandbox experience?

games.name: Cannon Keep
games.summary: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

games.name: Mellings
games.summary: Mellings are striking back! Control an excavator and grab resources to bring them back to the burrow, defend yourself with various cannons while harvesting, and destroy huge buildings and bosses!

games.name: Rasen
games.summary: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters.

games.name: RatSpiderFrog
games.summary: A cursed auto-battler where you take control of a bunch of rats to fend off enemy attacks. Crossbreed them. Grill them. Feed them. Make them POWERFUL!

games.name: Powerfuel
games.summary: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.

games.name: Potted Pets
games.summary: Potted Pets is a cozy farming and pet simulator, with an adorable cast of living plant pots. Spend time cultivating a personal garden while growing a personal relationship with your collection of “Potted Pets!” Sit down for a relaxing, customizable experience that brightens up your busy day!

games.name: Slay the Q
games.summary: Roguelike deck builder where you summon creatures to fight for you. Gain gold, buy magical Artifacts, enchance Cards with Runes, and create powerful combinations.

games.name: Deathly Delights
games.summary: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the truth behind a town stuck in Limbo during Hallows Eve.

games.name: Fancy Farm Brawl
