games.summary: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

games.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
games.summary: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

games.name: Satelital
games.summary: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

games.name: Epoch Vault
games.summary: Bring life back to a world shattered by Earth’s greatest mass extinction. Discover ancient creatures, watch ecosystems recover, and trace life’s journey from the survivors to the rise of the first dinosaurs in an atmospheric idle game set in the Triassic.

games.name: Warrior Quest
games.summary: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

games.name: Extract Survivors
games.summary: Extraction survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, extract, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

games.name: 10 Million Pixels
games.summary: Mine through millions of pixels to find the one golden pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.summary: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

games.name: Provinces
games.summary: Provinces is a compact turn-based strategy game about leading your one and only army across a medievalish war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, storm rival capitals and watch your tiny soldiers deal with the consequences in fast, automatic battles.

games.name: Dusteroids
games.summary: Dusteroids is a satisfying space-themed incremental game. Fill the screen with bullets, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship & do it all again! Do you have what it takes to seek the stars?

games.name: Frontier Tale
games.summary: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

games.name: Yoyo Blade
games.summary: Master a tethered blade in a mouse-only incremental action game. Throw it, build up speed, and upgrade it to fight back waves of enemies before corruption consumes your world.

games.name: Parcel Inspector Simulator
games.summary: Parcel Inspector Simulator is a first-person inspection sim set on the night shift of a transit post office in 1962. Every parcel that crosses the desk is weighed, X-rayed, checked under a UV lamp, listened to with a probe and looked up in the terminal, then stamped: approve, return to sender, hold, dispose or confiscate. Regulations change from night to night, wages pay for desk upgrades and for a brother's sanatorium bills, and a 20-night story campaign with seven endings follows a favour that somebody upstairs keeps asking for. After the campaign the shifts go on as endless nights with special conditions.

games.name: The Eggsortist
games.summary: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

games.name: Zombie Crawlers
games.summary: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! Zombie Crawlers a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

games.name: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
games.summary: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

games.name: Battlegenics
games.summary: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.

games.name: Escape Your Boss
games.summary: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

games.name: Blowhole
games.summary: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

games.name: Business Tycoon
games.summary: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

games.name: We March as One
games.summary: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

games.name: Goblin and Glory
games.summary: Build your goblin crew, upgrade your sword, and fight through 10 dungeons! Goblin & Glory is a pixel-art clicker game with auto-attacking helpers, relic choices, and 60-second boss battles. Earn prestige, unlock permanent abilities, and return stronger with every run.

games.name: Hellterns
games.summary: A chaotic co-op work sim set in Hell for 1–4 players. Catch sinful souls, put them through absurd machines, stamp their papers, and send them to Heaven before your shift ends. Fires, brawls, and write-ups included.

games.name: QUTAS67: Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
games.summary: Every criminal starts somewhere. You start in a dumpster. Welcome to Miami, 2067, where the economy is a joke and you’ve decided to become the punchline. Click to earn cash, upgrade your Click Power and work your way through 20 locations, from parking lots to banks and museums. Your goal? Stealing The Legendary Game the whole world has been waiting for. Apparently, asking nicely wasn't an option.

games.name: Kinsoku Ryokan
games.summary: Follow the ever-changing taboos, complete your exorcism missions, and make it back alive. A horror action game featuring the story of Satomi, an apprentice shrine maiden, and online play for up to 8 players.

games.name: Piercing
games.summary: PIERCING is a rhythm-action game where you smash every panel to the beat. Fail, and the Contract forces you to give your childhood friend a piercing.

games.name: No More Monsters
games.summary: It's time to challenge the monsters of Arvelia! Become one of the world's mightiest mages, slay thousands of creatures, and claim their power. They thought this world belonged to them. Prove them wrong. They used to be the hunters. Now they're the prey. No More Monsters!

games.name: Pawhold: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
aliases: PAWHOLD: Idle Desktop Cat Space Game
games.summary: Somewhere out there, an AI keeps generating worlds and enemies to conquer mankind. Your cats are on the task. An idle pixel squad shooter that lives along the bottom of your screen while you work: four cat commandos fight, you click to help, bank the bounty and refit the crew.

games.name: Knurlworm
games.summary: Knurlworm is a short character-driven game where every visual asset is made from real woodcut stamps pressed onto real paper. Watch a lone Carver's story unfold print by print as he searches for a mythical worm said to be able to change a person's fate. The Knurlworm.

games.name: Logosmancer
games.summary: A 5v5 wizard battler where every spell is cast with your voice. Yell FIREBALL, FREEZE, FLY, TRANSFORM or FART to fight in King of the Hill, Team Deathmatch and Free-for-All, or survive co-op waves in Sandbox.

games.name: Moga TD
games.summary: Moga TD is a cooperative tower defense game for up to four players. Each player controls a builder with its own race of towers and defends one corner of a shared board against 41 waves of creeps, ending with the Orc Warlord. Players share one pool of lives, earn Gold to build and upgrade towers, and must coordinate their defenses to win. Online co-op runs through Steam lobbies.

games.name: Dark Workshop Simulator
games.summary: Dark Workshop Simulator is a first-person dark fantasy shop simulator. The player runs an emporium serving adventurers, alchemists and monsters: ordering from suppliers, stocking shelves, setting prices and fulfilling contracts. Potions, blades and tomes are crafted at alchemy, forge and library stations by tracing sigils, and crafters can be hired to work them. Grime builds up over time and attracts customers, thieves must be caught, and hostile creatures are fought off with a hammer. World events such as plagues, wars and edicts reshape market demand. The shop expands with new rooms, zombie staff and a Grimoire skill tree of permanent upgrades.

games.name: A.N.S.I.A.
games.summary: It's your first day at ANSIA. Review citizens' paperwork according to regulations that change every day, growing more absurd by the minute. A satire of Italian bureaucracy inspired by Papers, Please, with 4 different endings.

games.name: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra
games.summary: Disrupt dark magicks and put an end to the powerful witchcraft of the Coven Queen in Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra.

games.name: Dongda Gangster
games.summary: DONGDA Gangster is a live-action interactive narrative game based on the popular Chinese IP Northeast Past, set in Northeast China during the 1980s and 1990s. Players take on the role of Zhao Hongbing, navigating the criminal underworld, shifting power struggles, romance, and bonds of brotherhood. Directed by the original novel's author, Kong Ergou, the game features returning cast members from the screen adaptation. Player choices influence relationships, story branches, and multiple possible endings. The game recreates the era through detailed environments and explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, friendship, and ambition.

games.name: Cat Simulator
games.summary: Cat Simulator is an adorable game where you play as a mischievous little cat! Explore cozy rooms, interact with all kinds of objects, pull playful pranks, and knock things over just for fun. Jump around, collect stars, and unlock new rooms to continue your curious adventure. Ready to cause some cute chaos?

games.name: Letter Schmetter
games.summary:
In this game you have to form words from an anagram in German. The individual letters bring different points, whereby the rounds become more difficult after each solved turn. The game is available for Twitch and is intended as a community game, since the entire chat is involved.

The name "LetterSchmetter" is a mixture of the English word "Letter" and the German word "Schmetter" (means to bounce something at high speed on a surface).

games.name: Badass Brigade
games.summary: Throw a dude at another dude! Badass Brigade is a light-hearted 2D action game where you shoot, punch, grab, and throw your foes. Take on missions where you can explore the world and uncover a wide variety of weapons and gear for new ways to fight.

games.name: Fate/Empire of Dirt: Stella Splendens
games.summary:
The second and last append for Fate/Empire of Dirt, taking places after Made in Heaven and adding new routes for Morgan and Musashi.
Anastasia, Murasaki Shikibu and Consort Yu are also upgrated from sub-heroines to heroines roles.

games.name: Monster Girls Dice Board
games.summary: On the mysterious Mysteria Island, embark on an exciting dice adventure with charming and unique monster girls! Use strategic board game mechanics to collect resources, buy lands, and compete in friendly matches while building heartwarming bonds and exploring the fantastical island together!

games.name: Water Maid
games.summary: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

games.name: Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your cafe business. Customize your shop with furniture and decorations, brew various beverages, serve customers efficiently, expand your space, and compete with rival cafés. Grow from a small shop to a thriving empire. Oh, and there's chicken wrestling too.

games.name: Snake Echos
games.summary: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

games.name: IWA Fighting Adventure
games.summary: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

games.name: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon
games.summary: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon is a management and building simulation about running a cruise line. Players start with a small river cruiser on the Rhine and work up through the shipyard to a coastal cruiser, a mid-size liner, a resort ship and a megaship, designing each ship's interior deck by deck inside a fixed hull: cabins from interior rooms to balcony suites, dining rooms and buffets, bars, pools, a theatre, a spa, a water park, galleys, stores, the laundry, crew quarters, the engine room and the bridge. They hire and schedule the crew, run power, fresh water, sewage, air conditioning and fuel, plan itineraries on the Rhine, along the Norwegian coast and through the Caribbean, and price cabins for simulated guests who write reviews after each voyage. Ships float on modelled weight and balance, and a sandbox mode can set off events such as a kraken, pirates, lightning storms, rogue waves and capsizes. The game has a six-chapter campaign, a sandbox and a creative mode.

games.name: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
games.summary: Have you ever wondered, how many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

games.name: Scopecreep
games.summary: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

games.name: NodalBastion
games.summary: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.summary: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Func Key
games.summary: Func Key is a spelling roguelike deck builder where your keyboard is the deck! Customize your keyboard to be the ultimate spelling machine, or leave words behind with rule breaking mods. Spell, build, and relax, all to the soothing thock of the keyboard.

games.name: Clicky Islands
games.summary: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

games.name: Tekken 8: Roger Jr.
games.summary: The Season 3 Pass includes the following content: 4 additional playable characters, 1 additional battle stage, and the Character Costume: Aurora Outfit Pack.

games.name: Topdeck Automat
games.summary: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself. Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

games.name: Highland Haven
games.summary: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

games.name: Dice Looter
games.summary: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

games.name: Pegs of Hell
games.summary: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

games.name: Raise, Rise & Die
games.summary:
Raise, Rise & Die is a dark fantasy deckbuilder adapted from a physical card game. In solo Arena runs, players face automated enemy decks, collect new cards, and build synergies to climb the leaderboard.
Every card has a Soul Value that determines its cost to play, the Reserve it generates when sacrificed, and the health lost when it falls as the face-up Top Soul. Between battles, sacrificing cards from the deck restores health, creating a choice between preserving a powerful build and surviving the next encounter.
The game also features online one-on-one duels and Ancients’ Path, an editor for creating and sharing custom runs.

games.name: Who Gave Them Weapons
games.summary: Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns into total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

games.name: Trafficity
games.summary: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

games.name: Rock and Found
games.summary: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

games.name: Here Comes the Horde
games.summary: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Earn coins, improve your army, unlock new units, grow stronger, and fill the screen with your troops.

games.name: Of Dice and Minions
games.summary: Of Dice and Minions is a pixel-art dice-rolling auto-battler roguelite developed and published by Foorbytes. Each turn the player rolls five dice, holding and rerolling them in the style of Yahtzee. Every die represents a minion type, and the number rolled determines how many of that minion are summoned. The resulting poker hand grants a bonus, such as extra units, increased damage or health, or sending all five dice into battle, after which the army fights automatically. A run descends 100 floors across ten zones, with a boss every tenth floor whose own dice rolls summon reinforcements, and continues into an Endless mode after the final floor.

games.name: My Little Ranch
games.summary: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch hands and grow your ranch.

games.name: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
aliases: AURORA REQUIEM: The Lullaby of Calvaris
games.summary: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

games.name: Dungeonbound
games.summary: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

games.name: Night of the Idle Horde
games.summary: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

games.name: One More Claw
games.summary: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

games.name: Watermellionaire
games.summary: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

games.name: Dreadgence
games.summary: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

games.name: Feed the Vessel
games.summary: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

games.name: White Christmas
games.summary: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

games.name: The Scratcher
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Scratch to fight, push your luck for the jackpot and stop before you go bust. Build a deck of tickets and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.

games.name: Chrono Cards
games.summary: Chrono Cards is a digital PVP card game that puts you in the role of a time traveler, summoning cards from across history and manipulating time itself to triumph over your opponent. The game is built around its unique Timeline mechanic which splits the board into Past, Present, and Future regions that move on every turn, forcing players to carefully plan ahead and adapt to a constantly evolving board state.

games.name: Barn Rush
games.summary: Barn Rush is a top-down time-attack collectathon roguelite set on a pixel-art farm. Gather food in 15-second rounds, haul it back to the barn, and bank it before the buzzer. Rounds come in sets of five, each with a Harvest Goal, and every fifth round is a 45-second Gauntlet with a game-changing challenge. Pick upgrades between rounds and build a different run every time.

games.name: Mizi No!: Hobby Time
games.summary:
We all have hobbies, and so does Mizi! Her favorite hobby? Lovingly undoing whatever you just spent hours creating.

Assembled a miniature mech? Finished a beautiful scrapbook page? Spent all evening crocheting something cute? Haha... yeah, we hope you loved it enough to do it all over again. ;)

The "Hobby Time" DLC adds 20 more items for you to put together all over again.

games.name: Socks Pair Up
games.summary: Socks Pair Up is a cozy first-person game about pairing up and sorting socks to get a specialty sock shop ready to open. Players match socks by color, pattern, and length, then arrange the pairs on shelves, in boxes, on clips, and on mannequins. Displaying pairs earns rewards and skill upgrades that make sorting and stocking easier, while completing shelves opens more of the shop.

games.name: No One Owns the Light
games.summary: This is the story of the first person in the world to be put to death in an electric chair.

games.name: Code Market
games.summary: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

games.name: Savebot: The Last Garden
games.summary:
Savebot: The Last Garden is a calm programming game about robots who bring a planet back to life.

The player writes programs, block by block, to teach a few robots that know nothing yet how to take care of a sleeping planet, until life comes back on its own across five worlds.

games.name: Nullnest
games.summary: Defend the Core in this incremental tower defense. Survive relentless enemy waves, unlock new abilities, and collect gems of different rarities that completely transform each run. Experiment with endless combinations and create unique strategies to overcome ever-growing challenges.

games.name: Orcthal
games.summary: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies! Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

games.name: Trust Me Fellow
games.summary: Trust Me Fellow is a psychological deduction puzzle game in which the player is a blind dealer. The player's cards are hidden from them but visible to an audience of characters, who give hints about what each card is. Some audience members tell the truth and some lie. The goal is to flip every O card; flipping a single X card ends the game.

games.name: Sort Memes Together
games.summary: A meme store has exploded! Grab, stack and throw 80 meme products with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sort every cat loaf, stonks bust and pet rock onto the right shelf, and turn total brainrot chaos into the tidiest meme shop on the internet.

games.name: Dawn of Defense
games.summary: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

games.name: Star-Coat
games.summary: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

games.name: Milki Delivery
games.summary: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

games.name: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
games.summary: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

games.name: Okurek
games.summary: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

games.name: Zero Sum
games.summary: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

games.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
games.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.
aliases: L'École des licornes : L'Île de la Magie
Academia Unicornio: La Isla de la Magia
Academia Unicórnio: A Ilha da Magia
独角兽骑士队: 魔法之岛
獨角獸學院: 魔法之島

games.name: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
games.summary: Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

games.name: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
aliases: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
games.summary: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

games.name: Uncosy
games.summary: An uncomfortable game about collecting plushies.

games.name: Monkeys!!
games.summary: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

games.name: Ratchet & Clank
games.summary: A port of Ratchet & Clank, originally released on PS2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Steel Gullet
games.summary: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

games.name: Game Shelver 99: I must organize my Steam Library and defend it against pirates with a shotgun
games.summary: Game Shelver 99 is a satirical first-person organizing game set in a retro PC game store. Sort game boxes onto shelves by genre, tags, year, developer, title, or price, then defend your carefully arranged collection from waves of software pirates. Play solo or team up with up to three friends, or choose a peaceful mode focused entirely on organizing.

games.name: Dravora
games.summary: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

games.name: Futa: Beer & Sex
games.summary: Futa: Beer & Sex is a fast adult arcade game. The player catches beer to unlock three futa bartenders and an uncensored animated sex gallery. The game contains explicit sexual content.

games.name: Angel Investor Simulator
games.summary: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

games.name: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
games.summary:
A port of Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2, originally released on PlayStation 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

In this sequel to the critically acclaimed Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver, reassume the role of Raziel, and battle back through the currents of time into pivotal, dangerous eras of Nosgoth's past in your relentless pursuit of Kain. Encounter new enemies as you unearth the mysteries of Nosgoth's ancient races, and expose the schemes that lie behind the corruption of the Pillars, and the terrible vampire genocide.

games.name: Space Station Designer
games.summary: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.

games.name: Eletta
games.summary: Explore an unfamiliar place filled with powerful enemies, advanced technology and scientific advancements in Eletta, an action game about a young girl looking for a way back home.

games.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
games.summary: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

games.name: Graveyard Orbit
games.summary: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

games.name: Dark Rail
games.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

games.name: Marque & Reprisal
games.summary: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary: Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and embark on a thrilling new ocean adventure.

games.name: Frog is Crime
games.summary: good criminal open world game of 2026. drive cars, commit crime, kill peoples and become crime king in world of humans as frog

games.name: Whitopia
games.summary: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

games.name: Please Confirm the Deceased
games.summary: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Bodies arrive with paperwork that has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

games.name: Bomb Them Ores
games.summary: Bomb Them Ores is a short arcade incremental mining game. Explode caves, collect minerals and unlock upgrades to delve deeper!

games.name: Strato Alto
games.summary: Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory! Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

games.name: Tidy Mall Together
games.summary: Tidy Mall Together is a cozy co-op tidying game where you and up to 3 friends work together to turn the messiest mall in town into the tidiest! Sort over 4,600 runaway items across 11 different shops. Grab, stack, and shelve everything back where it belongs, unlock helpful tools like magnets, scanners, and sorting robots, hunt for 25 golden items, and enjoy fun mini-games along the way. Whether you're organizing shelves or tackling the chaos together, there's always something to tidy up!

games.name: Soccerwarz
games.summary: Soccerwarz is a 7v7 soccer strategy game. Build a squad of fantasy characters — minotaurs, trolls, skeletons, bears, goblins, knights, sharks and more — and place 7 of them strategically on a 5x9 grid pitch. Once the match starts, passes, steals, 1-on-1 duels and shots play out automatically based on each player's stats, so the result comes from your placement and your read of the opponent's strategy. Reposition between rounds to turn a match around, and settle draws with a penalty shootout. Includes ranked seasons and Club Wars. Free to play with optional in-app purchases, available in 11 languages.

games.name: Tiny Dwellings
games.summary: From the creators of Moonfrost, Tiny Dwellings is a whimsical hand-drawn spin-off builder with kindred pixelly vibes! Delight in designing your dream petite homesteads and charming dioramas. Unwind in a stress-free haven and dig the heartwarming lo-fi ambiences as you express your creative muse.

games.name: Frog Collector
games.summary: Bring order to a shop overflowing with collectible frogs. Pick up and sort colorful figures, fill themed shelves, unlock helpful upgrades, and search for hidden eggs. Build your collection one frog at a time.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI je připravovaná videohra ve vývoji od společnosti Rockstar Games. Bude osmou hlavní hrou série Grand Theft Auto, navazující na Grand Theft Auto V (2013), a celkově šestnáctým dílem série.

games.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
games.summary: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

games.name: Axyn Adventure
games.summary: Will Axyn discover the secrets of the ancient civilization and will he find the prince?

games.name: Iona's Island
games.summary: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

games.name: Shrike
games.summary: Pickpocket rival birds to build a deck. A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder about a tiny bird's grim migration north through a wretched medieval kingdom. Steal abilities, chart your migratory route, survive.

games.name: Dungeon of Departure
games.summary: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

games.name: Lord of Undead
games.summary: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

games.name: The Legend of the 4 Elements
games.summary: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: Vintage Vice City Pack
aliases: Grand Theft Auto 6: Vintage Vice City Pack
GTA VI: Vintage Vice City Pack
games.summary:
All Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack, a collection of items that flash back to when the neon burned brightest.
Featuring a timeless '55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, decadent outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an iconic weapon pattern that echoes the excess of the past.

games.name: Flick
games.summary: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: Microscape
games.summary: Heavily inspired by Runescape, Microscape is a tiny community idle game for Twitch streams. Channel owners can add their community to the world. Players then earn playtime by being in these communities.

games.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
games.summary: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

games.name: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
games.summary: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!

games.name: Salt of the Earth
games.summary: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

games.name: Let Me Die
games.summary: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Unable to win, unable to die. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds and maybe you will find a way to break the loop.

games.name: Tilemancer
games.summary:
Tilemancer is a strategy roguelite deckbuilder where every battle plays out like a tactical board puzzle.

Build two parts of your army: a deck of units that determines the soldiers available to you, and a deck of cards that supplements your units. Different unit types, terrain types and card effects interact through simple rules that can combine into increasingly complex situations.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
games.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings.

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?
Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards.

games.name: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
games.summary: You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball! A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects. Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

games.name: Spinful
games.summary: A fantasy roguelite slot-builder. Upgrade, enhance and customize your slots into a powerful combat machine!

games.name: Neo Light
games.summary: Every room wants you dead in Neo Light. A brutal precision platformer where you master 9 short-burst powers while Glitch, your sarcastic assistant, guides, judges and mocks your failures in real time.

games.name: Widget Idle
games.summary: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness.

games.name: Kuroshio: Neon Blood
games.summary: Tokyo, at night, in the rain. Twelve years after vanishing, Kyōsuke Narumi returns to Shinbashi and walks straight into a war between yakuza families. An open-world crime saga: brawls, katana and gunfights, police chases, mountain-pass races and a shinkansen to the old capital.

games.name: Crumple Toss
games.summary:
A very difficult game of precise throws, dozens of misses, and world records.
The goal is simple: land the shot in the bin. But every level will make you miss again and again.
The timer is already running. Beat the level faster than anyone else and set a world record.
Build your own level, beat it twice, and challenge everyone else.

games.name: IconyX
games.summary: Dark Fantasy MMORPG

games.name: Beyond the Mist
games.summary: M. Webb, the I.S.C. requests your immediate presence. Our previous keeper has vanished without explanation. A replacement is needed at once for the offshore lighthouse under our care. Report to the local office of the company as soon as possible. Do not be late.

games.name: Tavern Clicker
games.summary: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

games.name: The Pyramid
games.summary: The Pyramid is an indie and roguelike roulette challenge that celebrates all of those games that have been collecting dust in your Steam library.

games.name: Rocket Scrapyard
games.summary:
A cozy first-person collecting and rocket-building game set in a private space company’s scrapyard. Gather discarded parts, sort them into sets, and assemble a custom rocket from engines, tanks, boosters, and more.

Each day brings a new launch, with flights that can reach new heights, the edge of space, or orbit. Earn experience, upgrade the scrapyard, fulfill client orders, and work toward building a space station.

games.name: Football Survivors
games.summary: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

games.name: Chigusa's Diary
games.summary: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...
aliases: 小千草的少女生活紀錄簿
小千草的少女生活纪录簿

games.name: Nightmare Conquest
games.summary: Nightmare Conquest is a game focused on strategy, planning, and build creation. Assemble your team of monsters, position them intelligently, and evolve their abilities to face increasingly difficult challenges. Every decision matters — from the upgrades you choose to how you combine your monsters on the battlefield.

games.name: Resettle
games.summary: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

games.name: Wand Keeper
games.summary: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you pair 3,500 wands with their matching cases and file them across a two-storey wand shop. Read each magical stave, restore every pigeon hole, unlock helpful skills, or race the clock in Hardcore mode.

games.name: Tanks Sweet Tanks
games.summary: Tanks Sweet Tanks is a sugar sweet yet intense, fast-paced tank shooter game. It is fun, easy to learn, and addicting. Play alone, together with friends or against your friends.

games.name: The Debtician
games.summary: Buy items to gain debt in this level-based Credit Card deckbuilder game!

games.name: Meifu Kanshiki-Ka: The Underworld Forensics Division
games.summary: You died at 4:44 a.m. Now you're the Underworld's forensic examiner. Rebuild the shattered memories of the dead with Picross, battle lying spirits, expose false testimony before King Enma — and find out who erased your own page.

games.name: We’re All In!
games.summary: Experience minigame chaos in We’re All In!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

games.name: ReactorX 4
games.summary:
The continuation of the adventures of the space saga "ReactorX"!
A robot technician and captain, flying through an asteroid field, receive a mysterious SOS signal with a "request for help." Tracking the coordinates, they are sent to an unknown mystical object in space. To get into the closed secret room, they need to turn on the power to the electrical system. There, a mystery awaits them.

games.name: Crazy Chess
games.summary: A game based on chess. Solve 50 puzzles on boards of every kind and shape, with different types of tiles. Mechanics and rules that are a little crazy but a lot of fun.

games.name: Kintsugi Cottage
games.summary: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

games.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop: Christmas
games.summary: Return to the flower shop for a Christmas tidy-up. Sort 16 festive flower varieties, stock gifts, decorate the tree, and discover the notes left behind.

games.name: Geo Book
games.summary: Geo Book is a geography trivia game featuring nine different mini-game modes focused on countries, flags, capitals, cities, landmarks, and other geographical facts. Players can test their knowledge through various challenges, including timed quizzes, puzzles, matching games, and map-based activities. The game features a progression system with 30 unlockable ranks, as well as daily and weekly challenges. Online leaderboards allow players to compete for high scores, while Practice Mode offers a way to improve their knowledge at their own pace.

games.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
games.summary: Etranger In the City of Doom is a puzzle-oriented RPG centered on the strong bond between Tio and Rikill, two companions on a journey to rescue the imprisoned angel Norn. Exploration and puzzle-solving are at the core of gameplay. Players advance the adventure by solving various mechanisms and riddles.

games.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
games.summary: Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer. Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

games.name: VacBot Simulator
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

games.name: Demon Eye
games.summary: Eyes are your weapons in this bullet heaven extraction shooter. Drop into raids, gather materials, fight waves of demons, and extract with your loot. Back in the Hideout, use your loot to craft eyes, make upgrades, trade, and take on quests.

games.name: Stellaris: Willpower
games.summary: Shape Minds, Rule the Stars. In a galaxy defined by borders, belief knows no limits. In Stellaris: Willpower, your Ethics evolve into powerful ideologies that can reshape entire civilizations.

games.name: Circuit Keep
games.summary: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

games.name: Jaden Industries
games.summary: Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands.

games.name: Hoard
games.summary: Two goblins, six worlds, and a dragon's hoard at the end of the road. Forge keys, crack open chests, dodge (or slay) the mimics, and pour your gold into upgrades and goblin helpers. A short, funny idle adventure where every chest could be loot... or teeth.

games.name: ArcaneBound
games.summary: ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG. Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

games.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
games.summary: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

games.name: Terminus: Day Zero
games.summary: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

games.name: Jurassic Architect
games.summary: Jurassic Architect is a cozy dinosaur zoo builder set on the far side of a Portal, where visitors from our world buy tickets to meet real dinosaurs. Players shape enclosures, discover more than 50 species, hire keepers, rangers and vets, and keep the dinosaurs happy before they start testing their fences.

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.summary: Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.

games.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
games.summary: Parenthood as told through a cozy, psychedelic, puzzle adventure. Solve hand-drawn escape room-inspired puzzles inside a baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

games.name: No Blink Allowed
games.summary:
Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game.
Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.

games.name: Ezalm: Magic's Memory
games.summary: A narrative-driven action RPG where each spell you use will punish you, requiring you to be strategic in the combat styles you will build. Lost in the land of your ancestors, unravel the secrets of magic to return home and defend the people you swore to protect.

games.name: A Drop of Magenta
games.summary: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

games.name: No Asteroids
games.summary: An asteroid of 5,000,000 m³ will hit Earth in 90 days. The government already spent 90 days arguing about who pays. Then one miner came to the tender with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. The vote was unanimous, for the first time in history. Every day the miner flies down to the rock and digs while his air lasts. Back on the ship he sells the ore and buys bigger tools and guns. From the observation dome he can see Earth through a telescope.

games.name: Zero Mass
games.summary: Carve through asteroids, haul valuable ore, and upgrade your mining ship in ZERO MASS, a single player space mining game. Take on contracts, deploy drones and drilling rigs, uncover buried artifacts, and tackle dangerous encounters across procedural asteroid fields.

games.name: Chop Loop
games.summary: A 3D incremental lumberjack game where every tree changes the way you play. Unlock unique tree mechanics, control which trees appear with runes and upgrade beavers to automate your harvest.

games.name: Karakara 3
games.summary: "Let us live on this land so arid." Leon's peaceful days suddenly come to an end when he hears the sound of a telephone, a Relic from the past and is informed that Cullen, a member of the town vigilante corp, is being held hostage. The final chapter in the KARAKARA series.

games.name: Paranormal Cleaner
games.summary: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.

games.name: Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party
games.summary: Grab your friends, lift them overhead and throw them off a pizza rooftop. Bungle Brawl is a wobbly physics party brawler for 1–4 players on one screen, with bots to fill every match, 11 silly maps and a ragdoll football mode.

games.name: Last Watchtower
games.summary: A short tower defense game where you gather resources and survive waves of monsters. Spend your resources on a variety of upgrades to incrementally grow stronger. Experiment with different builds and discover powerful synergies.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

games.name: Turbo Turkey
games.summary: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

games.name: Fireworks Incremental
games.summary: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

games.name: A Sector Darkly
games.summary: Experience an epic story in this open-world space exploration RPG. Stranded far from home in a region torn apart by war, you must scavenge, research, and craft what you need to survive as you chart a course through dangerous sectors, uncover rival alien agendas, and search for a way home.

games.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
games.summary: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is a human made top-down action-adventure game where you explore magical dungeons, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. What grade will you get?

games.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
games.summary: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

games.name: Sort On The Ball
games.summary: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

games.name: Mix Dunk: King of Basketball
games.summary: A new project in collaboration between B.LEAGUE’s professional basketball club Kawasaki Brave Thunders, the idol group AKB48, and the otome game brand Otomate.

games.name: Azur Promilia
games.summary: Azur Promilia is a fantasy world RPG with creature companionship. Step into a fantasy world, utterly different from the world you know. The world of various civilizations, magic and incredible fantasy creatures, together with tales echoing in the starry sky. Take a daring leap from the sky into the ocean, to once again encounter and bond with new life. Guided by shooting stars, amid the sparkling constellations, this is your very own journey. The entire universe eagerly anticipates the ballad of stars and odyssey, exclusively yours to unfold.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: An intense top-down shooter roguelite inspired by pinball mechanics. Master every shot with precision in the heat of the battle, and protect your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment and conquer spaceships to win the war!

games.name: The Retrospection of Tomorrow
games.summary: A full-length time-travel romance visual novel. Date handsome boys just like any other game… until they die before your eyes(!) Trapped between memories and delusions, fighting fate itself—can you rewrite their endings? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

games.name: Stealing Them Softly
games.summary: A popular Japanese visual novel by Dark One! — a touching story of two people torn by inner conflict and sorrow as they face separation from the one they love. What kind of ending awaits them…?

games.name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
games.summary: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

games.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Sands of the Damned
Reshine
games.summary: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Alice＝Alice ＆ Bad Medicine 2 in 1 Pack for Nintendo Switch
aliases: ALICE＝ALICE ＆ BAD MEDICINE 危險老師的特別授課 2in1 PACK for Nintendo Switch
ALICE＝ALICE ＆ BAD MEDICINE 2in1 PACK for Nintendo Switch

games.name: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
games.summary: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

games.name: The Pogo Witch
games.summary: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

games.name: Happy Weekend
games.summary: An all ages port of Happy Weekend

games.name: Fool's Trigger
games.summary:
Fool’s Trigger combines Russian roulette and card tactics in a deadly multiplayer game for up to six players.

Inspired by Buckshot Roulette, it puts a different spin on the formula: everyone acts simultaneously. Each player has cards, chips, and a revolver — the tools to outsmart opponents and knock them out of the game.

Bet on the outcome of other players’ shots, then spend your winnings on new cards and ammunition. Combine your actions, strike deals across the table, and betray your allies when the moment is right. With overlapping decisions and unexpected outcomes, every match can take a different turn.

Your goal is simple: be the last player at the table.

games.name: Night Concierge
games.summary: Night Concierge is a short first-person horror game with a retro PSX look, set in a Soviet-style apartment block in November 2003. The player works the night shift as a concierge: residents come home one by one, and the task is to let them in while keeping out the "others" — impostors who only pretend to be residents. To decide, the player uses lobby security cameras (including a mirror that does not always show what it should), a video intercom for questioning visitors, a resident logbook with photos and apartment numbers, and a phone for calling apartments to check who is already home. The campaign spans five nights and an epilogue with several endings. An optional streamer mode connects to Twitch chat, letting viewers vote on whether to open the door and trigger events during the shift.

games.name: QuizForge
games.summary: Create quizzes with images, audio and videos. Play solo, together on one PC or online via Steam. Connect smartphones over your local network, and discover or share quiz packs on Steam Workshop.

games.name: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
games.summary: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

games.name: Fishing Nooks: Beaver's Pond
games.summary:
A 2D painterly fishing game for gamers who just want to fish.

Relax on the water. No crops to water. No mines to crawl. No monsters to fight. No town to manage. No energy meter telling you when to stop. Just you, your boat, a tackle box full of lures, and a lake full of nooks, crannies and fish that are really out there, moving as the day progresses, the wind blows and the the weather changes.

3 fully shipped lakes - 1: Beaver's Pond - the developer's original lake designed by hand, plus Lake Okeechobee and Santee Cooper, inspired by the real-world North American fisheries.

games.name: Gravity Switch
games.summary:
Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

Step into a high-stakes sliding maze where stopping isn't an option. In this fast-paced arcade puzzler, once you push in a direction, you slide until a wall stops you. Plan your routes, collect all the dots, and activate the warp crystal to reach the next level - if you can survive the traps in your way.

games.name: Dome RPG
games.summary: Dome RPG is a game about a boy named Taro who once woke up in a strange world. Why is he here and how will he get out? Explore a mysterious world with unique visuals, interesting characters and lots of mysteries to uncover!

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Battlethorne: Reckoning
games.summary: Fight, build, and strategize in a massive third-person action-strategy RPG with hundreds of units and large-scale tactical battles across vast battlefields.

games.name: The False Alice: Retold Tale
games.summary: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

games.name: Starship Crafter
games.summary: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and repay the immense debt your father left behind. Upgrade your workshop, craft components, build starships, complete contracts, follow unfolding events through the in-game newspaper, and most importantly, repay the debt before the deadline

games.name: Doinaka Girls Utopia
games.summary: Doinaka Girls Utopia je hra z kategorie Vizuální novela od studia DESSERT Soft pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 27. 11. 2026.

games.name: One Night After
games.summary: One Night After je hra z kategorie Vizuální novela od studia Smee pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 27. 11. 2026.

games.name: Kanojo no Imouto no Azato Yuuwaku: Junai Nante Gomi desu yo Senpai
games.summary: A reverse NTR visual novel, where pure-hearted bookworm Naruse Shuya cherishes his innocent romance with his girlfriend Hazuki Akane...until her sister Fumino seduces him, escalating his desires that threaten to shatter his ideals of pure love.

games.name: Meow Star Archives
games.summary: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

games.name: You Can Sort It!
games.summary: A cozy soda-sorting sim set in a little shop. All 5760 cans have spilled across the floor - pick them up, read the labels, and shelve every one by flavor. No timers, no pressure. Sort alone, or with up to three friends.

games.name: Sort My Pigs
games.summary: Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

games.name: Sorcerous 2: City of Cults
games.summary: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

games.name: Iskra
games.summary: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

games.name: Yule Dads
games.summary: Yule Dads is a chaotic multiplayer Christmas party game. Gather your friends and trick, grind, and race through the mall to win the last presents before closing time.

games.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
games.summary: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! is a first-person organizing game set in a two-floor perfume archive containing 3,240 bottles. Players inspect bottle labels, locate the correct shelves using an archive map, and complete collections that illuminate cabinets and fragrance-family signs. The game supports solo play and two-player online co-op. Its four modes are Cozy, Speedrun, Duo, and Hardcore. Cozy mode includes unlockable carrying, movement, and search skills, while Hardcore adds breakable bottles and time penalties.

games.name: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
games.summary: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

games.name: Vibe Train
games.summary: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

games.name: Hit The Buzzer
games.summary: Stop the clock – to the hundredth of a second. One press starts it, the second stops it. But at some point the display goes dark, and from then on only your sense of time counts. From 1 to 60 seconds: how close can you get?

games.name: Mukimuki Nyankos
games.summary: Mukimuki Nyankos is a 3D party game about cats training in a gym. Up to eight players compete to gain muscle through exercise minigames, disrupt rivals and grow into giants before the in-game clock reaches 11 p.m. It includes three gyms, random events, a cooperative season mode, proximity voice chat and solo play against bots.

games.name: Bio Inc. Total Defense
games.summary: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

games.name: 6guY2
games.summary:
"Make your excitement go fly-by! We are 6guY2!!!"

After the mysterious departure of a former member, the rookie idol group 6guY2 has one more chance to make things right... There's drama, betrayal, love and most of all MULTICULTURALISM! oh joy!

games.name: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
games.summary: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive is a turn-based grid puzzle game in which players lure malfunctioning robots into collisions. Tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport provide additional ways to escape pursuit and outmaneuver enemies. The game features 50 campaign levels, an endless Survival mode, an ASCII Classic mode, and a Weekly Challenge with replay-verified online rankings.

games.name: Luminova
games.summary: Test your reflexes and precision in this minimalist 2.5D auto-runner platformer! Control a high-speed white cube, master wall jumping to change direction, collect 3 fragments in each level, and unlock the portal to victory. One button, 30 levels, and ultimate challenge.

games.name: Love is Undead
games.summary: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!

games.name: Neko-nin ExHeart Spin! 2
games.summary: Get ready to nyan-nyan and nin-nin in the latest entry in the NEKO-NIN exHeart franchise with even more ninja catgirls than ever before.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

games.name: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
games.summary: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

games.name: Fishing Tales: Neko's Journey
games.summary: A relaxing idle fishing game focused on companionship, featuring 26 fishing spots and over 200 fish species. Easy to enjoy without much effort. You can place the game anywhere on your screen while studying or working, without it intruding on your tasks.

games.name: Magic Kingdom
games.summary: Magic Kingdom je jedním ze čtyř tematických parků tvořících Walt Disney World Resort v oblasti Lake Buena Vista nedaleko Orlanda na Floridě v USA. Park byl poprvé otevřen 1. října 1971. Struktura parku i atrakce jsou podobné, jako v Disneylandu v Kalifornii. V roce 2006 navštívilo park zhruba 16 640 000 návštěvníků.
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

games.name: PixelHeroScramble Plus
games.summary: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

games.name: Paint Gang
games.summary: Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

games.name: Perfectly Folded
games.summary: Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game set in a clothing store turned upside down. Fold, hang and shelve every last shirt, hat and shoe, design your own fashion, and enjoy turning the mess into a perfectly folded store at your own pace.

games.name: The Previous Owner
games.summary: Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. Across books that should never have met, the same hand keeps writing. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

games.name: Collapsle
games.summary: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

games.name: Ayakashi Profile
games.summary: Ayakashi Profile is a Japanese-fantasy turn-based combo RPG. Control four party members through individual buttons, read enemy intentions, and choose your targets and attack order. Chain guard breaks, launches, aerial follow-ups and slams into ultimate attacks. Between battles, choose healing or blessings to prepare for the next fight. The story is presented through motion comics.

games.name: Pixel Knight: Nation War
games.summary: Pixel Knight: Nation War is a pixel-art isometric MMORPG playable in the browser and on mobile from a single shared world. Players join one of two warring nations, choose a class (Warrior, Rogue with bow or dagger paths, Mage, Priest), level up with parties, gamble their gear at the anvil with +N upgrades, and fight in an open PvP zone and scheduled nation events such as Altar War. Features include an auto-hunt bot, a player market, clans, Solo Tower, Shadow Arena duels and seasonal events.

games.name: Sort Till You Sleep
games.summary:
Sort Till You Sleep is a cozy first-person sorting game. A house is buried under 3,810 toy sheep in 190 costumes, and the player carries them by the armful to the shelves that match their costumes until every sheep is home, then goes to sleep. There is no timer and no fail state.

Finished shelves pay out balls of wool that buy upgrades at the Knitting Nook, such as carrying more sheep at once or reaching farther. Ringing a bell starts one of nine bedtime mini games, including tossing sheep through a dream cloud, counting sheep over a fence, catching wishing stars and pairing socks; each first win teaches a sorting skill. Small environmental mysteries are scattered through the rooms, and ten wolves in sheep's clothing hide among the flock. One continuous playthrough lasts about 3-4 hours.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Zaos
games.summary: International Free to Play Fantasy MMORPG game, featuring incredible journeys through a beautiful expanding world.

games.name: Sale a Devolver
games.summary: Sale a Devolver is a satirical management and bureaucracy simulator where players process tax returns under absurd, ever-changing regulations. Gameplay combines reading daily tax laws, managing undeclared income, meeting work quotas, and keeping stress levels under control.

games.name: DiscPods
games.summary: Fly your DiscPod robot and compete by being the ultimate and only winner of the arena! PvP your way to the championship!

games.name: Psycasso
games.summary:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your unique artwork while avoiding capture from the ever growing police presence using stealth techniques and unique traps. Buy property, upgrades, furniture, weapons, discover a bustling city and play a host of mini games in this controversial indie title like nothing before.

games.name: Roselle Hunt
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a bounty hunter in a PvPvE backpack auto-battler. Combine and upgrade gear, obliterate your foes, and... Find Roselle.

games.name: Hereditas
games.summary: Found your own house or lead one of eight noble dynasties. Build your castle stone by stone, furnish its halls, command companions and armies, and vie for the crown through war, trade, and diplomacy - or hold your ground when the enemy arrives at your gates.

games.name: RoRX
games.summary: A competitive strategy game where both players plan in secret, then every order resolves at once. Build an army of Robots from over 200 cards, fight on hexagonal arenas and outthink your rival, not outclick them. Every card is earned by playing.

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.summary: Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.
