games.name: L.OD
games.summary:
A 2D exploration adventure.
The main character, Yoi, receives a letter from his dead sister, Chitose, saying that she wants to tell him a secret.
In order to find out the truth, Yoyi heads to an abandoned laboratory.

games.name: Match Tree
games.summary: Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game). Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep. Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

games.name: GameChanger: Episode 1
games.summary: Take on the challenge to close the four Portals in this varied 2D-Action-Adventure with shoot 'em up elements! Explore the open Interworld, solve tricky puzzles in complex dungeons, shoot your way through the hordes of counter viruses and stop the dragon!

games.name: 100 Cats Greece
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Can you find them all?

games.name: Enginefall
games.summary: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?

games.name: Knights of Fresco
games.summary: Raise your own band of Knights and fight beasts from medieval paintings. Knights of Fresco is an open world party building RPG with auto-battling combat that tries to emulate medieval depictions of battles and wars.

games.name: Hellfire Poncho
games.summary: Hellfire Poncho is a western rogue-lite isometric shooter. Shoot little demons with your upgraded weapons, die, and try again stronger. Bet your upgrades against the creatures you meet in the saloon, and develop your best build. Don't push your luck...

games.name: 100 Cats Argentina
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Can you find them all? 😺

games.name: 100 Cats Pakistan
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Can you find them all? 😺

games.name: Algolemeth
games.summary: Dungeon Automata「Algolemeth」is an "autologic": a JRPG dungeon crawler meets auto battler where you control your party with visual node-based programming. Program your party and conquer dungeons automatically. Master the dungeon through trial and error!

games.name: Backrooms Game No. 999999
games.summary: Backrooms #999999999 is a singleplayer/4 player co-op horror exploration game. Unlock the puzzles, survive the entities, escape the deadly geometry and try to reach the final level in one piece. Good luck, wanderer!

games.name: Sunkissed City
games.summary: Sunkissed City is a life-sim set in an upbeat, sun-kissed seaside metropolis full of funky vibes and quirky characters. Stake out your new life in the city, tending to DIY gardens, learning new skills, and making life-long friends and help bring life back to its once-vibrant streets!

games.name: Junklands
games.summary: Junklands is a 3D action-platformer that thrusts Rahr, a brave paper fledgling, into a polluted world ruled by its toxic overlords. Forced from home, Rahr must navigate smog-filled lands and sludge-choked rivers on a perilous quest to cleanse the Junklands and restore life.

games.name: DearMyFriend
games.summary: Set off to the unknown world Stargather Land now. The shadow of chaos is shrouding here for so long, a girl from another world shoulders the responsibility of saving this land. Travel with the power of elements until the end of destiny, only fight will lead her to the finish.

games.name: Decurion
games.summary: Decurion is a skill-based, top-down shooter about scoring under a one-shot, one-kill rule. You get the score via combo chaining while trying to defend your base.

games.name: Neon Auto Party
games.summary: Build a party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its deck of cards that determines its performance in battle. Find and buy items while leveling up units to take advantage of powerful synergies and reach the end of the dungeon!

games.name: Lost Hellden
games.summary: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

games.name: DI: Debt is Inevitable
games.summary: A wave-based arcade shooter where between waves you visit a shop with prices that increase with each purchase/rental. Keep your combo high and grab as many coins as you can, and you can delay the inevitable. Powered by GZDoom.

games.name: Wiblu
games.summary: Wiblu: The Search for the Fire Tea, is a captivating video game with German mythology, following Wiblu's quest to find the legendary Fire Tea to save her sick grandmother.

games.name: Wildlife Rescue Simulator
games.summary: Get to the chopper and fly to isolated places to rescue terrified animals from man made disasters. Take photos of your adventures and share it with your loyal supporters to get donations. Upgrade your equipment in order to rescue even more animals.

games.name: Red Snow
games.summary: Experience the ultimate fusion of snowboarding and combat in RED SNOW! Navigate perilous slopes, battle enemy forces, and execute stunning tricks to earn cash in this epic board-n-sword adventure.

games.name: Ascent: Rivals
games.summary: Ascent Rivals is an Award-Winning Indie Combat Racer. Race. Shoot. Upgrade. Outplay Your Rivals.

games.name: V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls
games.summary: V.E.D.A is a Soulslike training game with weighty combat and exploration. The protagonist, awakened with no memory, undergoes combat training in a training simulator and uncovers hidden secrets. You too can enter the Soulslike genre. Don't hesitate.

games.name: The War in Chiapas
games.summary: Control a group of young people who enter the jungle of Chiapas, Mexico, in the eighties, to form a guerrilla whose objective is to create an army to overthrow the government through a new revolution, however, a paramilitary group appears unexpectedly.

games.name: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
games.summary: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.
aliases: The Magic World II: Curse of the Ancients

games.name: Ichorous Moon
games.summary: Run! Race through the corrupted streets of Türme to stop the rising of the Ichorous Moon

games.name: Kelp Keeper
games.summary: Take on a vital role in the ecosystem in this action-packed bullet hell. Control a charming sea otter and protect the kelp forest from an endless onslaught of devious sea critters. Skillfully dodge attacks, grab your prey, and eat them all at the surface for a huge satisfying snack.

games.name: Polda 8
games.summary: It´s the eight entry in the point and click adventure series Polda and the final game with Pankrác as the main character. Just like previous entries is this one focused on puzzles and crazy humor, however this time there are also action minigames and three controlable characters.

games.name: FPS Pro Team Manager
games.summary: Recruit and manage the team of FPS players of your dreams, create your own strategies and rise to the top of the world's elite.

games.name: Bounce Gun
games.summary: Maybe just a silly roguelike, maybe something more.

games.name: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
games.summary: CONFINED: Leaving OKB-134 is a Horror/Puzzle Adventure for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. Reactivate power, lights and complex machinery. Learn about long-gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

games.name: Incoherence
games.summary: Incoherence is a fragmented first-person point and click mystery game. Enter the mind of Jason Bethlam as you awake to a brightly lit room. Piece together fragments of your life and escape.

games.name: Greenfeet Haven
games.summary: A friendly fantasy colony sim where you manage halflings. Start with nothing, launch expeditions into the wilds, experiment with crafting to discover new items, and evolve your settlement into a thriving, self-sufficient town! Inspired by the genre of RimWorld and the ambience of Stardew Valley.

games.name: Bleak Remastered
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the dystopian world of Pinnacle with BLEAK Remastered. Experience stunning new artwork and enhanced gameplay in this dark adventure. Can you navigate the relentless hostile world and save your sister, Asha?

games.name: Antidote City Hall
games.summary: A noir pixel-art adventure where you explore the city, engage in dialogues with choices and skill checks, face tough moral decisions, and shape the story’s outcome.

games.name: Suspended Animation
games.summary: Suspended animation is the slowing or stopping of biological function so that physiological capabilities are preserved. States of suspended animation are common in micro-organisms and some plant tissue, such as seeds. Many animals, including large ones, may undergo hibernation, and most plants have periods of dormancy. This article focuses primarily on the potential of large animals, especially humans, to undergo suspended animation. In animals, suspended animation may be either hypometabolic or ametabolic in nature. It may be induced by either endogenous, natural or artificial biological, chemical or physical means.

games.name: Skyblivion
games.summary:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

games.name: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
games.summary: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.
aliases: 孤独的独立游戏开发者的一生
孤独的獨立遊戲開發者的一生

games.name: Steampunk Shinobi
games.summary: Steampunk Shinobi is a roguelite action game set in a Steampunk/Medieval Japan-inspired world. Play as a lineage of Shinobi, where each death passes the quest to the next generation. Procedurally generated maps evolve with your actions, making every playthrough unique!

games.name: Pararecords
games.summary: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

games.name: Pinbleton Park
games.summary: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

games.name: Cosmorons
games.summary: The Overlord demands you Conquer the Universe! Grab your friends in a 1-4 co-op roguelite shooter and deploy as grappling robot Drudges. Battle the alien swarms, complete missions and destroy the Cosmos! Stack outrageous upgrades to build the Ultimate Drudges or delve deeper into the Universe!

games.name: Feltopia
games.summary: Feltopia is a cozy, cinematic platformer set in a fully wooly world. Objects can be needle-felted and manipulated to solve puzzles and traverse through whimsical landscapes.

games.name: Snake in the Dark
games.summary: Sure, you've played Snake. But this is Snake like you've never seen before? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake, Sokoban, and Boulder Dash. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twists than you expect!

games.name: Iseikan Renai Guide: Interplanetary Love Guide
games.summary: This PC game is a love simulation game set in the distant future where interstellar travel has become commonplace. Slavery, crime, violence... Interact with unique aliens and form close relationships with them in a world where anything is possible, where high technology and low technology coexist.

games.name: Ask Gear Re:Boost
games.summary: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

games.name: Deprision
games.summary: DEPRISION is a first-person survival horror game where you are the subject of a classified mental manipulation experiment. Explore environments distorted by memories and trauma, survive a system that adapts to your personal fears, and endure traumatic threats.

games.name: Already Dead
games.summary: Classic 90's style survival horror, reimagined for VR.

games.name: Work In Progress
games.summary: It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your contract. Now go fire some people.

games.name: Unearther
games.summary: Journey into different places and environments in search of resources and valuables. Make tools and equipments, survive the dangers and lurking monsters. Craft your way of living and discover the unknown world hidden in plain sight.

games.name: Dream Bar Simulator
games.summary: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

games.name: Star Life
games.summary: Star Life is a space sandbox RPG where you start on a planet and carve your own path. Develop skills through "learn by doing," influence dynamic economies, schedule your life with the "Life Planner," and face the challenges of space. Balance risk and survival in a universe shaped by your choices.

games.name: Froggo's Adventure: Drifting Sky
games.summary: Drift across magical worlds of dreams and wonder as Froggo 🐸, who can jump, run or tongue his way through the obstacles. Drifting Sky is not only a simple, yet magical 2D platformer, but also a strange and bizarre videogame where you never know how things would progress.

games.name: Bat Galaxy
games.summary: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

games.name: Elflock
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a fairy tale, where your actions shape the story! Become a princess, navigate the murky political landscape, forge an alliance with the Fae, or turn your back on them. Make decisions that could save your kingdom, or destroy it if you misjudge the circumstances.

games.name: Catfall
games.summary: Taking a cat on a spaceship? Great idea, as long as everything goes according to plan. It's a short road from fun adventures to sudden problems. And who knows? Maybe now the fate of the entire crew depends on one little fluffy hero... After all, cats always land on their paws, don’t they?

games.name: Nightmare Circus
games.summary: Nightmare Circus is a platform video game developed by Funcom and published by Tec Toy for the Sega Mega Drive. The game was first released in April 1996 on the Sega Channel in North America by Sega, and physically released on cartridge in Brazil sometime that same year. It was also released on the Sega Channel in Europe the following year.

games.name: The Gambit Lost to Time
games.summary: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this roguelike tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

games.name: The Dropouts
games.summary: Heist your own school to get the exams' answers and discover why so many students have disappeared in Noirmont High. Spooky and nostalgic.

games.name: Re:Ver Project - Tokyo
games.summary: "Re:VER PROJECT TOKYO" co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

games.name: Null Path
games.summary: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles, and challenges designed to push you to your limits.

games.name: Bugboy
games.summary: Catch, train and battle creepy crawlies and uncover the secrets of Spider Town in this retro Gameboy-style RPG.

games.name: CitaDrill
games.summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

games.name: Three Verses3
games.summary: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

games.name: Dragon Realms
games.summary: Be the dragon! Customise, upgrade, and dominate a vast fantasy world. Destroy castles, battle foes, gather treasure, and rule Dragon Realms!

games.name: Zaleste
games.summary: Shmup collaboration between Compile Heart and M2.

games.name: Pico Drift
games.summary: Explore the city as your ultimate racing arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

games.name: Baba Yaga
games.summary: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

games.name: Melt Away
games.summary: People end up forgetting about the dead.

games.name: Sangra
games.summary: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

games.name: Biofactory
games.summary: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. You are an evolving hive-mind brain, driven by one instinct: The factory must grow.

games.name: Festered
games.summary: Brave the terrors of a contaminated research facility, where every step could be your last. PSX style survival horror game.

games.name: Grex
games.summary: Play as a Swarm in GREX, a fast-paced incremental auto-shooter. Our body is our weapon. We die to evolve. We evolve to become The Monolith. WE ARE ONE. WE INVADE. THEY DIE.

games.name: The Lightkeeper is Gone
games.summary: The Lightkeeper Is Gone is a retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

games.name: Near the Sun: Chapter 1
games.summary: God's punishment burns the earth to ashes, and eventually consumes the underground world as well. A stylish 2D stealth action game where how you explore determines your fate. A boy carries his sister on his back and races through the underground world.

games.name: Tower Deckfense
games.summary: Tower Deckfense is an exciting blend of tower defense and deck building. Build your deck strategically, upgrade your towers, and equip them with powerful modifiers to discover the best combinations and devastate your enemies.

games.name: Nightborn
games.summary: Fight, sneak, or charm your way through a gothic modern New Orleans as a Vampire detective of your creation. Unravel a vast centuries-old conspiracy involving Vampire factions, Werewolves, and far stranger horrors. Try to survive as a Nightborn without losing yourself to madness or damnation.

games.name: Super Debt
games.summary: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

games.name: Tape Us Out
games.summary: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

games.name: Deepspace Emporium
games.summary: Deepspace Emporium is a gritty shopkeeping sim set in the depths of a sprawling space station. As a former scavenger turned merchant, you trade in goods of varying legality—all while facing rising rent. Navigate a divided society, balance faction demands, and dodge authorities as you try to survive.

games.name: Ashes: Epoch
games.summary: Ashes: Epoch is a fan campaign being made by a fellow named Roobly. Vos gave him archive access so expect to see a lot of polished up cut content, including some stuff you oldhead Zdoom forums guys might recognize.

games.name: The Barkeeper
games.summary: A stylized top-down 3D bartender simulator. Your task is to quickly make cocktails & drinks according to recipes in a given time. Success depends on tactics, space planning and your adaptation speed. Ready for the challenge? Then grab your shaker and shake!

games.name: Poem Ex Machina
games.summary: Anime style, Ride X Fight, fast paced game.

games.name: Cryptage
games.summary: A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters and buying new staffs and skins to improve yourself! The game has endless mode.

games.name: Mortal Quest
games.summary: A survival-adventure game about a mortal who's been transferred to a demon-infested island.

games.name: With Dream
games.summary: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

games.name: Fungiman 2
games.summary: Just another adventure with your friendly neighborhood fungus — nothing to worry about… probably?

games.name: The Final Fragment
games.summary: A GxG coming-of-age visual novel. Nina sucks at choosing. But when a mysterious incident happens at the arts academy, will she muster the courage to choose–or will she let someone else decide on her behalf?

games.name: Where Noble Plans Lie
games.summary: Build-up your territory, your team of advisors, and your reputation as you bring every other noble to ruin at the behest of the Vampire Queen. Make the kingdom yours in the city-builder and turn-based RPG: Where Noble Plans Lie!

games.name: Bless You Again
games.summary: Lily” is a magician and a homunculus. She challenges a dungeon named “Tomb of Blessings” in search of a certain blessing! The player controls a character faithfully reproduced from the cel animation and defeats many monsters in search of a powerful blessing.

games.name: Off-Score: A Game of Songs
games.summary: A surreal music puzzle game that transports you into the stories of our original fusion-jazz songs. Through a mysterious vinyl player sitting on a songwriter’s desk, explore the magical worlds that unfold along with the music and lyrics.

games.name: Clawsome
games.summary: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

games.name: Fate's Masquerade
games.summary: In this animated manhwa-inspired romance fantasy, toy with princes behind their perfect masks. Fall in love? Maybe. Make them fall for you? Absolutely. You are unpredictable, audacious, and just unhinged enough to make history. Heroine or villainess? Why not both?

games.name: DigSite
games.summary: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

games.name: Gig Crawler
games.summary: WardCorp is hiring. The pay is good. The dungeons are not. Co-op extraction roguelite, every contract hits different!

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.summary: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!

games.name: Surge Generations
games.summary: Surge Generations is a complete overhaul of Shadow Generations with the goal of replacing everything Shadow-related with Surge, such as voice lines, cutscenes, animations, and more.

games.name: Death In Your Dice
games.summary: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

games.name: Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit
games.summary:
"Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit" is a mystery adventure featuring a public security duo tackling supernatural cases.

Players take on the role of Tsujitsuma, a member of the "Angelic Agency" investigating "Ghosturbance Cases." The game progresses through three phases: (1) Conversation Part, (2) Deduction Part, and (3) Salvation Part.

Players navigate these phases to uncover the truth behind each incident.
aliases: 天使機構執行部魂救済課

games.name: Rocket Penguin
games.summary: Rocket Penguin is a unique 2D flying game that may seem simple but requires master-level skills to reach outer space.

games.name: Rootbound
games.summary: A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.

games.name: 100 Cats Philippines
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Philippines! Can you find them all? 😺

games.name: Metal Coffin
games.summary: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

games.name: Animas
games.summary: Animas is a first-person psychological horror experience that plunges you into the dark secrets of the Blanco family. Explore a cursed house in the Venezuelan mountains, where time unravels to reveal decades of sectarian rituals and familial tragedies.

games.name: Ice on the Edge
games.summary: Become a coach in ICE on the EDGE, a figure skating simulation game. Train your athlete, master skills, and craft the perfect routine to win. Face fierce rivals and experience a dramatic story carved on the ice. Can your guidance lead them to the highest stage?

games.name: Recital of the Heart
games.summary: Battle and befriend new and familiar characters alike in this Adventure/Action game filled with discovery and whimsy. Experiment with an array of abilities and modifications as you explore a mirror world and unlock its secrets to reach the princess.

games.name: Moonbrella
games.summary: A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

games.name: Ghost Sector
games.summary: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

games.name: Wanted 3D: Dead or Alive
games.summary: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a UZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

games.name: Crimson Frontier
games.summary: Crimson Frontier – a fast‑paced top‑down shooter in the world of cyberpunk with the vibe of 90s action movies in single player mode, like super‑macho who crushes every enemy standing in his way.

games.name: Hero's Hand
games.summary: Embark on the ultimate Poker-Based Roguelike RPG Adventure! Hero’s Hand packs a strategic punch! Become the Knight of Spades & save the land of Cardunia! The game features hand drawn animation, humorous fantasy monsters, & addictive turn-based poker combat that keeps you coming back for more!

games.name: Digimon Alysion
games.summary: A new Digimon TCG game being developed for mobile.

games.name: Raev: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
games.summary: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.
aliases: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores

games.name: Dark Mass
games.summary: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

games.name: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
games.summary: A pleasant breeze of ease and casual fun ... or a satisfying challenge and strategy - you decide how you want to play the game ! Also, a lot of cute animals !

games.name: Melted Time
games.summary: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

games.name: Speak of my sin
games.summary: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.

games.name: Striker!
games.summary: STRIKER! is a retro-inspired football-golf game set across 40+ levels. Control your team of Strikers and shoot your ball over a wide range of different courses and mechanics.

games.name: Fatal Dopamine
games.summary: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

games.name: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
games.summary: Take control of your own airship, hire people for your crew, help them on their personal stories, follow the trail of a whimsical inventor of the colonisation era, trade, fight, discover, and try to stay afloat.

games.name: Cereal Reaper
games.summary: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

games.name: Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes
games.summary: A nonlinear pixel art visual novel set in the 1980s Soviet Union, inspired by Soviet children's spooky stories.

games.name: Immortal Boy
games.summary: A 2.5D Turn-Based RPG where you battle enemies with Minigames! - And also emotional abuse.

games.name: Hydraulic Slam
games.summary: In this turn-based, tactical tennis simulation you build, control and improve your own tennis robot. Play on grass, clay and hard courts and balance your energy, precision and condition throughout the match. Maintain and develop your robot between matches.

games.name: Digital Legacy of Zero
games.summary: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy domains, upgrade your basement to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

games.name: Galago
games.summary: As night falls, a galago — also known as a bush baby — ventures into suburbia, searching for elusive golden fireflies. But the world is perilous for one so small… Galago is an exploration-platformer, blending puzzle-solving, survival, and mystery.

games.name: Dwarf Legacy
games.summary: A challenging bullet-hell precision platformer. Climb up vertical dungeons of The Mountainhome, battling relentless swarms of enemies and navigating perilous traps. Uncover the secret of your lost legacy hidden atop the highest peak and secure the future of your village.

games.name: Drownlight
games.summary: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.

games.name: Groda
games.summary: GRODA is an intense arcade experience, blending nerve-wracking action with precision platforming and rogue elements

games.name: Wizard Hand
games.summary: A magical deckbuilder game where solitaire meets roguelike. Uncover dazzling combos and accumulate points with the help of enchantments, crafting, and a collection of powerful artifacts.

games.name: Spot Zero
games.summary: Spot Zero is a mission-driven anime action RPG where you lead a squad of Human and Yokai investigators through monster-controlled zones, securing outposts and pushing the frontline, with each character fighting in a distinct style from blade clashes to TPS mode and elemental bursts.

games.name: Pelican Post
games.summary:
Pelican Post is a cozy narrative game about delivering mail to a town of unique characters and helping to regain a lost sense of community.

You play as Pepper, a young pelican who recently moved to Port Pleasant to take a job as the town's mailman. Through your job, you'll get to interact with and get to know the townsfolk and help them out.

"Small acts of kindness" is pretty much in the job description.

games.name: Fantasy World Manager
games.summary: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

games.name: Drug Schedule
games.summary: Build your empire! Cook and make illegal drugs, expand your cartel, and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Play solo or team up in co-op to dominate the underworld! Your empire, your rules. Rise to power! Don't get high on your own dope!

games.name: The Calling
games.summary: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

games.name: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
games.summary: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

games.name: Flooded Burials
games.summary: Flooded Burials is an adventure game about exploring a sunken tower. Lower the water levels by completing stages, and find out what lays at the bottom of this strange structure as you explore further down it's depths.

games.name: In a World After People
games.summary: This is the story of humanity and a robot reaching their “end.” A lonely yet beautiful post-apocalyptic pixel-art narrative adventure, following a robot that awakens after humanity’s extinction until the moment it shuts itself down. Experience a rich and memorable journey lasting around two hours.

games.name: Beak Island Visitor Center
games.summary: You’re Beak Peak National Park’s first Ranger! Between quirky locals and bustling visitors, it’s always buzzing. Enjoy a slow coffee stroll or keep things tidy on patrol. Beak island is now in your hands.

games.name: Magical Girl Critical Deluxe
games.summary: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

games.name: Do Not Play
games.summary: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.

games.name: Slain 2: The Beast Within
games.summary: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where steel and savagery collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn, embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world against the forces of Vroll. The quest begins now.

games.name: Cozy Beach
games.summary: 🏝️ Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an beautiful tropical island where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, go swimming, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

games.name: Potion in Motion
games.summary: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

games.name: Sugar Sling Showdown
games.summary: Sling candies and fling sugar bombs at your friends in this tongue-based, chaotic, physics party game. Play against each other or join forces against enemies. Win rewards and use them to build your own ToffeeTown in a candy-coated world.

games.name: Splash Girls
games.summary: Splash Girls is an exhilarating shooting action game in which you must save girls who have grown gigantic due to a mysterious virus. Players wield a vaccine-firing gun and a massive syringe to stand against the rampaging virus. The only thing that can save these giant girls is your extra-thick injection!? An flashy rescue mission of extraordinary scale and intensity is about to begin.

games.name: Questing
games.summary: A satirical love-letter to classic 16-bit adventure games, about a chosen hero who never wanted to be chosen.

games.name: The Spirit Engine DX
games.summary: The Spirit Engine DX is a complete rewrite of the cult classic indie title from 2003 by Mark Pay. Instead of using a traditional turn-based system, an auto battler with real-time pausing is opted to allow players to switch tactics at their own pace without constant menu prompts.

games.name: Catena
games.summary: Catena is a surname. Notable people with the surname include: Alejandro Catena (born 1994), Spanish footballer Elena Catena (1920–2012), Spanish academic Gerardo Catena (1902–2000), American mobster Laura Catena (born 1967), Argentine vintner, physician and author Marina Catena, Italian soldier and United Nations official Michela Catena (born 1999), Italian footballer Paulus Catena (fl. 353–362), Roman notary and investigator Tom Catena (born 1964), American physician and humanitarian Víctor Andrés Catena (1925–2009), Spanish screenwriter and film, television and theater director Vincenzo Catena (c. 1470–1531), Italian painter

games.name: Plush Party
games.summary: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

games.name: Exovia
games.summary: Exovia is a physics-based mining and automation sandbox in space. Survey asteroids, engineer zero-G logistics without conveyor belts, and design complex Newtonian factories. Turn floating chaos into perfect order and experience true inner peace as you solve one satisfying problem and then the next.

games.name: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
games.summary: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

games.name: The Blue Cut Hook
games.summary: The Blue Cut Hook blends cozy tavern management with subtle adventure. You're no hero, just a humble tavern keeper, but your food, gear, and advice quietly shape the adventurers who pass through. They make the choices, take the glory, and face the danger, but your influence might keeps them alive.

games.name: Monolith's Dreamers
games.summary: A captivating 2D puzzle game where strategic thinking is essential. Explore the world of the Monoliths, outwit the traps guarding the ruins, and help the inhabitants. Solve puzzles that block your progress by collecting and redistributing energy.

games.name: Vikings Dynasty
games.summary: Embrace viking life and earn Valhalla’s blessing. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs. Build and customize ships and explore the fjords in the unforgiving world of Vikings Dynasty.

games.name: Bloodstone Rising
games.summary: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

games.name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
games.summary: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

games.name: Tarvos Desolation
games.summary: Survive on a hostile moon full of nightmares! Face hordes of monsters, explore mysterious locations, and uncover secrets that may save your life. Will you find a way to escape, or will you be consumed by the darkness of Tarvos?

games.name: Drakefall
games.summary: Explore the World of Drakefall in this roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, piece together the broken world, and journey through swamps and mountain peaks with a familiar playstyle.

games.name: Diner Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!

games.name: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
games.summary: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

games.name: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

games.name: Whiskers and Wizardry
games.summary: Mr. Sparkle’s tale has gone wrong. To escape the nightmare, you must combine runes to craft your own spells and survive relentless bullet-hell chaos.

games.name: Project Horizon
games.summary: Project Horizon was a 1959 study to determine the feasibility of constructing a scientific / military base on the Moon, at a time when the U.S. Department of the Army, Department of the Navy, and Department of the Air Force had total responsibility for U.S. space program plans. On June 8, 1959, a group at the Army Ballistic Missile Agency (ABMA) produced for the Army a report titled Project Horizon, A U.S. Army Study for the Establishment of a Lunar Military Outpost.

games.name: Sekira
games.summary: Dark forces are penetrating our world! Help the humble priestess Anachel crush the heads of the Dark Lord and all his minions!

games.name: Grav My Balls
games.summary: Grav your balls and let them fly! You are trapped and must escape with the help of the strange tech built into your hands. Launch your balls to change gravity on objects blocking your path. Use your mind and your new powers to solve gravity and mind bending puzzles.

games.name: Shrine Protectors
games.summary: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

games.name: CallMara
games.summary: CallMara is a psychological thriller with elements of horror, set in a gloomy medieval village. The protagonist, waking up in the forest, discovers a devastated village and explores its secrets, gradually realizing that he has become the cause of the evil that has engulfed his village.

games.name: Star Squadron
games.summary: Star Squadron is a next-generation space combat simulator delivering unmatched immersion. With seamless transitions, an interactive narrative, and revolutionary voice synthesis that personalizes dialogue to your actions, your choices, and your name, every journey will feel uniquely yours.

games.name: Bunny Rampage: History of Revenge
games.summary: Dive into Rabbit Rampage, a whimsical game where rabbit Max is accidentally transformed into a Plush Bunny Cyborg by eccentric scientist Lazar. Immerse yourself in a fantastical realm as Max embarks on an epic adventure, equipped with high-tech gadgets and cybernetic enhancements

games.name: Shuffle Farm
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where farming meets the arcane. Build powerful synergies, master production chains, explore uncharted lands, and face formidable challenges - all with the help of a mysterious god. Or just chill and plant some crops... you can do that too!

games.name: Ping Profit: Internet Tycoon
games.summary: Launch your hosting company straight from your parent's basement! Buy servers, solve problems, and grow your profits as you climb from startup to tech titan. Keep customers online, boost your reputation, and build the ultimate hosting empire in Ping Profit!

games.name: Bite the Crown
games.summary: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

games.name: Misty Garden
games.summary: Build the garden, fulfilling requests from the cute visitors, and even recruit them to create items! Decorate your misty garden to welcome cute little creatures, provide a place to help them relax!

games.name: Gloctopus
games.summary: Eight guns is better than one — if you have eight arms. Gloctopus is a bullet heaven roguelike where you equip, mutate, and build your tentacles into a one-octopus army. The ocean didn't stand a chance.

games.name: Herb Seek Slash
games.summary: Herbs Seek Slash is a 2D top-down scrolling shoot'em up game with fantasy background. An ordinary swordsman, Ethan, sets out to find an ordinary herb to save his sister, Elaine, on an extraordinary and perilous journey.

games.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
games.summary: Solve physics puzzles with magnets, springs, portals, fans, and more while your new best friend Sendy helps you along the way! But maybe keep an eye on him, he's been acting a little … strange, lately.

games.name: Infinite Alliance
games.summary: Heroes and villains from 17 Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, CrossCode, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

games.name: Grinville
games.summary: An abandoned park, a forgotten tragedy, and something that should never have been awakened. Years ago, a charming parade turned into a massacre when the animatronics, created to entertain, brutally attacked the audience. Now, you return to this cursed place to uncover the truth. But beware... they are still here, waiting.

games.name: Puffin Parcel Post
games.summary: Build a thriving postal network where puffins handle the deliveries! Place buildings strategically, unlock perks and upgrades that shake up the gameplay, and adapt to new challenges as you deliver an ever-growing number of parcels across the map. Can your puffins keep up with the demand?

games.name: Death of a Dungslinger
games.summary: Abruptly reincarnated as a dung beetle, you’ll battle a colorful cast of the neighborhood’s baddest bugs as you scoot, scuttle, and shoot your way through charming 3D worlds. Ball up whatever material you can find, then sling it at your foes—or hop on and ride it around to outmaneuver them!

games.name: Compress(Space)
games.summary: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

games.name: Coalescent: Tidal Rapture
games.summary: A hypnagogic 3D swimming/entanglement adventure game about harmonizing and want. Dive into a world of merpeople who are transforming and discovering casual relationships through the eyes of a floater who's just been dumped and refuses to evolve. Told in 3 chapters.

games.name: Ultima Chess VR
games.summary: Ultima Chess – chess as you've never seen before! Battle on the chessboard in virtual reality, where every piece comes to life and engages in a fantasy duel!

games.name: Prism Warriors DX
games.summary: The Prism Warriors return for another helping of retro-styled bullet hell action. Face off against the sinister Twilight Four, and fight to save more than just your friends...

games.name: Vampires Die
games.summary: Hired by the "Council" to take out a rogue coven, you must gather your clan and travel through the dark streets, graveyards, and crypts to battle for hierarchy against the deadliest of your own bloodline. Roll the dice in this "chill" turn-based board game, but remember, sometimes even Vampires Die!

games.name: Void Protocol
games.summary: Void Protocol is a 3D ​​hardcore puzzle​​ game built on ​​Temporal Imprint​​. In an indie-crafted cyberpunk lab, freeze/rewind objects' states (position, activation, motion) to crack ​​impossible puzzles​​. Manipulate causality—every action sparks solutions or paradoxes.

games.name: Loot Profit
games.summary: Merchant Simulator. It seems simple enough — buy low, sell high. But in this world, almost everyone’s out to swindle each other...

games.name: You Sure Wanna Drink This?
games.summary: A charming picture-book style interactive story with light puzzles and turn-based combat. After the Pharmacist’s knowledge vanishes, experiment on your partner to learn! Analyze potion effects to deduce ingredient properties. Enjoy vibrant art and story. Reclaim your lost knowledge!
aliases: You Sure You Wanna Drink This?

games.name: Grapple Car
games.summary: A car with a grappling hook! Twist and turn with tight driving controls around colorful tracks to complete challenges, customize your car, and race for a spot at the timed global online leaderboards.

games.name: No Gods of Men
games.summary: Rebuild a towering citadel, manage your disciples, and slash through waves of enemies in a hand-drawn world that combines roguelike metroidvania gameplay with base-building & colony management.

games.name: Emojis Battle
games.summary: Emojis Battle is a Tower Defense game where you build your army of Yellow Emojis to match your strategy. Strengthen them to fight Bluemojis, who grow stronger each round, requiring you to adjust to new types of Bluemojis and battle locations. Develop strategies, enhance your army, and make history!

games.name: Tank Core
games.summary: "Tank Core" is a 2D top-down shooter game infused with Roguelike elements. Players will collect various random tank components in levels, including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores, to assemble unique tanks that will protect base and defeat all enemies encountered.

games.name: Followers of Krow
games.summary: Possess yourself an adventurer in this roguelike autobattler! Train their bodies, teach them powerful abilities, explore the world of fantasy to find them powerful equipment, ancient runes and relics. Seek out your enemies and... whether they die is up to Krow.

games.name: Marble Run Maker
games.summary: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions.

games.name: Hollow Drive
games.summary: In that world, simply being alive was enough to bear the weight of sin. To prevent the depletion of energy that grants supernatural powers, those who fail to prove their "worth of existence" are eliminated. …In this desolate world, I awoke with no memories, not even knowing my own name.

games.name: Fecal Freighter
games.summary: Become a sewage truck operator and survive the foul dangers: drive your ZIL, battle sludge demons, complete tasks, explore a grim world, and uncover the mystery of an alien conspiracy.

games.name: Climb It!
games.summary: Take on the challenge and conquer the mountain! Test your coordination and resilience as you scale sheer cliffs and navigate through mountain caves - where every misstep can come at a high cost. Join this thrilling adventure and prove your skill!

games.name: Mess
games.summary: MESS is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment. Experience yourself in a role of Warden to maintain order, or Prisoner to try to break free and escape the prison.

games.name: Never's End
games.summary: Master a deeply systemic battlefield where every force interacts. Move heat to create wind, shift humidity to change the weather, and compress the earth, turning rock into lava. Possess townsfolk, explore an open world, and fight back the ever-creeping Never in this turn-based tactical RPG.

games.name: Castle Cab
games.summary: Castle Cab is a hilariously chaotic action sandbox game that puts you in the horseshoes of a majestic, yet slightly unhinged, steed. Hitched to your trusty cart, you’ll gallop, drift, and crash your way through a bustling medieval world where rules are more of a suggestion.

games.name: Mop'n Spark
games.summary: "MOP'N SPARK" is a 2D puzzle platformer where a street cleaner and an electrician—an unlikely duo—team up to tackle challenging stages.

games.name: The Shadow Beneath
games.summary: The Shadow Beneath is an action roguelike where you must fulfill an ancient prophecy and rise against the demonic forces that have taken over the world. You will battle relentless waves of enemies, master powerful abilities and reclaim what humanity lost since the Demon Lords reign began - freedom

games.name: Touhou Dream Duel
games.summary: Battle your way through a beautifully drawn Gensokyo in this unique fighting game inspired by the classics from the Touhou Project franchise.

games.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop inside a far northern city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

games.name: Time Jump
games.summary: You are a Wrestling Champion. A Kid. A Professor. A Rock. A Ghost. An Evil Maniac. Fight yourself or save yourself. Your choice!

games.name: Shrine of Haunts
games.summary: In the summer of 1990, you return to the secluded mountain village of Iwao as your grandfather falls critically ill. The village shrine is said to seal the yokai "Tsuchigumo." As the "Mushi Okuri Festival" nears, its ritual flames may awaken a thousand-year-old curse…

games.name: Five Heads
games.summary: Five prisoners each have a visible-to-others card on their forehead. Across three rounds, they logically deduce and rank their cards from lowest to highest. On the final round, each guesses their exact card, using every prior guess as a clue. A single mistake can doom them—can you solve it?

games.name: Shadows of Midnight: They Watch Me Sleep
games.summary: The game is a narrative-driven horror experience inspired by the Silent Hill and Fears to Fathom franchises. Live through two terrifying stories: a man’s summer getaway turns into a nightmare at a shady hotel, and a child grows up knowing something watches from the forest—always waiting.

games.name: Lost Ground
games.summary: 3x3 grid turn-based battle and the exquisite encounter of the rogue-lite deck building! Place multiple heroes on the 3x3 grid to strategically defeat your enemies. Customize and grow your heroes with various combinations of gears, cards, and relics. Defeat the demons to reclaim lost ground!

games.name: Escape Velocity
games.summary: Escape Velocity is a singleplayer game that tells the rather extraordinary life story of an ordinary man who struggles to obtain the things he desires. The game seamlessly interweaves robust runner-like gameplay mechanics with an engaging story, which has been previously unexplored or a weakly employed combination in endless runner games...

games.name: Mythic Isle
games.summary: "Create your mini fantasy island in the corner of your Windows desktop! Tired from work or study? Just click casually and watch adorable pets farm, mine, and build automatically for you~ From a deserted isle to a thriving paradise - all thanks to these little creatures with superpowers!"

games.name: On Donuts and Holes
games.summary: A psychological adventure through a dreamy landscape. Face unanswerable questions to reach the ultimate enigmas: Who are you? Who am I?

games.name: 100 Barcelona Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: 100 Lisbon Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: Software CEO
games.summary: Build your own software empire from scratch. Manage projects, recruit staff, design components, and grow from a garage startup to a tech giant. Create SaaS platforms, sell software, or fulfill contracts. Balance quality, deadlines, and innovation in this relaxing yet deep business simulation game.

games.name: Stip
games.summary: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

games.name: Deep Room
games.summary: An anti escape room game where you explore the depths of a mysterious room.

games.name: PayGame
games.summary: 《PayGame》is a black-and-white hand-drawn dungeon exploration game.You must race against time through randomly generated rooms, combining items and bills to pay massive amounts of money in order to stay alive.Each run offers a brand-new challenge and a completely different experience

games.name: Inferno Pathways
games.summary: Descend into the abandoned metro in Inferno Pathways, a first-person psychological horror game. Navigate dark tunnels, solve puzzles, and uncover sinister secrets. Confront your deepest fears and piece together the haunting story of Mike Collins. Can you escape the darkness?

games.name: Will O Wisp
games.summary: This is a platform action game in which you control light in a world shrouded in complete darkness and rely on it to progress. Use the light to travel from place to place and illuminate the buried truth.

games.name: Show Quiz
games.summary: Show Quiz is a dynamic quiz game that tests your knowledge and reflexes! Chain together questions, climb levels and improve your rank to impress Jack Pot, your supercharged presenter.Over 5000 questions await you in this game!

games.name: Journey to the Center of the Lost Waterpark
games.summary: In this first-person experience you visit a waterpark unlike any others you have seen before. Your adventure leads you through eerie and beautiful surroundings with puzzles and obstacles while you uncover the secrets of the lost waterpark.

games.name: Warbound
games.summary: Build your ultimate battle deck and lead your armies in epic strategic warfare. Collect powerful cards, conquer rival kingdoms, and rise to become the greatest ruler in WARBOUND!

games.name: Machine of the Wasteland
games.summary: High-octane vehicular combat action game set in a chaotic, post-apocalyptic world where survival hinges on your ability to outmaneuver and outgun your enemies.

games.name: Magic Scavenger
games.summary: 《Magic Scavenger》 is a casual looting game. You arrive at an unfamiliar continent, free to explore this medieval land. While scavenging items across the map, you'll also encounter potential enemies

games.name: Stealer
games.summary: Platformer with elements of metroidvania. Begin your adventure as a thief who is immersed in darkness. Use your lantern to explore eerie locations, search for clues, and interact with surrounding objects to uncover secrets and achieve your goals.

games.name: People of Mine
games.summary: A hand-drawn 2D arcade shooter about pilots, memory, and survival in the endless sky. Play as a Polish or Soviet fighter pilot battling waves of enemies in a minimalist, emotional story about courage, solitude, and the will to live above the clouds.

games.name: Gourmet Steak Odyssey
games.summary: A resource management platformer where you play as Sweet Baby Jesus on a quest to make the perfect steak. Use your gun to propel yourself through levels and use your feet viciously to crush your foes.

games.name: Bake Until Done
games.summary: You are a muffin. A wholesome little guy trying to navigate a baker's kitchen full of traps, tricks, and devious desserts. But those sweet treats are out for crumbs. Beat them back and get past the obstacles using only your muffin’s morsels. Just don't lose too much of yourself in the process.

games.name: 100 Astro Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.

games.name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
games.summary: Shadow Sacrament is a grim horrorvania where you play as a tormented detective who must investigate the secrets of an ancient, horrific monastery. Explore hidden chambers, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that lurk in its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

games.name: Teios' Journey
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling adventure through a vibrant world teeming with challenges and mysteries. Traverse diverse landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and engage in epic battles as you unravel the secrets hidden within the land.

games.name: Leap Galaxy
games.summary: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

games.name: No Straight Roads 2
games.summary: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

games.name: Canvas Street
games.summary: Canvas Street je videohra pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Tea, Please!
games.summary: Tea, Please! is a short 30-minute game that explores the contrast between the drudgery and noise of office life and the surprising happiness and peace gained through remote work during lockdown.

games.name: Mudang: Two Hearts
games.summary: In a unified Korea, masked terrorists strike at the heart of Seoul. Ji Jeongtae, a soldier sent in to stop the attacks, stumbles upon a K-Pop star named Gavi at the center of the unfolding crisis. As their stories intertwine, a chilling truth begins to take shape.

games.name: Arcane Eats
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

games.name: SkyRig
games.summary: Build floating automated rigs in a volatile gas giant. Extract elements, synthesize compounds, and descend through atmospheric layers in this sci-fi systems-builder focused on chemistry, engineering, and survival.

games.name: Barotrauma: Home & Harbor
games.summary: Home & Harbor is the upcoming expansion for Barotrauma. Introducing outpost ownership, building and management and a mysterious new faction: The Descendants, which will shake up the world of Europa's merry sailors.

games.name: Make Your Move
games.summary: "Make Your Move" is a song by Christian rock band Third Day. Written by Mac Powell and composed by Third Day, the song was released was serviced to Christian CHR radio in the United States on January 30, 2011, as the third single from the band's 2010 album Move. A southern rock song, "Make You Move" features a heavy kick drum and grunge-influenced chorus, while the vocals are distorted during the bridge and take on a muffled effect. Lyrically, the song depicts evangelism for the perspective of a non-believer.

games.name: Flashloop
games.summary: Survive on a dreadful planet. Explore a large, interconnected world. Gain new abilities, upgrade your weapons, and uncover secrets. Defeat treacherous bosses and reveal the dark secrets of this dreadful planet.

games.name: Hello Space
games.summary: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

games.name: Thumblemania
games.summary: Thumb up and fight! Thumblemania is an action-packed wrestling game where you smack down your opponents to become the “Strongest Thumb of the Univeeeeerse”!

games.name: Greta Sees Ghosts!
games.summary: Greta Sees Ghosts! is a lovingly crafted cozy adventure filled with quirky ghosts, witty dialogue, and clever shape-based puzzles. Explore remote islands, help the dead move on, and uncover Greta’s quietly touching story. One odd encounter at a time.

games.name: Farmbotic
games.summary: Get ready to venture into the world of Farmatic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

games.name: Fay Keeper
games.summary: Battle, catch, and morph hundreds of Fays in this new turn-based creature collector RPG! Traverse the vast realm of The Faylands, filled with bustling cities, challenging dungeons and arenas, hidden routes and unpredictable weather. Ascend ranks to become the ultimate Fay Keeper!

games.name: Deadly Deals
games.summary: You're a merchant in an antique shop. Buy, sell, develop. Easy as that. Just don't die. One little detail of a profitable location that realtors don't usually tell you...

games.name: The Great Hatch
games.summary: Lead an army of goblins in a quest to break a giant floating Egg. Build your village and manage hordes of goblins in a chaotic journey to uncover the mysteries of the giant Egg.

games.name: Cubic Blitz
games.summary: Cubic Blitz is an isometric puzzle game where you control a cube and solve loads of hand-crafted levels. With the power of paint, sponges, and much more, your task is simple: PAINT THE WORLD.

games.name: Bosslife Office Manager
games.summary: Set up your own office. Expand your office as you wish. Transform from a small office to a large company.Don't forget to make your employees happy too.

games.name: Always with You
games.summary: "Always with you" is a cute and relaxing action-puzzle game. Switch freely between controlling a girl and a cat, solve clever puzzles, explore the ancient Alto civilization, and defeat unruly guardians. Embark on an exciting adventure with three cats to find your mother!

games.name: GraviTech
games.summary: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.

games.name: Ascension
games.summary: Ascension is a fast-paced roguelite where skills evolve mid-run, quests shift based on your actions, and every room is unpredictable. Fuse powers, stay alive, and try not to think too hard about who's really watching.

games.name: Cameraman: The Pilot Episode
games.summary: Cameraman: The Pilot Episode is a psychological horror game. Manipulate time and gravity to solve puzzles in ever-changing, twisted spaces. With only a VHS camcorder, uncover dark secrets, face unseen anomalies, and navigate an uncharted dimension where reality unravels.

games.name: 1! 2! 3! Battle Card!
games.summary: A simple and interesting new poker game that supports 2-4 players online battles. The key to winning is to balance risks and benefits, perform operations to maximize benefits, participate in ranking and bidding competitions, and see who is the real "head-breaking" king!

games.name: Dungeon Sweeper
games.summary: A tactical roguelike that blends classic Minesweeper with auto-battler combat. Flag hidden monsters to avoid fights or trigger them and battle for loot. Explore randomized dungeons, gear up, and survive as long as you can.

games.name: Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror
games.summary: Run a cozy little soup shop haunted by unsettling stories. In Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror, uncover hidden mysteries and unlock every secret recipe. Serve the right soup from the Super Soup 2000.

games.name: Mistwilds
games.summary: Mistwilds is a vibrant online adventure where you collect, evolve, and battle magical creatures. Explore a vast world, unlock new zones, and join forces with friends to tame wild beasts, take on quests, trade rare loot, and conquer challenging dungeons.

games.name: The Symbiant II
games.summary: The Symbiant II is a BL-Yaoi-Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

games.name: Dungeons & Desserts
games.summary: Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also manage a pastry shop. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell in your cosy bakery, all while balancing the pressures of a greedy landlord constantly increasing your rent.

games.name: Finally a Florist
games.summary: Finally a Florist is a cozy, slice-of-life game where you gather flowers to arrange beautiful bouquets. Explore peaceful landscapes, befriend animals, and fill heartfelt requests from the local villagers as you finally become a florist.

games.name: Gatekeeper's Week
games.summary: Become a guard of the glorious kingdom of Cardenia! Your task is to let only law-abiding travelers into the city, while repelling bandit attacks and sending swindlers to jail! Be attentive and vigilant! For the glory of the King!

games.name: Plush Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy plushie shop in this management simulation game. Buy, price, and sell adorable plush toys, stationery, and mystery blind boxes!

games.name: HellPunk: Purgatorium
games.summary: HellPunk: Purgatorium is a roguelite that combines stylish action with inventory management. Equip gears, manage your grid, and conquer the tower.

games.name: Red Rust Pioneers
games.summary:
Your story begins stranded in the unforgiving wilderness of the Wild West.

Your one goal: to survive.

Endure scorching days and freezing nights as you battle hunger, thirst, and the elements. Forage for food, hunt wildlife, and fish to stay alive. Scavenge the land to gather vital resources and craft the tools and weapons you’ll need to stand a chance in this brutal but breathtaking frontier.

Can you master the elements and withstand blistering heat, violent rainstorms and freezing cold winters?

Should you beat the odds and live, alone or with up to three friends, you’ll find yourself in a gorgeous, rugged, vibrant land. Will you be able to not only survive, but thrive?

Build and grow your camp your way with easy to use base building mechanics. Fish in the lakes and rivers, or hunt in the atmospheric woodlands and open prairies. Farm and harvest a variety of crops to establish a self-sufficient camp. Adventure high into the mountains to mine resources, and craft better weapons and tools.

Explore a beautifully realized, open world, fictionalized Wild West frontier and become the first to discover the untamed wilderness of Red Rust Valley.

If you can overcome the threat of extreme hunger, brutal weather conditions and lethal wildlife you may just live to appreciate it.

games.name: Echoes of Night: The Exodus of the Stars
games.summary: In this world consumed by darkness, where aberrant creatures lurk in the shadows... Prometheus is the only hope. In this action-platformer, you must find lost star fragments and rebuild the constellations to restore light to the universe.

games.name: The Prophecy of Horn
games.summary: Lead your heroes through a psychedelic grimdark world in a fast-paced hybrid turn-based mode, where heroes take turns while hordes of enemies attack simultaneously. Execute devastating combos and gain extra turns through Rampage to annihilate the legions of the Demon Horn!

games.name: MassEve
games.summary: The quantum world is on the edge of revolution, and only neutrinos can shift its fate. Mass-Eve is a fast-paced roguelike twin-stick shooter diving deep into the mysteries of modern physics. The future of the universe depends on your choices, are you ready to reshape it?

games.name: The Bunny Graveyard II
games.summary: Help Skye the Bunny find her lost brother Claudio in this action-packed horror adventure with charming pixel graphics. Hop like a bunny and get ready to explore the haunted streets of Carrot Town!

games.name: Tuoni
games.summary: In Finnish mythology, Tuoni (Finnish pronunciation: [ˈtuo̯ni]) was the god of Tuonela (the world of the dead), and darkness personified. He was the husband of Tuonetar. Their children included Kipu-Tyttö, Tuonenpoika, and Loviatar, who were divinities of suffering. When in human form, he appears as an old man with three fingers on each hand and a hat of darkness.

games.name: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense
games.summary: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense is a real-time tactical tower defense game. As Princess Lua, defend the demon realm against the hero alliance. Build unique towers, manage unit morale, and use tactical pauses to repel invasions. Your strategy decides the demon realm's fate.

games.name: Age of Respair
games.summary: Age of Respair is a medieval strategy castle-builder. Build massive castles with fortifications while managing resources and production chains. Assemble a large army and lay siege to enemy castles. Lead your people and bring respair to your kingdom🏰⚔️

games.name: Discard All Hope
games.summary: Investigate an eldritch mystery in a town under siege, collect and upgrade powerful spells, fight grotesque cultists, twisted creatures, and bio-mechanical invaders in this twin-stick-shooter / Action RPG hybrid.

games.name: Die to Play
games.summary: Die to Play — a deckbuilder with dice, set on a cozy retro computer inside a medieval English mansion filled with horrors and mysteries.

games.name: Ghost Golfing
games.summary: Swing on to Ghost Golfing. Build haunting mini golf courses to ricochet, blow, burn or teleport the ball right in to the hole!

games.name: Tales of Meadows
games.summary: XIII century. Eastern Europe is torn between new beliefs and old rites. Learn about the events that will change Philip - once a kind and naive young man - and turn his path into a story of pain and bitterness.

games.name: Retro Rail Go!
games.summary: Drive nostalgic Japanese‑style trains through busy city lines and iconic routes. Follow timetables, signals, and station rules to become a master conductor. Choose between relaxed journeys or strict professional challenges in this retro 1990s console‑aesthetic simulator.

games.name: Ancient Shadows: Awakening
games.summary: Ancient Shadows: Awakening is a dark 3D dungeon RPG where you explore ancient ruins, battle terrifying creatures, and uncover the secrets of the deep.

games.name: Shardbreakers
games.summary: Reclaim and synergize raw Shards to craft your own Magic in this fast-paced bullet-hell action roguelike. Unlock new heroes, unleash chaos, and conquer hand-crafted realms swallowed by darkness.

games.name: Moon Princess
games.summary: Moon Princess, Lunar Princess, or Princess of the Moon may refer to:

games.name: Forestless
games.summary: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure where you'll journey through a world of fears armed only with a magical arrow of hope. Explore biomes that embody human nightmares - from misty wastelands of loneliness to scorched deserts of loss.

games.name: Aghori
