games.summary: Aghóríové je hinduistická sekta následovníků askety Kina Rama, která se údajně ve 14. století oddělila od tantrické sekty kápálika. Ve vnějším světě jsou známí především svojí praxí, která překračuje mnohá sociální tabu (požívání masa z mrtvol, výkalů, atp.).

games.name: Chain Letter
games.summary: Řetězový dopis je zpráva, která obsahuje příkaz pro příjemce, aby poslal kopie této zprávy dalším osobám, slibuje mu za to určitý profit či naopak mu vyhrožuje, pokud dopis nebude dál šířit. Existují papírové i elektronické verze, může jít i o internetové memy. Tématy bývají štěstí, láska, hoaxy, či sliby rychlého zbohatnutí prostřednictvím pyramidových schémat. Nejdříve existovaly „dopisy štěstí“, které slibovaly v případě šíření zprávy štěstí, naopak při neúčasti smůlu.

games.name: Hookah Simulator
games.summary: Start with a small cozy hookah lounge and turn it into the most popular spot in the city! Your goal is to craft perfect hookahs, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

games.name: Sonic Valkyria: Kanon
games.summary: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

games.name: 100 Amsterdam Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

games.name: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
games.summary: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

games.name: A Passing in the Night
games.summary: In the dead of night, Kai wakes from a dream. Walk aimlessly in a surreal town among apparitions, to escape reality, to pass the time. Time only matters to the living.

games.name: I Am Night
games.summary: A folk horror roguelike deckbuilder where you tear apart and scrap together cards to face monsters, unravel mysteries, and survive a world forged in fear. Set out on a brave, twisted adventure of self-discovery.

games.name: Killer Aces Volleyball
games.summary: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's clubs in the world!

games.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator
games.summary: Electronics Repair Simulator lets players operate their own electronics workshop where they diagnose and fix various devices including receivers, phones, and speakers. Players use authentic repair techniques like soldering and component replacement while managing a growing business. Through successful repairs, they earn money to expand their workshop and take on more complex projects.

games.name: Over the Moon
games.summary: The final game in The Rose Garden Trilogy. Can you convince Moon to come home, or will her anger towards you be ever resolute?

games.name: Birdoo
games.summary: Birdoo is an indie action game were you take control of a bird on his quest for revenge against the humans that mistreated him. For too long have you been called a flying rat and shooed away. It's time to take revenge!

games.name: Raiders Rise
games.summary: Explore hostile planets, face endless hordes of devourers, collect crystals, and upgrade your equipment. Choose the hero that best suits your playstyle, cooperate with your allies to survive… or betray the other team at the perfect moment and claim victory.

games.name: Mirealle
games.summary: A world has split into thousands of floating islands. A forgotten history is hidden in ruins. Mirealle is a touching puzzle adventure set in a cozy universe. It is about the search for hope where a lost part of the world… and of oneself… are hidden in every detail.

games.name: AirBoost Airship Knight
games.summary: the blonde Airship Knight Dorota, during a battle in the ruins, accidentally discovers an amnesiac girl, Agate. This also draws the attention of sky pirates, leading to fierce battles. The game offers rich levels and exciting battles, with many companions who will fight alongside you!

games.name: Voyage Router
games.summary: Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map. Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: Factories in Factories in Factories
games.summary: Build a fractal world. Automate the automation of your automation. Put Factories in Factories in Factories.

games.name: Don't Get Caught
games.summary: In Don't Get Caught, play as a manager or an office worker as you try not to get laid off. Workers can secretly sabotage or support the company to manipulate the boss's fate by day's end. This time, the boss isn't immune to layoffs.

games.name: Stories of Somnia
games.summary: Unravel a story-rich adventure blending a turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics. Use spells to grapple across gaps, uncover hidden routes, and combine abilities with powerful Dreamkin companions to overcome a world consumed by Gloam.

games.name: Where the Chips Fall
games.summary: Balatro Meets Blackjack with a Cuphead aesthetic in this casino rogue-lite where you gamble with you abilities. Every chip you bet can turn the tide in your favor, but you could also lose it all in a bad hand. Think you can beat the house?

games.name: SuperWeird
games.summary: Automate highly unstable and unreliable robots using microprograms installed along their paths. Design an automated system that is prepared to handle the challenges of a super weird environment, full of automated hazards left here long before your arrival.

games.name: Not Guilty!
games.summary: You are the judge, the executioner, and the warden — all in one. Investigate absurd cases, make questionable decisions, expand your prison, and keep the budget balanced. Bend your morals, play with verdicts, and build your own empire of justice.

games.name: Storm Settlers
games.summary: A survival citybuilder set in a desert afflicted by relentless sandstorms. Build, farm, research, clear sand and protect your people from the storms. Will you find water or desolation? Will your settlement thrive or be buried in sand?

games.name: Stellations
games.summary: A game about going in circles.

games.name: Ocean City Killer
games.summary: Ocean City Killer is an open-world corporate dungeon crawler. You play as Rick Atlanta, a private eye investigating the death of a former colleague. What starts out as a routine case pulls you into the dark labyrinth of a seedy megacorp. Hop in your muscle car to explore the city!

games.name: Hello World: a developer story
games.summary: The developer narrates. The world evolves. The fourth wall breaks. Welcome to Hello World, a charming Narrative Physical Adventure where you play a game as it's being created live.

games.name: Blood Vow: Survive the Night
games.summary: Defend the people of Sodermark from the hordes of darkness. Fight as an army of one, or online with up to four-player PvE multiplayer in this wave-based, action-survival game.

games.name: Spider Dynasty
games.summary: This is a completely innovative Metroidvania-like game. There are two ancient trees host two royal families who have maintained an aerial dynasty woven from spider silk for generations. However, unknown evil forces are corrupting the entire silk world…

games.name: Wanderstate
games.summary: You find yourself alone in a place that feels familiar… but not quite right. Wander aimlessly or with purpose, it won’t matter. Is there an end? Has anyone been here before you? Time feels slow. Or maybe it's frozen. Or maybe… you’re not meant to leave.

games.name: Low Battery
games.summary: A sokoban game with power restrictions. Plan your route carefully to find your way out.

games.name: Illusive Domain
games.summary: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

games.name: Cat-a-strophic
games.summary: CAT-A-STROPHIC is a goofy 3D rogue-like city destruction game where you play as Bluu, a colossal kaiju cat, rampaging through different cities to rescue your precious kittens! Embrace the purr-fect blend of chaos and relaxation as you level multiple towns and cities.

games.name: Among Space
games.summary: You are the subject of a failed quantum teleportation experiment. Due to a calculation error, you have found yourself in an abandoned complex on planet EC-10013, where dangerous creatures roam—creatures that emerged from the depths of its caves. Can you find a way to escape?

games.name: DungeonBox
games.summary: A new Dungeons & Dragons Party Game! Let our Dungeon Master take you and up to 8 players on an adventure, where you control the next move by answering and voting from your phones

games.name: Ugomeku Note
games.summary: Welcome to the world of UGOMEKU NOTE (“Wriggling Note”). You—gentle, kind, and always wearing a lovely smile—have been chosen as a hero to embark on an adventure full of humor and heart. This is a handcrafted RPG made with RPG Maker MV. All graphics, music, and systems are being created by a solo developer.

games.name: Hyperflex Ultra
games.summary: Dodge obstacles, switch gravity in ways you never even thought possible and see just how hard you can FLEX in this endless action platformer. Think you've got what it takes to master all four levels and achieve the VIBE?

games.name: Tinker's Ascent
games.summary: Jump to new heights in Tinkers Ascent, a 3D platformer adventure game. Collect, craft, and rebuild in this world of floating islands. The biggest thing to remember: don't look down... or maybe just don't fall down.

games.name: Tamer Town
games.summary: Collect Mokiton in this city management game, where tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve and bond together in their unique town. Design neighborhoods, unlock stories and grow a feel-good world where every connection matters.

games.name: Ripley Remembered
games.summary: A surreal, story-driven puzzle game set on a train caught in a time loop. Solve narrative-driven puzzles, battle psychic bosses, and uncover the truth about memory, grief, and a girl named Ripley—before the day resets again. Pixel graphics, bullet hells, puzzles, and dialog.

games.name: Table for None
games.summary: "Table for None" is a pixelated, bite-sized open world, food truck cooking adventure game. Explore diverse regions, discover new recipes, and prepare meals to manage your food truck!

games.name: Wanderlust
games.summary: A sandbox sci-fi adventure without combat. You have reached your adulthood and in accordance with the Mars Quorum, you are offered a Wanderlust, a period of time where you are given the means to freely explore the galaxy, getting to know the Ruhe societies and also yourself.

games.name: Space Diner Simulator
games.summary: After buying a rundown diner, you need to repair it and bring it to its full glory. Manage, renovate and upgrade the diner to attract more customers, and meet their demands. Bring a piece of home to the edges of space with Earths best recipes.

games.name: Wiffleball Legends
games.summary: Swing for the fences and become a backyard hero! Throw insane curve balls and other crazy wiffleball pitches in this 4v4 wiffleball game! Build your dream team to win a championship in season mode, crush home runs in a home run derby mode and lead your team to the national championship in Story Mode

games.name: Saveseeker
games.summary: Embark on a quest to overwrite save points in Saveseeker, a turn-based RPG about a time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

games.name: Mechs and Muskets
games.summary: Mechs and Muskets is a 2D isometric tactical RPG set in an alternate Napoleonic era where mechs rule the battlefield. Customize your squad with unique mech parts and abilities, and lead them through turn-based strategic combat in a story-driven campaign

games.name: Mech Log Zero
games.summary: Take control of a mechanized pilot and its Mech. Blast through Colossal Machines and secure the last remnants of life inside a dying God.

games.name: Lux Leonarii: A Mechanical Puzzle Adventure
games.summary: A puzzle game revolving around guiding beams of light throughout an ancient structure using a multitude of mirrors and devices, ranging from simple A to B connection to multiple colours and complex interactions.

games.name: Lead The Dragon
games.summary: Join your crew and conquer the narrow roads of America. Explore the open world, earn respect and money by competing in street races, but breaking the law will bring you serious trouble with the police.

games.name: Don't Mind the Robots
games.summary: Build deadly mazes and outsmart a rogue AI in this strategic tower defense game. Adapt your defenses, use aiming parameters to your advantage, and activate powerful perks to survive increasingly complex waves of incoming robots.

games.name: Oremus
games.summary: Oremus is a call to prayer. Oremus may also refer to: Orémus (grape), former name of Zéta, a Hungarian wine grape used in the production of Tokaji Oremus (Tárrega), a prelude in D minor for classical guitar by composer Francisco Tárrega Mirko Oremuš (born 1988), Croatian professional footballer Stephen Oremus (born 1971), American musician Orémus Press Newspaper, monthly print newspaper for traditional Catholic families, founded November 2010 at Dover, Oklahoma, USA

games.name: Road Truckers: New Beginning
games.summary:
Live a trucker’s life in the first trucking sim RPG. Explore villages, cities and wilderness in a fully customizable truck. Get on-foot to eat, sleep, and help people along the way. Your goal: to bring back prosperity in your region. Drive, grow, and inspire!

Experience trucking on a new level: by driving and interacting with the world around you. Make your truck unique by customizing it mechanically and visually, inside and outside. Meet people and decide how to approach them. Enjoy the beautiful scenery in different weather conditions. But most of all, see the change you’re making by supporting the economy.

games.name: Coup de Koala
games.summary: Seize back the crown in Coup de Koala, a cute bullet hell roguelite of furious rebellion. As an exiled koala king, unleash spells and steel against relentless undead legions to reclaim your throne. Build your deck of cards, die, upgrade your character, repeat.

games.name: Drone District
games.summary: Drone District is an adrenaline-charged FPV arcade experience that mashes up the flow of Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater with the freedom of Burnout Paradise—but with drones. Master flight tricks, grind power lines, launch off rooftops, chain mid-air stunts, and explore an open world.

games.name: Black Vultures: Prey of Greed
games.summary: Black Vultures is a tactical first-person shooter set in a fractured warzone where trust is scarce, resources are limited, and every mission begins with a choice. Navigate ruined infrastructure and contested zones. Intercept transmissions, track movements, and recover intel to locate your objective before rival squads close in. Engage only when necessary. Retreat when survival demands it. The deeper you push, the higher the risk, but greater the reward.

games.name: 10hit
games.summary: With the ability to hijack the minds of anyone who answers a phone call, "0" builds an army of remote controlled assassins to overthrow his twin brother, "1" as standing president.

games.name: Get It Up!
games.summary: Can you make it to the top while balancing the stick on your head?ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ...probably not. It's pretty hard.

games.name: Teknokrat
games.summary:
In the futuristic techno-metropolis of Nu-Vika, you are but a number in the system.

You have been branded as unemployed, and rely on the state to survive. Until you are assigned a temporary position at a cyborg repair workshop, giving you a shot at gaining freedom.

But when strange glitches start happening to your eye implants, you find yourself thrust into a plan far beyond your comprehension, tying your fate to one of three patients in your care.

TEKNOKRAT is a gay, y2k-fuelled sci-fi thriller/romance about the danger of enforced stagnation in the face of unstoppable change.

Explore a city where might makes right, and technology is absolute. Choose a partner in crime, and face the consequences of your actions with them.

games.name: Abyss Rebel
games.summary: ABYSS REBEL is a Turn-Based Tactical RPG combining grid strategy, intense combat, and loot progression. Set sail for a frozen archipelago at the universe’s edge, lead a four-member squad on a skiff, equipping skills, relics, tackling bosses and summoning mechs to shatter encroaching darkness!

games.name: My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend
games.summary: You take your femboy roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary. Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and getting closer to Robin. How will you make the most of this special weekend?

games.name: Dunthera
games.summary: Towers have always defended you… Now it’s your turn to keep them standing. Battle unique monsters across diverse maps, each with distinct abilities, looks, and stats. Upgrade your hero and fortify structures to hold the line!

games.name: PanzenTD
games.summary: A charming tower defense game where heroic panda warriors defend their homeland against waves of destructive robots. Build towers, deploy unique heroes, and outsmart your enemies across stylized jungle battlefields.

games.name: Astroburrow
games.summary: Astroburrow is a thrilling space adventure combining exploration, strategy and arcade action! As a mousey space cadet, explore beautifully pixelated galaxies to build new civilizations and fight for your species' survival.

games.name: White Rats
games.summary:
White Rats is a sci-fi survival visual novel set within the cold, decaying corridors of the research station UF-44.
When a group of survivors wakes up with fragmented memories and no clear way out, they must uncover the truth behind the station’s secrets — and the experiments that took place there.

Choices matter: each decision can lead to survival... or something far worse.
Investigate, adapt, and try to keep your mind intact as reality begins to twist.

Will you solve the mystery — or become just another test subject?

games.name: Frostliner
games.summary: The moon shattered. The world froze. Take command of a nomadic train city hurtling through a war-ravaged frozen wasteland. In this survival city builder on rails, gather survivors, scavenge resources, and do whatever it takes to keep the engine running and stay ahead of the frost.

games.name: Bher
games.summary: Delve dungeons, craft items and build relationships as you work to recover your memory. Bher is a town under siege, and you are an amnesiac with nothing to your name. Search dark woods and caves for resources and craft powerful weapons to delve into infested mines, forgotten swamps, and worse.

games.name: Coffee Shop "Keyhole"
games.summary: This is a mystery adventure game where you run a coffee shop and explore the mysteries of this coffee shop and this town! This coffee shop has some secrets Main character quit his job as a locksmith and rented a property last month to run a coffee shop. But this property seems to have a history...

games.name: Warfactory
games.summary: Warfactory is an automation RTS where production defines the war effort. Build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory.

games.name: HyperTyper 2000
games.summary: Type, dodge, parry, and survive in HyperTyper 2000! A hybrid typing/bullet hell roguelike where both halves of the action are nonstop! Test your typing skills with one hand on half the keyboard and dodge with the other hand.

games.name: DOBA: Dogs Battle Arena
games.summary: All urban packs of dogs need an alpha, and when it comes to rule over parks, dogs have their own ways! Splat pee all around to claim territory or knock your rivals using your crafted set of the craziest skills ever found in a battle arena.

games.name: Pikmon Flower White
games.summary: A rom hack of pokemon fire red set in the world of Pikmin. Catch over 170 unique creatures, fight familiar characters from across the Pikmin series, and uncover the mysteries of PNF-404 in this fan-made sequel to all 4 mainline Pikmin games.

games.name: My Bookshop Dreams
games.summary: A cozy bookshop management sim where you run, customize, and expand your dream bookstore. Restock shelves, host author events, play mini-games, and collect literary works as you grow your reputation across cities—and maybe even planets.

games.name: Mark My Words
games.summary: The word-building roguelike. 'Mark My Words' is an addictive deckbuilder where you assemble high-scoring words, discover fancy Stickers, and utilize Glyphs to unleash intriguing combinations. Master the Art of Wordplay in several different Game modes!

games.name: Papa Needs a Headshot
games.summary: Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS soaked in kin blood. Rip through flesh and bend the battlefield with your cursed metal arm. Use every bullet wisely to slaughter freaks and abominations on your warpath. Keep enduring only to put a bullet in the skull of the man who made you.

games.name: Survive: The Alien Tracing
games.summary: A survival game where you uncover the mystery of the alien civilization "The Fallen of Elun". Navigate a dark world, solve complex puzzles, face hostile creatures, and use many weapons to survive while searching for the truth behind your missing son.

games.name: Diceville
games.summary: Build your city, roll the dice, and outplay your rivals in Diceville — a card-based strategy game inspired by tabletop classics. Trigger building effects, upgrade your HQ, and race to victory in a game of luck, planning, and clever combos.

games.name: Bring Me Home
games.summary: a cute game about little octopus Blubi.

games.name: Frob
games.summary: The happy life of a whimsical little frog called Frob was turned upside down when his tadpoles were tadnapped by a heron. Now it's his quest to collect them all in this silly 3D platformer!

games.name: After Work
games.summary: Welcome to SPARK, a well renounced photography company. Here you'll find love, learn about consent, and meet friends. Use your observation skills to unfold motivation and stories behind characters. Be careful. You don't want it to end badly.

games.name: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
games.summary: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

games.name: Live Fire Exercise
games.summary: A live fire exercise (LFX) is a military exercise in which live ammunition and ordnance is used, as opposed to blanks or dummies. The term can also be found in non-military usage.

games.name: Aerosurge
games.summary: Perform daring aerial stunts, destroy your enemies and weave through hazardous environments to complete fast-paced missions. Upgrade and customize your jet to handle any situation and show off your piloting skills in this fast-paced arcade flying game.

games.name: Rot Together
games.summary: A first-person co-op horror game for up to four players set in a medieval world. Explore a procedurally generated map and fight a mysterious cult. Brew potions, kill monsters, chat with your friends. Survival is not guaranteed!

games.name: DDoD
games.summary: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

games.name: Chumaky
games.summary: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

games.name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

games.name: Before the Silence
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

games.name: Crimson System: VɅΔ Protocol
games.summary: A dark retro-FPS born from a solo AI-creation experiment. Blast your way through a vampire-ruled station, slay twisted enemies, and uncover the secrets of the VɅΔ Protocol

games.name: Your Judgment, Inquisitor
games.summary: Your judgment, Inquisitor Medieval Spain. You serve as an Inquisitor in the shadow of the dreaded Tomás de Torquemada. Cast out demons from the possessed. Burn heretics. Spare the innocent — or condemn them. Every wrong choice will bring you closer to the wrath of the Church… or the fury of the mob.

games.name: Bloodseed: The Last Helsing
games.summary: Bloodseed is a game that combines two very distinct but terribly addictive genres; card combat and survival.

games.name: Clerks & Quirks
games.summary: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

games.name: Wonderfall
games.summary: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

games.name: The Sword Game
games.summary: The Sword Game is a semi-fast paced retro styled 3D platformer, made to mimic shareware games of early 2000's. Your mission is to get the lowest time possible on all levels. You can cheat, find shortcuts, you have all the freedom in the world.

games.name: Breadieval
games.summary: Create unique baked goods by combining ingredients you find at the market. Befriend the puppet villagers by baking their favourite recipes or by combining tasty flavours. Have fun, you don't have to follow a recipe here.

games.name: Forge the Fates
games.summary: This roguelike deckbuilder transforms your classic hand of cards into a grid of runes. Play a rune and the ones behind it shift forward, so every move shapes what’s next. Build a unique deck, trigger match-3 combos, and outplay your enemies.

games.name: Omicrox
games.summary: Omicrox takes Ultimate Tic Tac Toe and adds powerful one-use ability cards for unlimited strategic possibilities. Earn abilities as you play, like swapping boards, blocking moves, or stealing cards, and use them to outsmart friends or AI in this battle of tactics.

games.name: Grindworm
games.summary: A short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine. Workplace safety rules no longer apply. Just remember: Don't. Stop. Digging.

games.name: Late Amusement
games.summary: Late Amusement is a first-person psychological survival horror game from an independent studio. Play as Liam Snow, a young aspiring author who enters the derelict theme park alongside his girlfriend Hannah, and fight to survive as you unravel the dark history buried beneath the attractions.

games.name: Valkyrie Rising: Hordes of Ragnarök
games.summary: Battle the End of the World in this Norse horde-survivor roguelite. Unleash godlike powers, collect powerful runes, and build insane combos. Survive endless waves, crush epic bosses, and fight to save Asgard from the Hordes of Ragnarök.

games.name: Infinite Soul
games.summary: Infinite Soul is a breath of fresh air for competitive fighters. Every battle will test your skill, cunning, and resolve. Attack and defend with Water, Earth, Fire, and Air; choose wisely because each one has a strength and a weakness.

games.name: Can't Even See the Sky
games.summary: Your character is a man with a troubled past who finds himself trapped in a city on the brink of civil war. Look for ways to get out of the city and make peace with the past. Will you pull yourself together or drown in the abyss of despair?

games.name: Magical Girl: Taboo Village
games.summary: The girls awaken in a mysterious village cursed by flowers. Every night at 8 PM, one girl is chosen as a sacrifice to the Kamibana—and hanged. Unravel the village’s tangled mysteries and sever the ritual’s endless cycle. A magical girl × folk-horror suspense visual novel from Acacia.

games.name: BPM: Bitcrushed
games.summary: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

games.name: Couch Planes
games.summary: Couch Planes is a fast-paced airborne party game where the craftiest pilot wins. Dodge missiles, grab power-ups, and race through hazard-filled maps in various game modes in chaotic local or online matches. Easy to learn, wild to master, always a blast.

games.name: Soup-of-War
games.summary: You are a clumsy one-armed pirate cook desperately trying to prepare meals for your crew by grabbing, cutting, and throwing ingredients into pots while your ship heaves violently on stormy seas, turning every simple cooking task into a chaotic physics-based struggle against time and your own limitations.

games.name: Frozen Feathers
games.summary: Frozen Feathers is a charming multiplayer game where cute penguins engage in fun snowball battles, scoring points in frosty PvP encounters.

games.name: Farmageddon
games.summary: Farmageddon started life in 1991 as a comic strip called The Funny Farm and was created by Niel Bushnell and Gordon Fraser. Bushnell and Fraser were friends from school and both wanted careers as comic artists. They began to develop an idea for a newspaper comic strip based around a farm. Initially inspired by American comic strips such as Calvin and Hobbes and Garfield, the comic soon found its own blend of humour.

games.name: Wildekin
games.summary: You've fallen out of the sky with nothing but your wits, fists, and an overwhelming urge to redecorate. Explore and survive in a perilous wilderness, construct your town, and befriend lost Wildekin in a 1-4 player online multiplayer adventure.

games.name: Shadows of the Deepforge
games.summary: An assassin weaving through ruin, striking fast and vanishing faster. The halls test your cunning, the darkness tests your nerve. Torchlight betrays, silence protects, and every shadow is both a hiding place and a threat.

games.name: Eggson
games.summary: After being captured by EGG CORP for failing to comply with them, it’s now your mission to escape their facility. Run, jump, and fight your way out in this fast-paced 3D platformer heavily inspired by KARLSON

games.name: Agecraft
games.summary: Agecraft is a historical strategy and city-building game where players guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the space age. The game combines settlement building, resource management, and technological progression. Players construct cities, manage the economy, provide for their people, and expand across different eras, unlocking new buildings, production chains, and methods of transportation as history advances.

games.name: Verismo
games.summary: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic-tragedy visual novel set in 1920s Sicily.

games.name: Obitus
games.summary: Obitus is an action-adventure game developed and released by Psygnosis in early 1991 for Amiga, Atari ST, and MS-DOS compatible operating systems. A version for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System was published in 1994 by Bullet-Proof Software. The game includes both first-person dungeon crawling and side-scrolling gameplay with action-oriented combat and an emphasis on item acquisition.

games.name: Project Kepler: Delivery Included!
games.summary: Project Kepler: Delivery Included! is a roguelike base-defense game where players control a lone cyborg stranded on a hostile planet. The objective is to survive waves of evolving alien creatures while managing resources, constructing automated defenses, and deploying drones for combat and support. Key features include procedurally generated runs, upgradeable drones and turrets, automation systems, daily randomized upgrades, and an ultimate fail-safe: an orbital strike to eradicate the planet.

games.name: Children of the Spring
games.summary: Embark on a quest to find your missing family in a world slowly being consumed by disaster. Explore the unknown, fight dangerous enemies in real time, utilizing variety of unique equipment to your advantage. Upgrade your ship and face the dangers of a boundless ocean.

games.name: Antenna Dilemma
games.summary: Antenna Dilemma is a short and witty point&click in which you'll follow the story of C432632, a finicky grey cube that sure doesn't want to miss his favorite TV show.

games.name: Jacob's Ladder
games.summary: Jákobův žebřík je slovní spojení odkazující na příběh popsaný v Bibli, ve Starém zákoně. V její první knize – Genesis (zvané též První kniha Mojžíšova) – jsou ve 28. kapitole ve verších 12. až 19. popsány události, které se Jákobovi, druhorozenému Izákovu synu, přihodily poté, co byl nucen prchnout z otcova domu před hněvem svého bratra, jemuž sebral prvorozenství.
aliases: Jacob's Dream of ladder to heaven

games.name: Bonemarrow
games.summary: Bonemarrow is a short action survival horror in which you play a mutant creature created in a lab, destined to be used as a test subject. When the facility you were created in falls into disarray, you finally have your opportunity to escape. You may just make it out alive.

games.name: The Next Stop
games.summary:
The Next Stop is a narrative adventure about a murder full of contradictions, where the clues don't add up and everything hides something darker. It blends point & click mechanics with the depth of a visual novel, all set in a haunting subway filled with secrets.

Eight people are on board. Eight stories. Eight hidden truths. Each stop on the train reveals a new chapter. Each carriage is a different experience. Every decision you make has consequences.

games.name: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
games.summary: Jump, dash, and brawl your way through beautifully animated 2D platforming levels, then shift perspectives into dynamic top-down 3D street zones to gather rare ingredients in chaotic, GTA2 - style street battles! Every fight feeds your menu. Every level is a recipe for madness.

games.name: Rotten Survivor
games.summary: Rotten Survivor is the ULTIMATE 2D top-down horde survivor game! Fight massive hordes of bizarre enemies! Upgrade your equipment, create crazy combinations between all of the different weapons and modifiers and become an unstoppable force!

games.name: Cards of the Abyss
games.summary: Cards of the Abyss is a movement based roguelike deckbuilder between Slay the Spire and Dofus. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, and unleash explosive card combos to explore the Abyss and uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

games.name: Quest & Rest: Inn Simulator
games.summary: Run a cozy fantasy inn where adventurers rest, restock, and head off to glory. Assign quests, serve buff-granting ales, sell magical gear, and manage your guests—then watch their stories unfold from the comfort of your inn.

games.name: Dosmic
games.summary: In a world crawling with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out on a journey to find the missing girl, Snoa. Use a variety of movement abilities and the surrounding environment to push forward, and at times confront overwhelming horrors, in this cinematic puzzle-platformer, DOSMIC.

games.name: War of Banners
games.summary: War of Banners is a sandbox turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval open world. Recruit companions, lead your army, and claim victory across brutal battlefields. From a wandering mercenary band to an empire-ruling sovereign — your fate is shaped by strategy and choice.

games.name: As We Unite
games.summary: As We Unite is a political strategy simulation game where you play as a high-ranking Consul of a secretive cult aiming to unite the world before an impending global calamity. Instead of controlling a country, you manage agents across different nations, each run has a crisis you have to resolve!

games.name: Roguebound Pirates
games.summary: Loot, upgrade & dominate! Your inventory IS your ship in this action roguelike. Customize weapons, create game-breaking synergies, and claim your place as the most overpowered pirate across the seas!

games.name: Tiny Shop
games.summary: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

games.name: Versalis
games.summary: Versalis S.p.A. (Polimeri Europa till 5 April 2012) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Italian oil supermajor Eni specializing in the production of chemicals. With more than 7,000 employees and a production of about 5.6 million tons of chemical products in 2023, it is by far the largest chemical company in Italy and one of the largest in Europe.

games.name: Meritaton
games.summary: A 2D adventure story about the daughter of a pharaoh who tries to change her predetermined destiny in the dark and mysterious Ancient Egypt.

games.name: Spaceships and Cellular Automata
games.summary: Spaceships and Cellular Automata is a tower defense game set in space! Place different towers to defend your ship against the waves of aliens. The enemies are simulated based on Conway's Game of Life. Even just one of your bullets is enough to cause a destabilizing chain reaction to destroy them!

games.name: The Grand Planto Heists
games.summary: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

games.name: A Kingdom of Soil
games.summary: A Kingdom of Soil is a pixel-art RPG set on a contested medieval frontier. Farm, hunt, and forge to survive; manage your tavern and sway allies; plot in shadows or confront rivals in the open. Every choice shapes the legend you leave behind.

games.name: Crossover Clover
games.summary: Second project of novamicus

games.name: Cinema Manager Simulator
games.summary: 🎬 Manage and expand your own cinema. Upgrade equipment, customize interiors, schedule movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, and handle repairs to create the ultimate movie-watching experience! 🍿

games.name: Intersecta
games.summary: In a nutshell, Intersecta is an intense and intuitive tactical top-down shooter with a distinct arcade feel. It blends fast, twitch-based gameplay with the intelligent use of tactics. The game has a unique audio-visual style, utilising the power of Unreal Engine 5 for a stunning 2.5D experience.

games.name: Cyber Siege
games.summary: Cyber Siege is a fast-paced twin-stick shooter with pure gameplay. Play solo or in local co-op up to 4 players. Upgrade your character and weapons as you fight 100+ enemy types across 20 levels in 4 distinct worlds.

games.name: Taisho Romance Theater
games.summary: This is a dark and diverse romance visual novel set in 1920s Taishō-era Japan, where amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma is pulled into long-buried secrets after a friend's mysterious death. As he becomes entangled in magic, conspiracy, and haunting blood ties, his search leads him toward a darker truth.

games.name: Blackwood's Dilemma
games.summary: Step into detective Brian Storm’s shoes and unravel a grim 17th-century mystery. Interrogate villagers, gather clues, and piece together the evidence in a deduction system where every secret matters.

games.name: No Tithe for Olaf
games.summary: A grimly humorous single-player tower defense roguelite set in 17th-century Norway. Defend your farm from the King’s tax collectors, build bizarre towers, and lead a farmer’s uprising as a goat-riding rebel! Upgrade your farm, manage resources, and weaponize onions in escalating rural chaos.

games.name: Sova
games.summary: Příjmení Sova (či jeho přechýlenou podobu Sovová) nosí více významných osobností: Antonín Sova – český básník a prozaik Emil Sova (1954–1999) – český plochodrážní závodník Jan Sova (rozcestník) – více osob Milan Sova (* 1962) – český fotbalista Mirek Sova – český kytarista Oldřich Sova (fotbalista) – český fotbalový brankář (I.

games.name: Late Fee Girls
games.summary: Late Fee Girls je hra z kategorie RPG / Indie pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Trip Movie /Mosaic: Shounen Alice Satsujin Jiken
games.summary: Trip Movie /Mosaic: Shounen Alice Satsujin Jiken je hra z kategorie Point-and-click / Adventura pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator
games.summary:
Full Moon Guildhouse Simulator is a cozy cooking game where you serve drinks to our loyal guild members! You might even run into some familiar Vtubers!

Man our drinks bar and learn the ins and outs of each station. Each station has different equipment and drinks to master.

Our state of the art coffee station offers espressos, lattes, and americanos!

We have a wide selection of tea and boba combinations at our boba station!

Make something healthy with fruits and vegetables (or not) at our smoothie station!

games.name: Barista Dream
games.summary: Barista Dream lets you create a variety of coffees, including espresso, Americano, latte, and cappuccino, with meticulous precision. It aims to provide both fun and learning while making coffee. Manage your cafe wisely and prepare as many orders as possible to boost your popularity.

games.name: Red Moon Kingdom
games.summary: When a group of outcasts is sent to retrieve a wondrous artifact, a fatal mistake brings chaos upon the world. Explore, solve puzzles and card battle your way through a unique medieval fantasy setting full of magic with 3 controllable characters and in stunning 4K hand-drawn visuals.

games.name: Fractured Library
games.summary: A cozy 2D pixel art adventure where you explore magical worlds, solve whimsical puzzles, and collect crystal fragments to restore a misbehaving library: no combat, just curious discoveries and a dash of chaos.

games.name: Piano at 5 am Encore
games.summary: The paid, complete version of Piano at 5 a.m.. It includes additional episodes that depict the characters' pasts and narrated voiceover.

games.name: Inspektor
games.summary: Play as the INSPEKTOR, sent to crush a violent uprising on a dark, industrial planet. Blast through rebels and machines in a savage mix of 90s-style shooter action, neon-soaked sci-fi, and nonstop blood-soaked carnage. Retro pixels, brutal combat, zero remorse.

games.name: Night Shift: 1999
games.summary: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

games.name: TrailRail
games.summary: Your path taken is the key. "TrailRail" is a physics-based action puzzle game where the trajectory of your movement becomes a tangible object. Control the girl and aim to escape from the mysterious research facility.

games.name: After Hell Freezes Over
games.summary: Venture into the desolate frozen wasteland in this open-world survival horror. Struggle to survive in the cold, where strange creatures roam in the darkness. Build a shelter, collect supplies, fend off unimaginable threats, and fight for survival After Hell Freezes Over.

games.name: The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
games.summary: A dark fantasy style pixel ARPG. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".
aliases: 花岬-The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape

games.name: The Hearth and Harbour
games.summary: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

games.name: Devoid
games.summary: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

games.name: Eggspedition
games.summary: Enter the Eggspedition - a terrifying survival horror with dinosaurs! Play solo or team up with up to 4 players to explore unknown planets, abandoned facilities, complete missions, and make daring extractions. It’s inhabited by… dinosaurs. Furious, massive, and very much alive.

games.name: Anima Shin Gun
games.summary: A Bullet Hell Rail Shooter where you get shot to survive. Engage enemies and absorb their bullets as “seconds of life” by switching to the right color frequency. Thus, surviving long enough to break the time loop you’re trapped in and complete the ENTIRE adventure before the countdown gets to zero.

games.name: Underground Security Inc
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against relentless waves of “heroes”. Manage your minions, mine ores, construct traps and cast spells to strengthen your defenses. Each run brings new challenges in this roguelite dungeon defense game.

games.name: Crimson Rest
games.summary: Fight relentless hordes of bloodthirsty monsters and choose which room lies beyond the next door in this retro-style dungeon crawler, where death is not an option. But tread carefully, do not awaken Count Dracula, or his curse will be unleashed upon you.

games.name: The Midnight Barber
games.summary: A narrative ASMR adventure about a supernatural barbershop in late 70s Barcelona. Trim and style your supernatural clientele, gain their trust, and uncover their darkest secrets.

games.name: Cutting Edge: Roots of Mutation
games.summary: Perform life-saving operations in this fast-paced surgery sim. As lizard surgeon Dr. Peri Maddock, you'll treat injuries, excise tumors, and hack corporate organs with speedy, surgical precision. The patient's life is in your claws!

games.name: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith
games.summary: Tokatonton: One-Armed Blacksmith is a medieval forge management sim. Craft unique weapons, satisfy demanding customers, or take risky deals for profit. Rebuild a crumbling forge with two struggling blacksmiths.

games.name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
games.summary: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action is a top-down bump combat action game where you control Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies!

games.name: Imitation
games.summary: Join the experiment! Imitation is a brain-teasing guessing game. It pits humans against AI. Given a set of questions, players must choose if the answer was provided by a human or generated by an AI. Can you tell the difference between human and AI?

games.name: Dress the Duel
games.summary: "Dress the Duel," is a roguelike deckbuilding game where your cards are your wardrobe and your outfit is your arsenal!Build a versatile wardrobe, disrobe strategically, layer outfits for powerful effects, and Dress the Duel!

games.name: BB Adventure
games.summary: “BB Adventure” is an immersive action game where you ride a real balance ball and clear athletic stages. Using a controller with an accelerometer, your balance ball’s movements control the in-game character, making you feel as if you’re inside the game.

games.name: Space Revolver
games.summary: Space Revolver is a strategic puzzle game set in a space station. Use limited moves—such as map rotation, gravity control, and horizontal movement—to find the optimal path. Enjoy clever and deep puzzles with retro-style pixel art and a classic sci-fi atmosphere!

games.name: Cat Girl Survivor 2: Beyond the Veil
games.summary: Demon invasion has shattered the dimensions, filling the world with corrupted souls. Cat girls with unique stories unite through friendship to restore balance by purifying souls and facing fierce bosses. An exciting and adorable side-scrolling action adventure!

games.name: Forsaken Lands
games.summary: Brave heroes unite to challenge the gods themselves and decide the fate of the world! Dive into an epic roguelite deckbuilder adventure. Gather your friends and take on divine foes together in thrilling online co-op battles!

games.name: Wayfarer Of Hydrangea
games.summary: Wayfarer Of Hydrangea je hra z kategorie RPG / Indie od studia 451℉ pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: IPS 13: All Signals Lost
games.summary: Take command of the massive VOD(Vehicle of Destruction) and journey across planet Gaiganthra with your IPS(Inter-Planetary Squad)-13 crew to uncover the mystery of humans there. Be prepared for the worse and ready to fight. Upgrade your VOD, hire new crew factions, to be the ultimate War Machine.

games.name: Delivery Issues
games.summary: In Delivery Issues, you do much more than simply deliver packages. It’s a race against time as you meet zany characters, outsmart and outmaneuver befuddling obstacles, and take on a mysterious enemy that will make this otherwise easy job rather difficult.

games.name: Spark! Photon Blast
games.summary: "SPARK! -PHOTON BLAST-" is a sports action game where players face off in a futuristic stadium, rendered with stunningly beautiful photorealistic graphics. Your goal is to score by launching a sphere into your opponent's goal. Enjoy the heart-pounding, high-octane action where every second counts!

games.name: In Harness
games.summary: IN HARNESS is an online co-op 3D jumping game for 1–10 players. With simple move and jump controls, pets team up to clear tough stages and reunite with a girl in heaven, bringing the warm “Helper’s High” of saving friends.

games.name: Cozy Forest
games.summary: Restore a sleepy forest with adorable animals. Explore, craft, and decorate a cottage-core haven at your own rhythm—no timers, no hassle. Progress continues while you’re away!

games.name: The Dowsing
games.summary: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

games.name: Over the Radio
games.summary: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.

games.name: Trick Eight
games.summary: On a remote village shrouded in bloody tradition, a centuries-old ritual endures. You are a detective with unique skills, yet branded as a traitor. Will you surrender your limbs to ascend like an immortal? Or risk everything at the edge of science and plunge into the abyss of truth?

games.name: Captain Corgi: Planetary Problem Solver
games.summary: Hop aboard your cosmic sailboat and seek out folks in need of help in this storybook universe! Investigate, trade items, and explore the galaxy in a chilled out adventure.

games.name: Surface Labyrinth Kurumabu
games.summary: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

games.name: I Saw a Flying Saucer
games.summary: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

games.name: Short Short Fictions
games.summary: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

games.name: Manaftory
games.summary: Collect resources, build machines, and automate everything. Explore magical lands, face hostile creatures, and turn their loot into part of your factory system. This is your Manaftory — a magical factory powered by mana.

games.name: Sokoku
games.summary: A block-pushing game where you not only push blocks, you are one. Plan your movements so that the right number ends up on top, while you interact with other cubes and mechanics. Can you roll your way to the solution?

games.name: Rite of the Dealer
games.summary: Rite of the Dealer is a roguelike multi-deckbuilder where you guide charming rat companions through a peculiar, otherworldly hotel.

games.name: Still Stars Echo
games.summary: An atmospheric science-fiction journey across distant alien landscapes. Traverse monolithic structures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the story of a lost civilization written among the stars.

games.name: Hoptale
games.summary: 《Hoptale》 is a casual and strategic Rougelite game that combines slot machines with combat. Players will use the slot machine to determine the character's next behavior, the damage caused to monsters, and the loot obtained!

games.name: Aerocube
games.summary: AEROCUBE is a Ski-Fi Roguelike + First-Person Boomer Shooter in a huge mysterious cube that always rotates randomly. Each room of AEROCUBE is different, but one thing stays the same: something’s always behind you, ready to kill.

games.name: External
games.summary: RPG extraction-shooter in a post-apocalyptic setting. Survive in the ruins of the old world, loot gear, level up skills, improve your equipment and shelter. Fight various factions, or complete missions to become their ally.

games.name: Despa
games.summary: DESPA is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter built for after-work warriors with more bills than free hours. Neon kill-boxes, railguns, and carbon katanas meet a five-second respawn loop, so every death flips into revenge before your coffee cools.

games.name: Thesis of Love
games.summary: During the endless summer in Chishima, you join a graduate program hoping to become worthy of your crush. Little do you know what awaits... In this otome dating sim, experience campus life with three lab members trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to new paths.

games.name: The Darkness Delivers
games.summary: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

games.name: Lootbane
games.summary: Lootbane is a roguelite RPG about risk, reward, and loot-fueled power. Explore changing regions, build synergistic warbands, push deeper into dungeons for legendary treasure, and lose it all to your insatiable greed

games.name: Infinite Bloom
games.summary: Embody beings from vast cosmos to tiny plankton, and even your mind in Infinite Bloom! Use your hands to flap or swim. Power, identity, and scale become fluid. Faced with the vastness of the world, human is only a drop in the ocean, part of a continuum of life far greater than us.

games.name: Advent Arena
games.summary: A PvP card-game/tower-defense hybrid.

games.name: Demondemon Demon Tamer
games.summary: Demondemon Demon Tamer combines swarm-survivor and monster raising. Manage, take care, and train your demons during the day. Survive the swarm of attacking demons at night. Raise your reputation among three factions of demon tamers, and unravel their hidden motives in this doomed city, Laknakarta.

games.name: The Name of the Night
games.summary: We were completely different, but back then we were both obsessed with the same thing in the same place... “The Name of the Night” is a text-based adventure game that explores the arcade music game culture of 2000 through the story of two girls' delicate emotions.

games.name: Cursed Memory
games.summary: A psychological dark fantasy visual novel with turn-based combat. Unravel the mystery of a curse that erases memories and transforms people into demons.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary: House Flipper 2 is getting rowdy! With dozens of pets to choose from, you can now adopt your new best friend. Let them accompany you during the pet-centered jobs or relax by petting them with your friends in the Co-op!

games.name: They Come in Fives
games.summary:
A story-rich collectible card game with a dark, horror-tinged atmosphere, set in a world where urban legends turn into devilish contracts.

Play as the Reaper on Lucifer’s payroll. Hand over souls, keep bodies, and build an army to overthrow the boss. Unravel urban legends and fight the hidden world government.

games.name: Curse of the Abyss
games.summary: Curse of the Abyss is a Traditional Roguelike with a twist. Manage your resources and explore the abyss and slay the various Guardians of the Abyss and remove the curses.

games.name: Hardkill System
games.summary: Take control of a powerful mech, scavenge for different weapons and upgrades, and complete missions to help the last humans recover from the AI apocalypse in this top-down real-time tactical action-roguelite.

games.name: Daibadestructor
games.summary: Become a minion of a nefarious corporation and jump into the sea from Odaiba to destroy an underwater base in this easy-to-play retro-style FPS.

games.name: Odds Chronicles
games.summary: A tactical roguelite RPG where every roll matters. Fight on a strategic grid, shape your hero’s path through dice-driven choices, and uncover a story-rich world inspired by tabletop adventures.

games.name: The Bold Bogey
games.summary: The Bold Bogey is a 3D golf adventure that combines open exploration with satisfying platforming. Explore a vast world filled with dungeons to dive into, bosses to fight, and new ways to upgrade your ball in a golf game unlike any other. Do you have what it takes to become the Boldest Bogey?

games.name: Everbrew
games.summary: Farm, cook, and design your very own woodland café in Everbrew, a cozy pixel-art management game. Harvest ingredients, craft delicious meals, and welcome woodland creatures as they gather to relax, eat, and feel at home.

games.name: Now Hiring
games.summary: Now Hiring is a top-down narrative adventure where you play a job seeker trapped in a scam syndicate. Across 21 days, your choices in dialogue battles and moral dilemmas will shape your fate, reveal human struggles, and lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Kingdom of Foundry
games.summary: Kingdom of Foundry is a pixel-style tower defense meat pigeon game. In the game, you will play as the king of a city-state, and ensure the safety and stability of the city-state by dealing with different events in each battle and recruiting different types of soldiers to repel waves of demons.

games.name: Erebus-9
games.summary: Erebus-9 is an immersive first-person psychological horror. Explore the derelict space station, solve puzzles, and run from the horrors that reside onboard. As you descend deeper into the station, uncover its dark secrets and the tragedy that unfolded.

games.name: The Everything Building
games.summary: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!

games.name: Cyte
games.summary: Blaze your path as CYTE, a being created to guard the flow of time, as you dash and slam your way through a mysterious enemy’s mechanical army in this first person 3d action game. Fight through a unique science fiction world in the perfect blend of intense combat and lightning-fast movement.

games.name: Trickshotterz
games.summary: BEER PONG GETS GUNS... Only shots in the top count, pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.

games.name: Slingbox
games.summary: The Slingbox was a TV streaming media device made by Sling Media that encoded local video for transmission over the Internet to a remote device (sometimes called placeshifting). It allowed users to remotely view and control their cable, satellite, or digital video recorder (DVR) system at home from a remote Internet-connected personal computer, smartphone, or tablet as if they were at home. On November 9, 2020, Sling Media announced that all Slingboxes had been discontinued, and that the Slingbox servers would close on November 9, 2022, making all devices "inoperable".

games.name: Duck Norris Tales
games.summary: Duck Norris Tales is a run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles. Play as a brave duck saving the world from an alien invasion. Make friends, discover secrets, wield face melting weapons and most of all shoot first and ask questions later.

games.name: Bellum
games.summary: Bellum is the next evolution of platoon-scale tactical shooters, built in Unreal Engine 5 and shaped by die-hard fans who demanded more from the genre. Set in a fractured Africa of the 2030s, players are thrust into counter-insurgency campaigns where global powers engage in proxy wars across dense jungles, open savannas, and broken urban sprawl. Our unique limited-life system captures the tension of immersive milsim operations while keeping every match accessible, focused, and intense.

games.name: Channel 51
games.summary: Channel 51 may refer to several television stations: Channel 51 (New Zealand), a regional television station based in Napier, Hawke's Bay, New Zealand

games.name: Office Party
games.summary: Take your escapades into the Office and other new locations in this long awaited sequel to House Party! You've made it through the interview process and you're starting a new job. Make a good impression and get promoted. Make the wrong choices and get demoted. Work your way up the corporate ladder in this hysterical, story-rich 3D adventure game with a lot of new surprises and upgrades from the traditional House Party game play.

games.name: Divine Tactics
games.summary: Lead your team of divine allies to victory in this roguelike autobattler. Position your units, unleash their unique powers, and outsmart rivals in this asynchronous multiplayer competition.

games.name: Reng Azure Requiem
games.summary: Face the soul guardians in your quest for the 7 master keys in this pixel art Action RPG. Evolve your abilities and rely on the help of your protector raven to explore and fulfill this purpose in the grim world of Tartarius.

games.name: Jump Frog
games.summary: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

games.name: Installation 19
games.summary: Alex Carter, part of The Abducted UFO group, acts on a tip about nighttime sightings. Unknowingly, he wanders into a top-secret military base, triggering a suspenseful journey.

games.name: Potat
games.summary: Potat is a quirky, physics-based 3D adventure where you play as a sentient potato trying to escape a house before you get cooked alive. Roll, flip, and flop your way through a bizarre home filled with deadly traps, chaotic layouts, and unexpected obstacles.

games.name: Through Hell and Back
games.summary: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

games.name: Silence of Elven Mage Rin
games.summary: A puzzle game featuring a beautiful elven sorceress.

games.name: Cosmic Composer
games.summary: Casual puzzle game on a cosmic scale. Build stars, planets and other cosmic objects. Evolve your cosmos using abilities of the stars from stellar winds to supernova.

games.name: Re:Curse
games.summary: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

games.name: R.E.A.P.E.R. Corp.
games.summary: A co-op horror about scavenging a post-apocalyptic earth and eating your friends.

games.name: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
games.summary: First-person dungeon crawling meets turn-based horror. Lead five fugitives into the depths of a cursed manor—and survive what’s waiting below.

games.name: Out on the Water
games.summary: Out On The Water is a short, meditative journey through memory and grief that tells the story of an inattentive father and his last chance to connect with his children. Set adrift in quiet waters that represent each child, catch strange memory fish to uncover the past and face regrets.

games.name: Gingerbread Holiday
games.summary: Learn to love a broken Holiday through romance. Build a gingerbread house as you form your new home.

games.name: Amanita
games.summary: Amanita is an introspective journey into your mind where the path seems to be only one, and it does not seem to be easy. Let yourself be guided by surreal characters in your thoughts, clash with your memories with sword blows, wander in your memory, play cards with your fears.

games.name: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
games.summary: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

games.name: Pizza Syndicate
games.summary: Run your pizza empire in this quirky retro tycoon! Manage restaurants, hire staff, craft menus, and outsmart rivals. Dive into the underground syndicate—rob banks, hire hitmen, sabotage competitors, and use any scheme to dominate the city with humor and strategy! WISHLIST NOW!

games.name: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive
games.summary: Teach My Little Sister How to Drive is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads. Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

games.name: Malleus Maleficarum
games.summary: Malleus maleficarum (česky Kladivo na čarodějnice) je latinsky psaná rukověť, jejíž autorství bylo později přiřčeno dominikánům Heinrichu (Institorisi) Kramerovi a Jakobu Sprengerovi (jemu patrně neprávem). Byla vydána poprvé ve Štrasburku roku 1486 (nebo na přelomu let 1486 a 1487 u tiskaře Petra Dracha ve Špýru). Obsahuje teologický výklad temných nadpřirozených sil, zejména čarodějnic, který obsahuje soudobé lidové představy, tradované nebo dokumentované případy a návody k pronásledování čarodějnic.

games.name: Ultra Damage
games.summary: Ultra Damage is a hand-drawn Boomer Shooter packed with humor and action, featuring hand-crafted visuals and a story blending gritty detective work with absurd comedy. Each level is a wild ride. Unravel the mystery, find hidden clues, and deal ultra damage to save humanity!

games.name: Joyful Masks
games.summary: Step into the subconscious mind of a brilliant professor, where memories twist, logic bends, and hidden truths await discovery through intricate puzzles

games.name: Deckanism: Singularity Island
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder meets auto-battler where every fight is a puzzle. Build mechanisms, counter enemies and unleash your perfect combo!

games.name: Face Interrogation
games.summary: Become the detective. Try and outsmart the killer by picking the right way forward. It's up to you to figure out clues, takes notes, then use your Command Computer to unlock and confirm core behaviors in the subject. Once you understand him, you may solve the case. Or you might just end the world.

games.name: BunkerZ
games.summary: Stylized WWI trenches meet explosive co-op mayhem. Hold the bunker as a Rifleman, Medic, Engineer, or Machine Gunner. Fight back with era specific WWI weapons, shovels, and flamethrowers, then launch undead sky-high with grenades and explosives. Solo or multiplayer survival at its most chaotic.

games.name: Motion Wulin
games.summary: "Motion Wulin" is a fast-paced martial arts action game where you play as a time-traveling warrior fixing broken timelines.

games.name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
games.summary: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.
aliases: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister

games.name: Metro Rivals: New York
games.summary: In a fractured near future NYC subway system, powerful Track Titans rule each district and line. You, on the other hand, start with nothing but a rundown train. Take jobs, earn cash, build prestige, and outmanoeuvre your rivals to claim their turf.

games.name: Lóng Shén de Xīnniáng Wàizhuàn: Yù Líng Qǐ Tán
games.summary: A Japanese-style fantasy x fairy-tale narrative adventure ADV, telling the story of an unnamed god and a wandering miko…
aliases: 龍神的新娘外傳：御鈴綺譚

games.name: Twilight Protocol
games.summary: Twilight Protocol is an atmospheric detective horror about an employee who becomes trapped in a corporate mystery. Explore the city, gather clues, talk to locals and colleagues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the surface.

games.name: My Eerie Lair
games.summary: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

games.name: Decay of Worlds
games.summary: A tactical fantasy defense game with RPG elements: Deploy powerful units, wield magic, and lead a band of heroes through dark missions filled with meaningful choices.

games.name: Brass Rain
games.summary: Join your friends and fight through defining battles of World War II in BRASS RAIN, a co-op combined arms combat game built around infantry, tanks, and heroic last stands. Inspired by real events, each mission recreates a unique historical battle with its own objectives, and unforgettable stories.

games.name: Ashen Vow
games.summary: You are a knight sworn to God’s word, wielding only a sword against the darkness. But not all believers walk in good faith. The Black Maw has sunk its claws into the misguided, twisting their devotion into madness. Explore a once familiar castle now warped by evil, and cut down the corrupted horde

games.name: Citrus Summer
games.summary: 以都市职场生活为背景的百合视觉小说， 作为在大城市游戏行业996的独身社畜， 想要改变却无能为力的吴依， 偶然间得到了一次改变命运的机会……

games.name: Neighborhood Video
games.summary: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and scouring shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

games.name: The Man Who Walked
games.summary: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

games.name: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
games.summary: An incompetent wizard is tasked with stopping a recently awakened evil entity that just so happens to be trapped inside a (deeply suspiciously heavy) spoon. What follows is a sprawling, absurd 1990s-style point-and-click comedy adventure across bizarre fantasy realms and also North Derbyshire.

games.name: No Exit
games.summary: No Exit is a small chapter based indie horror game. You'll have to face challenging enemies, and perhaps make some allies, as you try to escape the crooked dimension you're trapped in.

games.name: Galo's Strife
games.summary: Galo's Strife je hra z kategorie RPG od studia BLACK@ヌバタマゲームズ pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Runic Tower
games.summary: Stand as the last guardian of the god-bound Runic Tower in a groundbreaking 3rd-person roguelike tower defense experience. Command evolving powers, confront relentless invading factions, and utilize strategic planning to overcome your foes!

games.name: PooPig
games.summary: Shoot, dodge, and chase your acorns in this absurd, cartoon-style Bullethell filled with humor and visual gags.

games.name: Gladiators of Roma Revixit
games.summary: Gladiators of Roma Revixit is a unique, story-driven roguelike, set in world in which, after the nuclear fallout, a new Rome and thus a new colosseum rises from the radioactive-ashes. Rise the ranks, enjoy the celebrity of being a Gladiator, and make decisions that impact the story.

games.name: Project Obscure
games.summary: Forced to abandon Inertium, Barnicle Strass returns to Quark Corp to salvage his legacy. But inside this heavy steampunk facility, a different reality awaits. As the sole carbon lifeform among light entities, he must navigate the machinery. Inside these walls, LIGHT IS ALL THAT'S LEFT.

games.name: Spider Hotel
games.summary: Misfit bugs vs. Giant Spider in an asymmetrical game of tag! Cooperate to survive, or become the spider and hunt! The spider crawls on walls to capture prey. The bugs must rescue friends using teamwork. Escape the trap-filled hotel in a thrilling, hilarious survival game!

games.name: One With the Unicycleverse
games.summary: A precision platformer where you maneuver and weave your unicycle through hundreds of dastardly obstacles across dozens of levels and side modes. Upon mastering the controls; the game becomes a meditative experience and you will discover what it means to be ‘One with the Unicycleverse.’

games.name: Soulscape 2: Fragments of the Present
games.summary: Soulscape 2 is a Turn-based RPG set in the dystopian near future. Featuring an isometric exploration, party-based combat, and a branching dialogue that is shaped by your choices in the game.

games.name: Operation Purge
games.summary: Operation Purge is a story-driven sci-fi survival game set on Titan, Saturn’s mysterious moon. Explore the terrain, manage limited resources, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the surface. Will you survive long enough to find the truth?

games.name: Secret of Havendor
games.summary: Survive the shadows of your past. Forge your path in a world where blood and targets are currency. Will you cling to your humanity or become the monster they see?

games.name: GrappleBurger
games.summary: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

games.name: Zombie Typing
games.summary: Zombie Typing is a tense survival game where every action: moving, looting, reloading, and fighting off the undead, relies on your typing skills. Type fast and stay sharp, because one wrong key could mean the difference between survival and being devoured!

games.name: Cairn: Stone Towers
games.summary: Build balance, one stone at a time. Stack stones into tranquil cairns in this meditative physics-based puzzle game. Explore serene landscapes, master gravity and patience, and create harmony through careful placement. No timers. No stress. Just you and the stones.

games.name: B-Ricky High School
games.summary: Meet Ricky in this exciting arcade game mixing flipper, brick smashing and fight. Get ready for the challenges of Arcade or Story mode and for the tough ones, settle the score in the double 2-player mode.

games.name: RabbitHole Island: Turn-based Vtuber Battles
games.summary: Turn-based battles against powerful vtubers. Free to Play!

games.name: Someone's Inside Me
games.summary: Your teacher Ms. Morbid has trapped you and your classmates on a deadly multiplayer field trip inside a human body! With proximity chat, two teams must scavenge, sabotage, and outwit each other to see who escapes first.

games.name: Down Forward
games.summary: A fast-paced roguelike FPS where you survive shifting liminal nightmares and VHS-era horrors.

games.name: Innerwhy
games.summary: You just dissociated from reality. Unfortunately, the imaginary world you've landed in is as disturbed as your mental state. Gather your courage and confront your darkest thoughts in this 8-bit psychological horror RPG.

games.name: Human Planet
games.summary: 500,000 years ago in the Stone Age, explore uncharted lands in search of a settlement. Survive hunger and predators armed with only crude weapons and your wits.

games.name: Cairns
games.summary: Balance. Patience. Perfection. Cairns is the quintessential Stone Stacking game. Experience diverse and atmospheric environments, and master the art of building the freestanding stone towers know as Cairns.

games.name: Ekholux
games.summary: Ekholux is a mind-bending VR experience where language collapses and motion speaks. Solve sound-based puzzles, break through walls, and race on gravity-defying rails. Created by VR visionary Hsin-Chien Huang, it’s full-body storytelling like never before.

games.name: Nonetbeat
games.summary: NonetBeat is a TPS action game starring three charming heroines. Each with unique combat styles, they obliterate hordes of monsters with magic! Sandbox stages let you destroy terrain for dynamic battles. Collect magic and unleash dazzling combos in thrilling hack-and-slash action!

games.name: Chain Shotgun
games.summary: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?

games.name: GU Fighters
games.summary: GU Fighters is an action roguelike where you unlock and upgrade new abilities after every round of combat. Play with up to 4 players locally or online to create your own unique build and be the first to win, or go solo/co-op to traverse varying environments and defeat hordes of enemies.

games.name: Rustmire
