games.name: Trouble in Potion High
games.summary: Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

games.name: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
games.summary: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

games.name: Bait Ball Party
games.summary: A real-time billiard brawler for up to 6 players. Play as mini characters to dominate the scoreboard, sabotage your friends with power-ups, and punch them to win.

games.name: ProTax 98
games.summary: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

games.name: Rich Flavors
games.summary: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

games.name: Trigonometric Equations
games.summary: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

games.name: Sirin's Feather
games.summary: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

games.name: Treasures of the Goblin King
games.summary: Treasures of the Goblin King je hra z kategorie Adventura od studia JohnPeppermint pro PC (Microsoft Windows), Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4. Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Above Land: Rhapsody
games.summary: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

games.name: Calame
games.summary: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

games.name: CitySpotter
games.summary: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

games.name: Front Page
games.summary:
Front Page is a 1-bit narrative game where you play as the editor-in-chief of an independent newspaper and you are in charge of publishing daily front pages.
Through a story with multiple endings where choices have consequences, you decide the direction your newspaper is taking by picking the articles from a pool that changes every day.

games.name: Scattered
games.summary: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

games.name: Static Between Stations
games.summary: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

games.name: Mars Colony Simulator
games.summary: Build humanity's first home on Mars. Mine resources in first person, construct life-sustaining domes, grow lush vegetation, and launch rockets to reconnect with Earth in this immersive colony-building simulator.

games.name: Dark Watching Chapter 2
games.summary: After the door opens, you find yourself in the shopping mall. At first, everything is quiet, but after a while, you discover dead bodies. You ignore them and continue searching for your sister..

games.name: Lightfold
games.summary: Play as a cat weaving through light and dark in this minimalist puzzle game. Push light sources and solid blocks to craft shapes from cast shadows. Plan your routes, manipulate overlapping silhouettes, and recreate specific shadow patterns to unravel tranquil puzzles in a serene geometric world.

games.name: Hordestomp
games.summary: A third person survivors like with aiming and shooting. Mow down up to 10,000 enemies on screen at once!

games.name: Rise of Sorcery
games.summary: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

games.name: BoomScroll
games.summary: Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom! Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

games.name: 999Seconds!Survivors
games.summary: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

games.name: E.C.H.O.S
games.summary: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

games.name: Step Into the Dark
games.summary: Dive into the grim depths of the underworld, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

games.name: The Kingsward
games.summary: Explore an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

games.name: Rabauken: Spirit Resort
games.summary: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

games.name: The House Always Wins
games.summary: Build a top-tier business solo or in co-op (1–6 players). Start from scratch, keep the slot machines spinning and deal with chaotic events like vandals and alien invasions. Grow your fortune and show everyone why the house always wins.

games.name: Alpha Spectrum
games.summary: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where a massive cyberattack pushes humanity into systemic collapse. You are a CIA agent with psionic abilities caught in the chaos. Shape an immersive storyline through choices guided by your playstyle and intuition.

games.name: Skatebound
games.summary: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

games.name: River Drift
games.summary: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

games.name: Pill After Pill
games.summary: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. Your real enemy isn’t the gang chasing you — it’s the fear slowly consuming your mind. Drive, Shoot, Take Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after...

games.name: Green Mist Over Portland
games.summary: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

games.name: Kage
games.summary: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend

games.name: I Chew, Therefore I Am
games.summary: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

games.name: Twinkle Seek
games.summary: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

games.name: Veriventure
games.summary: Craft intricate levels from a variety of pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Play through the story, access online levels, or make and share your own in this 3D dungeon maker.

games.name: Exipath
games.summary: A survival horror game about liminality and depersonalization, telling the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she descends into warped recollections of her past in order to uncover her own future. Navigate treacherous rooms through in-between time while avoiding the nightmares of days gone by.

games.name: Elecade
games.summary: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

games.name: Infogrind
games.summary: Manage a bank of supernatural artifacts and secret information in a cyberpunk future. Solve mysteries in this new reality, explore the world, navigate the balance between influential corporations that want to rule this new world!

games.name: There’s Something Wrong With the Hero’s Choices
games.summary:
It's supposed to be a simple novel game, but the "choices" are just plain weird!?
A wildly unconventional text adventure game where twists beyond your imagination await!
Guide the hero's party to the Dark Lord by making one bizarre choice after another!

games.name: Grim Dice
games.summary: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

games.name: Samurai Bringer: Rampage
games.summary: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE - is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

games.name: Dungeon Sweeper Plus
games.summary: Expand the world map by uncovering surrounding tiles, aiming to complete your in-game Encyclopedia. Just be careful not to step on dungeon tiles (landmines)!

games.name: Numbers Go Up
games.summary: The 2048 roguelike deckbuilder. Stack game-warping mods and tile enhancements on a systemic board, chain merges, and compete online for the highest score.

games.name: Null
games.summary: Pending IP Transfer

games.name: Damnation84
games.summary: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

games.name: The Little Crumb
games.summary: The Little Crumb is a cute management sim set in a toy-like world. Bake and serve handcrafted treats, customise your character, befriend quirky wooden locals, and grow your shop into a warm, thriving bakery.

games.name: ForMind
games.summary: FORMIND (forest model individual-based) is an individual based forest gap model that is able to simulate the growth of species-rich forests. It was developed in the late 1990s to simulate forest dynamics of tropical forests.

games.name: Carnholt
games.summary: Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerfull spells, fight in tactical battles and kill a God that refused death. Carnholt is a deckbuilder roguelike where victory will only come to those ready to bargain with ancient powers.

games.name: Echoes of the Flame
games.summary: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

games.name: Airskipper
games.summary: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

games.name: After Hue
games.summary: After Hue is a charming puzzle platformer starring an adorable chameleon on a grand adventure! Shift colors, phase through obstacles, and unravel the mysteries hidden within every hue!

games.name: Mouse: P.I. For Hire Story DLC
games.summary: A brand new adventure for Jack Pepper awaits in the first Story DLC for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire…

games.name: Split Brain Samsara
games.summary:
You and your friend are locked in the same body!
In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure!
Communication will be key!

games.name: In:Dark Recall
games.summary: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

games.name: Dice Chess
games.summary: Dice chess can refer to a number of chess variants in which dice are used to alter gameplay; specifically that the moves available to each player are determined by rolling one or more ordinary six-sided dice. There are many different variations of this form of dice chess.

games.name: Broadside Bets
games.summary: This isn't a casino. This is war! Command the crew, upgrade your deck and collect rule-bending Booty. Discover devastating combinations and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of encounters, islands and treasure.

games.name: The Great Beyond
games.summary: "The Great Beyond" is a song by American rock band R.E.M., written for the 1999 film Man on the Moon. It was released as a single the same year for support of the film's soundtrack album. On the soundtrack, there is some dialogue from the movie at the end of the track; meanwhile, the single version is a radio edit, with the bridge omitted. "The Great Beyond" reached number three on the UK Singles Chart in January 2000, the band's highest-ever chart position in that country, and it was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Song Written for a Motion Picture, Television or Other Visual Media.

games.name: Stellar Breach
games.summary: Blast through massive waves and tough bosses in this chaotic sci-fi roguelite shooter. Guide the charming duo, Barnaby and C.A.T., through a branching narrative via multiple-choice interactions where your story decisions directly alter randomized loadouts and abilities on every run!

games.name: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
games.summary: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it's lost forever.

games.name: Welcome, [Employee Name]
games.summary:
Welcome, [Employee Name] is a satirical Papers, Please-like game set in a space station control room. You will experience being an employee of a giant corporation (HonkyTonk inc.) that controls everything entering and leaving the space station, sometimes to the detriment of its occupants...
Discover their secrets, help the people trying to make a difference, or not... your choice!

Control and cross-reference: Open manuals, read instructions, compare documents, this is your job!

Multiple story paths: Truck drivers have hearts too, and it seems like the company you work for has some... issues...

Choices have consequences: You have the power to make a difference, or to keep your head low in this big corporation. What choices will you make?

games.name: Angel in Inferno
games.summary: A visual novel that depicts the trials of four young girls who committed crimes during their lifetimes and have since passed away.
developers: ひとりサークル「匙投げ部」

games.name: Re:cord Noah: Fractal of Oblivion
games.summary: An upcoming otome game being developed for global release in 2026 for the Nintendo Switch. It is a collaboration between AmuLit and Soyogi Fractal, a vocal synth project made by Yuki Kaji.
aliases: Re:cord NOAH 忘却のフラクタル

games.name: Dragon and Mahjong
games.summary: Dragon & Sparrow is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes, escape the endless exploitation games, and fight the goblin corporation that owns the city — across three timelines, all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

games.name: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
games.summary: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

games.name: Addie Shen
games.summary: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

games.name: Handlime
games.summary:
Forget the keyboard! All you need are your hands.

Meet the protagonist of our 2D action-puzzle game "Handlime"—a quirky, hand-shaped slime! Using a webcam, the game tracks your hand movements in real-time, perfectly syncing them with the slime on the screen.

The controls are completely intuitive. Walk by wiggling your fingers as if "tickling" the ground, tilt your hand to move, or make a fist to punch and blast objects away!

games.name: Hermit Computer
games.summary: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

games.name: Sonnet
games.summary: Sonet (z provensálského sonet nebo z italského sonetto, tj. písnička) je literární poetický útvar, který vznikl v 1. pol. 13. století, vyznačující se přesně vymezenou strukturou 14 veršů a logickým členěním (14 veršů je rozdělených do dvou čtyřveršových a dvou trojveršových slok). V románských jazycích se v sonetech užívá obvykle hendekasylabu nebo alexandrínu, v angličtině jambického pentametru. Poněkud zastaralý český překlad slova sonet je znělka.

games.name: Line Forge BlackSmith
games.summary: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.summary: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: The Incentive Program
games.summary: The Incentive Program is a match-3 roguelike about a surreal corporate job that’s hiding something. You’re paid to play, but you won’t win. So rig the odds, exploit the rules, and escape the program.

games.name: The Way of Ping-pong
games.summary: A roguelike bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

games.name: Type & Magic
games.summary: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard’s castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle’s dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don’t.

games.name: Keep It Up!
games.summary: Keep It Up! is a 4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow genetically [redacted] test subjects slap a balloon through a mysterious obstacle course without it touching the ground. You've gotta Keep It Up!

games.name: Help me Cleaner Sama!: I Got Isekai'd to Clean Monster Girl Basements
games.summary:
This is a comedic fantasy puzzle game that follows an overworked cleaner transported to another world and tasked with clearing dangerous basements for a cast of eccentric monster girls. The story blends absurd humor and visual novel-style dialogue with satire about work, responsibility, and everyday frustrations.

Gameplay focuses on grid-based, turn-based puzzles where players manage limited movement, avoid hazards, and solve stage-specific challenges that vary by character. The game also includes mature themes, unlockable animated scenes, and a gallery mode.

games.name: Mym's Sword
games.summary: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

games.name: Cozy Campfire Club
games.summary: Go camping with other players and setup a cozy campfire. Chat and make friends as you relax by the campfire, customize your campsite, forage in the forest, and cook up different foods in this cute hangout game.

games.name: Celestial Temple
games.summary: Celestial Temple is a narrative action-adventure game from Ursa Majeur. Become Curiosity, uncover who and where you are, and journey through a dreamlike mythic odyssey across ages, facing enemies with your own face while seeking a sliver of light in self-made darkness.

games.name: Order 13 VR
games.summary: A psychological horror VR experience where you work the night shift inside a mysterious warehouse while taking care of your cat. Fulfill orders, survive the darkness, and uncover what hides between the shelves.

games.name: Friendship vs The World
games.summary:
A wholesomely chaotic 1-4 player co-op game! Craft your friends into HEROES and deploy them into battle against increasingly bizarre waves of enemies.

It's you and your friends against the world... Prove that the POWER OF YOUR FRIENDSHIP can overcome anything!

games.name: Pachinko Life
games.summary: A pachinko roguelike where every run is a life. every country, class, and choice changes how the board plays.

games.name: The Membrane
games.summary: Shoot, slash and slay the enemy hordes erupting from the jungle’s Membrane in this action survival roguelite. Hold the encircling trenches, fortify them, choose your build and rise from loinclothed-servant to unstoppable Amazon king.

games.name: Orbfall
games.summary: Orbfall - Reclaim the Planet is an upcoming action-packed sci-fi adventure currently in beta development. It is set in a shattered world devastated by the impact of mysterious orbital objects, players explore dangerous environments, gather resources, battle hostile alien factions, and fight to reclaim the planet from chaos. Featuring detailed base building, team-based PvE combat across multiple maps, and a dark atmospheric setting, Orbfall delivers an immersive blend of survival, exploration, and intense futuristic warfare as humanity struggles to rebuild its future. (Still in development though)

games.name: Cartefact
games.summary: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity's energy crisis.

games.name: Shinovi Nexus: Senran Kagura
games.summary: Shinovi Nexus: Senran Kagura je videohra od studia Honey Parade Games pro PC (Microsoft Windows), iOS, Android. Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Grisaia: Shuuketsu no Hyakka - Les Rassemblement Cent Fruits de la Grisaia
games.summary: A gacha game sequel to Grisaia no Rakuen.

games.name: Akasha
games.summary: Embark on a 32-player Mecha adventure that unfolds over 3 real-world days.

games.name: Point in Time
games.summary: Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles. Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history? Design your own escape.

games.name: Earths Edge
games.summary: Earths Edge is a fast co-op movement FPS for 1–4 players. Enter the battlefield from the flying hub with your own fully customizable mech and pilot. Smash through destructible environments, enemy factions and mutated monsters. Double jump, slide, wall-run and shoot your way through Earths Edge.

games.name: Lane-4: A dystopian Programming Thriller
games.summary: An open-ended programming game in which you optimise 4-core assembly code to maintain a 1990s alt-history dystopian megacity's infrastructure. Take jobs from middlemen with hidden agendas and uncover the chilling consequences of your "routine" fixes in this assembly language puzzle thriller.

games.name: Please, Spin
games.summary: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

games.name: Bloomino
games.summary: A cozy game about running your own little flower shop Place flower tiles, create charming bouquets and brighten your customers’ day. Decorate your shop, unlock new flowers and discover a variety of beautiful combinations.

games.name: No One Returns
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what happens if you wake up and everyone is simply gone? No One Returns is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Denis, search a chillingly silent city for clues about your missing family while fighting the frightening zombies swarming the streets.

games.name: Hug Factory
games.summary: An incremental/management game about hugging people to generate profits and the neverending pain of inflation.

games.name: Guns, Princess and Braves
games.summary: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

games.name: Sunyata CCG
games.summary: Set in Earth’s magical future, Sunyata is a tactical, action‑packed collectible card game where you command fantastical creature and castle abilities. Ride dragons, summon the undead, and evolve magical beasts in duels that reward creative deckbuilding and adaptive strategy.

games.name: Rabanaz
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder set in a steampunk casino run by ravens. Rewire the machine in your favour and they won't take it quietly. Blend your chips into new colours and change what "random" means to steer a run toward the build you have in mind.

games.name: AntiMatcher
games.summary: In this abstract rule-discovery puzzle game, you manipulate bubbles to destroy antibubbles in a series of handcrafted puzzles designed to encourage experimentation.

games.name: Just an Ordinary Bike Ride
games.summary: In this adventure horror game you experience nothing but a calm bike ride home, your chauffeur is late and it's starting to rain. You only have a bike but you need to get home, it's a rather empty street aside from some debris. It's just a bike ride home.

games.name: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
games.summary: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

games.name: The Only Droid
games.summary: Tear enemy robots apart piece by piece in a physics-based action roguelike. Destroy weak points, stack upgrades, and create your unique build as you turn relentless robotic enemy waves into mechanical graveyards.

games.name: Deadzone Rogue 2
games.summary: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

games.name: Into The Haunted Land
games.summary: An online co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Team up with your friends to explore ruins, loot cursed items, hide from monsters and extract safely. Do whatever it takes to meet the Guild’s quota.

games.name: Where Dolls Hang
games.summary: Where Dolls Hang is a survival psychological horror game where you investigate a place plagued by strange and unsettling events filled with hanging dolls. Explore dangerous locations, gather evidence, uncover hidden secrets, and use your boat to confront the unknown as you search for answers.

games.name: Snack Factory Together
games.summary: Team up with friends to build a successful snack business. Start with a small room and simple machines, then grow into a massive factory.

games.name: Hardware Simulator
games.summary: Build your hardware empire from scratch! Experience real business with product sourcing, dynamic pricing, online orders, and delivery management. Boost your popularity, expand your store, and become the country's most successful hardware merchant!

games.name: Bus Terminal Simulator
games.summary: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

games.name: Biosphere Simulator
games.summary: Biosphere Simulator is a planetary god game sandbox in which players guide a barren volcanic world through billions of years of evolution. Players shape the atmosphere, carve oceans, and seed the first microbes, then watch ecosystems, species, and civilizations develop across three eras: Geological, Biological, and Technological. Features include procedural world generation, a DNA and mutation engine spanning 48+ species, ecosystem and atmospheric simulation, emergent civilizations, and god powers such as asteroids, volcanic eruptions, wildfires, and rainstorms.

games.name: Crow's Requiem
games.summary: A narrative-heavy, comic-infused survival visual novel & puzzle game where you are a licensed body collector navigating a dystopian world of moral dilemmas and resource management; where belief, rebellion, or control will prevail through your choices.

games.name: Straying Rules
games.summary: Straying Rules is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You need to escape from various worlds governed by strange rules within 12 hours by all means. Levels, objectives and dangers are ever-changing every time you enter. You must discover and interpret the rules to find your only hope of survival.

games.name: Rotted: A Brain Rot Simulator
games.summary: Humanity is trapped in an infinite scroll. Your mission: Break the loop and escape the rogue AI controlling your mind. Stack wild powerups and survive the digital prison in this retro PS1-inspired survival roguelite. Shut down the network... or rot.

games.name: Earn Your Legacy
games.summary: Earn Your Legacy by yourself or with your friends by slaughtering enemies with flashy combos, finding epic loot and powerful upgrades, parkouring around traps and fighting epic bosses!

games.name: Fetidity
games.summary: Dive into the mysterious and terrifying world of Fetidity and help Mark solve all the puzzles and discover the secret of this place.

games.name: Bean Base
games.summary: Bean Base is a survival base building farming game where you are solely responsible for your very own space station. Grow crops, explore the stars, and decorate your base; however you want to, survive the elements of space.

games.name: Block Machine
games.summary: A difficult programming puzzle game about building parallel computing machines by placing blocks to solve surprisingly hard problems.

games.name: Rekindled
games.summary: "Rekindled" is the 21st episode of the ninth season of the American police procedural drama NCIS, and the 207th episode overall. It aired on CBS in the United States on April 17, 2012. The episode is written by Christopher J. Waild and Reed Steiner and directed by Mark Horowitz, and was seen by 18.08 million viewers.

games.name: Gido Gido: Kaiju Battle Party
games.summary: A chaotic 4v4 party brawl is about to go down! Control your giant cuddly combative creatures in a cozy city you can smash to pieces, and fuse with your teammates into even bigger kaiju you collectively control for more devastation. Unleash the mayhem and let's gooooo!

games.name: Birds of Ascent
games.summary: Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds. Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

games.name: Echo Pandemic
games.summary: You are a bat, and the aliens are afraid of you. Stalk occupied towns by echolocation, bite a single host, and let the virus do the rest. A stealth game where your weapon is a disease. Engineer strains, manage outbreaks, and stay invisible. The hunt starts at dusk.

games.name: Moonlight Cradle
games.summary: This is a traditional simulation management and raising game with multiple endings featuring beautiful girls.

games.name: Inversion Day
games.summary: Invert the world around you in this atmospheric pixel-art puzzle platformer. Escape an alien spaceship with your dog using mysterious artifacts that reshape reality, uncover hidden secrets, and solve increasingly difficult handcrafted puzzles.

games.name: Ball Buster Breakout
games.summary: Grab your balls and get ready to bust! A hyper-kinetic Idle incremental breakout game.

games.name: Outscratched
games.summary: The scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble a unique selection of scratchcards, blessed charms, and magical stickers. Discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

games.name: Sanctuaries
games.summary: The conquistadors just landed and they are coming for your treasure! You must protect your Sanctuaries against this new threat. Take arms, lay down traps, improve your empire and lead your Heroes into battle to repel the invaders!

games.name: Unmixable Syrup
games.summary: I wolf down a cold, lonely meal. Work's wearing me down, and money's shaky. The syrup I pour into my cold coffee never mixes, no matter how much I stir. So I figure I'll just wander around in my dreams.

games.name: Llamero
games.summary: Llameros (lit. "people who drive llamas"; also known as pastores or caravaneros) are indigenous peasants who run llama caravans throughout the Andes of South America. During the Inca Empire, llameros were high-ranking officials tasked with managing the emperor's llama and alpaca herds, and facilitating trade and communication throughout the empire. Nowadays, roads have reduced the need for llameros, and they now mostly serve isolated mountain villages inaccessible by road.

games.name: Spaceman's Luck
games.summary: Do you have a Spaceman's Luck? A space strategy game.

games.name: Returnless
games.summary: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run.

games.name: Szkeletal
games.summary:
Szkeletal: Estrogen Dracul's Potato Hunger (also known by its original Polish title: SZKELETAL: Ziemniaczkowy Głód Estrogenowego Drakula) is a 2D top-down action roguelite and bullet heaven game heavily inspired by the gameplay loop of titles like Vampire Survivors. It serves as a satirical parody of the Polish internet, specifically targeting the gaming community, local content creators, and self-proclaimed "ludologists".

Set in a vaguely defined, fictionalized location, loosely inspired by the internet lore of personalities fleeing to Romania. Players take control of the titular "Estrogen Dracul". The core gameplay involves collecting potatoes and automatically attacking hordes of meme-based enemies. Key features include the "Destiny Cards" system, which allows players to manually pick up and throw cards to trigger specific tactical effects, as well as a dynamic weather and day/night cycle that actively modifies visibility during runs.

games.name: Mobius
games.summary: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

games.name: Project Roy
games.summary: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

games.name: Garage Mechanic Simulator 2026
games.summary: Build your own car empire in Garage Mechanics 2026

games.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms
games.summary: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft crowbars and magic potions, fulfill demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

games.name: Travelling Light
games.summary: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

games.name: Book Nook
games.summary: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

games.name: Spiriki: Tiny Island
games.summary: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!

games.name: Sword & Banner
games.summary: Mount & Blade meets Total War with classic RTS controls - brought to life in pixel art. Lead your warband across a living fantasy world, raid settlements, trade goods, and fight large-scale tactical battles with formations, dynamic weather, and an army you build from peasants to knights.

games.name: Expendabots
games.summary: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

games.name: Zolana: Girl Galactic
games.summary: Saving Planet Earth, one outfit at a time! Zolana must save the planet Earth from having its fashion taken away, by challenging the Uniforian conquerors to a runway competition! Dress to a new theme each round in order to wow the judges and save the day!

games.name: Dice'n'Go
games.summary: Dice’n’Go is a turn-based tactical board game where every roll can change the outcome. Choose your hero, move across a tile-based arena, and use unique abilities to outplay your opponents. Master positioning, timing, and cooldowns to win with both strategy and a bit of luck.

games.name: Synapse Chronicles
games.summary: Synapse Chronicles is a gritty, visceral action-adventure game that blends intense cosmic horror with tactical, physics-driven combat. Unravel a cosmic conspiracy at the center of the universe and explore a bleak world filled with danger, secrets, and tense action around every corner.

games.name: SCP RP
games.summary: A multiplayer SCP roleplay experience where a living facility is powered by programmable-driven characters, dynamic events, and player choice.

games.name: 4Mecheros
games.summary: A narrative-rhythm game I made to deal with my things 🚬, about how a predatory contract forces a fragmented band—composed of irreparable broken friendships—to get together for a final show. A coming-of-age story about reverb-punk, playing a real bass and the meaning of (not) loving forever.

games.name: Boto Labo
games.summary: Solve up to 100 Sokoban-Puzzle levels with the help of your robot friends! Arrange them. Move them. Watch 'em go and... reach the flag in your own style! We got cats, dogs and many more!

games.name: Hardcheologist
games.summary: You are an archeologist descending through mysterious and ever-changing ruins using only your weapon's recoil to control the fall. Shoot, try not to touch the ground, reveal secrets and survive. How deep can you go? What lies hidden in the depths of this pyramid?

games.name: Cthulhu Go Teaching
games.summary: Go has never been so 'within tentacle's reach'! With Lord Cthulhu as your teacher, playing Go is no longer boring. Whether you want to learn the basics, improve your skills, or grind Life & Death problems, Lord Cthulhu will accompany you until the end of time!

games.name: Auto Empire Tycoon
games.summary: Start in the 1950s with a small factory and one dealership. Research new technologies, design cars, manage production, stock your showrooms and outsell rival brands to build a dominant automotive empire in this isometric tycoon simulation.

games.name: Abiotic Factor: Entropic Break
games.summary: Embark on a new tropical adventure, roaming sun-drenched seas and forgotten islands. Investigate the warped GATE Leaf Test Facility and surrounding isles, confronting a new breed of fanatics, digital disorder, far-flung anomalies, the Flesh Dimension, and more in this world-crossing DLC expansion.

games.name: Boxing Bastards
games.summary: Plunge into a medieval world where knights brawl with their fists rather than swords! Get creative with physics-based combat as you fight through several thematic biomes full of unique enemies and encounters. Complete quests, buy upgrades, and kill baddies to become the ultimate Boxing Bastard!

games.name: Signal Zero
games.summary: A sci-fi roguelike shooter where aim and movement are unified into one mouse. Pilot a Simuler, command your ship, deploy escorts, and tear through colossal bosses. Easy to grasp, ruthless under pressure.

games.name: Starting a Village from Zero
games.summary: This is your own village-building story — You are a familiar summoned by Lily, an apprentice witch. In her place, gather materials, construct buildings, and create a thriving village. A new kind of miniscape × survival × roguelite simulation.

games.name: Maximum Thunderness
games.summary: An extreme response to minor problems. MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike side-scrolling co-op action game where you battle space alien criminals attempting to conquer Earth through a series of increasingly petty crimes.

games.name: Fendershot
games.summary: Intense street racing with some outrageous Race Tech Inspired by Blur, Midnight Club and NFS:U. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Test drive the demo on PC, Mac and SteamOS (Proton)!

games.name: Nobunaga's Ambition: Hishou
games.summary: Nobunaga's Ambition: Hishou je videohra od studia Koei Tecmo Games pro Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Microsoft Windows), PlayStation 5. Termín vydání: Q4 2026.

games.name: Plant Game
games.summary: Run-based plant survival and growth game about learning the world through imperfect senses. Grow leaves, roots, and resilience, unlock biological “sensors” as UI progression, and earn your reveal when you bloom or die.

games.name: Corrupted Dice
games.summary: Corrupted Dice is a dice-based roguelite where every die eventually breaks. Build a pool of unique dice, reach escalating score targets, discover new unlocks, play risky betting minigames, and push Heat and Corruption to the limit.

games.name: Human: Profit
games.summary: An accurate depiction of our world, baked into a short, classic incremental game. Take over Grandpa's farm, rebuild the town, and do whatever it takes to succeed. Also rabbits.

games.name: Hannibal
games.summary: Hannibal is a city along the Mississippi River in Marion and Ralls counties in Missouri, United States. According to the 2020 U.S. census, the population was 17,108, making it the largest city in Marion County. The bulk of the city is in Marion County, with a tiny sliver in the south extending into Ralls County. Nestled on the Mississippi River, commerce and traffic has long been an integral part of Hannibal's development, including by river, rail and the interstate/highway system. Today the city is intersected by Interstate 72 and U.S. Routes 24, 36, and 61. Hannibal is approximately 110 miles (180 km) northwest of St.

games.name: Nano Reef
games.summary: Turn every keystroke into a thriving ocean! Nano Reef is a cozy companion game where typing or clicking earns gold—without interrupting your work. Spend gold to buy marine fish, vibrant corals, and decorations, or feed your fish to interact. Build your unique, relaxing desktop aquarium!

games.name: Break Point: Brace & Breach
games.summary: [Hero-Building] + [Frontline Tower Defense]｜Hold against multi-lane assaults｜Adjust positions, facing, skill builds, and formations to create a unique defense｜Push the front, seize resources, and strengthen your heroes｜Let the enemy tide shatter against your masterpiece

games.name: Arthur’s Tale
games.summary: Guide Arthur through a world that’s out to get him! Sprint, leap, and faceplant your way through a vibrant adventure overflowing with devious traps, oversized bosses, and enough "Try Again" screens to last a lifetime. It’s colorful, it’s chaotic, and yes—you’re probably going to fail. A lot.

games.name: Vanguard Tides
games.summary: Fight in massive-scale battles where armies paint the battlefield in their color. Captured territory affects both your health and your abilities. Level up your vanguard and your army, defend your castles, and survive the shifting tides of battle to claim ultimate victory!

games.name: Interred
games.summary: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

games.name: Loop
games.summary: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

games.name: The Murder of Yesterday
games.summary: A psychological horror crime experience where time is your only weapon. Travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

games.name: Write Night
games.summary: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

games.name: Schoolgirl vs. Fishman
games.summary: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

games.name: ICU: Intensive Care Unit 8
games.summary: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

games.name: Lost Exit
games.summary: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

games.name: Still Warm
games.summary: Deep-fry lángos in a Budapest alleyway and serve the regulars from the apartment building across the courtyard while they slowly realize someone is picking them off, one by one.

games.name: Shadow & Steel
games.summary: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

games.name: Guildmaker
games.summary: Run a guild of valiant, procedurally generated adventurers who fight, trade, craft, and do quests on their own. Do your best as their guildmaster to provide them a place to rest and thrive, and restore an old guild to its former glory.

games.name: Tyrants Rafting
games.summary: Tyrants Rafting is a chaotic co-op escape game where two players control one rigged boat and race from checkpoint to checkpoint before the timer runs out. Play as infamous dictators on the run, survive deadly rivers, grab pickups, and stumble through a satirical escape full of golden speedboat boosts, pickup-truck shootouts, and friendship-ruining shared controls.

games.name: Flipping Football Clubs
games.summary:
A roguelite football management game designed around meaningful progression in 1-2 hour play sessions, with each season structured as a single run.

Your aim is to buy and sell football clubs "flipping" them for profit. Each successful Flip becomes progressively more challenging, with cumulative handicaps that carry forward across runs.

games.name: Antarctic Grave
games.summary: A first-person survival horror set in an Antarctic research station. Explore the frozen complex, search for tools and weapons, keep the generator fueled, and outsmart mutants to survive the harsh conditions.

games.name: Quality Assurance
games.summary: Participate in chaotic testing sessions with up to eight players where you'll work together to solve a wide variety of randomized tasks while navigating hindering conditions. Prove to your creators that you're not just functional — you're exceptional.

games.name: One Last Push
games.summary: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

games.name: Omea
games.summary: Your words shape the adventure. Omea is a revolutionary AI-powered narrative game where your personal Game Master responds to everything you write. No menus, no limits. Just type and forge your own legend across fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and beyond.

games.name: Lab Loonies
games.summary: Lab Loonies is a physics-based descent into madness where "logic" is a suggestion the developer ignored. In this 1-4 player lab experiment, the platforms are lying, the physics are "opinionated," and the Narrator is actively rooting for your demise. Make good choices, or don't. The Lab doesn't judge

games.name: Foosball Manager
games.summary: Foosball Manager is a singleplayer table football management game.

games.name: Mob Drop Castle
games.summary:
Awaken from your slumber o’ castle overlord!
It’s time to rise up and rebuild your fortress to protect it from the invading adventurers in this reverse hoard-survivors real-time idle castle management!

games.name: FantômeRapport: Intermezzo
games.summary: Fantôme Rapport is a multi-genre visual novel that blends romance, horror, and mystery. Uncover the secrets of a ghostly luxury cruise liner and the enigmatic women aboard.

games.name: Board of the Future
games.summary: Is it a board? Is it a plane? Is it the coolest, fastest piece of alien technology from the future that you and your friends have ever been riding?

games.name: The Obsessive Shadow: Chapter 2
games.summary: Something sinister stirs on Old Diamond Drive. 16 year old Justin, armed only with a flashlight and camcorder, takes a dare to spend the night. As shadows close in, he realizes escape isn't possible, and he's not alone. Witness the horrors of the past as you explore the ruins of what once thrived...

games.name: Lane of the Eternal Night
games.summary: An exploratory, self-chosen experience type of light roguelike turn-based pixel indie game, currently without much storyline. Although the combat is turn-based, it's more like a rock-paper-scissors style game mode, and it also includes skills.

games.name: Who Wants To Be King?!
games.summary: The year is 865. Vikings are sailing to avenge Ragnar Lothbrok. Build your city and defend it—alone or with friends.

games.name: Little Lilicia
games.summary: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.
aliases: フォレスティア～ちいさな町の牧場ライフ～

games.name: Pubes
games.summary: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

games.name: Deliver Together
games.summary: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

games.name: Skill Eater
games.summary: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

games.name: Runa in Nightmare House
games.summary: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

games.name: Shatterfarms
games.summary: Farm. Forage. Fight. SHATTERFARMS is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the Calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to SHATTERFARMS.

games.name: Touhou Sousenkyou: Land of Oracular Zeitgeist
games.summary:
An extraordinary new entry to the world of Touhou shmup fangames is arriving in 2026!

With the sudden announcement of a "popularity contest" occuring in the Human Village, a variety of maidens—from familiar faces like Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame to completely new and original characters never seen before—set off to win the contest by battling it out.

But lurking in the shadows behind the curtains of this "popularity royale" lies a mastermind attempting to fix the matches...

A Phantasmagoria-styled versus game, sure to draw in allies, spectators, and even fairies!
aliases: 东方苍仙京 ～ Land of Oracular Zeitgeist
東方蒼仙京　～ Land of Oracular Zeitgeist

games.name: Ember Express
games.summary: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

games.name: NowLoading Forever
games.summary: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

games.name: MLF: Pro Catch
games.summary:
The official Major League Fishing game, a fishing sim you can play solo or online with friends. Cast, troll, and feel every fish fight back as you control the drag, manage line tension, and read each run and dive to land your catch. Reel in over 50 species, from Largemouth bass and Rainbow trout to Muskellunge, Alligator gar, and sharks, each with its own model, habitat, and behavior.

Explore six diverse waters, including Shadow Lake, the Everglades, the Florida Keys, and Lake Whitney, all with a full day-night cycle and shifting weather. Fish from shore, docks, or boat, and gear up with tackle from real brands like Mossy Oak, YETI, Abu Garcia, and Berkley. Compete in tournaments, climb the leaderboards, and chase your personal-best trophies.

games.name: God, Save the Queens!
games.summary: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and defeat the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

games.name: Tyrants Must Fall
games.summary: Build your rebel army and lead them to victory over the Tyrant King in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Improve your leader's skills, unlock new units, and hone your battlefield strategy as you march towards your fate as the Hero of Destiny.

games.name: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
games.summary: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed is a goofy 3D puzzle-platformer where your greatest asset is your backside. Solve lateral thinking puzzles to complete your Civic Disturbance Duty.

games.name: Don't Get Fired!
games.summary: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

games.name: Dumb Dunks
games.summary: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

games.name: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki No Emaki
games.summary: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

games.name: Monster Hatcher
games.summary: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

games.name: Underground Business
games.summary: Underground Business is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for a rural town at a pizzeria kiosk. Take orders, cook pizza, investigate the suspicious pizzeria underground and run for your life in high-intensity chases!

games.name: Going My Way?
games.summary: In a world consumed by an insomnia pandemic, where there are no laws and people are going crazy, you're a train conductor racing through an endless night blizzard. Study the strange passengers, solve mysteries, and survive the time loop before the snowy abyss swallows you up.

games.name: Cat a Photo
games.summary: Cat a Photo is a lively, fast‑paced multiplayer game all about capturing the perfect cat photo.

games.name: PulseWave
games.summary: Every weapon fires to the beat you create. Mix guns, modifiers, and upgrades to build deadly combinations in this rhythm-shooter roguelike.

games.name: Turbo Loop
games.summary:
Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game built around simple gameplay that is easy to pick up, yet challenging to master. Whether you're chasing perfect lap times or battling head-to-head, every race is about precision, timing, and control.

Take on AI opponents, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, and push your skills across a wide variety of tracks. Unlock new cars, fine-tune their look, and create your own racing circuits with a simple and easy-to-use track editor.

games.name: Saintless
games.summary: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

games.name: Tidy Tidy
games.summary: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

games.name: Don’t Return to Wonderland
games.summary: A dark fairy-tale horror adventure inspired by Alice in Wonderland. Use mysterious powers to forge your path and confront the horrors lurking within a world that is both adorable and cruel.

games.name: Crown Control
games.summary: Tactical roguelike deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

games.name: The 4 Masked
games.summary: A 4-player co-op FPS adventure where you swing through trees using vines, escape wild animals, and survive dangerous biomes. Each player has a unique role, and teamwork is the key to survival.

games.name: Lost in Art
games.summary: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

games.name: Covert Koalas: Phasco
games.summary: A comfy hidden-koala game with unique hand-drawn visuals and adjustable difficulty. The story follows a group of koalas escaping their captivity and searching for a new home. Has hints, over 10 levels and original soundtrack.

games.name: SWAT God
games.summary:
SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

SWAT God can do things that most do not understand and many refuse to believe. Move like lightning. Dispatch whole squads with one burst and vanish before the sound hits their friends. Bolt to the hostage and rush them to safety in a blur. Shoot one enemy and before his friends can turn to look, flank around the entire building in an instant to finish off the rest.

This is a hyper speed top down shooter that aims to remove all speed limits. Mouse control gives you as much speed and precision as you're capable of. Enemies with faster-than-human reactions will hunt you down, surround you, bombard you with grenades and rockets.

games.name: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life
games.summary: No graphics, No tiles. Just text-RPG adventure! Explore a shifting labyrinth, regain the Ring of Life from the wizard Shingor. Classic roguelike-style messages guide your journey, with narrative scenes evoking the spirit of MUDs and gamebooks. Death is permanent. Every run brings new discoveries.

games.name: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
games.summary: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

games.name: Tileburg
games.summary: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

games.name: Some Type of Trip
games.summary: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.

games.name: Oops Unit
games.summary: Oops Unit is an online co-op game where up to 6 players team up as a bomb squad. Solve puzzles, gather resources, and push through deadly traps and enemies to reach and defuse every bomb. Extract, buy new gear, and repeat—or die trying, because anything, even your friends, can sabotage the mission.

games.name: Don't Lose Face!
games.summary: Don't Lose Face! is an abstract simulation game that makes you flustered and laugh until you're exhausted. What you're about to face: multi-tasking torture, facial features that slide down like cream, hilarious physics feedback, abstract random events…

games.name: Never Look Back
games.summary: A psychological, rule-based horror game set on an infinite liminal staircase. Players have to descend the staircase, squeeze a cute rubber duck, and never look back as the Darkness follows behind.

games.name: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown
games.summary: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!
aliases: 怪兽公主：集结！超超超生存大战略
怪獸公主：集結！超超超生存大戰略

games.name: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror
games.summary: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror is an upcoming third-person survival horror game set in a frozen gothic landscape. Players navigate cursed streets, morgues, and Dr. Frankenstein’s laboratory while surviving both brutal creatures and the horrors of his experiments.

games.name: Micro RPG
games.summary: Monsters have invaded the kingdom, taking advantage of the knights' annual holiday! You are the last hope! Equip yourself with weapons and fight the monsters surrounding you in this turn-based game with your spinning attacks across a dozen fantasy worlds!

games.name: A Mountain Called Hope
games.summary: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

games.name: Train Set Code
games.summary: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

games.name: Good Hands
games.summary: In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with over 100 uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.

games.name: Cold Contours: Intake
games.summary: Cold Contours: Intake is an atmospheric first-person 3D puzzle game set inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Use magnets to explore its halls and machinery: throw them, attach them to metal, change their polarity, and activate old mechanisms.

games.name: Squishy League
games.summary: Squishy League is a fast paced versus sport game where you control a squishy character that can only move by dashing. Smash the Ball into your opponent’s goal to score points ! Master charged shoots, spins, and wall bounces to outsmart your opponent. Play locally or online in crazy 1v1 matches.

games.name: The Rifted Skies
games.summary: The Rifted Skies is an active VR roguelite set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Parkour and fight to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover - can your home ever be saved?

games.name: Steel Maiden
games.summary: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous visuals.

games.name: Backrooms: Eternals
games.summary: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

games.name: Flesh Fossil
games.summary: Stranded on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs, you must find a way to escape. Uncover the island's past, manage your resources and evade those pursuing you.

games.name: HAFO: Horse Around, Find Out
games.summary: Take control of an elite, equine warrior, defeating jobber jockeys who stand in your way as you race to the finish line, using fierce foreleg punches, hind leg kicks. HAFO isn't your grandsire's horse racing game. Wanna know how? Well Horse Around, and Find Out!

games.name: Gunjutsu
games.summary: GUNJUTSU combines the score-chasing creativity of Skate 3 with Call of Duty Trickshotting. Learn the basics, master the 'Trickshot Iceberg' and compete on the global leaderboard. If you’ve ever hit a 360, this game was made for you.

games.name: Bee Space
games.summary: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

games.name: Pest Protocol
games.summary: The swarm is infinite—your hands aren't. Pest Protocol is a short, satisfying incremental game. Start by clicking to eradicate pests, then rapidly deploy autonomous systems to clear the screen for you. Build, upgrade, and scale your extermination empire. Automate the eradication.

games.name: Skroll
games.summary: Wake up, junkie. Your brain is hungry and only infinite scrolling can satisfy it. Manage dopamine, battery, and sanity in this survival roguelike about digital slavery.

games.name: 100 Yen Exorcist
games.summary: Welcome to your part-time job cleaning up evil spirits! We picked up everything you’ll need from a 100-yen shop—more or less. Use your supplies properly, or just chuck them at the ghosts. Your call.

games.name: Bear Horror
games.summary: Real-time strategy meets dark SCP survival. Play as the self-replicating SCP-1048, also known as the Builder Bear, gather grotesque resources, mass-produce a horrifying army of teddy clones and survive against Foundation personnel.

games.name: False Hope
games.summary: False Hope is a survival horror game where you play as Stanley and Harriet, a couple trapped in an abandoned mall. As they navigate dark corridors, mannequins come to life, turning their escape into a fight for survival. Solve puzzles, uncover the mall's dark secrets, and evade relentless threats.

games.name: Find the Beer
games.summary: The lights have gone out, find as much beer as you can in the set time limit. There is however walls in your way use your flash light to guide your character around in search for the Beer glass.

games.name: Altar Corp
games.summary: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

games.name: Super Magic Ball! Home Run Derby
games.summary: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

games.name: Tiny Fortress
games.summary: A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

games.name: Fragment Collapse
games.summary: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

games.name: Cube & Seek
games.summary: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

games.name: Midnight Scour
games.summary: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

games.name: Sushi Loop
games.summary: Sushi Loop is a fast-paced cooking game where keeping order over your restaurant's conveyor belt is essential. Plan your Route, direct dishes along the belt, complete orders, and think quick to stay ahead of the clock. Every second matters. One mistake can break the loop.

games.name: Tete
games.summary: A wobbly climbing adventure featuring a clumsy little golem. Can you conquer the hardcore controls and jiggling physics?

games.name: Rooftops and Alleys: The Parkour Game - Trail Pack DLC
Rooftops and Alleys: The Parkour Game - Ninja Pack DLC
Seasonal Lockdown
games.summary: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

games.name: Dear Passengers
games.summary: Play in co-op as the crew of the worlds worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

games.name: Paper Shredder
games.summary: Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath.

games.name: Oblivion 2666
games.summary: A slipstream magical realist visual novella about an outsider, a borrowed camera, and a city that no longer matches its own photographs—told through literary prose and ever-shifting, textured cinematic presentation.

games.name: Memento*Fragment
games.summary:
Memento*Fragment is a visual novel in which [You], the protagonist, recover your memories by viewing memory fragments.
The first contains the past of a girl, traveling alone through a world on the brink of destruction.
Continue watching to learn about her past, your relationship with her, and rediscover your identity.
Don't look away, no matter how tragic the answer may be.

games.name: Guildrun
games.summary: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.

games.name: Ultimate Chaos Gambling Battle
games.summary: Poker, mahjong, hanafuda, blackjack… Welcome to the ultimate “ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE” where every form of gambling has been thrown into a chaotic melting pot! Don’t just understand the rules—master the chaos, bet your entire fortune (ALL-IN), and seize victory!
developers: キザミレモントースト

games.name: Grilluminati
games.summary: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

games.name: Ramen://Protocol
games.summary:
Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder.

Players aim to complete 10 days of business operations while upgrading their skills and toppings.

games.name: SchoolBoy OutDoors
games.summary: You’re a schoolboy who ran away from home to hang out — but this is only the beginning! Summer, friends, backyard mischief… and mysteries hiding something much darker. Explore the streets, avoid adults, and uncover a secret you were better off not knowing.

games.name: Withering State
games.summary: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

games.name: Oomi's Nook
games.summary: Oomi’s Nook is a relaxing and heartwarming sticker decor game. Decorate a cozy little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

games.name: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
games.summary: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

games.name: Here Again
games.summary: You wake up in a silent underground facility with one simple instruction: REMEMBER THE BUTTON. Weird dreams and changing surroundings haunt this place. Explore, observe, and unveil the mystery that envelopes this place in this Retro Psychological Horror Game.

games.name: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager
games.summary: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and use your deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A unique hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

games.name: Unfated
games.summary: An immersive post-apocalyptic MMO. Survive, resist and conquer in a world ravaged by ancient invaders. Form alliances, traverse diverse terrains, and reclaim humanity's destiny with Unreal Engine 5's breathtaking graphics and Chat GPT 4 natural language.

games.name: Dark Earth
games.summary: Dark Earth is an atmospheric real-time action-adventure set in a dying, sunless world where your choices shape the future of humanity. Explore Sparta, one of the last cities of light, as you unravel a murder plot and fight to survive before darkness consumes you.

games.name: Dieathlon
games.summary: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

games.name: The Minesweeper's Tale
games.summary: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: DLC 4
Chess of the Hidden Gates
games.summary: Chess of the Hidden Gates fuses roguelike deckbuilding with the footwork of Chinese chess—every card in your hand is a move, and every move decides who gets taken. The world is a board; everything is a piece. Outmaneuver ancient spirits square by square: victory takes more than raw power—it takes position. The battle of Zhuolu never ended; its endgame lies locked behind the Eight Gates, and you are the last player to enter.

games.name: Bowl Big
games.summary: Bowl Big is an incremental bowling game where one pin becomes hundreds. Every throw brings you closer to the next upgrade. Optimize pin placement. Power up balls. Do you have what it takes to bowl big?

games.name: Idle Pixel Battle
games.summary: Idle Pixel Battle is a fantasy idle auto battler focused on loot, upgrades, and constant progression. Build a team of heroes and watch them fight automatically through waves of monsters.

games.name: Tower of Insolence
games.summary: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

games.name: Reels of the Damned
games.summary: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

games.name: Whiplash
games.summary: Whiplash is a 2003 platform video game for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox. The game follows the adventures of Spanx, a long-tailed weasel, and Redmond, a rabbit, who find themselves chained together inside the warehouse of Genron, a product testing corporation run by the animal-hating CEO Franklin D.
