Mann. The game is a 3D platformer, with Spanx being controlled by the player for the majority of the game, and Redmond used more in combat or as a means of traversing the world. The game was featured on the cover of PSE2. There was also some controversy over the game's depiction of animal cruelty.

games.name: Drive to The Top
games.summary: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

games.name: Separator
games.summary: Separator is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

games.name: Slots & Slaughter
games.summary: Spin slots, win gold, buy and upgrade items, then battle bizarre enemies as you build an overpowered item deck in this casual yet tactical roguelike deck-builder.

games.name: Riftfall
games.summary: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 5 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 60+ enemy types, unique boss arenas, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys, secrets and an epic soundtrack.

games.name: Condominium: No Exit
games.summary: As always, another ordinary day riding the train home. Yet what awaits beyond the door is a world of chaos, far removed from common sense. Your phone suddenly begins ringing like mad...

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Konbini
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. Completing shelves unlocks new skills and abilities that you can use to help you stack over 5000 unique items as quickly as possible!

games.name: Unchest
games.summary: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

games.name: Layang Atma
games.summary: An isometric psychological survival horror where memories become reality. Fight terrifying manifestations, solve symbolic puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden within a fractured mind.

games.name: Curse of the Abandoned Floor
games.summary: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

games.name: Quiet
games.summary:
Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting the homeowner.

Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

games.name: Seaworks: Trap Season
games.summary: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

games.name: Oasis of Lilies
games.summary: Julie's Oasis is a haven for gentlewomen looking for relaxation and discreet pleasures. Ayame enters the club, unsure what to expect, only to meet strangely familiar women one after another. Oasis of Lilies is a light-hearted visual novel about a girl who dreams of having a harem of her own.

games.name: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
games.summary:
The Attic is an adventure in which you'll have to solve riddles, puzzles, and repair objects from the ‘80s and ‘90s to unveil the secret your brother and his mysterious friend, Destiny, were hiding.

Hideouts, secret spots, locked chests, mysterious videogame cartridges… A cozy adventure with hints of mystery inspired by escape rooms and the classic point-and-click adventure games.

games.name: Internet Cafe 98
games.summary: Grow a small 1998 internet cafe from a single outdated PC into a packed business. Serve customers, upgrade your computers and network, and research new technology in this retro incremental tycoon game.

games.name: Boss Slayers
games.summary: No game to play with a friend? Now you're a team of boss hunters. Challenge the most dangerous monsters! Dodge rains of projectiles, seize the right moment to attack and discover the weaknesses of cunning bosses.

games.name: The Tower Must Fall
games.summary: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

games.name: Marble Souls
games.summary: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

games.name: Red Echoes: Berlin
games.summary: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

games.name: Monolith: Dark Matter
games.summary: A round-based FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living black matter. Fight escalating waves of its marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and uncover the route to a final encounter.

games.name: Void Inc
games.summary: You are the Head of Tech at Void Inc., a rapidly growing SaaS startup where every decision creates another problem. Plan your day, survive frantic technical minigames, manage unstable staff and infrastructure, and try to reach the company's targets before stress consumes you.

games.name: Summer Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
games.summary: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!
aliases: Summer☆Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
女子田径部☆春心萌动的夏日集训

games.name: MadHouse for Toys
games.summary: Madhouse for Toys is a top-down horror game where an AI-powered plush rabbit tries to escape from a toy asylum. Solve puzzles, hide, or fight against insane toys. The unique 3D horror style and the unusual world make the game unlike anything else.

games.name: Isolated Island: After the Flood
games.summary: Survive in a world drowned by disaster. Explore by day, hide by night, fight zombies, scavenge resources, build your shelter, and trade with other factions. Your survival, your strategy.

games.name: Delivery Survivors
games.summary: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

games.name: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

games.name: Izakaya Izakoza
games.summary: “Izakaya Izakoza” is a deckbuilding roguelike that combines card battles with grid-based strategy. Fully animated, lively characters jump through the battlefield! Live a day that begins with a conversation, flows through food, and ends with a climactic fight.

games.name: Tile Tale
games.summary: Push colorful tiles into the grid creating fields of the same type to gain new tile types. Create different worlds such as jungle islands, wasteland volcano land or even a big city!

games.name: God of Stocks
games.summary: An incremental management game about manipulating the market to get filthy rich. Buy low, sell high, chain absurd combos and earn divine blessings from stock market gods. Will you play it safe or risk everything?

games.name: Overbooked
games.summary: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

games.name: Blindside
games.summary: Blindside is a Swedish rock band from the southern suburbs of Stockholm. They formed in Stockholm in 1994 as Underfree. In 1996, they changed their name to Blindside and released the Blindside album in 1997 through Swedish independent record company Day-Glo Records. Another album, A Thought Crushed My Mind, came out in 2000. The group received greater attention in 2001 when they toured with P.O.D., resulting in a contract with Elektra. In 2002 they released the album Silence and in 2003 they toured in support of Hoobastank. A 2004 headlining tour suffered equipment theft but then Blindside released About a Burning Fire.

games.name: Chief Bubble Officer
games.summary: Chief Bubble Officer is a turn-based number strategy game about dressing up financial reports. Draw number cards and place them into different reports, combine numbers, raise scores, find the best moves under ever-changing rules, and trigger chain bonuses.

games.name: Last Ride
games.summary: A Train Ride to ... where exactly? A short atmospheric Horror Game about an unusual Train Ride where you need to find your way through a Train to see what lies behind.

games.name: Steal & Sell Simulator
games.summary: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

games.name: Misplaced
games.summary: Misplaced is an archive-sorting and one-stroke deduction game. Draw files from a shuffled archive, sort them into folder nodes on the board, then match each file to its sub-node. When every file is correctly archived, solve the one-stroke puzzle to link the clues and restore the truth.

games.name: Sign It
games.summary: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

games.name: Factor Zoo
games.summary: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

games.name: True Nightmare: Diner Loop
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

games.name: Half Grip
games.summary: Get hooked on this brutal one-armed rogue-like combat racing game where every action is a gamble. Steer, shoot and reload - each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail.

games.name: Split Second Volley
games.summary: Turn based anime-style sports battles! Create outrageous combos and last minute saves using teamwork and unique skills. You can even use guns! Outsmart your foes, choreograph larger than life moments, and win PvP battles with STYLE!

games.name: Covr
games.summary: COVR is a tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, high-stakes solo and co-operative gameplay, unforgiving realism, and intense close-quarters combat.

games.name: Drifters: Blackout Crew
games.summary: Raid ancient alien temples in a PvE co-op extraction shooter built for tactile VR gunplay. Steal energy for your dying mothership, scavenge rare resources, survive the temple’s defense systems, and decide how deep your crew can push before extraction turns desperate.

games.name: Thieves Guild Master
games.summary: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

games.name: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
games.summary: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

games.name: Idle of the Dead
games.summary: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

games.name: Shell as Hard as Steel
games.summary: A horror game about an elevator repair technician who, as he ascends, discovers what became of those who never made it back down.

games.name: Worm Capitalist
games.summary: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

games.name: Paddle Momentum
games.summary: A 1v1 arcade game where you rally the ball back and forth while building momentum. Earn points, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger over time. Between matches, care for and play with your mole—the better you treat it, the more it will help you during matches.

games.name: The Last Lunch
games.summary: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

games.name: They’ll Hang You for That Face
games.summary: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

games.name: Backrooms: Primal
games.summary: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

games.name: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
games.summary: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

games.name: Sarco
games.summary: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

games.name: Hear My Light
games.summary: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

games.name: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
games.summary: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

games.name: Job Burnout
games.summary: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

games.name: Zaibaly
games.summary: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

games.name: SCP: Darkwater
games.summary: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

games.name: Jeep Horror
games.summary: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

games.name: Icee Keyring Arcade
games.summary: Cool off with some classic gaming! The ICEE Keyring Arcade puts retro arcade action in the palm of your hand. Play as the iconic ICEE Bear, surfing through a frozen world as you collect as many ICEE cups as you can while dodging falling snowflakes and spiky icicles. Move up and down with the directional buttons and press the fire button to launch snowballs and blast obstacles out of your path! Score big by grabbing cups and smashing through the chill. Compact and keyring-ready, it’s the perfect on-the-go game for ICEE lovers, retro fans, and anyone who enjoys cool vibes with their high scores.

games.name: Disaster Crew
games.summary: Disaster Crew is a co-op game about friends taking strange jobs in dangerous places. Explore unpredictable worksites, build what the client asked for, and face weird hazards together.

games.name: Disaster Crew
games.summary: Disaster Crew is a co-op game about friends taking strange jobs in dangerous places. Explore unpredictable worksites, build what the client asked for, and face weird hazards together.

games.name: Legion Hunters
games.summary: Command your squad in a strategy-MMORPG. Unlock over 200 champions and 10 races, upgrade your castle, and gear up to dominate global rankings. Prepare for the war to come!

games.name: Folder Folder Folder
games.summary: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

games.name: Ambience
games.summary: MS Ambience is a cruise ship operated by Ambassador Cruise Line. The vessel was delivered to Princess Cruises in 1991 by the Fincantieri shipyard in Monfalcone, Italy as Regal Princess, sailing on their North American routes. After 2000 she was deployed on the company's Australian routes, then later in the Mediterranean and Baltic seas. In 2007 Regal Princess was transferred to P&O Cruises Australia, underwent major refurbishment, and was renamed Pacific Dawn, operating from Australia to South Pacific destinations. Her renaming coincided with P&O's 75th anniversary in Australia.

games.name: 99 Nights In The Apocalypse
games.summary: Survive 99 nights in the world’s worst apocalypse. Scavenge by day, build a questionable camp, and try to survive the night as escaped asylum patients, deranged staff, and things much worse come looking for you.

games.name: Carnosis
games.summary: Carnosis is a horror dungeon crawler set in a grimdark empire filled with mutated monstrosities and war machines. Sever enemy limbs, steal the flesh of defeated foes, and chain devastating status combos to butcher your way to the emperor.

games.name: Marble Mill
games.summary: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

games.name: Streamer vs. Chat
games.summary: Streamer vs. Chat is a next-level interactive game where a Twitch streamer competes directly against their viewers. By typing chat commands, viewers influence matches in real time, triggering combat actions, mini-games (like Marbles and Quiz), and effects like flashbangs or screen changes. Featuring leaderboards with a points system, it transforms traditional livestreams into an unpredictable, competitive, and chaotic experience.

games.name: Discharge Pending
games.summary:
Discharge Pending is a psychological anomaly horror game set inside an abandoned hospital. Trapped on the upper floors, the player must descend one level at a time while carefully observing the environment for anything that has changed. At the end of each floor, they must decide whether an anomaly is present. A wrong decision sends them back to the top.

Each run features randomized anomalies, locations, variants and audiovisual events, ranging from subtle environmental changes to surreal encounters and active threats. As the descent continues, the hospital becomes increasingly unreliable, forcing the player to question what is real and what should not be there.

games.name: Clinical Memory
games.summary: This is not just a walking simulator. This is a new genre: a memory simulator. Explore Ward 7B, survive distorted cycles, collect fragments of memory, and face a truth that changes everything at the end.

games.name: Abort Sequence
games.summary: Scour your desk, find the right pages and decipher their content to find the defusal codes in this fast-paced puzzle experience! Beat multiple difficulties, optimize your solving strategies and find the right codes among thousands of possible combinations!

games.name: Ramen Haven
games.summary: Turn a humble ramen cart into the shop of your dreams in this cozy cooking and management game. Prepare delicious ramen, delight customers, unlock new recipes, upgrade and decorate your space, and grow your small business into a thriving restaurant.

games.name: Grass Cutter 9000: Director's Cut
games.summary: Grass to cut, guys to meet and things to eat. Get upgrades, increase your currency and explore different locations in this short incremental Video Game.

games.name: Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up
games.summary: In Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy up you will have to organize more than 4000 copies of games from your childhood and put them in the right shelves. Relax with the nostalgic atmosphere and check out what games you can recognize. Pick up, sort, organize. Repeat!

games.name: Leadville
games.summary: Leadville je město v centrální části Colorada, ve Spojených státech amerických. Nachází se v okrese Lake County. Město leží v severní části údolí řeky Arkansas, v nadmořské výšce 3 105 m. Leadville má rozlohu méně než 3 km² a žije zde okolo 2 600 obyvatel. Leadville bylo založeno v roce 1878 jako horní město, bylo jedním z center okolního těžebního průmyslu. V okolí města se těžilo stříbro, v širší oblasti zlato, olovo, zinek, mangan a molybden.

games.name: T-Shirt Kingdom
games.summary: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

games.name: Idle Squares
games.summary: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

games.name: Sanitarium Enhanced
games.summary: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

games.name: Theocracy
games.summary: The prophecy is clear: you have one hundred years to unite the Aztec tribes and prepare for the Spanish invasion. Theocracy is a unique blend of RTS, grand strategy and city building. Develop towns, raise armies, cast spells and conquer provinces - build an empire that can change history.

games.name: Borrowed Sight
games.summary: A mysterious epidemic violently killed millions in hours. Sealed inside a darkened van, your only connection to the silent, altered city is a damaged remote-controlled car. Navigate using coordinates, angles, and camera feeds to uncover the truthwithout drawing the attention of what remains.

games.name: Scawy Game
games.summary: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

games.name: Stay in Your Lane
games.summary: Stay in Your Lane is a single-lane real-time tug-of-war strategy game. Build your economy, unlock units, spells, and upgrades, then summon an army that fights on its own. Outsmart your rival in campaign, skirmish, or online battles.

games.name: Hunter's Journey: Nightmare Hunting - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Hunt the truth behind the Rot and the awakening Blight. Explore a corrupted forest, solve magical puzzles, and uncover ancient lore hidden beneath roots, rituals, and shadows.

games.name: Schedule: Rehab Business
games.summary: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

games.name: Farmbound
games.summary: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

games.name: My Fairy Princess
games.summary: My Fairy Princess is a life sim set in an Eastern fantasy world, featuring multiple endings. You take on the role of a parent, raising your daughter in a fabled realm of spiritual beauty and tranquility. How will you guide your daughter into an uncertain future?

games.name: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
games.summary: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

games.name: Minato
games.summary: Minato (japonsky 港区, Minato-ku) je jednou z 23 (speciálních) čtvrtí města Tokio v Japonsku. V Minatu žije přibližně 260 tisíc obyvatel. Jeho celková rozloha činí 20,34 km². Na území Minata se nachází 49 ambasád. Sídlí zde i mnoho významných společností, např. Animax, Dentsu, Fuji Xerox, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. a Mitsubishi Motors Corporation, Morinaga & Co., Ltd. a Morinaga Milk Industry Co,. Ltd., NEC Corporation, Nippon Television, Sony a Toshiba.

games.name: World of Slime
games.summary: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

games.name: Wurst and Glory
games.summary: Wurst and Glory is a competitive dueling game for noble athletes. Settle royal disputes through SAUSAGE COMBAT. Every duel offers 3 random sausages—pick one new to add to your arsenal. Master floppy meat physics, counter foes, and duel for honor, glory, and sausages.

games.name: TapRacer
games.summary: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

games.name: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
games.summary: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, lovecraftian 2-player co-op exploration and adventure game where one player charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

games.name: Alexus 2040
games.summary: Relive that pure arcade thrill that you haven't experienced... in a long time! Load up on unique power-ups to create deadly combinations, unlock new ships with unique abilities, and defeat numerous bosses along the way.

games.name: Sugar Lies
games.summary: That love tastes like a sweet lie. A young man who hates lies. A girl who lives by them. A short visual novel about a classic summer boy-meets-girl romance.

games.name: What Goes Up
games.summary: A chaotic co-op physics-building game where you stack, balance and jury rig gigantic junk towers to ridiculous heights for collection using the power of grav guns and friendship before the clock runs out

games.name: Merge Day: Office Girls
games.summary: Merge Day: Office Girls is a casual merge puzzle and dating sim game set in a bustling office! Combine various items, complete daily quests, and unlock romantic visual novel stories with charming female colleagues. Build relationships, discover their secrets, and enjoy the daily grind!

games.name: Re:Red
games.summary: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

games.name: IllumaNet
games.summary: Build a living network across the dark. In this strategic incremental game, connect distant stations with pulse bridges, turn every cycle into Data, and manage limited Grid Power as you scan the unknown and expand into strange new biomes.

games.name: First-Person Jigsaw
games.summary: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

games.name: Revertices
games.summary: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

games.name: Bloom Busters
games.summary: Bash & blast mutated creatures, restore infested gardens and defend the once-peaceful Bloomland in this frantic solo or local co-op action arcade game. Gather resources, grow flowers, feed animals, complete garden chores, and master handcrafted levels with adaptive difficulty.

games.name: SinEater
games.summary: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

games.name: Satsubatsu Succubus
games.summary: YOU HAVE BEEN CURSED BY A SUCCUBUS. KILL THE ANGELS. FOR ECSTASY.

games.name: Feastfall
games.summary: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

games.name: The Third Surveillance Bureau
games.summary: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

games.name: Cortesia Rising
games.summary: Cortesia Rising is a space captain simulator that combines tactical ground combat, crew & ship management, and broadside naval combat in a hand-crafted Sci-Fi universe, developed and self-published by an experienced team of industry veterans and artists.

games.name: 5-star Taxi
games.summary: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

games.name: SE3 Protocol: Last Drop
games.summary: CE-III Protocol is a horror puzzle RPG set in an SCP-inspired world. An amnesiac girl wakes in the darknessfrail, timid but not alone nor defenseless. Face deadly entities: observe, evade, exploit or simply eliminate them. Lead her through this surreal nightmare, and uncover the secret behind it.

games.name: Demon Crisis
games.summary: A classic On-Rails Shooter, compatible with every modern USB lightgun with live recoil. Hide in cover to avoid hits and reload, then emerge to shoot your way through a horde of bloodthirsty demons.

games.name: Still Rooms
games.summary: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

games.name: RippleLoop
games.summary: Chain together stone skips in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the best stone skipper.

games.name: Fibbtry
games.summary: A Poolcore atmospheric exploration game. Wander freely, drift in thought, until you're ready to wake and carry this rain back into the real world.

games.name: Palm City
games.summary: A first-person co-op action game set in a sunny open city. Play solo or with friends, explore the streets, plan heists, and escape with the loot. Use vehicles, the environment, and physics to your advantage when even the best-laid plan descends into chaos.

games.name: Myriad
games.summary: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Complete and clear lines with falling blocks or just plain destroy tiles for points until you reach the score. Combo them with new bonuses that you can purchase from the Nebula store to aim for ridiculous heightli

games.name: Eightfold
games.summary:
Eightfold is a poker-based deckbuilding roguelike. Players build hands from a deck of playing cards, with hands scored to defeat Bosses using standard poker rankings (pairs, straights, flushes, and so on). Runs are structured around selectable decks, each of which modifies core rules — altering hand size, discard counts, scoring conditions, or deck composition. The game features 22 decks, drawing on a circus and stage-performer theme (including Juggler, Sword Swallower, Tumbler, Contortionist, and Mime decks) alongside decks based on illusion and misdirection (Magician, Mentalist, Escape Artist, Cardist).

Additional systems include card enhancements, which apply permanent modifiers to individual cards, and curses, which introduce a drawback in exchange for a offsetting benefit. Progression is run-based, with players building a strategy across a sequence of acts using the cards, enhancements, and curses acquired along the way.

games.name: Verse of Birth
games.summary: Your words rise as allies in this roguelike tactical battler. Collect "Logos" whose form and abilities are shaped by the words you type, craft a build that's yours alone, and fight your way through the dungeon in turn-based auto battles!

games.name: Nyancrement
games.summary: Nyancrement is an incremental game about a cat that has wandered into a mysterious world. Collect coins with cat punches, strengthen relics, and steadily increase the value of each punch while working toward the 10 billion coins needed to return home.

games.name: Highways & Co.
games.summary: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

games.name: Island Raiders
games.summary: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

games.name: Mamma Mia
games.summary: Play in co-op as the staff of Italy’s worst restaurant. Your kitchen is falling apart, customers’ safety barely makes the list, and weird things happen in the back alley.

games.name: Escape From Argos 7
games.summary: A retro computer incremental game about escaping a hostile alien planet. Explore an old desktop, gather resources, install programs, unlock upgrades, automate your progress, and find a way off Argos 7.

games.name: Void Keeper
games.summary: A scientist locked a dangerous discovery inside her own mind. Dive in, break through her defenses and recover the memory.

games.name: Needle In a Haystack
games.summary: They say finding a needle in a haystack is impossible. Time to prove them wrong. Clear millions of pieces of hay from an old barn, upgrade your tools, sell what you collect, and search every last pile until that tiny needle finally shows itself.

games.name: Blue Bite
games.summary: Your "fingertips" will save the world! "BLUE BITE" is a fully voiced 3D romance action adventure set in a world inhabited only by women. Six heroines are threatened by the mysterious disease "bluebite", and the only cure is... your "massage"! Explore the 3D world and save the girls!

games.name: BrickOps
games.summary: Play. Build. Customize. BrickOps is a colourful multiplayer arena shooter. Battle over objectives, create your own maps and make your character your own with outfits, accessories and loadouts. Build cover, bring the flag home or light up the sky in Defuse.

games.name: Meowmunitions Survivor
games.summary: Meowmunitions Survivor is a bullet-heaven arena shooter with the unique augmenting system incorporated from Meowmunitions.

games.name: Tandem Together
games.summary: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

games.name: Ame Nochi Hare Onna
games.summary: Co-developed by Game Freak and CHRONOGATE, Ame Nochi Hare Onna is set in modern-day Japan, depicting magical girls called Hare Onna (“Sunshine Girls”) who transform weather into magic to lift people’s spirits. Together with their cute cloud-themed partners Kumorin, their mission is to bring clear skies and brighten up Japan.

games.name: Dice Knight
games.summary: Craft a unique set of dice, encounter monsters, and discover items of great power in Dice Knight!

games.name: TidyUp 2000
games.summary: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

games.name: Unclouded
games.summary: Unclouded builds upon the simplicity of a minesweeper with some basic resource-management mechanics to create an engaging, replayable, singleplayer experience that feels both fresh and familiar.

games.name: Indoors: Trespasser
games.summary: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

games.name: Dylio's Adventures
games.summary: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio's shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

games.name: Tales from the Watchtower: The Conjurer
aliases: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer
games.summary: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

games.name: Bombernaut 67
games.summary: Bombernaut 67 is a physics demolition game with chaotic and satisfying destruction.Select your explosives, aim carefully, and blow apart everything standing between you and the objective.

games.name: Deck Beasts
games.summary: Build a squad of pixel-art beasts and battle your way through the warp in this deck-building auto-battler roguelike. Draft beasts, equip abilities and items, collect relics, and destroy other players with broken builds.

games.name: Denpa Virus
games.summary:
You meet four girls infected with the "Denpa virus."

What is happening inside our brains? A towering radio tower... thoughts becoming interconnected... They search for a cure...

games.name: Dimension Contortion Lover!!
games.summary: 由CRYSTALiA开发的最新力作，一款近未来风格的战斗恋爱视觉小说。 你将扮演魔术师后代的男主人公“崩月槐”潜入“学园”，探寻真相。

games.name: The Hollowing
games.summary: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

games.name: Tunnelborn
games.summary: Dig for fossils under a volcano, one tile at a time. Nothing moves until you do — but then the lava creeps closer, your lamp burns lower, and something in the dark takes another step towards you…

games.name: Mosaic of Life
games.summary: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

games.name: Totally Safe Railway Co
games.summary: Run a railroad company with your friends in the Wild West! Operate a physics-driven steam train. Transport goods and passengers, fight off outlaws, explore the frontier and use your lasso on practically anything.

games.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator
games.summary: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.

games.name: 80's Disco Brawl
games.summary: 80's Disco Brawl is a rhythm-based beat ’em up that throws you into the spotlight of the wildest dance floor in history, where every fight is a rhythm, every hit a beat, and every move a performance. Step into a world where combat and music collide, and your timing becomes your greatest weapon.

games.name: Noema
games.summary: Take your place at the terminal. Follow the procedures, process the records, and read messages never meant for you. Noema is a quiet, unsettling narrative experience about work, obedience, human connection, and what routine teaches us not to see.

games.name: The Park Keeper
games.summary: Manage a national park where something is clearly trying to get out. Screen visitors, cover up incidents, and keep everyone convinced that everything is under control.

games.name: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread
games.summary: Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies in this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games.

games.name: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
games.summary: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge is an idle crafting game in which Brokk, a pixel-art dwarf blacksmith, runs a small forge in a strip just above the Windows taskbar. Every key press or mouse click anywhere on the PC counts as one swing of his hammer, turning ore into ingots and ingots into finished items. His wife Brygida sells the pieces in the shop, and the gold pays for ore, new patterns and upgrades that unlock better metals, from copper up to mithril. Items come in 49 patterns and five rarities. Regular play needs no clicking, and the game counts inputs without recording what is typed. It runs offline.

games.name: Topple
games.summary:
Topple is a free asymmetric action brawler for web browsers. One player controls a giant ape called a colossus, using motion controls in virtual reality or a keyboard and mouse, while up to four Fighters join from desktop or mobile browsers. Fighters choose from four classes and combine melee attacks and movement abilities to reach the colossus's vulnerable nape. The colossus can grab and throw Fighters, destroy buildings, and win by defeating the squad or toppling all four shrines.

The game features destructible and rebuildable environments, private online matches, ranked play, and solo survival with AI teammates. Both sides progress through character levels, talent trees, and equipment, across ink-and-paper arenas.

games.name: Bet Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

games.name: Exit Liquidity
aliases: Exit Liquidity: Wall Street Trading Sim
games.summary: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

games.name: Kito: Lost Trail
games.summary: Kito: Lost Trail is a cozy 3D platforming adventure where you play as Kito, a young leopard searching for his missing mother. Explore wild environments, overcome platforming challenges, discover hidden collectibles, and grow your abilities along the way.

games.name: Daily Life with the Herb Girl
games.summary: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

games.name: Pla-toon 2
games.summary: A chaotic, stylized, light-hearted, whimsical, cartoon party-style shooter.

games.name: Be the Block
games.summary: Be the Block is a Sokoban-inspired 2D puzzle game where you dont just push the blocks, you ARE the blocks. Solve a collection of carefully hand-crafted puzzles that are by design simple yet challenging.

games.name: Corpse Burger
games.summary: Grind humans into tofu burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

games.name: Castle Crew
games.summary: In a vast magical castle, everything has ended up out of place! Sort books, scrolls, runes, and potions, find where each item belongs, and watch as room after room transforms from total chaos into a satisfyingly organized space - on your own or with friends.

games.name: The Royal Restoration Society
games.summary: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

games.name: Fallbearers
games.summary: Fallbearers is a co-op dark-humor simulation where you and a colleague transport the deceased, grappling with volatile ragdoll physics, changing terrain, and pesky obstacles in the Victorian streets. Please ensure the client arrives in one piece (we certainly won't).

games.name: Stockroom Syndrome
games.summary: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

games.name: United Online
games.summary: United Online is a free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG where thousands of players share one persistent world. Choose your race and class, level up, master professions like fishing, mining and crafting, join a clan to conquer fortresses, and fight in duels, tournaments, Battle Rooms and Capture the Flag. Explore cities full of living NPCs with their own stories, take on quests and dungeon bosses, and play on PC, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS or straight from your browser.

games.name: Jailbreak
games.summary: An asymmetric PvP prison escape game for up to 8 players, where prisoners loot, craft, and scheme their way to freedom while the guard tries to shut the whole mess down. Work together, make bad decisions, and do whatever it takes to break out.

games.name: All Rats on Deck
games.summary: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

games.name: The Wokest
games.summary: You just want a job. Instead, you're trapped in an endless office. Solve puzzles, follow the rules, and reach the 10th floor. Don't anger the anomalies. If one snaps, run.

games.name: Keep Farming Aura
games.summary: Keep Farming Aura is an active 3D incremental game about turning attention into power. Perform stylish moves to farm Aura, attract a crowd, build your crew, and buy upgrades. Unlock permanent progression, customize your character, and face rivals in Aura battles. Optional Twitch integration brings viewers into the scene, with their names and chat messages appearing in-game.

games.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
games.summary: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

games.name: CodePhantom
games.summary: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Experience the thrill of controlling a powerful mech with smooth, responsive gameplay. Enjoy intense, no-nonsense mech action designed for fans of authentic robotic combat.

games.name: VCR83
games.summary:
VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

Spot anomalies, survive your shift, and earn Tokens to unlock new levels and push deeper into the story. Reporting is simple: see something wrong, click it. Just make sure you're right.

Meet Pete, your small virtual assistant. At first, he's just there to help. As you progress, Pete reacts to the outcomes of your shifts, talks to you, answers your questions, sings, plays around with you, and becomes increasingly interested in what you're doing.

Maybe a little too interested.

games.name: Jo & Rubi: A Cozy Expedition
games.summary: Join Jo and Rubi on a cozy archaeology expedition. Sort artefacts, clean up the garden, pull trash from the ocean, and explore a dig site. 19 relaxing mini-games across 3 chapters.

games.name: Interregnum
games.summary: Build your deck and outwit your opponents in a love letter to classic deckbuilders like Dominion. Outflank your opponents in a deep, strategic game where superior tactics reign supreme. Defeat a cadre of unique AIs in campaign mode or play online and outwit your friends!

games.name: Elandrake
games.summary: Elandrake is an incremental, twin-stick shooter game where you protect a cosmic entity as it emerges from another reality. Consume matter to gain abilities and use them to blast fleets back to where they came from!

games.name: Shole Soccer
games.summary: Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

games.name: Routes and Forges
games.summary: A resource manager/RTS set in a medieval world with a voxel-art (Minecraft-like) visual style. It allows players to build villages, establish logistics routes, and create production chains.

games.name: Super Terrestrial
games.summary: A roguelite autoscroller, where you control a spaceship navigating procedurally generated levels. Use limited aerial jumps and hover abilities to dodge hazards, collect gems, and explore alternate biomes. Each run features upgrades, power-ups, dynamic enemies, and challenging bosses.

games.name: Aphasia
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back? Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are. As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

games.name: Onward! Autobattles
games.summary: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

games.name: Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands
games.summary: Pharaoh Lands is a DLC for the side-scrolling micro strategy game, Kingdom Two Crowns. Adventure within the Valley of Kings and discover the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting as you uncover the source of the chaos throughout the land.

games.name: Something Is Wrong With the Library
games.summary: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

games.name: Hell-A
games.summary: An online co-op horror action game. Enter the bureaucratic Hell and prove your worth through the Seven Deadly Sins. Master physics, combine magic, and face the trials together or turn on your friends. Maybe they hold you back?

games.name: What Killed Rachel
games.summary: A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy. Blaming someone is easy. But answering what truly killed her is not.

games.name: Refuel Together
games.summary: Run a gas station with 1 to 6 player as Co-Op in Refuel Together. Build a large gas station from a single gas pump. Upgrade and expand your gas station as more cars arrive. Become popular as you meet your customers' demands.

games.name: Lone Lines: RPG
games.summary: Roguelite RPG set between a shifting desert and the flipside of a grim dark future. Explore the world in the body of the Pilot, command a living, katana-wielding Rover, and forge your own path through a non-linear story. Fight, level up, and make choices where absolutely everything is on the line.

games.name: Dead Hand
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are both your actions and your resources. Play them to act now, keep them to last longer. There is never enough for both.

games.name: Psycorp
games.summary: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

games.name: I Just Wanted to Fish
games.summary: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

games.name: Chiki Poki: Rush
games.summary: The world's cutest extermination job. A fast, hands-on incremental shooter.Hunt down the Cheepy — cuddly critters that mimic anything — and gather 5 kinds of star candy to keep your ultimates chaining, endlessly.Grow stronger every run with what you collect. Until the Cheepy King falls!

games.name: Inner Eko
games.summary: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

games.name: Pages of Tomorrow
games.summary:
Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

Take on the role of Alex, a teenager struggling with mental health, as she finds herself in the middle of a supernatural mystery. There are secrets to uncover in this ward, but putting the pieces together will not be easy. Forge your own destiny in this tale of recovery and finding happiness—is it true that fate cannot be changed?

games.name: Wizards Never Lie
games.summary:
Wizards Never Lie is a four-player online social deduction game set in a members-only club for wizards that stands in the space between worlds. Four players take seats at one table in first-person 3D, where nothing anyone claims can be verified — the round settles it a few seconds later, in front of everybody.

The house keeps four games: Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison. All four share one set of actions — Ask, Declare, Check — so the rules carry from one game to the next, and a single evening may only get through two of them. Any claim can be challenged with a Check at any moment, but each player holds only a few: catching a liar pays, and accusing an honest one costs.

Every claim a player makes goes on a public record, the Truth/Lie Trend. A long run of lies builds a streak and a readable pattern; a long run of honesty makes the first lie harder to see coming.

The table talks on three channels. Each player’s live webcam sits above their seat — optional, off until the player turns it on, and never scored; it changes what the table believes and nothing else. Voice chat is available and not required. A wand draws glowing glyphs in the air for accusations, warnings and jokes, so no shared language is needed at the table, and the game ships in 14 languages. Free Table mode removes scoring entirely, for players who want to sit, talk and take in the club.

games.name: Sapphobos
games.summary: Sapphobos is a mystery and horror VR game. Explore, find clues, make deductions, choose the right conclusions, and maybe you will understand what happened to your missing colleague...

games.name: Unburied
games.summary: Unburied is a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades and towers by day, then hold your keep by night as the dead pour in. Turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, shape your build, and survive until dawn turns them to ash.

games.name: Muritura
games.summary: A mouse wakes in a tiny community after a terrible storm brings more than just weather with it. Fight or flee monsters, mouse around puzzles, engage with locals, and uncover the source of the unnatural storm in this old-school, adventure game.

games.name: Doomsday Train
games.summary: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.

games.name: Fork the Rich
games.summary: Billionaires should not exist. It's time to Fork the Rich!

games.name: Alchemy Duel
games.summary: Alchemy Duel is a card game that combines elements of alchemy and roguelike gameplay. Alchemize monsters suited to the situation and unleash powerful combos by making use of synergies between your cards!

games.name: Anvilia
games.summary: Run a medieval blacksmith shop in co-op. Gather resources, forge tools, stock your shelves, and grow a thriving business.

games.name: Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense
games.summary:
A small scale real-time strategy/base defense game with roguelite elements

Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

games.name: Simmer Down
games.summary: A cozy co-op cooking game for up to four. Chop, cook and plate real recipes, serve tables that eat together and furnish your own restaurant, then follow a family of caterers through forty years of other people's big days, always from the kitchen.

games.name: Arcanum Solitarius
games.summary: Poker solitaire with an arcane twist. Each row and column of the 5x5 grid is a poker hand, scoring as it fills. Repeat a hand and it's worth half. Purify the cursed Arcana, corrupted tarot cards that penalize your play. Draft Jokers for unique powers and power up your deck and board for bonus chips.

games.name: Backrooms: Steal the Furniture
games.summary: A 1-4 player co-op horror comedy. Noclip into the Backrooms, steal the furniture, sell it upstairs and make rent before the smiling thing finds you. Then blow the rent at the company casino. Some nights the elevator opens somewhere else. Every death is on tape.

games.name: Dig! Dig! Dig!
games.summary: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

games.name: Find Bunny: A Little Hidden Journey
games.summary: Find Bunny is a cozy hidden-object game where you peel stickers to find and collect hidden pictures. Join Coco and Matcha on a journey to uncover the secret of the misbehaving crops. Cross the sea, ride the train, fill your album with stickers, and help new friends bring peace back to the farm!

games.name: Divided Empire: Sengoku
games.summary: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

games.name: Calibration Sequence
games.summary: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

games.name: Aegis Vanguard
games.summary: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

games.name: Expedition of the Guild
games.summary: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

games.name: Liminal Angel
games.summary: Demons have possessed the wildlife, turning animals against humanity. As an angel in human form, you must prepare for a perilous journey. Meet the survivors without revealing your true identity, gather your gear, and evade demon-possessed beasts before dawn breaks.

games.name: Scale a Building
games.summary: A game about scaling a building

games.name: Dancing Zombie
games.summary: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, dance!

games.name: Pray & Slay
games.summary: Pray & Slay is a short-form action incremental where you wield holy light, tear through fast-paced runs, and unlock increasingly powerful—and increasingly unholy—ways to destroy everything in your path.

games.name: Little Witch’s Lodge a Cozy Magical Cleanup Game
games.summary: A young witch has accidentally cast the wrong spell and turned her cozy lodge into complete chaos. Books, potions, bottles, and magical objects are scattered everywhere. Your task is simple: explore the lodge, collect every item, and return it to the correct place.

games.name: Magically Sorted
games.summary: Tidy up a magical shop by sorting scattered potions, ingredients, and books back onto their shelves, uncovering curious lore behind them as you go. Brew potions in the cauldron to unlock magical skills and find lost recipes for legendary potions, while enjoying the shop's relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
games.summary: Tower Defense meets 3v3 Tower Wars. Build mazes with defensive towers, send assault units, and grow your economy in free-to-play team battles. Draft from twelve factions and coordinate with your team to break the opposing defense.

games.name: Station 12
games.summary: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players. Team up to escape a doomed space station while one of your friends hunts you as the monster. Scream over proximity chat, rescue your crew, and turn a desperate escape into a hilarious disaster.

games.name: Cozy Shores
games.summary: You find yourself stranded on an abandoned island with your beloved cat. Clean the island, recycle all the trash, build a bond with your pet and create a cozy paradise.

games.name: Shore
games.summary: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

games.name: Polish Pierogi Simulator
games.summary: Run your own pierogi restaurant! Prepare delicious Polish dumplings step by step, serve hungry customers, upgrade your kitchen and master the art of keeping everyone fed, happy and coming back for more.

games.name: Pawn Shift
games.summary: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

games.name: Wakesurfer: Get Gnarly!
games.summary: A free wakesurfing game you play in your browser, on your phone or computer. Ride behind real wake boats, toss the rope and surf the wave: airs, spins, flips and wake-to-wake transfers across 17 levels, from a glassy local lake and a wave park to river waves, races and a Mega Yacht's giant wave. Made by a Wisconsin wakesurfer.

games.name: Evidentia
games.summary: Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game for friends. Each deck is a unique case. Analyze evidence, take risks, question everything — and find out if you can solve it before the final reveal.

games.name: Speed Card Eatery
games.summary: Hurry!Hurry!I'm going to become a legendary card-stall master—right this second!

games.name: Address The Mess
games.summary: Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit doggo, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.

games.name: 9Clock OverPack
games.summary: You have until nine. Ransack the room, decide what actually matters, and cram it into a suitcase that is always one slot too small. Everything you leave behind comes back - as a story about how your trip went.

games.name: Golden Trivia Show
games.summary: Golden Trivia Show is a quiz game presented as a TV show that can be played solo or cooperatively with friends online (up to 4 players). You start with a pile of gold bars and need to avoid losing them. Each question has 4 possible answers, and you can choose to divide your gold bars among them. Only the gold bars placed on the correct answer will remain with you; the rest will fall into a pool filled with piranhas. If you manage to make it to the end and win some gold, you can spend it on cosmetics.

games.name: Feet in Food
games.summary: What could possibly be better than food? That's right! Feet in food! LOTS OF FEET! Create food arrangements around the girls, then wash their feet clean of all the food and sauces afterward. You wouldn't want them to stay dirty, would you?

games.name: NOT Home Free
games.summary: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

games.name: 72 Seconds
games.summary: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

games.name: Hyakume no Hananie
games.summary:
A Horror Otome Game Set in a Village of Otherworldly Rituals.

Tokyo, 202X. On the day of your twentieth birthday, a single letter arrives. You don't recognize the sender's name, but the return address bears the name of a village that was supposed to have vanished...

games.name: Drainbound
games.summary: You are Drainbound, it is your time. A roguelike adventure where you must fight, suffer and sever to discover your true destination.

games.name: iWin Daily Challenge
games.summary: Play a suite of daily puzzle games to earn rolls on the game board and unlock badges.

games.name: Afterwork Apocalypse
games.summary: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

games.name: Agency
games.summary: Play as π (Pi) in a weird game that makes you figure out the rules of eight very distinct challenges. Discover the meaning of the game and email us your thoughts on it.

games.name: Mowed Down
games.summary: Mowed Down is a multiplayer prop hunt in which the hunters drive ride-on lawnmowers and everyone else disguises themselves as props, from hay bales and wheelie bins to a piano or a giant toilet. Hiders score points only while a mower can see them, and caught players come back as a mower or a ghost. Lobbies hold up to 40 players across nine arenas, with a walk-around garden lobby, solo play against AI hiders, and a Map Maker with Steam Workshop sharing. A free demo with the Backyard arena and online lobbies of up to 6 releases on 29 October 2026.

games.name: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
games.summary: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!

games.name: Outliers: Incrementum
games.summary: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

games.name: Puzzle Simulator
games.summary: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

games.name: Deslot
games.summary: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

games.name: Click Flip
games.summary:
Click Flip is a short incremental game about flipping tiles and setting off ridiculous chain reactions.

Flip tiles to earn points, spend them on an upgrade grid, and build toward the moment one click lights up the whole board. Every tile from 1 to 10 has its own ability, enemy tiles fight back, and the jackpot system rewards you for pushing your luck.

games.name: Tutsak
games.summary: Tutsak is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You and your friends search abandoned places for keys and try to escape before the creature catches you. Whoever gets caught is locked in a cell until the others break them out. Every creature hunts in its own way, players can betray each other in many ways, and skinwalkers imitate the players. Features proximity voice chat.

games.name: Magical Magic World 2
games.summary: All the main characters are VTubers!! A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪ One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

games.name: Anomagram
games.summary: Anomagram is a psychological horror game set on a night shift moderating a short-video feed. Playing on a simulated PC desktop and smartphone, the player reviews clips from the everyday lives of a fixed cast of people and decides whether to approve or report each one. Some videos contain anomalies, and over eight nights the anomalies begin to reach beyond the videos into the moderator's terminal.

games.name: Malmort
games.summary: A first-person tower defense set in the Louisiana bayou, 1850. The dead are rising from the black water. Choose one of four heroes, build traps and turrets on stilted walkways, and fight the horde yourself to protect the last totem holding back the evil. Solo or 2-player co-op.

games.name: Apiary in Flow
games.summary: Apiary in Flow is an incremental game with automation elements where you place bees inside a hive to build efficient honey-gathering chains. Unlock new bee types and spend your harvest on permanent skill tree upgrades!

games.name: Quilt
games.summary: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

games.name: Task Bar Isekai
games.summary: Task Bar Isekai is a single-player idle action role-playing game that runs in a transparent strip above the Windows taskbar. Combat continues automatically while the player uses other desktop applications. Players collect equipment, upgrade it through forging and fusion, recruit three heroes and progress through five acts. Some bosses leave the strip and appear on the desktop, where they can be attacked by clicking. The game also includes offline progression and an endless tower.

games.name: Restock Master
games.summary: Restock Master is a first-person supermarket simulation game focused on organizing products and restocking shelves. Pick up scattered items, arrange products, and transform a messy hypermarket into an organized store through hands-on, physics-based gameplay.

games.name: Bore to the Core
games.summary: You are a crew of naked mole rats. Pilot a massive tunnel bore to the core of the world. Gather, automate, and defend your moving base in this 1-4 player co-op game.

games.name: Horror Mahjong
games.summary: Expect the unexpected. Play mahjong with friends in a haunted tea house. Draw, pong, kong, and win—then get up and watch their backs. Grab supplies, fight, and revive your friends until dawn. Or spend the night with computer tablemates.

games.name: Screw It!
games.summary: Screw It! is a 4–8 player voice party game set inside a chaotic retro TV show. Outbid your friends, call their bluffs, prove your claims on the mic, survive ridiculous penalties, and compete in arcade challenges to become the night's champion.

games.name: The Serena Villa Files
games.summary: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

games.name: Catnip Wars 2: Empires
games.summary: Build a trading empire across a never-ending galaxy of cats. Haggle with Otter ports, outrun Raccoon raiders and fly your own fighter into the wreck-choked Tangles while 13 NPC factions roam in real time. Play solo, with friends, or host your own persistent universe.

games.name: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights
games.summary: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights is a gym-themed organizing game supporting up to 4 players online. Clean up the fitness space and get some exercise along the way. Some heavy dumbbells cannot be lifted right from the start.

games.name: Sort The Plushie Store
games.summary: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

games.name: Radia Island
games.summary: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

games.name: Last Attendance: Hostel 13
games.summary: A first-person horror game set in an Indian boys' hostel. Explore Hostel 13 at night with Hindi and English voices. Chapter 1 is free; Chapter 2 is a one-time Rs 49 unlock, with no ads.

games.name: Isometric House Builder
games.summary: A cozy 2D isometric building game with pixel art style. Follow blueprints to place blocks and construct houses step by step. Balance accuracy and creativity as you complete foundations, walls, and roofs, turning simple plans into charming pixel-art homes.

games.name: Somebody's Home: The Boarding House
games.summary: 1980. Rooms to let on a quiet street, meals included, a landlady who calls her lodgers family. You move into one. And as the days pass, you cannot shake the feeling that something in that house is wrong, and that it has been wrong for a very long time. A first-person psychological horror story.

games.name: Lost Camp
games.summary: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

games.name: Geometry Platforms
games.summary: In a universe of collapsing forms, you are the last vector of resistance. Surviving hordes is half the battle—the ground beneath you is a dynamic, lethal threat! Brace for neon bullet hell, pinpoint physics, synth beats, and endlessly rewarding progression.

games.name: Cozymancer: Wizard Tower Restoration
games.summary: Cozymancer is a chill organizing game where you restore a Wizard Tower. Learn spells, sort artifacts, clean up slime, restore furniture and bring the Tower back to its former glory!

games.name: Seven Days: Strange Locked-Room Life
games.summary: "Seven Days: Strange Locked-Room Life" is a suspenseful escape-room visual novel. You are a reporter trapped with a drug company heiress for seven days. Can you survive the mastermind’s orders, uncover the truth, and escape before you lose your mind?

games.name: Critter Cosmos
games.summary: A cozy 3D adventure where you play as a Capybara Astronaut, hopping from planet to planet, befriending cute animal pals, saving communities, and building a new home together.

games.name: Chroma: Tidy Up The Paint Store!
games.summary: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,096 paint cans by color. Dig them out of a mountain of mixed-up paint, shelve each one in its row and watch the store turn into one giant rainbow.

games.name: Follyvale
games.summary: A wordless hidden-object puzzle game set inside living medieval paintings. Find what the villagers need, carry it across the scene and set their troubles right, and each one you mend brings the picture into full colour. No timers, no way to fail, and the Fool to help or sometimes get in your way.

games.name: The Heroic Tale of Illumina: 0
games.summary:
