games.summary: Plan your kitchen, grill burgers, and keep orders flowing in this fast-paced singleplayer cooking game. Design efficient layouts, prepare and serve orders under pressure, unlock unique playable characters with unique perks, and adapt to demanding customers.

games.name: AsterMaster
games.summary: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Every step, shot and dodge lands on the rhythm as you dig into a dead mining asteroid — stack weapon mods, chase synergies, break bosses, and haul your ore back out alive. Full controller support, Steam Deck friendly.

games.name: Kill the Thing
games.summary: Kill The Thing is a challenging roguelike turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

games.name: Midnight Flare
games.summary: Midnight Flare is a multi episode point-and-click puzzle adventure. In this demo you explore a house in a town drowned in an eerie red glow, rummaging through objects, unlocking mechanisms, and dealing with strange characters. Can you solve the mystery of this strange house?

games.name: Please File Accurately
games.summary: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

games.name: Clean Tides
games.summary: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

games.name: Kristi Sky Islands
games.summary: Kristi Sky Islands is a turn-based strategy game. Lead a group of heroes, face various foes, upgrade and equip your heroes, fuse your items to obtain higher-rarity items, and conquer bosses.

games.name: Count on Chaos
games.summary: Your computer is infected. Help Buddy, a tiny calculator, fight through the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

games.name: Nightbound
games.summary: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

games.name: Drain It All
games.summary: Drain a 10,000-ton dam, starting with a paper cup. Sell water, buy pumps, build a filtering and bottling plant, and find out what is at the bottom of the dam. A first-person incremental game about one extremely bad plan.

games.name: Cascabel
games.summary: Cascabel is an online western role-playing game set in a valley in the Brazilian countryside, played in the PC web browser with no download. Players arrive as travelers and choose their own path: learning trades, fishing, hunting, raising a ranch with crops and livestock, and riding between villages. Goods are sold and traded with other players in the village Market, and duels in the street only start when both players accept.

games.name: Grow a Girlfriend
games.summary: You accidentally grew a mushroom girl! Overcome your social anxiety to help her live her brief life to the fullest! Or… don't ;)

games.name: Wasteland Collector
games.summary: Explore the wasteland, scavenge and mine resources, rescue survivors, and uncover the secrets of your forgotten past. Manage your inventory, upgrade your gear and fight monsters in auto-battler combat.

games.name: Hephaestus Protocol
games.summary: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

games.name: Blood Covenant
games.summary: Blood Covenant is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror job-sim. Players are a hazmat cleaning crew taking night jobs at farmhouses, barns in the woods and an abandoned psychiatric hospital. Each shift they scrub blood, bag remains, seal breaches and repair fences, then return to the van before the entity that has moved in comes for them. Players spot anomalies, read messages written on the walls under UV light, and must identify the entity before lighting the ritual altar; naming the wrong one turns it against the crew. Can be played solo or with up to three friends.

games.name: Stranded in the Abyss
games.summary: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

games.name: Wait, They Can Climb?!
games.summary: In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

games.name: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare
games.summary: A tactical survival and outpost management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

games.name: BrokenLore: Ascend
games.summary: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Dreadshell
games.summary: Dreadshell is a first-person sci-fi horror game, built on quiet tension and paranoia instead of constant jump scares.

games.name: Tails & Talons
games.summary: Tails & Talons is a roguelite deckbuilder where spell-casting cards and card-matching combos intertwine to create a addicting and strategic experience! Join a colorful cast of furry adventurers, unleash powerful spells, and chain devastating combos as you descend down a mysterious tower..

games.name: Midgardr
games.summary: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

games.name: Stellarch
games.summary: Stellarch is a deterministic, provably-fair trading-card game on the Hive blockchain. Draft a seven-card team of Fighters across eight elemental affinities and let a seeded combat engine resolve the battle; every match replays byte-identically from its seed, so any result can be verified. You own your cards on-chain, and a smart deck beats a deep wallet. Fair, not free. The alpha is ongoing at stellarch.io.

games.name: The Hambagu Shop
games.summary: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

games.name: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.
games.summary: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, and the explosive power of chemistry. As a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter, you’ll craft potions for the resistance, engineer devastating bombs, and dismantle tyranny from the shadows.

games.name: Last Man Running
games.summary: Last Man Running is a physics-based parkour party game in which players race across procedurally assembled rooftops while escaping a zombie horde. Players can tackle, grab and throw rivals in free-for-all or team elimination matches, cooperate to survive, or chase high scores solo. It supports local and online multiplayer, including mixed couch and remote players.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

games.name: Flask
games.summary: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.summary:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

games.name: Everfront
games.summary: A roguelike territory-control strategy game where you continuously expand against AI opponents. Master six doctrines, unlock upgrades, and dominate procedurally generated maps.

games.name: Terranigma
games.summary: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.name: Sturmjäger
games.summary:
Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up for everyone who wants to skip the cinematic fluff and dive straight into unadulterated, chaotic, and adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Master ten unique missions, either solo or with a friend in local co-op.

Every single stage features its own distinct visual theme and a custom-tailored soundtrack, taking you from the deepest corners of outer space straight to the bottom of the ocean, merciless boss fights included.

With three different game modes and three difficulty levels, maximum replayability is guaranteed, no matter how fast your reflexes are.

The rules are simple: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't move... shoot it anyway, just to be safe.

Genre veterans are in for a treat: The deep, finely-tuned scoring system rewards aggressive and flawless gameplay. Rack up massive score multipliers with quick kills, kill chains, risky proximity close-quarters attacks, no-death runs, and much more. Perfect your strategy, climb the global online leaderboards, and test your mettle against the best pilots in the world!

games.name: Ananta
games.summary: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Echoes of Agony
games.summary: A dark turn-based roguelite where you are hunted by your own inner demons. Master the dynamic turn economy, collect loot and push your limits. The more you suffer, the greater the rewards. How much are you willing to endure in the pursuit of power?

games.name: Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation
games.summary:
Mandatory orientation at a corporate hellscape. The loop never ends. A psychological horror visual novel where your accumulated choices build a hidden profile and the world around you adjusts accordingly.

Public demo available on Steam. Full release is currently in development.

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of the U.S.A.
Fit Boxing: Touken Ranbu - Shutsujin! Exercise Honmaru
Greenbound
games.summary: Green sahara desert with your friends in online co-op. Get paid for every square meter, buy upgrades, drones and vehicles, and automate the job. No big company wanted this job. Now it’s yours.

games.name: Thornspell
games.summary: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. Thornspell is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

games.name: Cogito: Requiem
games.summary:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

games.name: Third Bloc
games.summary:
Third Bloc is a text-based political strategy game set during the Cold War. The player founds a small, fictional republic in 1945 and steers it through 45 years of superpower pressure, six months at a time, until 1990. The state is run from a single operations terminal: every order is a numbered line, typed or clicked, and every consequence arrives in print, from parliament votes and bank offers to letters at the State Telegraph Office.

Caught between Washington and Moscow, the player can stay a client state, switch patrons, or call a congress and found a third bloc of their own, while climbing the nuclear and space ladders from the first rocket to a crewed landing on Mars. The whole game, including its animated films, is drawn in ASCII characters.

games.name: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
games.summary: This is an action game where you explore ruins buried in the forest with Ethnic BGM. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), goes on a journey around the ISEKIZIMA (Ruins Island of dreams and romance : as it was written in the tourist brochure).

games.name: Portabellows
games.summary: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

games.name: Usual June
games.summary: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

games.name: Rottenroots
games.summary: In this haunting visual novel, you become Salem - torn between forbidden love and regime loyalty. Make split-second decisions that transform his personality in a solarpunk dystopia. With multiple paths and endings, your choices define who Salem becomes in a world where being different is dangerous.

games.name: You've Changed
games.summary: You've Changed is an anomaly horror game in which you unravel a mystery behind the anomalies. Imagine "spot the difference" but scary. The game features 8-bit era inspired art and rotoscoped enemy animations.

games.name: Demra: Rifts of War
games.summary: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics, with a twist of its own. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself. 15-mission campaign, skirmish and online multiplayer.

games.name: Plush Rangers
games.summary: Survive waves of wacky mutated constructs and defeat powerful bosses with your team of Plushie friends in this quirky chaotic Survivors-like. Collect loot! Acquire merit badges! Dodge and dash your way to victory!

games.name: Murder Meet Cute
games.summary: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

games.name: Zombillionaire
games.summary: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

games.name: Crystals of Irm
games.summary: Crystals Of Irm is an old school RPG with a distinctive combat system and dungeon crawl elements. With three heroes you explore Irm, visit the different regions of the land and climb deep down into the darkest dungeons.

games.name: Calx
games.summary: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.name: Lelu
games.summary:
Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

Navigate your way through the toy factory, a labyrinthian tower filled with puzzles and traps set by the factory’s eccentric guardian. Use your wits and agility to overcome challenges, from conveyor belts and electrifying circuits to sentient toys and towering toy titans.
As you delve deeper into the world, uncover hidden abilities to aid you in your quest, alongside a variety of secrets and other toys sharing your desire for freedom.

Will you find your way to the elusive exit, or will you just be another toy on the shelf?

games.name: UvsU: You vs. You
games.summary: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

games.name: Wandering Sword
aliases: 逸剑风云决 (中日英韩文版) - A Tale of a Young Swordsman
games.summary:
The hit pixel-art RPG set in the world of Chinese martial arts is finally coming to PlayStation!
Play as a young swordsman gravely injured after being caught in a violent conflict.
Having narrowly escaped death, you set out on a journey to master the martial arts and fulfill your destiny as a true hero in a vast wuxia world.
Includes Original DLC
All DLC released on other platforms is included:
“Immortal Trails Across the Blue Sea”
“Mount Pack: The Supreme Steed”

games.name: Arizona Sunshine
games.summary: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

games.name: Dead Reckoner
games.summary: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

games.name: Alien Archeologist
games.summary: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

games.name: Smashteroids
games.summary: A twin-stick Asteroids roguelite where you stack 190+ absurd upgrades until one fragile ship fills the whole screen with firepower. 22 ships with unique kits, 22 handcrafted bosses, mini-boss packs that crash your stage, 100+ colour palettes, and a branching campaign toward a dying star.

games.name: Tide of the Depths
games.summary: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6: Expansion 1
games.summary: Release date shown is placeholder and will be updated. Expand your Forza Horizon 6 adventures with this expansive add-on introducing a new location to discover, exciting new vehicles to collect and drive, and fun new gameplay to engage with.

games.name: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
games.summary: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools is a first-person anomaly-spotting horror game set in a looping complex of liminal poolrooms. Players study tiled corridors, pools and flooded chambers, turning back when something has changed and continuing when everything looks normal. In the Survival Stage, players photograph multiple anomalies before time runs out.

games.name: Demon Slayer Rome
games.summary: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

games.name: Prison of Husks
games.summary: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

games.name: Fallgrade
games.summary: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.summary: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

games.name: Fate/Extra Record
games.summary:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew…

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

games.name: Mirth Island
games.summary: You're about to embark on an epic adventure with a young duck who's tired of feeling sad all the time. He's packed his bags, set sail on a rickety boat, and is headed straight for Mirth Island - a place where happiness is said to grow wild like daisies!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
games.summary: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

games.name: Cleaner Company
games.summary: You have officially joined the elite team of "Star Wipers"! Your mission? Cleaning! Alongside your trusted crew, you will embark on exciting expeditions to abandoned space stations, ruined restaurants in the cosmos, and unexplored planets.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.summary: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

games.name: Until Dawn 2
games.summary:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

games.name: Metroid Ravenous
games.summary: It’s eat or be eaten! Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes. You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.

games.name: Virtual Encore
games.summary: VTuber業界を舞台にしたビジュアルノベル。事務所マネージャー・若葉として、担当タレント・月宮エリカの初ソロライブまでの6日間を支えよう。選択肢によって物語は分岐する。その6日間の先に待つものを、あなたはまだ知らない。

games.name: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto
games.summary: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto is a coming-of-age fantasy visual novel that depicts the summer of nine boys and girls. The game will be released in multiple installments, with each installment focusing on one protagonist and two heroines, together weaving a single story that unfolds over the same period of time.

games.name: Mr Mageboy
games.summary: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to start a business selling resources. Upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and help your village!

games.name: Elemental Lands
games.summary: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

games.name: Sun to Sun: Endure
games.summary: Online co-op survivor for up to 4 players. Hold out from sun to sun against endless hordes, buy weapons from the merchant, stack power cards and bring down 16 bosses across three maps. Or take on the single-player campaign alone.

games.name: Stabjack
games.summary: A combination of Roguelike Deckbuilder and comic noir tragedy. Stabjack plunges you into a dark, gritty, demon-infested world, with gameplay that builds on the familiar concepts of Blackjack. Can a talking knife help you solve your wife’s murder, or is this just the beginning of your descent into madness?

games.name: Destiny Is Dice
games.summary: A dungeon of chaos determined by a few dice rolls. The only one you can rely on here is Grin, the witch who rules the all of this place. She’ll gladly rig the dice for you. Use this to create options that never existed before and build the strongest team! Until, one day, you no longer need her help.

games.name: Brain Hack Squad
games.summary: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

games.name: Shell Soldier
games.summary: " Shell Soldier " is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

games.name: Ember & Blade
games.summary: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

games.name: Sorrow: Rise of Divinity
games.summary: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

games.name: Galactic Space Guard
games.summary: Galactic Space Guard is a turn-based tactics game. Lead your squad of elite soldiers against feral alien beasts and defend humanity’s space stations. Upgrade your squad, prepare for battle, and restore peace to the galaxy!

games.name: Macaronpolis
games.summary: Macaronpolis is a simulation game that creates an efficient and universal process for customers to produce the products they want. You develop sales strategies by predicting customer demand, developing production designs, and sometimes finding solutions to problems faced by neighbors.

games.name: Last Floor
games.summary: Оne day your life changes dramatically and you become a hostage of your own home. Your task is to survive but to do this you need to get outside.

games.name: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
games.summary: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.
aliases: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol — Book One: Black Signal

games.name: Cats in the Shell
games.summary: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

games.name: Voidhold
games.summary: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies, push through 10 biomes, and hold the line at the edge of the void.

games.name: The Battle of Olympus
games.summary: The 1988 classic action-RPG returns! The original creators are rebuilding the code and redrawing the pixel art for a handcrafted Steam remake of a mythic journey across ancient Greece.

games.name: Duoshift
games.summary: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

games.name: Buggos: Death Squad
games.summary: Buggos: Death Squad is a first-person co-op wave defense shooter for 1 to 4 players. The squad drops onto a planet overrun by the Buggos, an alien insect swarm, builds a base of turrets, walls, generators and shields, and holds out against waves of hundreds of Buggos until it has gathered enough research to escape. Players can also assault Buggo nests and fortifications to reduce wave pressure. The swarm evolves as the run goes on, adding new species, upgrades and boss Buggos that counter the players' defenses. Weapons, armor and buildings all have module sockets that add effects such as split shots, chain hits and explosions on kill. Before each drop, players choose a loadout on their ship and unlock new weapons, armor and modules through meta progression. In Versus mode, one player commands the swarm against 1 to 3 human players.

games.name: Paper Perjury
games.summary:
Investigating a simple robbery reveals a tapestry of mysteries!

Solve a series of cases as newly hired police clerk Justina Smith and find out the truth behind a string of suspicious crimes. Work with the energetic detective Ernest Hunt and dig for clues in the paper trail to discover the secrets that paperwork can hide.

games.name: Vanguard Exiles
games.summary: Blending deep board game strategy with auto-battling mastery, and designed by Richard Garfield (creator of Magic: The Gathering), lead your Squads over an ever-changing dieselpunk battlefield where no two games are ever the same. Think ahead, adapt fast, outwit your opponent and claim victory.

games.name: Astonishia Story
games.summary:
Follow Lloyd von Reuental on his quest to recover a stolen relic and regain his honor in this tale of prejudice, manipulation, and duty. The Elven Queen is set on claiming the powers of an ancient god, and it'll be up to you to stop her!

Astonishia Story is an updated version of the classic Korean RPG, featuring enhanced visuals and refined mechanics. Master grid-based battles, recruit mercenaries, and do whatever it takes to see your duty through, even if that means saving the world in the process.

games.name: Coven: All Powerful
games.summary: A chaotic spell-slinging party brawler where Sages clash in ever-changing magical realms. Stack wild enchantments, unleash devastating spells and combos, and outlast your friends in fast, unpredictable battles full of pure arcane mayhem.

games.name: Bonebuilder
games.summary: In this action roguelike you will fight imposing enemies in heavy, deliberate third-person 3D action combat. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

games.name: Aftershock
games.summary: When your own mind becomes the enemy, can you protect the one who matters most?

games.name: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.summary: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

games.name: A Date with Death 2: Remnants
games.summary: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

games.name: AstroDiner Manager
games.summary: Become a manager for your own diner on a lonely asteroid. Order snacks and drinks, cook dishes, and serve them to quirky alien slimes. Talk, hire, investigate, and keep an eye on the visitors to reveal the hidden mystery behind this place.

games.name: Every Wednesday
games.summary: When Hideki steps inside for the first time, he does not yet realize that this is where he will finally stop feeling invisible after a long time. Meet new friends alongside him, uncover their stories, and support them through life’s challenges. They might even help you rewrite your own story …

games.name: GTJ: Grand Theft Japan
games.summary: Grand Theft Japan is a tribute to GTA and Yakuza, set in Japan. Featuring stories inspired by real events: soaring rice prices, roaming bears, yakuza clans, otaku culture, and shocking political incidents.

games.name: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One
games.summary: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria is a 3D Metroidvania set in Seoul — a ghost city run by AI after humanity's population collapse. Explore a twisted Seoul and discover new abilities.

games.name: Alchemist
games.summary: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

games.name: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
games.summary: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

games.name: Vertigo Enigma
games.summary: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

games.name: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
games.summary: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique! Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

games.name: Yeommae
games.summary: Yeommae is a point-and-click game about traditional Korean shamanism. Investigate objects, witness past memories, and solve puzzles. Uncover the truth through the four senses and untangle the twins' twisted fate at the hands of the Mudang.

games.name: Lunar Crypt
games.summary: Journey through the spirit world to exorcise the twelve zodiac animals and save Chinese New Year in this zero-gravity precision platformer inspired by Chinese mythology and folklore.

games.name: The Infinite Shift: Backrooms
games.summary: The Infinite Shift is a psychological horror exploration game. As a pool cleaner caught in an unending shift, traverse eerie liminal spaces from submerged Poolrooms to Level 0. Solve environmental puzzles, evade lurking entities, and try to escape—before you drown in the depths of the Backrooms.

games.name: OxyDungeon
games.summary: You wake up in a bizarre pop-art world, armed with a baseball bat and only four buttons: Up, Down, Left, and Right. Input dance-game-style arrow combos to create items, then smash and launch them with your bat to obliterate enemies and survive the chaos!

games.name: High Typer
games.summary: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

games.name: Wiltcards
games.summary: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

games.name: Ante Inferno
games.summary: The poker RPG. Ante Inferno is a roguelite card battler where you play poker hands as attacks, tear through hell with forty class abilities, and stack boons until the damage counter gives up on digits.

games.name: Your New Family
games.summary: They offer you a bed, a seat at the table and a new family. All you have to do is stay. A narrative psychological horror adventure in a community where everyone is kind and nobody quite answers your questions.

games.name: Tales of Tuscany
games.summary: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

games.name: Game Quest: The Backlog Battler
games.summary: This Arcade Hack & Slash answers the age old question: "What if the games you never play could attack you?" Fight back your backlog! The more you paid, the more damage they will do to you! (just like in real life).

games.name: Gazar
games.summary: GAZAR is an intense vertical arcade space shooter where you fight against an alien fleet destroying the galaxy. Battle through Story Mode or test your skills in Infinity Mode with 5 difficulty levels and leaderboards. GAZAR delivers non-stop action, stunning visual effects, and dynamic combat.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

games.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.summary: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

games.name: C3 Nightfall
games.summary: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

games.name: Rookie Raiders
games.summary: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

games.name: Space Daram
games.summary: Become a cute space chipmunk and manage your ship with companions as you explore alien planets, build and upgrade your base, and craft gear by generating power and refining resources. Meet unique alien species, grow your foothold in the universe, and play solo or with friends in multiplayer.

games.name: Shatterswarm
games.summary:
Shatterswarm is a narrative-driven 2D space shooter that combines direct ship combat, fleet command, tower defense, and base building into a strategic colony survival experience. Command Captain Hope's hero ship as you defend Earth's last bastion, The Citadel, against the relentless Voxan Empire.

Take control of your hero ship in intense 2D space combat while simultaneously building and managing a fleet of ships, constructing defensive networks around your citadel, and managing resources to survive wave after wave of alien invaders. Every decision matters as you balance offensive capabilities with defensive structures, all while facing unique enemy types that require different strategies to defeat.

The game features a diverse roster of challenging enemies, each with distinct mechanics: parasites that hack into and take control of your own ships, motherships that spawn smaller vessels, deflectors that fire your projectiles back at you, and robotic enemies that latch onto your ships and tear them apart. Face off against epic multi-phase boss battles against Voxan commanders Gordox, Gudrak, and the dreaded General Mortex.

With its perfect blend of action, strategy, and base building, Shatterswarm offers a unique short game experience where tactical thinking and quick reflexes are both essential for survival. The Citadel's survival depends on your strategy—will you focus on overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defenses, or a balanced approach?

games.name: Flock Off!
games.summary: Flock Off! is a first-person action adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off zombified sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

games.name: 11 pm
games.summary: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.summary: Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

games.name: Metro 2039
games.summary: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

games.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
games.summary: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Find your path in this fallen realm.

games.name: Wild Life
games.summary: Become the heroine Maya - strong, beautiful and able to call upon her wings, her tribal heritage - in this gripping Adult Action-RPG. Roam the world from fertile forests to dry and sun-soaked deserts, spread your wings and cut through the skies of a world torn by greed and vanity. Find your own way to ensure your survival and embrace the possibilities of fighting and sex.

games.name: Encryptid
games.summary: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

games.name: Spyder: Agent 8
games.summary: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Wake Up
games.summary: Experience a shattered and surreal dream filled with fascinating riddles, where your only guide is an elusive butterfly. Can you make the journey and wake up?

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.summary: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX
games.summary: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!

games.name: Among Us Story: On Guard
games.summary: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.summary: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary: The Road of Dust and Sorrow is a tense, story-driven pixel art horror inspired by ’90s classics. Survive a world gone wrong and protect what matters most: your daughter.

games.name: Yuna and the Spirit Forest
games.summary: A 2D pixel-art metroidvania where you fight using elemental spirits instead of basic attacks. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles in a magical forest.

games.name: Fable
games.summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold
games.summary: Prepare for Evercold, the sixth expansion pack in the ever‑expanding world of Final Fantasy XIV Online.

games.name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.summary: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

games.name: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - Definitive Edition
aliases: Hyrule Warriors: La era del cataclismo – Edición definitiva
games.summary: Experience the events of the Great Calamity with higher resolution visuals and smoother performance on Nintendo Switch 2!

games.name: Blossoming Yandere
games.summary: You've moved into your first apartment. A girl gazes at you, craving your love. What are you to do when you're the center of someone's world? Make choices, explore your new home, piece together a mystery, and be careful. Your actions and words have consequences.

games.name: Ballseye
games.summary: A Goofy 2D Nubby-like featuring Monsters, Shooting, Explosions. There are a total of 8 different areas and their contents are procedurally generated each time they are played. The game can be played Solo, but it also supports Multiplayer PVP, Co-op, Level building and sharing.

games.name: Flearun!
games.summary: A retro, fast paced multiplayer on foot racing game for up to 4 players

games.name: Last Chance Market
games.summary: When a grocery list becomes a struggle to survive against cosmic horrors, will you make it through the door? Stay alive, solve the mystery and make your offerings - or end up on a missing person poster in this first-person, non-linear nightmare. But you'd better hurry, the store's closing soon.

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Protocol: Zero-Day
games.summary: Protocol: Zero-Day is a brutal and fast-paced Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Wield your electric baton, master lightning-fast dashes, and survive endless hordes of corrupted anomalies. Navigate the shattered digital grid, upgrade your stats, and purge the system before you are overrun. Pure skill, zero compromises.

games.name: Rainfusor
games.summary: Each element combination creates its own playstyle. Reclaim the lost parts of yourself in rooms in a side-scroller physics rogue-arcade without any boring stat boosts or platforming. Rip apart segmented bugs, uncover new runes and synergies and find crazy emergent mechanics.

games.name: Idoly Pride
games.summary: Idoly Pride is a mobile idol management game developed by QualiArts, where you become a manager and support your idols in their busy activities, such as handshake meetings, TV appearances, and live performances. You can consult with them, deepen your bond with them, and lead them to become top idols!

games.name: Meg's Monster
games.summary: Take control of the Underworld’s grumpiest ghoul to help a lost little girl find her way home in this creepy-cute indie adventure. Just be warned: if she cries, the whole world dies.

games.name: No Rest for the Wicked
games.summary: "No Rest for the Wicked" is the sixteenth and final episode of the third season of The CW television series Supernatural, and the show's sixtieth episode overall. Written by series creator Eric Kripke and directed by Kim Manners, the episode was first broadcast on May 15, 2008. The narrative follows the series' protagonists Sam (Jared Padalecki) and Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles)—brothers who travel the continental United States hunting supernatural creatures—as they attempt to save the latter's soul from damnation. Having made a year-long demonic pact in the previous season finale, Dean has just one day left to live.

games.name: Inzoi
games.summary: InZOI is a life simulation game in which the player takes on the role of an intern at a virtual reality company, managing a neighborhood of simulated characters called "Zoi." Gameplay takes place across open world environments including a dense metropolis inspired by Seoul and a coastal city inspired by Santa Monica. Players direct their characters through careers, relationships, education, and daily needs, while also customizing homes and editing the broader city environment. The game features AI-driven character behaviors, generative AI tools for creating patterns and objects, mod support, and a community content-sharing platform called Canvas.

games.name: The End of History
games.summary:
"The End of History" is a sandbox-style strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

games.name: Super Battle Golf
games.summary: An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

games.name: The Legend of Khiimori
games.summary: The Legend of Khiimori is a system-driven game where you explore the untamed land of 13th century Mongolia as a brave courier rider. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Tremble of Towers
games.summary: Tremble of Towers is a CO-OP tower defense game where you can build any structure with any resource. Countless of combinations are waiting for you and your friends to be discovered in order to protect your beloved Goal Stone from all kinds of enemies in various maps!

games.name: Croak
games.summary: Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.

games.name: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
games.summary: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

games.name: Crafters Heaven
games.summary: Crafters Heaven is a lowpoly RPG sandbox adventure blending survival, crafting, and exploration. Build your base, fight wild creatures, and discover an open world full of secrets! Demo coming soon!

games.name: Kiipluu
games.summary:
Kiipluu is a hardcore stealth adventure set in a brutal Neolithic world.

Every encounter is a tense survival puzzle. Study patrol routes, use tall grass, shadows, sound, and terrain to stay hidden. Set traps, strike from ambush, or slip past unseen. Being discovered can quickly become fatal.

When stealth fails, combat is fast, brutal, and unforgiving. Weapons are primitive. Injuries matter. There are no easy victories.

Along the way, Kiipluu is haunted by dreamlike spirit journeys and visions of his father, a legendary hunter whose shadow looms over every choice. Your decisions shape who survives, who is lost, and what kind of person Kiipluu becomes.

This is a story of fear, survival, and growing up in a world that wants you dead.

games.name: Flutterfield
games.summary: Flutterfield is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Buy butterflies and raise them in real time, or catch fully grown ones yourself. Unlock, upgrade, and customize habitats while filling your collection with real-life butterfly species!

games.name: Join Us
games.summary: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

games.name: Vale's Echo
games.summary:
2D cozy horror adventure that blends dark comedy, psychological storytelling, and surreal art.

In Vale’s Echo, death isn’t the end — it’s your last chance. Players take on the role of Vale, a sarcastic and troubled soul who wakes up on a mysterious train to nowhere. No pulse. No past. No clue. Her only company? Echo — a floating skull full of secrets, charm, and just the right amount of mischief.

As Vale and Echo journey through the underworld to confront Death and uncover Vale’s past, players will meet a bizarre and unforgettable cast of characters — from chatty fish-human hybrids to leech merchants and morally dubious spirits. Each encounter challenges not just Vale’s choices, but also the player’s empathy, humor, and sense of right and wrong.

Gameplay in Vale’s Echo revolves around dialogue choices, unsettling puzzles, and branching narratives that shape Vale’s relationships, memories, and ultimate fate.

Beneath its eerie charm lies a deeply emotional story connecting the surreal with the human — all wrapped in cinematic visuals, melancholic music, and darkly witty writing.

games.name: Seasons Turning
games.summary: A farming/life sim focused on exploration and immersion. There's no stamina bar and no broken tools. Aside from the genre's norms, it has four puzzle-filled dungeons, secret locations, irrigation, gene splicing, mafia kittens, and one rusty, well-loved bicycle. Save whenever. Play at your own speed.

games.name: The Concrete Sutra #1
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

games.name: Orbit to Riches
games.summary: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

games.name: Caliban
games.summary: A strategic blackjack roguelike. Stack drinks, runes, and gems into game-breaking combos. Beat cursed bosses. Chase the leaderboard. One deck. One dealer. Infinite builds.

games.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
games.summary: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

games.name: Hex Tower Boogie
games.summary: Hex Tower Boogie is a tower defense game combined with factory-style automation, played on a hexagonal grid. Players build conveyor belts, splitters and mergers to route ammunition to their towers; towers only fire when supplied by the production line. It mixes logistics and supply-chain management with wave-based defense. Developed with the Godot engine.

games.name: Bureaucromancer
games.summary: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

games.name: Hearts Gone Black
games.summary: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down survival horror game where you scavenge abandoned homes and gather or mine resources in open world, fight infected, manage survivors, build a base, and endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices slowly wear you down.

games.name: Green Inferno
games.summary: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

games.name: Die First
games.summary: Die First is a casual, physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Run, jump, dash, and use items or map hazards to destroy yourself while saving your opponents.

games.name: A Trans-Siberian Tea
games.summary: A journey through the carriages of a Trans-Siberian train buried in the snow to reveal the identity of a legendary gentlewoman-thief as you speak with the frozen corpses of the passengers.

games.name: Raid Haven
games.summary:
Raid Haven is a strategy, wave-based survival game focused on building fortified bases and defending against ever-more-powerful raids. Gear up your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, adapt your defences, and survive wave after wave of increasingly dangerous enemies.

Build walls, traps, killboxes and defences to create an impenetrable fortress.

Face different raider archetypes every wave, each with their own strengths and tactics. Adapt your defences and strategy to survive whatever comes next.

Choose powerful rewards, equip your pawns, upgrade your gear, hire mercenaries, and adapt your defences before the next wave.

Inspired by RimWorld's tactical pawn-based combat, Raid Haven takes that foundation and puts the focus entirely on building, defending and surviving increasingly dangerous raids. Raid Haven is an independently developed game, built from the ground up by a solo developer with a passion for strategy, base building and tactical combat.

games.name: Evergrowing
games.summary: Grow the tree you live on in this cozy incremental game. Play as a squirrel, tend its leaves and build along the branches. Travel by balloon to other trees or explore the roots below. Your tree keeps growing while you're away.

games.name: Last Haul
games.summary: A mining roguelite where you fly a really small spaceship. Mining calls the enemies in. Haul the crystals home on a tractor beam and turn them into upgrades. Every zone ends on a boss, and if your ship is destroyed, the run is over.

games.name: Breakremental
games.summary: Breakremental is a brick breaker incremental game. Break bricks, get coins, buy upgrades, add more balls and watch everything slowly get out of control. There are bosses too, because apparently breaking normal bricks wasn't enough.

games.name: Dodgeball Disorder
games.summary: Dodgeball Disorder is a chaotic online multiplayer dodgeball game where throwing, dodging and staying upright are equally important. Score hits, survive the ridiculous ragdoll physics and compete in different game modes in a school gym with questionable supervision, sillyballs and crazy faces.

games.name: Picatso
games.summary: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

games.name: Solar Arena
games.summary: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

games.name: Catacombos
games.summary: Catacombos is a physics-driven roguelite combo-builder where you throw and merge cats, build absurd synergies with cards and cat hats, and crush armies of dogs in the depths of the catacombs.

games.name: Coup de Grass
games.summary: Coup de Grass is an incremental management game about turning a small grass field into a sprawling automated operation.

games.name: NAND²
games.summary: Build a computer from a single NAND gate: wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline, branch prediction and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. A long campaign through the eras of computing, plus a level editor and Steam Workshop.

games.name: Who Heckled?
games.summary: Heckle, hide & hope you don't get caught. Who Heckled? is a 2-8 player online social deduction party game set in a comedy club. Sit among the crowd, heckle whoever's performing on stage with iconic memes, then blend back in. Get spotted and you're out. Grab your friends and figure out Who Heckled?

games.name: Bocage
games.summary: Bocage is a cozy isometric puzzle game where every farm piece has its own needs. Fill the grid tile by tile. Fence in the cow. Grow wheat around the windmill. Rethink each move as the constraints pile up. No timer, no game over.

games.name: Fathoms
games.summary: Fathoms: Narrative psychological horror meets anomaly game. Survive 24 days in a row with your wife in an apartment in the underwater city of Fathoms while you lose your mind or die – and the nightmare starts all over again...

games.name: Mini Market Tidy Up
games.summary: A cozy pixel-art organizing game about tidying up messy supermarkets. Sort products, stock the right shelves, earn money, unlock upgrades, and take on bigger stores as you turn every chaotic market into a perfectly organized space.

games.name: What Da Font: Tidy Up the Print Shop
games.summary: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

games.name: The Retired Mage's Apprentice: Tidy Up the Magic Tower
games.summary: A relaxing organization game where you play as a retired mage's apprentice. Tidy up a magical tower, discover hidden secrets, and slowly learn magic along the way.

games.name: Odd Rock Out
games.summary: You're locked out, and your spare key is inside a fake pebble somewhere among 5,000 real ones. Pick them up, shake them by your ear and listen for the one that rattles. A cozy first-person search game, solo or with up to four friends.

games.name: Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion
games.summary:
Silicon Life: From Bedroom to Billion is a tycoon game about building a computer empire, starting in 1981 with a bedroom and a workbench.

The player assembles, repairs and sells PCs in 3D, using the real hardware of 1981 to 2025 under parodied names, and grows from the garage to the factory with the goal of reaching a billion.

games.name: Fox Arcana
games.summary: Delve into the mystical depths of the Forest in this captivating roguelike. You play as a courageous fox, wielder of powerful spells, the last bulwark against the growing corruption.

games.name: Wavertree Mountain
games.summary: A 2D top-down MMORPG on an island the humans left behind. Choose one of six species, pick a side, and dig a burrow of your own. Gather, craft, build and fight your way across the island, run the local economy with your wares, or just go fishing. You choose.

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.summary: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fantasy world.

games.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.summary: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

games.name: Megabait
games.summary: A brutal top-down obstacle course where every second counts. Master precise movement to survive deadly hazard rooms, leave a bloody trail of your past mistakes, and uncover every secret on your path to 100% completion.

games.name: Eternal Anima
games.summary: Yearning for a better future is considered a capital offense in the kingdom of Urvis Ael. After Wade questions this key tenet of his society, he finds himself on the run in an era-spanning adventure that challenges his core beliefs and reveals an unknown world filled with hidden truths. Alongside an eclectic group of new allies trying to survive a dangerous journey, Wade must travel through time to save civilizations of the past from catastrophes and unravel the secrets of a lost history.

games.name: Next: The Portopia Serial Murder Case
aliases: Zoku Portopia Renzoku Satsujin Jiken: Boukyaku no Maisou
games.summary: The legendary "The Portopia Serial Murder Case" is reborn! Under the executive direction of Yuji Horii comes an all-new entry featuring five brand-new investigation files. Set in 1980s Kobe, conduct your investigation alongside a new cast of characters and uncover the secrets hidden behind the case.

games.name: Keep Making Games
games.summary: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

games.name: OmniMart Tycoon
games.summary: Design and manage the ultimate retail empire in OmniMart Tycoon! Build complex store layouts, optimize daily supply chains, and set prices. Hire staff and watch hundreds of simulated shoppers navigate your aisles as you balance profits with ultimate customer satisfaction.

games.name: Shin-chan: Me and the Professor on Summer Vacation - The Endless Seven-Day Journey and Shin-chan: Shiro and the Coal Town Double Pack
Tales of Eldoria
games.summary: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

games.name: Gundam Rogue Orbit
games.summary: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

games.name: Byte Bistro
games.summary: Program a little robot crew and bring a neighborhood café to life. Cook, serve, restock, and refine your routines across 24 services. Mix visual programming with hands-on minigames, then keep your kitchen humming in Desktop Companion mode.

games.name: Barbe-Yeux
games.summary: Barbe-Yeux is a single-player comedic narrative adventure set in a pirate world. Players follow a self-proclaimed legendary captain and his two companions on a treasure hunt, exploring islands, meeting eccentric characters and taking part in story-driven minigames. The game combines absurd humour, dialogue, exploration and party-based combat.

games.name: Paladin HC
games.summary: Command a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer in scenarios based on real military operations. Calculate firing range, adjust your tactical position, manage resources, and support your allies.

games.name: Petal Runner
games.summary: Hop on your bike and join Cali and Kira as they ride across the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a solarpunk, pixel art-powered open-world RPG about life, loss, and what we carry with us.

games.name: Frieda is Changing
games.summary: Frieda’s fourteen, furious, and sick of secrets. Uncover the real reason for your sister’s disappearance: Snoop through an isolated village, crack puzzles and stir up trouble. But hurry - monsters are lurking where you least expect them.

games.name: Backrooms: The Savior
games.summary: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

games.name: Balls to the Walls
games.summary: A short incremental physics game about upgrading and annihilating your balls. Equip chaotic special balls and buy physics-altering upgrades to break the simulation and get rich.

games.name: I Wanna Be a Supernova
games.summary: Devour celestial bodies, grow from red dwarf to supernova, and build your own sky. Forge worlds, choose zodiac relics, and dodge incoming threats. A chill space adventure in pixel art: Normal is relaxed and flowing, Hard is there if you want a challenge.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.

games.name: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell
games.summary: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Trainwatch
games.summary: A time-management psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing. What seems like a simple 1-month job as a gatekeeper operating a crossing turns into an exploration of occult grounds, meeting unsettling folk, and trying to fix your own life.

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.summary: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: Phase Zero
games.summary: Phase Zero is an unfinished shooter video game that was being developed by Hyper Image Productions and would have been published by Atari for the Atari Jaguar. Set in the future on a terrestrial planet, the player takes on the role of a newcomer to the Phase Zero squad, piloting a hovercraft to fight rival corporate states. The player is tasked with various objectives while fighting enemies in multiple missions. Phase Zero was the first project by Hyper Image, a game company led by Jeremy Gordon, Matías Duarte, and brothers Otávio Good and Paul Good.

games.name: Road Kings
games.summary: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

games.name: Sakunaverse
games.summary: An upcoming life simulation game about the VTuber Yuuki Sakuna.

games.name: Category Connections
games.summary: Category Connections is a chill puzzle game where you sort 3,000 things into 100 categories. No timers, no stress, just a big grid of things for you to organize. Perfect for a rainy afternoon.

games.name: Iron Curtain Call
games.summary:
Iron Curtain Call is a fast-paced first-person shooter drawn in the style of rubber hose cartoons and set in an absurd alternate 1965, where World War III is run by a customer service AI and fought by armies of wind-up robots. Combat rewards aggression: punching robots restores health, prying them open yields ammunition and setting them on fire builds armor, while double jumps, air dashes, a grappling hook and parries keep the player moving through its arenas.

The campaign spans twelve chapters, each aimed at a satirical target of the Cold War era and closed by a theatrical boss, from a game show studio and a carnival election to a world's fair and a moon base. Its arsenal treats diplomacy as a weapon, with a shotgun called the Diplomat, a typewriter, a rotary telephone and a cash register among its guns.

games.name: My Cozi Shop: Craft & Sell
games.summary: A cozy first-person toy shop sim. Cast rubber ducks, sew plush toys by hand, then box, tape, ribbon and ship each order out the window. Customers review every parcel, and they notice a crooked eye. Spend what you earn on new toys, a helper and decor.

games.name: Luna Plena
games.summary: "Read your enemy. Count every turn." A Short RPG Beneath the Full Moon.

games.name: Altiros
games.summary: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

games.name: Ash and Flame
games.summary: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 6.2: Invaders from Another World
games.summary:
Earth Defense Force 6.2: Invaders from Another World is the latest entry in the Earth Defense Force series, and a significant update of Earth Defense Force 6, which has captivated over one million players worldwide.

The series' signature appeal—the overwhelming sense of despair and the exhilarating feeling of defeating gigantic and countless enemies—will be elevated to the next level through PS5-specific advancements.

games.name: Bon Voyage
games.summary: "Bon Voyage" is the original series finale of the American comedy-drama series Gilmore Girls. The episode serves as the 22nd episode of the seventh season and the show's 153rd episode overall. Written by David S. Rosenthal and directed by Lee Shallat-Chemel, the episode was originally broadcast on The CW in the United States on May 15, 2007. Gilmore Girls centers on the relationship of Lorelai Gilmore (Lauren Graham) and her daughter Rory (Alexis Bledel). In this episode, Rory gets a job offer, which forces her to cancel her plans to go on vacation with her mother, and the town of Stars Hollow organizes a farewell party for her.

games.name: Rex Summons a Meteor
games.summary: A short game about a large rock. You accidentally summoned a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in this silly first-person puzzle adventure.

games.name: Fold'Em
games.summary: Join the table for a surreal high stakes poker card game experience. Discover creepy characters and survive each round with whatever you can. There is something sinister at play...

games.name: ReVamp
games.summary: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

games.name: Parkour Bot
