games.summary: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

games.name: High Elo Girls
games.summary: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

games.name: Demon Spore
games.summary: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

games.name: Dreaming Worlds
games.summary: Dive into the dreaming worlds of the four dream keepers and find out why they don't answer anymore. Rescue the trapped inhabitants of the dream worlds, change the dreams back to good and discover mysterious places and puzzles. But something dark will stand in your way.

games.name: Vice Undercover
games.summary: VICE Undercover is a point & click narco-thriller set in an alternate 1980s Miami - where every choice matters. You play as undercover agent Vida, and for one hour per day, you're taking control over a cartel-run computer using Amigo OS, a fully-functional 1980-inspired operating system.

games.name: Interwoven
games.summary: Welcome to Interwoven - a compact, but dynamic adventure inspired by traditional turn-based JRPGs! Follow an unlikely trio on their journey up to defeat the Obsidian Drake atop Anvite Mountain. Use the unique Augment Battle System to create all sorts of interesting strategies.

games.name: Super Cucumber
games.summary: Super Cucumber is a 16-bit inspired action-adventure game filled with tight platforming, unlockable abilities and plenty of secrets to discover. Traverse more than six towers and overcome dozens of levels, fight your way past devious bosses and become the greatest Aardvark Superhero in the world!

games.name: Pineview Drive: Rising Storm
games.summary: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

games.name: Vampire Rancher
games.summary: Rancher by day, Vampire by night. Manage your time and resources to restore your sleepy little town to its former glory, all while satisfying your vampire needs for blood. Oversee shops and saloons, farm crops and humans, and explore ancient vampiric ruins in the Weird Wild West!

games.name: Becrowned
games.summary: A surreal survival horror that explores how your unfulfilled desire will manifest as your greatest torment. Explore the ruins of an ancient kingdom, fight monsters, and try to survive in this brutal world. Will you become its savior, or will you seek to destroy it? The choice is yours.

games.name: Nine Rounds Rapid
games.summary: Blast your way to freedom, solo or with a friend in online or local co-op, through a possessed, fragmenting space station. Upgrade abilities, mod your weapon builds, and manipulate time to defeat the station's nine gatekeepers. Power up, progress, and learn the ugly truth with every escape attempt.

games.name: Squid Grid
games.summary: A squid-squirting, tentacle-bending puzzle game in a steampunk ocean

games.name: Elemdian
games.summary: RPG that combines exploration with magic combat. Unfurl your claws as a powerful werewolf warrior wielding the power of the Elegems! A journey to find the Elegems, unleash devastating spells, and unravel the mysteries of Morrok.

games.name: Medimon
games.summary: "Medimon" is a health science-themed monster-taming RPG. Players capture, battle, and evolve creatures symbolizing health concepts, turning intricate biology into an interactive and captivating game experience. Dive in and make education an adventure!

games.name: Folder Dungeon
games.summary: Dungeon crawler roguelike inside computer folder!

games.name: Another Door
games.summary: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

games.name: Simulacro
games.summary: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

games.name: Hexforger
games.summary: Craft your spells in ONLINE CO-OP with your friends in this SURVIVORS-LIKE! Slaughter monsters, gain gold, upgrade your spells to infinite heights. Crush challenges and unlock new spells, upgrades, pickups, realms. Up to 4 players in this unique twist on the survivors-like formula!

games.name: Bestiario
games.summary: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: Heaven Crawler
games.summary: Explore The Womb, a forgotten man-made tower built to reach the heavens. Wield Mechanical Arms to overcome deadly enemies and carve your path upward on a deeply personal journey. And remember: Bring her back.

games.name: Dark Queen of Samobor
games.summary: Experience a thrilling adventure through the dark and atmospheric world of medieval Croatia where an evil queen rules from the shadows and her haunted guardians await you. Venture into a dark fantasy tale wrapped in a cinematic action side-scroller with a unique 2.5D style.

games.name: Sick Samurai
games.summary: It's 1972 on Furikyu Island. A jazz-hop record spins up. Your deranged mentor lights his cigarette. Slash every enemy before it burns out. One-hit-kills, no mistakes... well, maybe a few.

games.name: Codebreakers VR
games.summary: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

games.name: Hark the Ghoul
games.summary: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

games.name: Lords of the Fallen II
games.summary: Lords of the Fallen 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the game released in 2023, is set to arrive in 2026. The team at Hexworks aims to create a sequel incorporating more commercial elements, particularly in visual design, to attract a broader audience of players.

games.name: Shine On, My Little Sun
games.summary: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

games.name: Nonolith
games.summary: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

games.name: Deserter
games.summary: In this stealth RPG, you play as a deserter who is forced to become a thief in a grim, war-torn town. You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

games.name: Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream
games.summary: NOT your typical simulator! Is it your dream job or are you just working in your dream? Work fast, or face the consequences. Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream is a surreal and dark descent into human psyche, burnout and the horror of the working culture.

games.name: Deadly Rehearsal
games.summary: The rehearsal must be flawless. Every sound, every light timed perfectly. You are one of the best stage manager's after all. Failure is not an option. The play is cursed... and it demands perfection.

games.name: Phi: The Broken Strings
games.summary: Play as PHi in a mysterious world, where emotionally charged levels reveal past wounds, restore balance and reignite fading hope.

games.name: TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods
games.summary: 「TouHou Koishi's Enchanted Woods」 is a Touhou fangame.This is a "reverse-construction" action rogue-lite.Koishi vs. Kokoro! But as the playable character, Koishi uses various enhancement cards to continuously strengthen Kokoro. Can she ultimately defeat the Kokoro she has built up herself?

games.name: Valerie
games.summary: Valerie is generally a feminine given name, derived directly from the French Valérie (a traditionally female name). Valéry or Valery is a masculine given name in parts of Europe (particularly in France and Russia), as well as a common surname in Francophone countries. Another, much rarer, French masculine form of the name is Valère. Both feminine and masculine forms of Valerie have derivatives in many European languages and are especially common in Russian and other Eastern European languages. The masculine form is not always a cognate of the feminine; it can have a distinct etymology.

games.name: Artius: Pure Imagination
games.summary: ARTIUS is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as artists battling to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction! Dash, swing, and smash your way through a vibrant, hand-drawn world in this adrenaline-fueled platformer where art is your strongest weapon.

games.name: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
games.summary: A run-and-gun metroidvania set in Voivod’s dystopian universe. Battle biomechanical mutants, explore a twisted post-apocalyptic world, and recover fragments of your lost mind. Featuring pixel-art visuals, tight action-platforming, and Voivod soundtrack.

games.name: Project; Virai: Doomer's Life Escape
games.summary: Help a doomer girl make her VTuber persona popular and escape her depressive routine. If you can.

games.name: Lemonade Apocalypse
games.summary: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

games.name: Anemorie
games.summary: Anemorie is a visually rich, story-driven adventure game that invites players to step into the life of Anna, a young woman on a journey of self-discovery, love, and resilience.

games.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
games.summary: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or dominate your enemies to claim the Iron Throne in multiplayer skirmish. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm.

games.name: Out of Words
games.summary: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

games.name: Stars of Icarus
games.summary: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.

games.name: Dwarven Village: Dark Siege Td
games.summary: Dwarven Village Dark Siege is a game that you need to defend your crystals from orcs and goblins, Place Allies on paths, Place towers to the sides and make upgrades in the village

games.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
games.summary: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

games.name: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
games.summary: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

games.name: Ashfield Hollow
games.summary: Ten years after the outbreak, you’re found unconscious and taken in by a camp of survivors. Learn to fight, scavenge, farm, and craft as you rebuild your life, form bonds, and maybe even find love in this post-apocalyptic life sim RPG.

games.name: Astro Architect
games.summary: Astro Architect is a city-builder game, where your employees votes define what you build. As an architect working for the corporation, build your own space station, expand your influence, take care of your employees needs, manage logistics and space expeditions.

games.name: Hextalia
games.summary: Hextalia is a strategic tower defense where you craft powerful items and attach them to your towers. Shape enemy paths with walls, craft the desired items, defend corrupted crystals, and unlock new powers as you grow your collection. Build, defend, and adapt.

games.name: Chaos the Devil
games.summary: A Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and spin your way through a new adventure, done the old way.

games.name: Shutter Story
games.summary: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

games.name: Starfinder: Afterlight
games.summary: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

games.name: Zeroth
games.summary: Zeroth is a run-based action platformer with mechanical depth and interplay inspired by traditional Roguelikes. Learn the rules of Zeroth through hilarious deaths and guide your heroes as they seek to escape the 0th circle of Haell.

games.name: Dino Citadel
games.summary: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
games.summary: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

games.name: Helcast
games.summary: Fight your way from the Underworld to the gates of Asgard in a turn-based, merge-puzzle roguelite deckbuilder rooted in Norse mythology. Assemble godslaying builds and battle the unleashed dead by combining weapons, weighing velocity and mass with every shot to chain physics-driven merge combos.

games.name: Phase Nexus
games.summary: Phase Nexus is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action-platformer starring speedster Cyanser and teleporter Raviel (once again not playable yet). Think of a fever fusion between Sonic (without the loops), Viewitful Joe, Sparkster/Rocket Knight and Luminous Avenger iX/White Steel X. In terms of mechanics and movement from those games, they blend well surprisingly.

games.name: Nocturnal Visitors: Book One
games.summary: Discover a world where magic and science, chaos and order, are two sides of the same coin.

games.name: Ruin: Beast City
games.summary: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

games.name: Eye of Khaos
games.summary: Slay your enemies in this sword and sorcery roguelike! Ancient dungeons, fallen ruins and cyclopean towers and their primordial denizens present a tactical and deadly challenge that can only be overcome by the most resourceful heroes.

games.name: Inquisitor Shepherd
games.summary: Become Shepherd, an inquisitor sent to a suspicious village. Unveil the secrets of a world filled with fear, and make an inevitable choice. In this visual novel mystery, your decisions change the world. Can you survive the desperate horror?

games.name: Decision Point
games.summary: Plans meet friction in Decision Point, a wargame where you issue NATO-standard orders, observe AI execution in real time, and adapt as the battlefield evolves. At key Decision Points, the action pauses—giving you time to reassess, redirect your forces, and outmanoeuvre the enemy.

games.name: Clan Fantasy Adventures
games.summary: Clan fantasy adventures is a turn-based 2D RPG. Play Marco, a young boy who wants to become a swordsman, through various adventures that will plunge him into the heart of a major conflict.

games.name: Cuzuco
games.summary: Challenge yourself and demonstrate your precise high-speed hand control to help our little armadillo get back home as fast as possible in this fair but unforgiving platformer game.

games.name: The Detectorist Guild
games.summary: A cosy village-life RPG set in Yorkshire, England, in 1999. Follow James as he explores a quintessential British village with his metal detector, uncovering lost treasures and slowly unravelling a dark mystery that draws him and his family into its depths.

games.name: Five More Minutes
games.summary: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

games.name: Golden Retriever Simple Life
games.summary: Share your days with an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Feed, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day. Teach tricks, discover new walks locations, and keep your furry friend happy and healthy.

games.name: Animal Bakery
games.summary: Manage a cozy subway bakery in an underground animal city - run by a "retired" gangster you're secretly investigating. Serve cute locals, expand the bakery, prepare for festivals, meet strange visitors and explore the subway after hours for fun stories and special rewards!

games.name: The Quiet After
games.summary: The Quiet After is a narrative visual novel where players guide Ava, a survivor navigating a quiet but dangerous world shaped by memory, trauma, and choice. Every decision branches the story, influences Ava’s inner voice, and determines how you survive in the aftermath. The game blends choice-driven storytelling, psychological horror, and atmospheric art to create an emotional narrative experience focused on healing, survival, and the consequences of the past.

games.name: Quantum Quartz
games.summary: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles!

games.name: Timberflow: Sawmill Simulator
games.summary: From a single tree to an entire industry! Manage and automate your lumber business in this relaxing, yet challenging Sawmill Simulator. Start small, grow rich, dominate the market.

games.name: A Game About Breaking A Cube
games.summary: Take a role of a factory worker opressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facilty and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with the cold can of drinkable meat.

games.name: Abismo
games.summary: Abismo is a deep-sea co-op horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to three friends into shifting trenches, recover classified research, and survive the crushing dark while uncovering an analog-horror mystery buried in corrupted VHS tapes.

games.name: Pripyat 0
games.summary: Chernobyl has broken down. As radiation rains down upon you, the world starts rapidly mutating. You've gotten stuck in a nightmarish loop. Can you correctly spot the anomalies on time and get to safety? Or will you become one with the zone?

games.name: Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG
games.summary:
Humanity Echo is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the rusted harbour slums of Odesa, 2044.

You play as an Engineer - not a soldier - using sabotage, environmental manipulation, and raw intellect to outsmart a corporate machine. In this high-tech, low-life world, every explosion carries physical weight and every shot leaves a unique acoustic imprint.

games.name: Twisted Grove
games.summary: A non-violent Roguelike Deckbuilder about befriending critters in a magical forest. Assemble unique decks, pet/compliment/smooch your way into the heart of corrupted flora and fauna, and dismantle the capitalist systems tearing down the Grove.

games.name: D.A.D.S.
games.summary: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

games.name: Kosmosis
games.summary: Two xenobiologists find themselves stranded on a mysterious planet that appears intent on their anihilation.

games.name: Retromine
games.summary: Retromine is an ultra-satisfying, highly replayable, tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful synergies on your way to the bottom of the world.

games.name: Imprinted
games.summary: Looking for a forensic specialist to restore damaged audio tapes (late 1970s). Warning: The artist was involved in the occult; she disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The nature of the recordings may be distressing. Mental clarity and resilience are a must. QUOTE REQUESTED.

games.name: The Granny Detective Society
games.summary: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

games.name: Terrafactory: Idle Planet
games.summary: A planet building idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop while you do other things.

games.name: Pearls of Wisdom
games.summary: A relaxing card game with real-world side quests. Match inspiring and reflective quotes, combine special effect emblems, do out of game side quests and build your deck to get high scores. Reflect, relax, and walk away feeling good after you've finished playing.

games.name: Whisk
games.summary: A whisk is a cooking utensil which can be used to blend ingredients smooth or to incorporate air into a mixture, in a process known as whisking or whipping. Most whisks consist of a long, narrow handle with a series of wire loops joined at the end. The loops can have different shapes depending on a whisk's intended functions. The wires are usually metal, but some are plastic for use with nonstick cookware. Whisks are also made from bamboo. Whisks are commonly used to whip egg whites into a firm foam to make meringue, or to whip cream into whipped cream.

games.name: Golf-Like
games.summary: A golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves. New road, new deck, every run.

games.name: Fossil Quest
games.summary: Fossil Quest is a cozy fossil‑digging life sim where you travel to dig sites, excavate bones, and assemble exhibits to build your own dinosaur museum. Upgrade tools, decorate your home, and curate displays before opening the museum to visitors in a relaxed, collectible‑focused experience.

games.name: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
games.summary: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

games.name: Perceptum
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

games.name: Sin Return
games.summary: An obscure adventure begins in the Silent Kingdom, a land decaying under the spread of the Sin-fication plague. This dark fantasy turn-based RPG emphasizes exploration. Reclaim lost memories in this sinful land, defeat formidable foes, and piece together the truth behind the catastrophe.

games.name: Crypts of Carith
games.summary: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

games.name: AGX GP
games.summary: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

games.name: Hollow Faces
games.summary: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

games.name: Pecado: SD Card
games.summary: Pecado is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

games.name: Bulgasari: Consume·Evolve·Survive
games.summary: Amidst the ruins of a crashed starship, you inject the mysterious ampoule BGS-01 and awaken an insatiable hunger for steel. Devour steel to evolve, and trade with the Space Stagecoach to secure vital supplies. Slaughter the swarms of alien monsters hunting you down and survive!

games.name: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World
games.summary: Embark on a colorful adventure in Crimson Realms! Battle creatures with four unique attack styles, defeat powerful demons to claim relics, overcome perilous obstacles, and complete epic missions in a world filled with danger and wonder.

games.name: EpiDexa Racing
games.summary: EpiDexa Racing is an arcade racing game focused on time trials and online multiplayer. Play with keyboard or controller, climb the leaderboards, and prove your skills against friends or players from around the world.

games.name: Deg
games.summary: A non-linear pure puzzle game where you solve various puzzles using logical reasoning. Explore unknown puzzles in the game world.

games.name: Boiled
games.summary: America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter inspired by Hotline Miami, set in the 1920s Old West.

games.name: Rules: Motel Horizon
games.summary: Start your job as a night administrator at the mysterious Horizon Motel, where visitors from another world try to pass as ordinary people, and the rules have the highest priority — breaking them leads to… undesirable consequences.

games.name: Villain: Path of the Necromancer
games.summary: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

games.name: A Little Less Desperation
games.summary: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

games.name: Veiled Shadows
games.summary: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

games.name: Cosmo Cargo
games.summary: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelite game where you fight to preserve the chaos of the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

games.name: Void Hunters
games.summary: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

games.name: SlashZero
games.summary: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

games.name: Kitman
games.summary: KITMAN is a 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

games.name: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game where your personality shapes the experience. Answer unsettling questions, endure disturbing trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave.

games.name: Plagueborn
games.summary: Plagueborn is a 2D action roguelike where you and your allies battle through plague-ridden dungeons. Explore procedurally generated floors, master a wide arsenal of weapons, forge unique builds, and cut down relentless hordes of darkness.

games.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2026
games.summary: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

games.name: Deus Exia
games.summary: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

games.name: Lurking
games.summary: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

games.name: SnowRunner: Season 20
games.summary: Season 20 of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.name: M.A.Y.A
games.summary: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

games.name: Dithered
games.summary: Dithered invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

games.name: Obake Nante Kowakunai JK vs. Gakkou Meikyuu
games.summary: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

games.name: Knightstones
games.summary: Deploy your armies on a war table in this tactical roguelike! Plan your formations, trigger tons of chain reactions, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be ready… or perish in the final battle.

games.name: Hypnagogia: Broken Dreams
games.summary: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

games.name: Infamous Keepers
games.summary: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

games.name: Czar Ry
games.summary: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

games.name: Manafinder II
games.summary: Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek a new purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

games.name: Fuman Ghoul
games.summary: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

games.name: Fear Tall Grass
games.summary: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

games.name: Bravo, Gaspar!
games.summary: "SURVIVE my SADISTIC SHOW. An ACTION ROGUELIKE where your performance with COLLECTIBLE CREATURES serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: ENTERTAIN OR DIE!"

games.name: Beards Go Underground
games.summary: The Mining Deckbuilder. Craft a deck of bombs and pickaxes to mine the mountains. Place down your card-arsenal and unleash a screen-shaking chain reaction that pays out in a juicy explosion of gold.

games.name: MeowRig
aliases: ニャリグ ～地底のニャン宝団～
games.summary: MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game. Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

games.name: Kerogen
games.summary: Kerogeny jsou polymerní organické látky, které se nacházejí v usazených horninách, například v ropných břidlicích, kde tvoří jednu z forem nekonvenční ropy. Jsou nerozpustné v běžných organických rozpouštědlech kvůli svojí vysoké molekulové hmotnosti (více než 1 000). Každá molekula kerogenu je jedinečná, protože se skládá z náhodné kombinace různých monomerů.

games.name: Dungeonery
games.summary: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

games.name: Caravana 2000
games.summary: Choose your almost-famous costume and face the dangers of Brazilian chaotic nights. In this action roguelike, survive hordes, farm aura, wield sinister gadgets, and create insane combinations while dancing in the face of danger.

games.name: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
games.summary: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

games.name: Charlatan
games.summary:
A slot-machine roguelike built on dirty tricks.
Rig the reels and escape a cursed amusement park, before it takes your soul.

games.name: Bug Bounce
games.summary: A co-op action roguelike where you evolve insect heroes, build absurdly powerful loadouts, crush swarms of enemies, and fling your friends through chaotic physics-based combat.

games.name: Hotel Paraíso
games.summary: Explore this ancient haunted establishment in a game that blends RPG, puzzle, and turn-based strategy mechanics, and investigate the powerful tremor that has unleashed thousands of supernatural creatures, as the dreamlike and the magical intertwine.

games.name: Ariadne's Tale
games.summary: Ariadne's Tale is a 3D first-person puzzle adventure. Play as Ariadne, use a magical thread, navigate ancient traps and unravel the secrets of the Labyrinth to rescue Theseus. Myth, cunning and biting humor around every corner.

games.name: Hyve
games.summary:
The First and Only 2v2 Digital Card Game
Combine cards with your teammate in real-time to create powerful synergies and defeat your opponents in fast-paced 2v2 matches.

games.name: Kopernicus: Extraction
games.summary: Incremental suffering. Experience the 2-bit terror of the sole SSC KOPERNICUS survivor. Expand your base, construct weapons and face nightmares while trying to EXTRACT forgotten memories. There is no escape from THE THINGS you love.

games.name: Inherited Shadows
games.summary: Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother's absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.

games.name: Pair at Sea
games.summary: Manage your own pirate crew and sail across the sea. Take care of the ship morale, drag your sailors from one room to another and raid other ships as you navigate the seas.

games.name: Haunted Cleaner
games.summary: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

games.name: True Confession
games.summary:
Dramatic and hardcore pixel art shooter that turns into crossroad of anger, gilt, religion and psychoanalysis

True Confession is a game aimed at fans of action movies 80-00 years (Heat, Training Day, The Wire, The Departured). In visual style resembles POSTAL, Crimsonland, GTA2. So it's oldschool but seasoned with modern mechanics and deep religious and psychological plot.

The game is hardcore, each opponent can pose a fatal threat and gives rise to a healthy sense of rivalry. True Confession is distinguished by its down-to-earthness, the game does not have automatic health regeneration and superpowers, an important distinctive mechanic of the game is "anger".

As the game aims to feel grounded, there are no rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or tanks — this game is about crime in the streets, not the battlefield.

Let's pray/play together!

games.name: Clutch
games.summary: Clutch is a fast-paced arcade racing game which will challenge the resilience of anyone's nerves. You play as a person who has survived a catastrophe of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), while everyone else in the city has been transformed into a bloodthirsty zombie.

games.name: Astral Dive
games.summary: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

games.name: Come To My Party!
games.summary: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.
aliases: わたしのパーティにきて!

games.name: Dead Rose
games.summary: Hand-crafted 2D pixel art action-adventure. Play as Lucky, a skeleton lost in the world of spirits, and set out in search of Rose through a dark and magical world that blends Metroidvania exploration with Zelda-like adventure.

games.name: Foxfire
games.summary: Full Thrust, Full Inertia, Full Auto! FOXFIRE is a top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

games.name: Moonlight Pale
games.summary: Juliette follows the ghost of her dead cat into a nightmare where she has to fight and solve puzzles through eerily familiar corridors as she tries to survive and help the rest of the girls trapped inside. Discover the sins buried under St. Birgitta's Female Seminary.

games.name: They Stop for Gas at Night
games.summary: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

games.name: AmaTisMo
games.summary: A visual novel about depression and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind players.

games.name: The Cinderling
games.summary:
The Cinderling is an immersive, rhythmic blacksmith and shop keeper game.
Complete mini-games and feel the heat of the cracking coals, work the bellows to push the flames and strike the anvil in perfect time.

Stay in sync with the music and lose yourself in the rhythmic ring of hammered iron.
Explore a narrative rich world. Get to know the eccentric customers and the reason behind their weird requests. Uncover the secrets of the forge. And break the curse that binds you!eries of the forge.

games.name: Haparoot
games.summary: Step into a dream world. Become the sole source of light in the darkness and Explore an authentic handcrafted landscape in third-person. Solve layered environmental puzzles, discuss some familiar issues and uncover secrets shaping the journey toward balance.

games.name: Starship Bloopers
games.summary: Starship Bloopers is a chaotic co-op space survival game where one wrong move can doom the mission. Play with 2 to 6 crewmates as you traverse space, gather resources, survive disasters, battle aliens and each other's incompetence before the sun goes supernova. Can you keep your SHIP together?

games.name: Cages: Hidden Worlds
games.summary: Cages: Hidden Worlds is an immersive first-person puzzle escape game, where every sound, shadow, and mechanism bring an eerie sense of mystery and impending doom. Solve the workings of complex, original machinery you’ve never seen before and uncover the secrets buried inside them.

games.name: Between the Shelves
games.summary: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

games.name: Cyberwars
games.summary: Cyberwars is a turn-based tactics roguelike. You move infantry, vehicles, helicopters, naval units, and aircraft across hand-built maps, capture cities and factories for production, hold airports and ports to control the air and sea, and use terrain and fog of war to break the enemy line.

games.name: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror built on stealth and dread. Raise your real phone to reveal what your screen can't — hidden threats, impossible paths, and the truth about a sister who vanished 15 years ago. What took Emily never left, and it remembers you.

games.name: Cozy Interiors
games.summary: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.

games.name: Ignitement
games.summary: As a fire shaman, descend into a meditative battle against your inner demons. Wield explosive fire magic in a rogue-lite inferno. Burn through hordes, gather coins, unlock upgrades, and master the flame.

games.name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
games.summary: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games like Star Control, Solar Winds, and Lightspeed. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat; build out modular, upgradable ships; and explore a galaxy torn by war.

games.name: The Bed Above My Head
games.summary: Youre playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

games.name: The Sinkhole
games.summary: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouseyour real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

games.name: Kwad
games.summary: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

games.name: Rebel Roar
games.summary: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

games.name: Crop and Claw 2
games.summary: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

games.name: Elysium
games.summary:
Elysium is a next-generation third-person mmorpg featuring a seamless open world, multiplayer gameplay, survival mechanics, crafting systems, AI companions, and player-driven progression; created by Mercenary Games, Elysium combines the best elements of mmorpgs, rpgs, open-world adventures, strategy games, and social multiplayer experiences into a living universe shaped by both players and artificial intelligence.
Explore vast lands, discover hidden secrets, build your legacy, participate in large-scale events, develop professions, engage in trade, battle powerful enemies, and influence the evolving world around you.

games.name: Jawed
games.summary: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

games.name: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
games.summary: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

games.name: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
games.summary: An action roguelike deckbuilder with a twist: build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver’s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are observing you. Although it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin flips, you were the one to take its job offer.

games.name: Incyanspace
games.summary: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

games.name: Most Scuffed Golf
games.summary: Build the course, then break it. Most Scuffed Golf is mini-golf for 1–4 couch players: each one places a tile in the hole layout, then everyone shoots through the chaos you all built together. Ramps, curves, bridges — and a hole that's always somehow still reachable.

games.name: Gods Play Dice
games.summary: A dice themed roguelike where every roll matters, and your journey will be lead by faith.. Luck isn't on your side, it is the game. Throw dice. Adapt. Survive, and most importantly believe in your dices.

games.name: Irondrive
games.summary: Irondrive is a top-down vehicular roguelike with real-time crew management. Players command a massive moving fortress crossing a hostile wasteland, managing a crew that fights fires, repairs critical systems, and mans weapons while the vehicle takes damage from combat and environmental hazards. Inspired by the crew survival mechanics of RimWorld and the tense, chaotic decision-making of FTL: Faster Than Light.

games.name: Deepward
games.summary: Choose 3 heroes from a roster of six, each with distinct weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Build the right squad, switch between heroes on the fly, and fight relentless horrors in this fast-paced horror FPS roguelite set in the 1920s. Descend beneath a god-forsaken place where death is permanent.

games.name: Protocol Bound
games.summary: Bound is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

games.name: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
games.summary: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

games.name: Souq Boss Simulator
games.summary: Run your own Baqala in a nostalgic 2002 Gulf neighborhood inspired by old Dubai and Riyadh. Stock iconic childhood products, serve familiar faces, complete quests, unlock special items, make deliveries with friends, and use your BB Gun to stop thieves as you build your way to becoming the Souq Boss

games.name: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
games.summary: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

games.name: Ultimate Lemon Basket
games.summary: Ultimate lemon basket is a platformer where you lose if you drop a lemon on the ground. Between you and the goal are ghosts, cows, snipers, acid rain, hopes, dreams and other things AS WELL!!

games.name: Billionaire Life Simulator
games.summary: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

games.name: Seasons of Books and Keys
games.summary: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

games.name: Conatus: Forgotten Depths
games.summary: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon defines a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and unravel the mysteries of a world built from everything humanity chose to forget.

games.name: Dance of the Butterflies
games.summary: Your twin sister is missing. Under her name, you uncover a deadly system where 50 people compete for a Wish powerful enough to change anything. The price of entry is a piece of yourself, signed away in a contract. Survive. Find her. And try not to lose yourself to the people you meet along the way.

games.name: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
games.summary: This is the most chaotic farm in the universe. Combine 150+ crazy items to theorycraft game-breaking builds. Trigger massive, automated chain reactions to skyrocket your yields, poop to win!

games.name: I Want to Play the Villain!
games.summary: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

games.name: Harvesters
games.summary: A short incremental game about gathering resources in different planets. Upgrade the harvesters, unlock new buildings, and unlock new ways to gather resources! It's all about watching lil people do their thing.

games.name: Not Monsters
games.summary: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

games.name: Lexicon
games.summary: Reality calls you home. Will you return to her? Lexicon is a 2D single-player puzzle adventure game where you escape back to reality by ascending the six layers of Limbo, uncovering its secrets, overcoming its challenges, and discovering the truth of who you really are. #duckinadungeon

games.name: The Missing Threads
games.summary: Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

games.name: Capitol Diktatoria
games.summary: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

games.name: Me and You
games.summary: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

games.name: Steel Core
games.summary: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

games.name: Magic Shop Chaos
games.summary: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

games.name: Just Another Guild Day
games.summary: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

games.name: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
games.summary: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

games.name: Party's Over: Backyard Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: A satisfying first-person cleanup sim. Collect trash, cash it in, unlock upgrades and new areas, and piece together what really happened last night.

games.name: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
games.summary: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

games.name: The Ignition Protocol
games.summary: The Ignition Protocol is an incremental, top-down mining game set in space. Mine and haul asteroids in zero-g, build and automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

games.name: No Clean, No Exit
games.summary: A 1-6 player co-op horror comedy about cleaning. Mop the filth out of a procedurally generated house while roaches, bedbugs, and ceiling-crawling spiders try to drag you off. The truck doesn't leave until the place is spotless.

games.name: Deadline: Afterlife Processing
games.summary: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

games.name: Armed-Mageddon
games.summary: Grab some guns, mow down endless enemies and grow insanely powerful! Equip outrageous weapons, level up with game-changing upgrades, and create devastating synergies as you blast your way through the end of the world!

games.name: HopScout
games.summary: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

games.name: The Necessary Evil
games.summary: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

games.name: Kayak Photography Sim
games.summary: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

games.name: Vital Decisions
games.summary: Take charge of a chaotic emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

games.name: Diss Diss Discussion
games.summary: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

games.name: Silent Mainland
games.summary: Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder based on movement and grid mechanics. Players engage in tactical battles on a vast 5x12 battlefield. Facing waves of oncoming monsters, use card-driven movement and positional control to defeat foes in dynamic formations.

games.name: Blight Doctors
games.summary: Discover, diagnose, exorcise. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

games.name: The 7th Shift
games.summary: A psychological horror game about working overnight shifts alone in a grocery store. Stock shelves. Clean. Do your job. But you soon realize something sinister is watching. Survive seven shifts to discover why you were really hired and face a choice that will seal your fate.

games.name: Fleshgrinder
games.summary:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic action-rpg where every decision has weight.
Set in 2053, six months after the Fleshgrinder virus outbreak transformed 70% of augmented humanity into a hive-minded techno-organic collective.

Features three distinct characters with their own skill trees, optional friendly fire, hardcore permadeath mode, dismemberment physics, randomized mission areas, 30+ unique weapons, 100+armors, augmentations, consumables, ammo types with deep penetration mechanics and tons of loot with highly randomized attributes. NPCs with lots of side-quests and a faction reputation system which determines trade prices, dialogue choices and overall behaviour. Battle 11 unique enemy types through seamless mission areas in a huge persistent world where everything stays as you left it - all to stop the evolution of the Fleshgrinder and save humanity from extinction.

games.name: Dino Cleanup
games.summary: Toxic goop has spread across the dinosaur land! Use the power of the vacuum to clean your way through multiple levels, being rewarded for fully cleaning. Make new dinosaur friends you save along the way and uncover the ancient secrets around the source of the goop.

games.name: Hollow Crew
games.summary: Hollow Crew is a survival horror set in the confines of an isolated space station. Its loyal androids have suddenly been turned against you - survive their relentless hunt and contain the emergency, or die trying.

games.name: RoboSquare: Recharged
games.summary: Race friends, crush rivals, and master five chaotic minigames! RoboSquare: Recharged is a fast-paced 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump, and slam opponents off the map. Customize your bot, climb the leaderboards, and claim the crown!

games.name: Team Hero Coder
games.summary: Assemble your team of heroes. Program their strategy with PseudoC or C#. Watch them battle, learn from what happens, and improve your code. Are you game to code?

games.name: Greenrise
games.summary: Greenrise is a short and cozy incremental game about chopping wood, breaking stones and mining gold to buy upgrades and grow your island.

games.name: Unexpected Tasks
games.summary: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

games.name: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
games.summary: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

games.name: Ravenous Greed
games.summary: Trapped in the body of a raven, Pacer begins his quest to restore his human form. He must collect all of the treasures to fill his vault with coins! Only with enough wealth can he finally overcome the curse.

games.name: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell pets, place stands, decorate your store, satisfy customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate pet shop.

games.name: Family Time
games.summary: Build a family with thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

games.name: Deck Breaker
games.summary: Deck Breaker is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder in which players choose a hero, build a deck during branching quests, combine spells, characters, and artifacts, and preserve selected foil cards across runs.

games.name: Open Land
games.summary: Transform barren land into a thriving ecosystem in this relaxing building game. Recycle trash, grow plants, and reintroduce wildlife to create a self-sustaining world.

games.name: Seaside Wash
games.summary: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

games.name: Fox Stamps
games.summary: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

games.name: Still Breathing
games.summary: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

games.name: Heroll: If
games.summary: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

games.name: RingOut
games.summary: Grab a weapon and blast your rivals out of the arena. RingOut is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter with 23 fighters, 13 weapons and 29 arenas. Play solo against bots or battle online — team up or go free-for-all across 6 explosive modes.

games.name: Astrocraft
games.summary: Open your own shop on a space station: stock the shelves, serve space travelers, and grow from a lone miner into a space tycoon. Mine asteroids for goods, hire a crew of robots, found outposts, and take to the stars in your own ship, solo or with up to four friends.

games.name: Infant God
games.summary: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

games.name: Really Illegal Golf
games.summary: A stealth golf adventure in places nobody dared to take golf. Slip past security and line up risky shots. Tee up in cities, beaches, ski resorts, military sites and more. Keep quiet and sink it under par.

games.name: Toxic Frontier
games.summary: Unlock powerful cards and build a safe haven for your people within a world in ruins. In this roguelike city-builder, deploy cards across a hex grid to expand your colony and purify the land, buying another day of survival in the noxious wastes.

games.name: Graveheart
games.summary: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

games.name: No Truce With The Groceries
games.summary: No Truce With The Groceries is a Disco-lite narrative point-and-click adventure set in the decaying hinterland of a declining America.

games.name: Too Many Clankers
games.summary: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: too many clankers. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the clankers to scrap.

games.name: Bloom Control
games.summary: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

games.name: Cursed Gas Station
games.summary: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

games.name: Shiki Tea House
games.summary: Shiki Tea House is a single-player cozy life-sim game. Open a little cozy tea shop and take part in farming, running tea business, exploring the town and more.

games.name: Night at the Fun Park
games.summary: A horror game set in an abandoned amusement park. Players search for exit keys while avoiding a giant spider, using noise to distract it and freeing captured teammates from cocoons.

games.name: Cards after Midnight
games.summary: A dark roguelike card adventure where a deadly curse controls the clock. Become a savage werewolf at midnight and a weapon-wielding survivor by day while escaping the villagers hunting you down.

games.name: The Wrong Ones
games.summary: The Wrong Ones is a dialogue-driven social deduction game where players must unmask Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight among innocent townspeople. Stripping away action and visual giveaways, the experience challenges players to rely entirely on logic, active observation, and critical reasoning to catch the monsters through what they say—and what they leave out.

games.name: Honey or Else
games.summary: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.

games.name: The Final Lane
games.summary: Realistic bowling meets deckbuilding roguelike where the balls are the cards! Draft a synergistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle the fellow damned as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

games.name: Theoria: A God Simulator
games.summary: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

games.name: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
games.summary: Idle Incremental MMORPG Simulator where you start grinding manually, then gradually unlock Bot Modules until the game plays itself. Setup combat behavior and farming routes to find the most optimal configuration.

games.name: S.O.V.A.
games.summary: S.O.V.A. is a first-person psychological horror about a Yugoslav AI built to predict wars and disasters, then shut down under suspicion it was also influencing them. Inspired by a real bunker and re-imagined history. What happens when the AI finds a way to survive?

games.name: Photoncytosis
games.summary: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation in which a tiny organism feeds on the light of the screen and grows while the player works. Each cell stores energy, and absorbed colors influence the organism's development. Players can inspect cells under a microscope, research mutations, move creatures toward light, and confine them to an application window. Specialized cells support harvesting, perception, movement, energy storage, and repair. Organisms can split, regroup, and compete for resources in a changing desktop ecosystem.

games.name: Contract Terminated
games.summary: Lead your band of mercenaries and figure out a way to survive on a hostile planet in this oldschool 1980s-style party-based RPG with pixel graphics. Features a mix of grid-based movement, turn-based tactical combat, and first-person dungeon crawling just like the classics.

games.name: Martial Art's History
games.summary: Martial Art’s History: Early Republican China kung fu fighter inspired by classic kung fu films. Play varied warriors with unique authentic martial arts. Retro flat art depicts old dojos and arenas, with single-player story and local 2P duels & solid fluid melee combat.

games.name: Mise en War
games.summary: A multiplayer cooking brawl for 2 to 8 players. Race to finish your recipe by chopping, frying, and baking while slapping rivals, stealing their prepared food, and deploying hilarious sabotage traps in a shared, chaotic kitchen arena!

games.name: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
games.summary: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

games.name: Curse of Cards
games.summary: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

games.name: The Facility
games.summary: You look different today. Yesterday, you looked different too. Which one is really you? A psychological horror game about paranoia, identity, and the fear of trusting the wrong person.

games.name: Jubaku
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

games.name: Rondo's Romp
games.summary: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

games.name: Pew Pew Magic Wizard Fighter
games.summary: It's Wizard VS Wizard in this isometric arcade battle blaster! Dominate a gauntlet of Best-of-5 duels across unique, destructible arenas that change with every match. Out-maneuver rivals with your chosen fighter's special moves to an eclectic electronic score by inflexi0n.

games.name: Lemony Fresh
games.summary: You are a tiny lemon who cleans filthy spaces. Explore and restore a home with a warm, beating heart.

games.name: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
games.summary: Wonder Air: Lunaras Adventure is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

games.name: Dronefall
games.summary: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

games.name: Gamble Hunters
games.summary: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

games.name: Dave the Diver: Subnautica 2
games.summary: Dave the Diver dives into the mysterious world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure. New waters, strange creatures, and unexpected discoveries await beyond the portal.

games.name: Frostmason
games.summary: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

games.name: Synapse
games.summary: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller where your emotional score determines everything. Explore a city under constant surveillance, hack its systems, build dangerous connections, and make choices that decide your access - and whether you survive the night.

games.name: Freshly Caught
games.summary: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

games.name: Tiny Patisserie
games.summary: Run your own cozy pastry shop. Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

games.name: Taskbar Chickens
games.summary: Taskbar Chickens is a cozy desktop companion game where a tiny chicken farm lives on top of your Windows taskbar while you work or play other games. Pet your chickens, toss them around and let them wander across your desktop. Breed them to hatch new chickens with unique looks and outfits, grow crops to keep them fed, clean up after them, and sell eggs to unlock new tools, structures and skills. Grow your collection and turn a small taskbar farm into a thriving chicken empire at your own pace.

games.name: Dungeons of Destiny
games.summary: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Loot! Dungeons of Destiny is an action-packed anime 3D dungeon crawler. Explore perilous dungeons, defeat formidable fantasy creatures, master powerful skills, and gather valuable loot to strengthen your character.

games.name: Hit the Anvil
games.summary: Strike the anvil, forge rare gear, and build your legacy in a pixel-art incremental crafting game.

games.name: Hex Party
games.summary: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.

games.name: Project: Null Hypothesis
games.summary: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

games.name: Massively Singleplayer
games.summary: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

games.name: Laylines
games.summary: Laylines is a sailing management game set in the world of the oldest trophy in sailing. The player runs a challenger syndicate competing against five rivals for the right to face the defender. Off the water, the game covers crew scouting and contracts, training, sailor careers and retirement, boat research and development with component reliability and sea trials, design philosophy and target wind, sponsors, TV rights, merchandising and headquarters upgrades. On the water, match race duels play out in real time, boat against boat, under real racing rules: right of way, penalties, laylines, wind zones and shifts. Each Cup is made up of round robin groups, a Semi-final, a Challenger Final and the Cup Final, followed by a new season with a rule change, in an open-ended campaign.

games.name: Warstead
games.summary: Build your base, secure vital resources, and lead your troops into battle. Warstead combines base building with tactical real-time combat. Will you invest in your economy, strengthen your defenses—or launch an attack?

games.name: Cue Knight
games.summary: Cue Knight is a physics-based roguelite inspired by billiards. Slingshot yourself through dungeons, smashing monsters with precision shots. Collect powerful weapons and items, upgrade your stats, and clear an endless series of rooms in as few moves as possible.

games.name: Police Stories 2
games.summary:
Police Stories 2 is a cooperative tactical top-down police shooter.

The sequel to the iconic Police Stories will feature new challenges, new mechanics, and a brand-new story. Take command of a rundown precinct in the most crime-ridden part of the city. With limited resources, dangerous choices, and enemies on every side, the line between justice and compromise starts to blur.
Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Survive the system.

games.name: Forgotten Towns
games.summary: Build a flourishing settlement above a dangerous cave system. Explore unique biomes, manage happiness and grief, invite traders, defend against invasions, train soldiers, recruit heroes, defeat world bosses, and prepare to dig into the depths below.

games.name: Watch Out: Shark!
games.summary: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

games.name: 7Komada
games.summary: A social deduction death game set in a backwater of alternate universe Europe. You and your class's graduation trip has been cut short by a novel 19-man kidnapping - and as you all wake up trapped in an abandoned mansion, you take it upon yourself to figure out what's going on before it's too late.

games.name: Unwanted Guest
