games.summary: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a gloriously grotesque monster horror sim. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation!

games.name: Chosen Anyway: Card Game
games.summary: Chosen Anyway is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder with permanent progression. Build your deck each run, face challenging bosses, and grow stronger as your cards scale with Ryn's RPG stats.

games.name: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier
games.summary: Star Trek: Shadow Frontier is a story-driven, action-adventure set in the expansive Star Trek universe. Step into the fractured mind of former Lieutenant Ro Laren (voiced by Michelle Forbes) as she seeks to rescue an old friend by embarking on a harrowing journey of survival and self-discovery.

games.name: Brassfang
games.summary: Explore a castle filled with monsters and sinister experiments in this steampunk action RPG metroidvania. Combine vampiric and mechanical powers, face challenging bosses, and create unique builds through randomized upgrade choices.

games.name: Bad Magpie
games.summary: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

games.name: Senua
games.summary: A Celtic warrior is trapped between life and death in a fractured vision of purgatory. In an action‑adventure set in the Hellblade universe, Senua fights to reach the afterlife and reunite with those she loved and lost, battling forces that threaten all she believes in.

games.name: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
games.summary: Magicians: The Devils Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

games.name: Red Kiss
games.summary: Dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty Tactical Narrative RPG.

games.name: Wardens of Avalon
games.summary: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

games.name: Smalland II: Lost Realms
games.summary: The Smallfolk are back with a massively expanded universe in this open-world survival adventure set on a tiny scale! Enjoy up to 10 player co-op where you craft weapons and armor, form companionships with creatures, build encampments, and discover strange new lands.

games.name: Sunset Survival: Miami
games.summary: Gear up, get out, and survive the neon-soaked apocalypse. Sunset Survival: Miami is a top-down PvE extraction shooter. Raid a mutant-infested Miami for vital supplies, blast your way through enemy hordes, upgrade your base, and unlock powerful skills. Can you make it out alive?

games.name: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton
games.summary: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rival sorcerers, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.

games.name: Xenoblade Genesis
games.summary: A new beginning for the Xenoblade series is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

games.name: Pikuniku 2
games.summary: Absurd puzzle-exploration adventure Pikuniku 2 brings the whimsy! Wander, solve, and gossip your way through a weird and wonderful world where not everything is as happy as it seems. Protect the potato!

games.name: Save Humanity.exe
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder based around designing a microchip from a pile of junk circuits to out compute incoming viruses trying to crash your system. Combo hardware with software programs to chain multipliers that overflow your FLOP meter before the glitches overwhelm you.

games.name: Renegade Run
games.summary: Renegade Run is a rogue-lite deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

games.name: Echoes of Midnight
games.summary: Bound. Dressed. Displayed. A serial killer's ritual has begun — and you're the centerpiece. Use silence as your weapon, solve the killer's twisted puzzle, and escape before midnight. Play solo, survive together in co-op, or become the hunter in versus mode.

games.name: Eclipse
games.summary: Three friends known as The Ghost Hunters are documenting abandoned locations. What begins as a normal episode suddenly turns into a nightmare inside The Holloway Mansion. Something terrifying happens, leaving Jack to survive alone in the mansion and face the horrors.

games.name: Might of Fate
games.summary: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

games.name: World Railway
games.summary: In World Railway, a sim management game, you're a conductor reviving a rundown train. Produce and gather resources via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

games.name: Hunter White
games.summary: White Hunt is a 2.5D open sandbox co-op hunting game. Every weapon features unique branching attack chains. Mix and match countless talismans to forge your exclusive combat style!

games.name: Herd
games.summary:
Herd is a cute-but-competitive tactical card battler set in a magical musical world.
Build your deck, and face your rival in fast strategic duels where every card you play becomes part of a live musical performance.

But victory is not about reducing health points.

In Herd, you win by converting the Mélodus — adorable divine creatures who react to music, magic and momentum. Read your opponent, control the stage, trigger powerful synergies, and turn the crowd before your rival does.

games.name: Broken Cycle
games.summary: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically — while you engineer their battle tactics, loot, craft and enchant their gear.

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Bosch & Outfit 2 & Outfit 3 (Yasmine, Arjun, Tifa, Bosch)
Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Tifa & Outfit 2
Wanderdawn
games.summary: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

games.name: Loaded Dice
games.summary: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in Loaded Dice, a fast action-strategy party game.

games.name: Shadows of Eldemir
games.summary: Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, Victorian cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG, where a London schoolmaster travels to a remote Eastern European village searching for his missing fiancée, only to discover the archaeological expedition she joined may have disturbed something ancient.

games.name: Monji
games.summary: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. Monjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !

games.name: Mori
games.summary: Experience lightning-fast combat as Mori, a grieving widow on a quest for revenge. Armed with nothing but a scythe and cloak, carve your way through countless foes, dismantle a criminal empire, and discover what it means to lose yourself.

games.name: Insomnia Club
games.summary: Insomnia Club is a dark, grounded emotional visual novel about early-adult confusion, social issues, intimacy, and self-identity. You play as a long-term insomniac employee whose life gradually slips out of control as reality tightens around you.

games.name: Cresata
games.summary: Betrayed. Imprisoned. Left to die. Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

games.name: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
aliases: Muv-Luv: Tactics 迦梨陀娑的噩梦
Muv-Luv: Tactics 迦梨陀娑的惡夢
games.summary: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

games.name: Dhalman
games.summary: Dhalman is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

games.name: MoonHack
aliases: Jinrui Saitekika Keikaku: Eden Protocol - Order of 2125
games.summary: MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world. The story segments are closely integrated with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized with vocal performances, and through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten.

games.name: Elderfeast
games.summary: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

games.name: Motorsport Manager 2
games.summary: The world of motorsport returns in the next evolution of the ultimate motorsport management sim. Compete in multiple series, master deeper strategy than ever before, and lead your team to victory on and off the track. Build your racing legacy.

games.name: Deltarune: Chapter 6
games.summary: An upcoming chapter for Deltarune.

games.name: Sticks and Stones
games.summary: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid (or asteroids) impact.

games.name: I Shall Name the Dead
games.summary: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

games.name: Precinct IX
games.summary: Precinct IX is a cyberpunk police management and turn-based combat game. Receive visitors, manage cases and resources, dispatch unique officers to unstable scenes, and change case outcomes—and your relationships—through dialogue, command, and battle.

games.name: Hemlon the Grey
games.summary: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

games.name: Pact of the Black Tide
games.summary: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

games.name: Hatsune Miku Starry Party
aliases: 初音ミク スターリーパーティ

games.name: 3Souls
games.summary: 3 Souls is an isometric open-world adventure set in a vast archipelago. Control three brothers with unique playstyles, explore forgotten ruins, and gather resources to build your base. Uncover the secrets of the Althmerium in a grand journey where your choices shape the fate of a shattered world.

games.name: Oath Eternal
games.summary: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

games.name: Carpet Cleaning Master
games.summary: Clean filthy carpets until they look new again. Mind each one's rules, watch your water and power bills, and try not to think too hard about the company you work for. A cozy cleaning sim with something underneath.

games.name: Torizon Telecom
games.summary: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

games.name: Whiskers In The Sand
games.summary: Whiskers In The Sand is a fast-paced survivors-like arena roguelite where battle-ready cats shred through hordes of undead desert monsters. Unlock new cats, collect relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds to survive the pharaoh's second reign.

games.name: Attack Only
games.summary: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

games.name: Black Well Devil
games.summary: Ascend from the depths of hell in Black Well Devil, the stylish high-stakes platformer. Flick yourself into the air to reach higher heights, fall again and again, fight challenging bosses, and mayhaps fall in love.

games.name: Dung Slinger
games.summary: An action-packed physics platformer about being chained to a giant dung ball! Master a complex movement system to move, swing and launch yourself forward. Defeat enemies, overcome obstacles and regain your freedom in a game that blends traditional platforming with a tight physics system!

games.name: The Subminer
games.summary: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

games.name: Steel Princess
games.summary: A Souls‑like 3D action game starring a spirited princess. Defeat powerful foes scattered across the open field to unlock new skills, grow stronger, and keep pressing forward!

games.name: Keyboard Smash
games.summary:
Keyboard Smash is a fully voice acted story driven comedy game about running a small store while the characters around you are too stupid for their own good.
Help strange and random customers, travel to many bizarre locations, and make choices that turn the story upside down.

games.name: American Navy Seals
games.summary: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

games.name: Balance: Umbilical Wake
games.summary: Step into a fishermans recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move. Learn the worlds rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up. But the nightmare keeps returning until your childs birth begins to reshape it.

games.name: Ringwyrm
games.summary: Ringwyrm is an immersive action horror game with survival elements. Explore a nonlinear interconnected world, meet a large cast of memorable characters, slay a huge cast of sickly monstrosities and avoid myriad diseases and ailments.

games.name: Agro Tycoon
games.summary: Grow a farming empire from a single plot of land. Agro Tycoon is an isometric pixel art management simulator where you're not just a farmer - you're the CEO of your own agricultural operation.

games.name: Legend of Bakehime
games.summary: A thrilling Japanese-style action game featuring Saya, a half-yokai princess who fires spiritual arrows from her bow, and Jubei, her kind-hearted retainer who wields a spear with mastery. Together, they stand against waves of terrifying yokai through the power of their bond!

games.name: Häxeri
games.summary: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

games.name: Jay and Silent Bob's: Joint Venture
games.summary: After Jay and Silent Bob sell you a bad dimebag, you help New Jersey’s legendary slackers take their operation from a rundown backyard to the best operation in the tri-state area in this gleefully obscene cozy farming adventure.

games.name: The Money Man
games.summary: A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes

games.name: Nursery Rhyme: Full HD Remaster
games.summary: An all ages remaster of Nursery Rhyme with a new Kururu route, re-recorded and re-arranged OP/ED songs and movies.

games.name: Spirefall
games.summary: The wars are fake. The grudges are real. A roguelite deckbuilder set in the taverns of Spirefall — win the Gauntlet, build your caravan, and conquer the greatest tables in the realm. One card at a time. Probably after questioning the stew.

games.name: Ladder Lad
games.summary: In a world that has forgotten how to jump, one Lad must rise. Climb, wobble, and bounce your way to new heights in this challenging, 100% ladder-themed precision platformer.

games.name: Dice Crawler
games.summary: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

games.name: My Perfect Nails
games.summary: My Perfect Nails is a retro simulation game inspired by the 2000's web games, where you create the perfect set of nails for your customers! Choose between many options and accessories to create the nails of their dreams! ✨

games.name: Monster Girl Clinic
games.summary: Welcome to Monster Girl Clinic. You arrive as a patient — but something here isn't adding up. Get to know the clinic's unusual staff, follow the clues, and uncover what's really going on, in a story-driven visual novel of mystery, romance, and monster girls.

games.name: Man I Just Wanna Live
games.summary: Mia wakes up with a hangover and a dead body in her apartment. Unfortunately, the body has friends who are about to break in through the front door. From there, things only get worse. This "MSPaint-noir" VN with 16 endings is as stylish as it is relentless. Mia just wants to live! Well, who doesn’t?

games.name: Girlfailure Art Club
games.summary: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

games.name: Cheeky Cheerhythm
games.summary: "Wanna crush my pride? No way, you wimp!♡" Coach your proud student Iroha, designed by Asanagi, in this physical rhythm game! No matter your flawless timing, you'll get cheeky banter. Yet, your coaching works: her smooth Live2D animations react in real-time to your rhythm!

games.name: Goblin God
games.summary: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

games.name: Desouled
games.summary: How many times have you wished you could forget and just sleep? Desouled forces you to look at what we avoid seeing: raw, cruel, sometimes inhuman stories. All of them real. In a relentless fight, dodging is your only defense. You can't win. You can only survive.

games.name: Cold Case
games.summary: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

games.name: Kimbap Factory
games.summary: Automate the ultimate Korean kitchen. Route belts, watch ingredients transform, and physically assemble each kimbap roll step by step. Discover new recipes, fulfill requests, and expand your kitchen at your own pace. No pressure, no timers, just a satisfying and unique casual factory experience.

games.name: Sin or Suffer
games.summary: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

games.name: Ignite the Depths
games.summary: Ignite the Depths is a cooperative hack-and-slash dungeon crawler set across three hand-crafted dimensions. Venture into the Abyss alone or form a party of up to four players to battle monstrous creatures, solve environmental puzzles, and forge wildly different builds.

games.name: Across Crime
games.summary: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

games.name: Panic 64
games.summary: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

games.name: Susuki Kaidan
games.summary: A first-person survival horror set in the dying fields of Sengoku Japan. To reach Kyoto and escape the war, a lone survivor must cross endless fields of susuki grass while the White Ghost watches from within.

games.name: Lilith
games.summary: Every head is a world. Lilith is a folk-art puzzle-platformer set inside nesting dolls: climb into heads, hang characters on your tree to wear their skills, and descend through an İstanbul of graveyards, malls and rooftops, until you find the man in the shower.

games.name: Spell Breakers
games.summary: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

games.name: Hyperdrop
games.summary: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

games.name: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
games.summary: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

games.name: I Hear the Forest
games.summary: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

games.name: No Signal: Chornobyl
games.summary: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

games.name: C.A.G.E.
games.summary: C.A.G.E. is a satirical first-person narrative adventure where your choices influence the story. Guided by an entity with questionable morals, you must navigate through corporate gaslighting and environmental oddities to complete your tasks. Your empathy is a glitch, compliance is your currency.

games.name: Between Gods
games.summary: Between Gods is a punishing action roguelite where your crusade is to slay every god. Master precise parries, battle relentless foes, discover powerful gear from shops and enemy drops, and grow stronger by spending skill points after each death.

games.name: My Brother Hacker
games.summary: My Brother Hacker is a single-player hacking game set in 2036. Your brother has been missing for two weeks. He left a USB stick behind: an unfamiliar operating system, and an AI that starts teaching you how to break into networks.

games.name: Within The Experiments
games.summary: A system-driven turn-based RPG bringing new strategy to the classic Wizardry-style formula. Cut in on enemy actions with the "Interrupt Timeline Battle" system. Lead a five-member party, strengthen your team through combat and item discovery, and explore the dungeon's depths.

games.name: Clock Mayhem
games.summary:
Clock Mayhem is a fast-paced platformer built around urgency, where players must run quickly and overcome obstacles and challenges to reach the end of each level before it is too late.

What makes the game unique is that each level is designed with its own twists and challenges. Every stage has its own time limit and collectibles, providing a dynamic experience.

You will start with Luni, but other characters can be unlocked after completing all cycles. Each character has their own abilities and their own set of completely different levels, providing a unique gameplay experience. To master the entire game and set new records, players must complete every cycle with every character.

Each level you reach will automatically become available in Practice Mode, where you can select and replay it, learn its patterns, and improve without penalty. This helps you prepare for each cycle, since every cycle must be completed in one go to master it.

games.name: Medium Rare
games.summary: Medium Rare is a turn-based survival dungeon crawler set in a post-apocalyptic Pacific Northwest where cannibalism has been industrialized. Move floor to floor across a grid-based map, managing scarce ammo and resources while deciding when to push deeper for a richer haul and when to extract back to camp. Between runs, process what you carried out into permanent upgrades to your loadout and your camp, then go further.

games.name: Mica King
games.summary: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

games.name: Lovers Die
games.summary:
Beat the Devil at his own dice game. Get out of Hell with Romeo.

Upgrade your dice, hit target scores, unlock new story branches and see where your choices take you. Inspired by Shakespeare, Dante and Baz Lurhman, alongside games like Yahtzee, Lovers Die starts with Juliet waking up in purgatory with no way out, a handful of dice, and one thing she knows for sure: Romeo got there first.

To find him, she has to play her way through Hell, making deals, taking risks and figuring out what she's willing to sacrifice for redemption. Wagers, conversations and questions all give you choices. Some open new paths. Some close them. Some have consequences you won't see coming.

games.name: Stories Once Told: Echoes of Valor
games.summary: Cut your way through dark dungeons and solve riddles and puzzles, all from a first-person perspective. Choose your hero, master the tactical combat system, and face merciless bosses in solo mode or co-op.

games.name: Worms Galactic Tactics
games.summary: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

games.name: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
games.summary: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

games.name: Murals
games.summary: These are not the tales you were told. Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong.

games.name: Humankind II
games.summary: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

games.name: Age Twisters
games.summary: Age Twisters is a 2-player co-op narrative adventure game that allows you to send a free invite to friends via the Friend’s Pass. Play as a grandfather and granddaughter to solve puzzles by freely changing your age and reveal the dark secrets hidden beneath a facade of lies.

games.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow 6 Tactics
games.summary: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in the R6 universe. Command operator squads in tense battles, execute synchronized breaches, exploit destruction, and unravel a conspiracy.

games.name: Exterminauts
games.summary: Exterminauts is a co-op third-person PvE shooter using weaponized power tools and mad-science gadgets to exterminate alien pests. Take on MegaCorp contracts amid energy supremacy clashes, while aliens' thirst for Polymorphic Plasma disrupts plans. Punch In. Clean Up. Get Paid.

games.name: LEGO Skylines
games.summary: Build what only you can in LEGO Skylines. In this cozy, customizable city-builder, your choices bring a living, breathing metropolis to life. Go big or obsess over the details. No instructions. Unlimited space. And there’s just one rule. Make it yours.

games.name: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
aliases: Heroes of Might and Magic 3 Remake
games.summary: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

games.name: Vivid
games.summary: Be a plant in this cozy, narrative-driven plant survival simulation about nature, responsibility, and interconnected systems. You will grow procedurally over time, explore evolving environments, and shape a fragile ecosystem through meaningful choices.

games.name: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside
games.summary: Grandma calls for aid! Well she wants a visit, but she lives in the middle of nowhere. Pack wisely, step into the wilderness, and see if you can reach her!

games.name: Conquista: Tide of Wills
games.summary: Conquista a strategy game that blends colony sim w/ 4X gameplay. Build thriving cities and lead your nation to dominance. With living units who work, build relationships, and pursue ambitions of their own, you must respond to their desires. The seeds of history may be sown through one's dreams.

games.name: Nostra
games.summary: A story-driven dark fantasy JRPG with tactical party-based combat, built by a solo developer with external artists and musicians. Three kingdoms hold an uneasy peace while something older stirs beneath it. Leave your village and lead a party into a world of fragile beauty and gathering shadow.

games.name: Chosen By Odin
games.summary: Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga.

games.name: Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms
games.summary: Greak 2 is a hand-drawn co-op metroidvania adventure. After fleeing their invaded world, siblings Greak and Adara find themselves in the hostile lands of Synoraz. Split in parallel dimensions, they must work together to save the last Storm egg before the ancient species is lost forever

games.name: The Creature Mafia
games.summary: Battle creatures, survive the mob, and explore the city prohibition forgot! An action RPG + creature collector set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the mob?

games.name: Sweetheart
games.summary: Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.

games.name: Police Simulator
games.summary: The latest entry in the Police Simulator franchise lets you build your career in Faremont City. Take on over 50 missions and callouts, patrol with a K9 partner, drive specialized police vehicles, and play solo or with a friend.

games.name: Kingdom III: Rising Realms
games.summary: Protect your crown! Kingdom returns in an all-new micro-strategy and tower defense game set in a shattered realm. Embark on an atmospheric adventure across lands of legend to build a lasting legacy and challenge the empowered Greed threat.

games.name: Last Ditch Effort
games.summary: Enter a grimdark world consumed by endless war and join Igor on a desperate mission in Last-Ditch Effort, a pixel-art character-action game featuring fast-paced combat, handcrafted animation and stylized comic-book storytelling.

games.name: Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern
games.summary: Tired of going on adventures? Build and run the finest tavern in the coziest corner of the Dungeons & Dragons universe. Let heroes face danger, while you turn their tales into your fortune. Every legend needs a long rest.

games.name: Cutout
games.summary: Dismember your enemies and steal their limbs to gain new powers in this side-scrolling action horror game set in a grim, handcrafted fairy tale world made of paper. Rebuild Lena, child of the forest, and shape who she becomes through the choices you make.

games.name: Black Walls
games.summary: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

games.name: Rogue Fortune
games.summary: Fast-paced action roguelite where greed meets relentless combat, demanding ever stronger builds and sacrifices. Cut through hordes of monsters, arrange Relics into devastating arcane synergies, and gamble your newfound fortune for the strength to escape a temple determined to take it all back.

games.name: Rise of the Spellbaker
games.summary: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

games.name: Vaewolf
games.summary: Half-werewolf, half-vampire… all vengeance. Unleash your relentless wrath in a brutal, ceaseless quest for revenge in a bold Hack and Slash power fantasy set in the untamed English North.

games.name: Grampage: Life at 67
games.summary: Your retirement isn't going to fund itself! Pension not cutting it? No problem. Grab up to three fellow retirees, break into houses, and steal your way to the retirement you deserve. Work together when you have to - but remember: only one of you gets to retire!

games.name: Outblight
games.summary: "Nothing down there is what the stories say." A turn-based clash roguelite where you pit your moves against the enemy's, slot against slot and the stronger strike breaks through. Kirs takes the contracts nobody else will. The legends are silent about the abyss, so Kirs goes down to ask in person.

games.name: Escape the Exomoon
games.summary: Escape the Exomoon is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

games.name: Yttrium X
games.summary: Zellia Mots goes awol and steals yttrium X the Plutocracy of Yeoman's secret Mech in this PvE mech brawler!

games.name: Last Wail of the Sea King
games.summary: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

games.name: Retrobot
games.summary: The year is 2109, and Retrobots is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to kick some bot?

games.name: Likvar: Zoya
games.summary: You are assigned to Zoya, a candidate with 30 days to become a Likvar—a superpowered field operative. Manage her condition, send her on dangerous missions, and report or alter the results. Your choices shape her performance, trust, and future.

games.name: Super Bloom
games.summary: Grab your watering can, find some seeds and make the desert around you bloom. - No combat, no death, no timer. Just you and your garden.

games.name: Hound Riders
games.summary: A western post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where cards are bullets. Build your ammo, chain blood-magic combos, and target enemy aim spots in tactical turn-based duels. Explore a cursed wasteland in a nonlinear map where every route, shot, and choice matters.

games.name: My Friend, Dysentery
games.summary: A darkly comedic "horribly realistic fantasy travel simulator" survival adventure roguelike inspired by Oregon Trail. Journey to the Promised Land to kill a dragon! Fight monsters, manage supplies & disasters, and learn that fantasy journeys are nothing heroic like the films, but cripplingly brutal.

games.name: Shrine Labyrinth
games.summary: A 1–4 player co-op Japanese horror game. Beyond the torii gate lies an otherworldly labyrinth whose layout changes randomly. Work together to escape as you run from, hide from, and sometimes confront terrifying supernatural entities!

games.name: Silk & Sorrow
games.summary: Two children stumble into a hidden world where all the unwanted from humanity ends up to find new purpose. Together, they must explore a haunting, hand-drawn landscape, survive its twisted horrors, and uncover the origins of the Chrysalis

games.name: Fedanheim
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror set in a plant that runs on human flesh. Lose limbs, scavenge scrap, and craft prostheses at the workbench to open the way forward. Every replacement makes your steps louder, and something in the corridors hears everything. You cannot fight it. Run and hide.

games.name: Captive Love Melty Holic
aliases: ガチ恋監禁♡めるてぃほりっく
games.summary: Ruito, a popular underground idol, is suddenly kidnapped and confined in an unfamiliar abandoned building. Blocked by tricky traps and relentlessly pursued by obsessive stans—can Ruito safely escape this building of madness...?

games.name: Churrasco
aliases: Churrasco: Trying to Cook in Peace
games.summary: Be the family BBQ master and try to grill in peace while your chaotic relatives turn everything upside down. Manage the grill, handle food orders, complete quests, and capture memories.

games.name: Maneater 2
games.summary: The splash-hit ShaRkPG returns in Maneater 2! Eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom — an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster, where YOU are that disaster.

games.name: Uncanyon
games.summary: Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure that drops you into a forgotten world, tucked into the seam between unparallel realities.

games.name: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
games.summary:
Lurk in the shadows and hunt the shadows.
The Eminence in Shadow comes to home consoles for the first time!
Challenge the powerful opponents that stand in your way in this roguelite action game.

games.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger: A Hero's Eternal Legacy
CONQ: Crown of No Quarter
games.summary: You were promised the heavens, but found only eternal purgatory -- unable to escape, unable to truly die. Gather your forces across sea and land, show no mercy, and give your enemies no quarter. It's time to bleed again.

games.name: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
games.summary: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Story Expansion Pass
games.summary: Final Fantasy VII Revelation's Story Expansion Pass. This product includes Accessory: Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set, Story DLC 1: Sephiroth, and Story DLC 2: Vincent & the Turks.

games.name: Battle of the Kyoshin
games.summary: A miko gal and a Kyoshin go head-to-head with an enemy Kyoshin! Power up your Kyoshin as you fight, and take them down! Finish them with a trump-card Kamiwaza!

games.name: Carta Bellum
games.summary: A turn-based roguelike RPG for wizards with no self-control. Stack charms until your spark throws knives, calls meteors and builds Tesla turrets that zap whatever moves. Pick your path across a map of shops, treasure and weirdos. Rob graves or play the saint, and your magic goes holy or full devil.

games.name: Heartreasure: Recolor the World
aliases: 爱心之宝 重拾色彩
games.summary: “This world was never meant to be so blank!” Help Mary, a fairy Mendako who can’t remember her precious friend, as you find hidden hearts to bring color back to the world! A point-and-click hidden object adventure…Wait, why did the world disappear in the first place?

games.name: SinsKiller
games.summary:
SinsKiller is an action arcade shooter where you play as a fallen mage in a Dante's inspired Hell. You get to use your magic powers to obliterate hordes of enemies and bullet-hell bosses.

In SinsKiller you get a mix of bullet-hell and survivors like gameplay with no RNG, where movement, aim and timing matter most. You can choose from different magic elements to fit your playstyle then equip other items to create a build that feels truly yours. Each circle is inspired by the literary classis Divine Comedy while story itself draws inspiration from another Italian classic Jerusalem Delivered.

games.name: Lancelot: The Silver Knight
games.summary: Experience the legends of Lancelot: The Silver Knight, as he sets out on a quest to reclaim his title as a knight. A quirky top-down action-adventure game set in an mystical Brittany filled with enigmatic dungeons, legendary monsters and chickens?

games.name: The End of Allegoria
games.summary: A turn-based tactical RPG where your choices determine the fate of the world. Traverse a world that changes as you explore it, find new companions, and combine different class skills by mastering a multitude of equipment.

games.name: Rummy Attack
games.summary: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

games.name: The Miracle Of San Martin
games.summary:
A survival horror experience that mixes classic and modern elements, a story where faith meets fear.

Explore San Martín, a remote hispanic town where a missing girl, a pit in the outskirts, whispered miracles, unspeakable sins, and buried horrors, challenge everything a Priest believes.

games.name: The Stalked 4
games.summary: Desperate for work, 27-year-old George signs up for the remote lighthouse job. What starts as beautiful and peaceful scenery slowly turns unsettling day by day. Is it just your mind playing tricks on you? Or is someone else here...?

games.name: Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients
games.summary: Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients is a turn-based RPG set in the Tang Dynasty. As amnesiac Tianji Guard Shangguan Shuo, investigate the mysterious Xuanxin Order and uncover the truth of your past—only to discover your fate may be deeply tied to the Order.

games.name: Mana Alchemy
games.summary: An open-world bullet heaven RPG. Explore a cursed island, forge spells via alchemy, and arrange them in your grimoire like a puzzle. Mow down monster hordes and hunt your 7 ruling sisters. Your final choice—execute or forgive them—determines the ending of this dark fantasy.

games.name: Spirit of Diwata
games.summary: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

games.name: Alumbra
games.summary: Alumbra is a suspenseful and surreal Metroidvania. Play as Vince, a frightened child trapped in a nightmare shaped by his fears and imagination. Armed with a lantern, master the light, explore haunting dreamscapes, overcome terrifying creatures, and face your fears to wake up.

games.name: Wolf of The Desert
games.summary: Infiltrate Qamaria tower. Sneak through shadows, observe your surroundings. Gather ability chips to destroy and hack security devices, vanish, teleport past enemies, outsmart them using clones. Combine and upgrade ability chips for the ultimate loadout and bring down a corporate empire

games.name: Onyx: The Dark Grip
games.summary: Set in an isolated town trapped in an endless winter, ONYX: The Dark Grip challenges players to survive through two deeply intertwined roles. As The Vessel, players explore a bleak, frozen world, fight for survival, manage scarce resources and confront the dangers hiding within the town and beneath its snow. But human strength can only go so far. When The Vessel cannot survive alone, players become The God, reaching directly into his world to manipulate reality, protect their host and change what happens beyond the limits of an ordinary human being. Survival depends on knowing when to act as The Vessel and when to intervene as The God.

games.name: Ondeh Ondeh Kaya's Tasty Tale
games.summary: Join Kaya on her quest to become a Worldbuilder in this heartwarming puzzle action-adventure. Explore the whimsical world of Selera, inspired by the rich cultures of Southeast Asia, where rhythm powers exploration, puzzles, and combat in a heartfelt tale of family, courage, and self-discovery.

games.name: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection
games.summary:
Metal Slug Ultimate Collection is a compilation of the entire Metal Slug series, including mainline entries, handheld titles, and the rare Location Test Version. It features quality-of-life improvements like Quick Save and Rewind, plus new modes such as Combat School and online leaderboards for added replayability.

Included Titles:

Metal Slug 1996)
Metal Slug 2 (1998)
Metal Slug X (1999)
Metal Slug 3 (2000)
Metal Slug 4 (2002)
Metal Slug 5 (2003)
Metal Slug Advance (2004)
Metal Slug 6 (2006)
Metal Slug 7 (2008)
The legendary Metal Slug Location Test Version (Never officially released)

games.name: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
aliases: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Itsuwari no Outei
games.summary: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

games.name: Hoshin Engi Re:surrection
games.summary: Wield mythic treasures, ride spirit beasts, and hack and slash through ever-shifting dungeons in an all-new roguelite steeped in Chinese myth, based on Ryu Fujisaki's Weekly Shonen Jump manga. A new hero, a new story, thirty years on.

games.name: Professor Layton and the Curious Village Remake
Pinbomb
games.summary: The Pinball Roguelike! Pinbomb traps you in a room with a pinball machine hungry for higher and higher scores. Buy new parts to upgrade it, build wild synergies to feed the machine, and send your score through the roof. Oh, and there's a bomb strapped to it, so score big or go boom!

games.name: This Is Not For You
games.summary: After a ghost ship crashes into an isolated lighthouse, Ulysses’ memories come back to trap him in an endless, twisting maze full of riddles, blood, and magic. Draw your own map, and find a way to burn it all down.

games.name: Feed The Frog King: Incremental TD
games.summary: A short incremental tower defense game with a massive skill tree! Recruit a team of cute and deadly animal friends, shop for powerful hats, construct buildings, assign workers, and unlock powerful upgrades to Feed The Frog King!

games.name: Donny Donut: Stardust
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Donny Donut, a world full of colors and sweets! This time, Donny will travel through many planets and galaxies to save the whole universe from the evil Burger King!

games.name: Chibits: The King's Tomb
games.summary: Collect, train, and battle Chibits in a fast-paced roguelike card game. Manage your creatures between runs, master tactical combat, and travel through a branching galaxy where every choice shapes your destiny.

games.name: Pirate Troops
games.summary: Follow the journey of Sammy Shortlegs in this fun yet mysterious tale! Uncover the whereabouts of powerful pirate relics lost to time, and confront the terrifying Shadowbeard.

games.name: Everything Must Fit!
games.summary: In this puzzle game, transform, combine, and break items to arrange them to fit the grid. No matter what, everything MUST fit!

games.name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster
games.summary: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong arrives as a mahjong game! Harness your mahjong skills to face the tragedy! Featuring an original scenario supervised by original creator Ryukishi07 and animated cutscenes with over 7,000 frames! This is the ultimate Hinamizawa mahjong experience!

games.name: Sonar
games.summary: Sonar is a survival-horror game set on an abandoned alien planet. Explore vast, dark caves using sonar pulses that briefly reveal the world around you. Research unknown species by taking photographs, recording audio, and collecting samples. Upgrade your equipment and survive deeper explorations.

games.name: Mezanine
games.summary: Mezanine is both a literal and figurative small scale sandbox builder where you can construct and recolor your own creations to compliment its gigantic environment.

games.name: Faraday Blues
games.summary: Faraday Blues is a surreal science fiction adventure about a daughter searching for parents who don't know she exists. Play as Lina, a mysterious girl who awakens in a place she doesn't understand. An old computer introduces her to a strange game table filled with cards. Two of them bear the faces of her parents. However, they have no idea who she is. Worse still: their lives are already marked by tragedy.

games.name: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
games.summary: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

games.name: You Are Family
games.summary: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

games.name: Bad House
games.summary: Welcome to your new home. The previous tenant left some things. You can have them, but there's just one condition: don't go into the basement. Explore the many rooms of a mysterious basement in Bad House, an auto-battler dungeon crawler.

games.name: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
games.summary: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.

games.name: Beltfed
games.summary: You are a rogue AI with one directive: Automate death. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In Beltfed, the factory is your weapon.

games.name: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga
Loaded Dice
games.summary:
Loaded Dice is a Yatzy roguelike where Balatro meets Slay the Spire.
You build your deck with special dice and charms to explode your multipliers and win the round.
The Lore of the game is explained in the event rooms and the deeper you go into the Casino, the more you learn about it.

games.name: Cryptwake
games.summary: Cryptwake is a fast-paced first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Fight through ever-changing floors, uncover strange secrets, wield powerful weapons, build devastating synergies, and survive the horrors that stalk the dungeon.

games.name: 3AM Anomaly Store
games.summary:
Step into the shoes of a clerk in 3AM ANOMALY STORE: Night Shift Horror, a tense first-person horror simulation where running a quiet roadside convenience store is only the beginning. This isn't your average neighborhood market. While you keep the shelves stocked, answer calls, and serve customers, a dark supernatural secret lurks just out of sight.
Behind the backroom door, a shimmering portal awaits. Every night, you must feed an otherworldly creature with specific visitors - not true human beings, but entities that look like ordinary people. You must solve the mystery of who belongs and who is an anomaly before they leave your sight.

games.name: Wednesday 13th
games.summary:
Midnight strikes.
The gates slam shut.
The manor begins to breathe… and hunt.

You are Vanessa Mort — the lost soul trapped inside the haunted Institute on Wednesday the 13th, the cursed night when walls whisper, shadows stalk, and your darkest fears take shape. Every creak in the dark could be a jump scare. Every corridor could be your last.

games.name: Agent Skunk: Stink Ops
games.summary:
Step into the paws of the world’s stealthiest operative, a highly trained skunk agent on a mission to infiltrate, sabotage, and extract without ever being seen. Adorable on the outside, unstoppable in the field.

In this dynamic stealth-action adventure, you’ll crawl through shadows, leap across rooftops, and sabotage alien technology using a unique arsenal of spy tools. Set traps, deploy gas bombs, or vanish entirely with invisibility mode; every mission can be approached your way.

games.name: Bleach & Blood
games.summary: Bleach & Blood is a retro slasher horror game about surviving the night shift at a small-town laundromat while a killer stalks the streets.

games.name: Another Medium
games.summary: Another Medium is a non-linear adventure featuring a mix of sci-fi, horror, drama, and thriller. Explore the world, make decisions, create your psychological profile, remain a puppet in the hands of outside forces, or break the control, even if the price turns out to be too high.

games.name: Kigurumi Hearts
games.summary: Interrogate the suspect. Survive the shift. Interrogation survival horror about exploration of inability to become, and rotting with it.

games.name: Weiß Schwarz Online
games.summary: Battle with cards from your favorite titles! Weiss Schwarz, the world's No. 1 card game by number of participating titles, is now a video game! With a full tutorial and online battles, players of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, can enjoy the game.

games.name: Backtrace: Mechanisms for Forgetting
games.summary: Backtrace is a yuri mystery and puzzle game set inside a retro computer. Log on night after night to uncover a story of internet exploits and unexpected friendships with a crew of 80s hackers. Solve 2D grid-based puzzles to piece together the mystery.

games.name: No One Will Miss Me
games.summary: An existential horror visual novel. Play as a voice inside a troubled mind. Identify her cognitive distortions, shift her perspective, and win the debate that decides whether she lives or dies.

games.name: Pinetrail
games.summary: Deliver packages across Pinetrail in an overloaded rusty rickshaw truck! Meet the locals, uncover mysteries, and explore beautiful hidden spots. Use your vehicle's unique abilities to cross rivers, glide over trees, and battle cargo-stealing boars!

games.name: Rose of Dragontail
games.summary: Kick tail with tail! Enjoy blazing-fast beat-em-up action as Rose, the scrappy fishing village girl turned half-dragon hero. Kick, slam, tail slap, tackle, pile drive, spit fire, and throw whatever and whoever you get your claws on to a groovy surf rock soundtrack.

games.name: Giantess Naval Defense
games.summary: Giantess Naval Defense is a “Giant Girl vs. Kaiju Naval Artillery Defense Game” where you control Orca, the only giant beast humanity can rely on, and fight back against hordes of invading kaiju with devastating naval gunfire.

games.name: Faraway Galaxy
games.summary: Faraway Galaxy is a card-based roguelite about a battle-hardened space wolf in a bizarre galaxy, focused on short, intense tactical battles and meaningful decision-making. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

games.name: In Vino Veritas
games.summary: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

games.name: Acorn: Seed of Resistance
games.summary: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

games.name: Hino
games.summary: Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the white Monimoni Skeleton journey through a world of darkness in this 2D dark fantasy game. Having lost her memory, Hino seeks a safe haven in a land overrun by monsters, uncovering the truth of the dark world as she travels.

games.name: Huemon
games.summary: Discover and collect Huemon, and lead your full team into tactical turn-based battles. Journey through a world powered by color, experiment with team compositions, positioning, and synergies to overcome every challenge.

games.name: The Word
games.summary: The Word is a Christian word game that recounts the life of Jesus through more than 600 cryptogram puzzles based on Gospel verses. Decode each passage using a revealed word as a clue, adjust the difficulty and play settings, and choose from several Bible translations. Solving puzzles also unlocks traditional artwork depicting moments from Jesus’s life.

games.name: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
games.summary: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

games.name: The Emperor Penguin Incident
aliases: 皇帝企鵝襲擊事件報告
games.summary: "All Antarctic researchers dead. Cause of death: Emperor Penguin attack?" Log into the isolated 'Amundsen-4' server. Extract and combine [keywords] from fragmented emails, chats, and logs to uncover the truth behind the bizarre disaster.

games.name: Swaggerfall
games.summary: Swaggerfall is a first-person open world fantasy RPG that plays in the terminal. The graphics are ascii based and limited to what the command line offers. Playable with keyboard or gamepad.

games.name: The Crossing
games.summary: Explore a world inspired by the landscapes of the Gobi Desert behind the wheel of a rally car. Find your way through vast steppes and seas of dunes, and uncover Misheel’s story and the reasons behind her return to the land of her childhood.

games.name: BrokenLore: Miki-chan
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

games.name: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
games.summary: Build a roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

games.name: The Other Side of the Wall
games.summary:
This is the story of Julian Reed, a 13-year old boy attending Saint Maximus the Confessor Catholic School in the early 1980s. Saint Maximus is an all-boys boarding school that shares a wall with another institution for "troubled cases" called Cedar Tree House. Cedar Tree House is shrouded in mystery, as discussing it is frowned upon by the Benedictine monks who make up most of the teaching staff at Julian's school. There is no contact between the two institutions, at least not as far as the students are concerned.

It's late August, the semester has not even started, and only a few students and faculty members are present when Julian discovers a tiny hole in an isolated corner of the wall separating Saint Maximus from Cedar Tree House. The hole is just big enough for him to see a pair of blue eyes. They belong to a girl who soon becomes his closest confidante.

The opportunity to spend time with a girl, albeit separated by a wall, is a welcome distraction from Julian's routine, but it will not be the only one. One boring morning, during class, he notices that one of his classmates is missing from his usual desk. When Julian asks about him, he is shocked to discover that nobody acknowledges that the student ever existed.

The Other Side of the Wall is more than a whodunit game. It's a coming-of-age story of a boy who stumbles upon a mystery and finds himself in over his head. A story about friendship, curiosity, and the unsettling feeling that something is terribly wrong.

The Other Side of the Wall is a traditional 3rd person point & click adventure game. This is a game for people who enjoy being challenged with (mostly inventory based) puzzles and being rewarded for paying close attention to subtle clues.

games.name: System Intruder
games.summary: Dive into the atmospheric dread of classic 3D games. Unravel the dark secrets of the ASGARD-04 research complex in this gripping, narrative-driven retro-cyberpunk survival horror.

games.name: Arctic Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

games.name: Impossible Machine
games.summary: Impossible Machine is a 2.5D graphic adventure where you explore, talk, and build solutions while solving a mystery. No minigames, but plenty of terrible jokes. What could possibly go wrong?

games.name: I Am Plague
games.summary: I Am Plague is a dark incremental roguelite with automatic combat and permanent progression. Lead a horde of rats, collect mutations, create powerful synergies, and devour your enemies as you climb 200+ floors of a vast underground fortress. Every death makes you stronger.

games.name: Moonlight
games.summary: Moonlight is a survival crafting game set in a dynamic alien world that shifts around you. Change the landscape of a beautiful, deadly, procedurally-generated 2D world by growing food, encountering strange creatures and building powerful machines that will help you escape this awful place... maybe.

games.name: Whistle Willie
games.summary: A Steamboat Willie-inspired first-person, open-world horror game. Navigate a haunting world by boat, upgrade your vessel, and arm yourself to survive. Uncover the chilling secrets needed to free the inhabitants from Willies relentless attacks.

games.name: Tabletop Inc.
games.summary: Start a tabletop game company in your bedroom workshop! Develop unique genres and themes, assemble the game boxes yourself, pay your bills, hire your friends, upgrade your workshop, and design even better games in this cozy management tycoon.

games.name: Sundae Drive
games.summary: Hit the road in your very own ice cream truck! Explore a cute neighborhood, park in the perfect spot, and serve adorable animal customers their dream sundaes. Scoop, drizzle, and top to perfection. Upgrade your cute truck, restock supplies, and create your own ice cream flavors!

games.name: Bird Roll 64
games.summary: This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world. Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

games.name: Dark Pals: The 2nd Floor
games.summary: The next chapter of the mascot horror game Dark Pals: The 1st Floor is set in the abandoned depths of UpWard. Armed with your Ink Blaster, you solve puzzles and navigate encounters with new creatures, including the Devourer, while uncovering the mystery of your connection to UpWard and the Dark Pals.

games.name: Garden Hustle
games.summary: Start your own gardening service in a charming neighborhood! Take on relaxing jobs like mowing lawns, planting flowers, blowing leaves, cleaning backyard pools, and more with bite-sized mini-games. Earn money to upgrade your tools, unlock plants, and decorate your own garden between jobs!

games.name: Largely Legal Monstrosity
games.summary: Largely Legal Monstrosity is an incremental bullet heaven with optional auto-aim. Survive, consume, and GROW! Craft your build in a race to disrupt the market leader. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history!

games.name: Roly-Poly Panda: Desktop Pet
games.summary: A desktop pet panda who lives on your screen. Pat it, squish it, pick it up and toss it, or offer bamboo and watch it react. While you work, it munches, naps, climbs windows, and peeks in from the screen edge, quietly keeping you company.

games.name: Charnel
games.summary: Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

games.name: Intercept Course
games.summary: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

games.name: His Last Film
games.summary: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

games.name: Jiaohun
games.summary: Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And now, a message from Fairy Town's end...

games.name: Gods with Badges
games.summary: Patrol the streets of Scarhelm. Decide the fate of your fellow citizens. Take down criminals in brutal turn-based combat. You are a god with a badge, and when you turn on your bodycam, the only thing you answer to is your conscience, and your fellow officers.

games.name: Little Prince Tyger
games.summary: Combine archery and simulated physics in single screen levels in this violent action roguelike. By order of the Queen, hunt and do not question it.

games.name: The Escapists 3
games.summary: Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3. Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call.

games.name: Boba Bears
games.summary: Run a cozy boba shop for bears, discover hidden drink and topping combos, decorate your space, prep ingredients through playful minigames, and meet new bear customers at your own pace. No timers, no pressure, just sweet drinks, curious experiments, and soft village moments.

games.name: Cosmic Dominion
games.summary: Cosmic Dominion is a 2D space combat and real-time strategy game. The player pilots a flagship in direct ship-to-ship combat while expanding and defending a territory of planets across a galaxy. Each planet runs its own economy: it mines ore, builds infrastructure and defences, recruits crew from its population, fields a garrison of ships and pays its holder a share of its income. Planets can be won by investment, by breaching their defences and landing a boarding party, or by destroying them and settling the ruins. Rival AI factions led by commanders play under the same economic rules as the player, mining, trading, colonising and going to war. The game features weapons with distinct damage classes and upgrade tracks, ship and planet modules, periodic invasions by an Insectoid swarm hostile to every faction, and configurable galaxies with up to eight player slots, teams, map sizes, wraparound edges, difficulty settings and shareable seeds.

games.name: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
games.summary: The year is 1907, set in a small, nearly abandoned town. Two murders within three days will shatter the peaceful life of recent years. A point-and-click adventure game where you play as both the killer and the detective, alternating each day, experiencing the story from both perspectives.

games.name: Echo Sequence
games.summary: An isometric, top-down roguelite shooter where your deaths are your squad. Die, and your last life fights on as an Echo, repeating every move and every shot. Die again and there are two. Plan across loops, split the work between your past selves, and clear each level together.

games.name: Force Typhoon
games.summary: Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash your arsenal to defend your home against overwhelming odds!

games.name: Overtime at Holiday's
games.summary: Overtime at Holiday's is a point-and-click adventure game. Cleaners Bill and Jules take a weekend job cleaning Max Holiday's mansion, but when they find Max dead in his pool they become trapped in an endless loop of overtime, forced to move his body around the mansion while avoiding security and the other guests. Players look at items, pick them up, use them and talk to characters to solve puzzles and find out how to escape the time loop.

games.name: Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda
games.summary: Hanafuda × Roguelite × Action! Explore dungeons, collect Hanafuda cards, and grow stronger as a Miko. Battle enemies with the power of your cards, then face powerful bosses in Hanafuda battles. Form winning hands and unleash devastating attacks!

games.name: Malsort
games.summary: Malsort is an action MMO inspired by the classic ARPGs. A cursed world of ash and burning thrones, shared with every hero who dares. Hunt in parties, craft from what you slay, sell your finds at your own stall, and raid the world bosses to loot ancient relics.

games.name: Encryption
games.summary: Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure set during a climate catastrophe burning through southern Italy. A father searches for his missing daughter in Matera, one of the oldest inhabited places on Earth, now evacuated, while something awaits in the darkness below.

games.name: Afterzero: The Last Drive
games.summary: Drive and survive through a frozen post-industrial wasteland. Gear up your vehicle with different tools to tackle hostile threats, while scavenging for resources. Lead a small survivor camp while discovering the truth about what happened.

games.name: Demiourgos
games.summary: A first-person horror. A man wakes up at 3 AM and the sea starts calling. Every person and every animal has a line of destiny. Can you change them before the great end?

games.name: Odd Shop
games.summary: Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late.

games.name: Clown Hole
games.summary: An incremental mining and management game about digging into a dangerous hole in search of valuable ore. Mine deposits, build hiring signs, and recruit workers to expand your subterranean expedition while fighters help fend off hostile clowns. Bring ore back to the surface to trade for tools and supplies, unlock upgrades, and build structures that support deeper runs.

games.name: Clickomorph
games.summary: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

games.name: Nascor Descent
games.summary: Nascor Descent is a first-person dark fantasy dungeon crawler with a grim atmosphere, fast-paced combat, and meaningful choices that will affect both the story and your gameplay.

games.name: Magenta Down
games.summary: You and your crew have crashed and are now scattered across the surface of a harsh, remote exoplanet. With limited supplies and surrounded by hostile terrain, can you find your crew and escape?

games.name: Waveling Island
games.summary: Waveling Island is a Creature-Collecting Sim that takes place on a beautiful, hand-drawn pixelart island full of mysterious creatures called Wavelings. Catch, train and battle these creatures in order to complete quests, gather materials, and make a stake in this new tropical home of yours.

games.name: Abdication
games.summary: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

games.name: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat
games.summary: Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too

games.name: Sanarara R
games.summary: Sanarara R is a multi-ending visual novel about a young man approached by a mysterious girl who claims she can grant any wish. Explore seven heroine routes, each with its own story and ending, through fully voiced Japanese dialogue, except for the protagonist. This version adds stories for Higuchi, Kanae, and Hikaru, extra scenarios from the fan discs, widescreen graphics, and a gallery mode.

games.name: Kiwi Boing
games.summary: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

games.name: Baleful Tactics
games.summary: You are a demon lord, using history’s famous dead to climb the ranks of Hell. Their traits determine your play style. Death leaves them with a wound. Decide who to save, star-up, gear up or sacrifice for more power. Achilles, Genghis Khan and Cleopatra, await your command!

games.name: Nookmaker
games.summary: You're the new interior designer in a small town. Read your clients' letters, decorate their rooms and discover hidden furniture combos along the way. Then spend what you earn on your own little home, where nobody asks for anything.

games.name: Coin Shower
games.summary: Coin Shower is a short, cozy incremental casino arcade game. Every machine pays out in a burst of coins that pile up on the floor. Scoop them up, spend them on upgrades, unlock new machines, and chase the $1,000,000 moon shot.

games.name: Beloved, Below
games.summary: A story of unconditional love and sacrifice told in between puzzles and combat, where each player navigates either the spirit world or the physical world as you escape through elemental realms.

games.name: Heroes Never Die
games.summary: Choose your hero, rally your troops, and carve a path through hordes of foul creatures in a fast-paced fusion of strategy and survivor gameplay. Grow your army as you march, change your tactics on the fly, and lead soldiers, goblins, minotaurs and more into glorious, chaotic battle.

games.name: SakuSaku Witch
games.summary: “Kawaii is Justice!” A classic 2D platformer packed with cute pixel art and bunny-cute charm! Snappy to play and satisfyingly challenging, starring a clumsy little witch who gets caught up in one huge conspiracy!

games.name: Shimagurashi: Island Life
games.summary: Move to a quiet island in southern Japan and take life at your own pace. Drive your little kei truck along the coast, go fishing, carry lumber to build a home, and shop at the corner store. A slow-life game about bringing the lights back to a fading island, one house at a time.

games.name: Sprig
games.summary: Sprig is a cozy 3D exploration game about discovering real-world animals, solving gentle environmental puzzles, and filling your nature journal as a curious rabbit. Explore peaceful, no-stress levels at your own pace in a short, wholesome adventure with a clear ending.

games.name: A Light Touch
games.summary: A Light Touch is a puzzle adventure game where you play as a guiding light, protecting a small chick from danger. Together you solve puzzles and explore a mysterious world consumed by darkness. Can you uncover its secrets and restore light to the world?

games.name: Master of Treasure
games.summary: Sweep an endless procedural coastline with friends and dig up treasure no one has ever seen. Every coin, gem, relic and fossil is generated in 3D and is practically one of a kind. Level up, upgrade your gear, and see how far out you are willing to go for the rarest finds.

games.name: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
games.summary: An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players! Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system! Friendship or betrayal? Money or power? Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

games.name: Dustlings: The Hidden Wilds
games.summary: You stumble into a mysterious, uninhabited wilderness—but you're not alone. The little beings that glow at night will be your closest companions. Bond with extraordinary plants and animals, build a home together, explore the wilds, and follow scattered diary pages to uncover the truth.

games.name: Conversations with My Imaginary Friends
