games.summary: A free collection of explorable scenes capturing conversations spanning two decades between the creator of To the Moon and the fictional characters they've created. About life, making games, and everything in between.

games.name: Spadegrave
games.summary: What if poker hands were your greatest weapons? Spadegrave combines roguelike deckbuilding with poker-inspired combat. Build pairs, full houses, and four of a kind to unleash powerful effects, outplay enemies with higher cards and trumps, and bend the odds with game-changing relics.

games.name: Goral: Highlander Simulator
games.summary: Become a young shepherd in the 1930s Tatra Mountains. Herd sheep, make traditional cheese, and face wolves and unpredictable mountain weather. Start with no sheep of your own, earn your keep, survive each season, and build a flock of your own.

games.name: Super FNaF 2: Second Wind
games.summary:
Explore four worlds full of platforming, puzzles and boss fights as Circus Baby, and be a witness to a new unfamiliar scenario resulting from unusual deviations within the Freddy's timeline.

This second entry is an entirely stand-alone experience, and can be enjoyed by old fans and anyone entirely unfamiliar with the now unlisted original game alike.

games.name: Prima Materia
games.summary: Prima Materia is a dark surreal visual novel set in a sterilized wasteland ruled by Angels, where consciousness is harvested, brewed, and sold. Mana, a Mind Digger who survives by eating minds, takes one last job: fixing a demi-angel worth keeping whole.

games.name: BoosterWare
games.summary: A deckbuilding autobattler where you cheat at your favorite card game. Crack packs, build decks, and install shady tools to automate the grind. Just when you think you’ve seen everything, something new arrives. All running on an early-2000s desktop that feels a little too real.

games.name: Let's Build a Zoo: Amphibian Encounters
games.summary: Ready to add a brand new AMPHIBIAN ENCOUTER to your zoos? Dive in and get your zoo ready for some new froggy friends - the amphibians are here!

games.name: Franky Psychedelic Adventure
games.summary: Join Franky on an epic journey across breathtaking dimensions to reclaim the stolen cookies. Harness powerful psychedelic abilities to overcome challenges, master impossible obstacles, and conquer extraordinary worlds.

games.name: Beaked!
games.summary: Beaked! is a tile-based puzzle-platformer about sound manipulation. Following a little Starling in an abstract world of wooden toys, players will learn to peck buttons, mimic noises and trick people -- all to reach the finish.

games.name: Palimpsest: Where Magic Remembers
games.summary: A hand-painted magical sky-world full of fantasy and adventure. Relive the memories in its ruins, befriend the fantastic beasts you are forced to fight, and decide the future of magic.

games.name: Starmadillo
games.summary: As an armadillo space archaeologist, you've crashed onto a mysterious planet. Luckily you're equipped with a Mobile Defense Unit (MDU) that can defend you from danger, but its capabilities were severely reduced by the impact. In true Metroidvania fashion, explore this alien world and find a way home

games.name: Doughn't Panic!
games.summary: A co-op adventure where 2 players share the controls of a single pizza, bound by a spell neither asked for. Explore a world never built for your size.

games.name: Silent Horizon
games.summary: A turn-based RPG where post-apocalypse meets dark western and weird fiction. The Red Fog that ended the Old World has sealed you inside Rusty Eden. Navigate rival factions, carve out a place for yourself, and uncover what the Fog really is.

games.name: Coin Frenzy
games.summary: Coin Frenzy is an incremental game about launching coins and growing your rewards. Upgrade coin values, launch more coins, and boost your sectors. Earn skill points, rebirth into the skill tree, and unlock new ways to fill and collect your board

games.name: Soulcake
games.summary: Soulcake: A fantasy‑romance AVG with yuri (LGBTQ+) & female-dominant dynamics. As the female lead, you can travel into others’ minds, gather ingredients to bake desserts filled with emotions. People come to you with their secrets. Forge bonds with them and…uncover the truth behind your ability.

games.name: Kaori
games.summary: Kaori is a first-person puzzle and adventure game. Explore ancient ruins on a sun-drenched archipelago and uncover the many mysteries of a lost civilization.

games.name: Novanoom
games.summary: A colorful isometric sci-fi action-adventure. Explore handcrafted alien biomes with T.O.A.S.T.E.R., your companion drone, fight strange creatures in real time, and craft tools from what they drop to open hardlight bridges, shortcuts, and the way to the next biome.

games.name: Steinvar
games.summary: Explore a mysterious, atmospheric world and cleanse creeping corruption using the power of light. Discover secrets, restore lost places, and shape your journey in a story-driven fantasy adventure.

games.name: Weave & Wander
games.summary: Weave & Wander is a cozy, atmospheric adventure where you play as a small spider finding its way through a vast, living world. Climb across walls and ceilings, weave your own paths, and leap through the unknown as you journey from the depths of a cave into the wild beyond.

games.name: Station Between
games.summary: A cozy, small-scale, coffee shop and talking simulator. As a raccoon barista, you have a gift for warming people’s hearts: brew coffee, match flavours to your customers and discover their stories. Help travellers sort out their final errands before they catch their last train.

games.name: Amberly Hollow
games.summary: A Life Sim RPG set in an isolated village. Train and master a variety of skills, collecting resources and rewards as you complete quests, upgrade your home, and discover the secrets of the village of Amberly.

games.name: Misty and the Last Breeze
games.summary: Platform it, then skate it. Jump, wall-run and vine-swing through bright hand-built stages, then call your air board mid-run to grind vines, ride waterfalls and kickflip across canyons. Chain it all into one fast line and chase the gold time.

games.name: Tactical Blitz Fleet
games.summary: A 3D space fleet RTS of ten-minute battles. Lead up to ten squads, each three flagships and a cloud of escorts, into a fight of thousands of ships. Pause any time to set position, height and heading, and play six-sided shields, lines of fire and energy against an enemy you must outthink.

games.name: Pounce Brigade
games.summary: Recruit a brigade of cats, arrange them on the living-room rug, and combine their talents in this auto-battling roguelite. Protect a nap or take on enemy packs through twelve rounds, solo or in private two-player co-op.

games.name: BloodBuild
games.summary: BloodBuild is a roguelike deckbuilder built around build-crafting, where the challenge isn't collecting items - it's making them work together. You progress by fusing, enchanting and combining your loot into ever more powerful builds, against ever stronger enemies.

games.name: Farlane
games.summary: Command a Nomad-class Frontier Runner and lead your crew on the edge of a fading galactic empire. Take on freelance contracts, explore unstable farlanes, upgrade your ship, and survive where civilization ends.

games.name: Surfin' Landes
games.summary: Welcome to Contis, a little beach in the Landes, southwest France. In this 100% co-op pixel art game, become lifeguards: one surfs, the other flies a parachute. On the menu: beer, rescues, giant fish, piranhas, dolphins, pelicans, bazookas, a dog… and ever more beer.

games.name: FrogPop
games.summary: FrogPop is a single-player arcade roguelite in which a frog uses its tongue to pop bouncing bubbles that split into smaller threats. Players dodge hazards, catch Power Bugs for temporary abilities, combine relics, and purchase upgrades between waves. Runs span 20 waves across four zones, with a boss encounter every fifth wave and persistent progression that unlocks more options for future runs.

games.name: Euphorbia Milii
games.summary: A ruined research station reclaimed by nature. Days pass, resources disappear, and decisions leave lasting marks. Euphorbia Milii is a narrative, text-based roguelike RPG where existence costs more than survival. This is vegetation…

games.name: Total Loss
games.summary: Low-poly crash-for-cash co-op comedy for 1-4 players, set in a British seaside town. Stage crashes, fling yourself under buses, claim for every bruise and hope you earn enough money to pay the rent. Short? Do odd jobs at the weekend to make up the difference.

games.name: Argent Cocoon
games.summary: Humanity has fallen, the ruins a breeding ground for the Insecta. Through the Argent Cocoon, they rewrite genes. Evolution is the unquestioned law. You, a gifted Eularva, are meant to surrender your soul to the Great Collective Consciousness. But exploring deeper, you question that destiny.

games.name: All Army Attack
games.summary: Hold onto your clucks! All Army Attack is a chaotic large-scale roguelike auto-battler. Unite animals and plants, build an army that spills off the screen, gamble it all with every battle, and fight your way toward a formidable cosmic threat!

games.name: Cloudlapse!
games.summary: Cloudlapse! is a pop-matching puzzle action roguelike that aims to bring the experience of classic Premium Casual Games into the modern era by blending old-school charm with modern game design.

games.name: Wind Runners
games.summary: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

games.name: Food Industry
games.summary: A city building game, focus on construction, management and strategy economic of the agri-food industry. Build, develop and manage the different sectors of this industry.

games.name: Slime 64
games.summary:
Slime 64 is a 3D collect-a-thon platformer inspired by retro classics!

Play as air, fire, water, and earth slimes, in any order you'd like, as they meet each other on their journey and combine their powers to save the world from the diabolical Wurltson and his ever-expanding robotic enterprise. The Golden Keys, and assorted Bells and Whistles, will unlock new worlds to explore as you amass your strength in numbers (and your pile of goodies).

games.name: Trailer Park Life
games.summary: Build and manage your own trailer park to either become a peaceful haven or a pit of unruly partiers. Expand on services and amenities to keep tenants happy. Manage staff to keep your park safe and clean or let chaos run amuck and risk it all for higher gains.

games.name: Greed Hunters
games.summary: Earn rewards for your greed in this chaotic, multiplayer rogue-like game. Explore randomly generated dungeons with up to 8 players in a world where greed is the currency. To survive, you must outsmart and out-hoard your teammates.

games.name: TouHou: Legend of Fairy Souls
games.summary: “TouHou: Legend of Fairy Souls” is a TouHou fan game.In the game, because of someone's conspiracy, Reimu turned into Kedama and caused her power to weaken.Reimu then had to embark on an adventure to recover herself and finally uncover who was behind the scenes.

games.name: The Last General
games.summary: Lead your army through raging conflicts in this massive RTS modern war game. Execute tactics and conquer the resources you need to achieve your goals. Take the enemy territory, perform assassinations, lead insurrections, rescue your stranded troops and much more, in millions of different missions.

games.name: Beyond Astra
games.summary: Lead your civilization in a galaxy brimming with life and intrigue. Seamlessly explore and expand across uncharted worlds, from their surfaces to the stars. Forge your destiny in this sci-fi 4X offering a unique blend of grand strategy, planetary city-building, and RTS combat.

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Lead the world's greatest Strategists through a virtual war. Decide how humanity will approach the mysterious island of Atlantis.

games.name: Radioactivity
games.summary: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

games.name: CountDown
games.summary: CountDown is a casual, semi-idle, 2D tower-defense. Waves of enemies are advancing, it's your job to bolster your city, or rather, ammunition, and wipe them out. Will you rise to the challenge, or let your city crumble?

games.name: Chronicles: Medieval
games.summary: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

games.name: Into The Unwell
games.summary: Dive into The Unwell as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits in this delightfully despondent third-person roguelite game, playing alone or with up to two friends.
developers: She Was Such A Good Horse

games.name: Night Crew
games.summary: A lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Foul creatures roam the halls - and management still expects YOU to mop the floor. Even though the floor ate Gary. Welcome to the Night Crew. You are 𝙙𝙚𝙛𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙮 not paid enough for this.

games.name: Space Scum
games.summary: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

games.name: Gang of Frogs
games.summary: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

games.name: Blazing War World
games.summary: 3D Apocalypse Level-Based Action Game. Players navigate radiation-ruined areas, using walking, jumping, shooting, exclusive ultimate skills to fight mutated zombies, wasteland thugs, agile creatures, elites. Core goals: defeat bosses or finish tasks to advance, with classic level challenges.

games.name: Starbump
games.summary: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !

games.name: Pizza Agent
games.summary: Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

games.name: Rift Fishing
games.summary: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

games.name: Westlanders
games.summary: Forge your legacy in the Westlands. Survive and thrive in a Wild West open world. Alone or with friends, explore, fight, and build from your customizable wagon. Expand into bustling settlements, recruit allies, and forge a network to tame the wilderness and build your legacy.

games.name: Re:Aktor
games.summary: Re:Aktor is a metroidvania about going fast and rewinding time. Race the clock, unlock new abilities and shortcuts, and solve temporal puzzles. Tear through walls and enemies with damage that scales with momentum, and punch ever deeper into a mysterious underground facility.

games.name: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak
games.summary: ASCENDERS: BEYOND THE PEAK is a turn-based exploration roguelite where survival is vertical. Lead a team of alpinists to recover ancient artifacts from cursed peaks, prepare your expedition, evolve your climbers, master rope mechanics, and face H.P. Lovecraft-inspired horrors within the mountain.

games.name: Desolation Arcanist
games.summary: Craft your own magic in this action roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

games.name: Lootspire
games.summary: Co-op roguelite dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Pick a class, choose abilities, gear up, and fight through a procedural spire that gets harder the higher you go. Gear and Hero Level reset every run, but Unlockables persist.

games.name: Space Hauler
games.summary: Space Hauler is a space flight sim set around Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Fly your spacecraft using realistic aerodynamics and orbital mechanics, take on contracts, and build your career as a pilot-for-hire.

games.name: Idol Manager: Virtual Venture
games.summary: The management simulation game Idol Manager depicted the good and bad sides of the idol industry... another entry in the series is here! This time, the focus is on virtual streamers! Manage a new streaming agency and raise your staff to become the best agency in the industry.

games.name: Guild Wars 3
games.summary: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder. Play solo or form a band of adventurers, forging impactful and enduring bonds with fellow players, a formative cast of memorable NPCs, and the nature spirits that call Orr home.

games.name: Lost Ages Hunting
games.summary: Hunt across time itself. Track dinosaurs, Ice Age beasts, modern wildlife, and creatures from future eras in a unique hunting simulation spanning multiple worlds.

games.name: Regions
games.summary:
Regions is a agent-first city builder focused on infrastructure, procedural growth, and living city systems. Build roads, shape districts, manage transportation, and watch thousands of agents move through a region where every connection, event, and decision helps shape the city’s future.

Regions is a single-player city-building and regional management simulation focused on infrastructure, transportation, development, and the people who use them.

games.name: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
games.summary: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

games.name: War Forge
games.summary:
War Forge is a 2D lane brawler where two teams of champions battle across three lanes to destroy the enemy base. Players fight enemy champions, push lanes, destroy towers, and work together to gain an advantage.

What makes War Forge different is its unique second layer of the map, where teams can leave the lanes to fight over powerful objectives and team-wide buffs. This creates another layer of strategy beyond simply pushing lanes.

Fight. Push. Capture objectives. Destroy the enemy.

games.name: Wolcen II
games.summary: Many years after Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem, return to a world on the brink of collapse. Master brutal combat, build your character without fixed classes, combine skills and gear, and unleash your Shadow Form in this dark fantasy Action RPG. Play alone or in co-op.

games.name: Matelotes
games.summary: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic (though unqualified) sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and, as fate would have it, poultry. Visit a variety of islands, resolve political conflicts, and upgrade your boat in this narrative adventure game inspired by RPGs.

games.name: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
games.summary: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

games.name: Covenant of Gears: The 3 Musketeers
games.summary: Lead the Musketeers in this steampunk tactical CRPG! Tactical pause combat against the English invasion. Use the powerful Campaign Editor to create and share your own adventures. And play the official campaign and those from the community.

games.name: Mayhem À La Carte
games.summary: Cook, fight, and serve under pressure in this chaotic 4-player co-op first-person cooking shooter. Prepare delicious meals, defend your kitchen from relentless enemies, and keep the orders flowing before everything falls apart.

games.name: Project Creatures
games.summary: Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends in a vast Open World!

games.name: Shattered Realms
games.summary:
Shattered Realms is a dark fantasy roguelite action RPG set in the aftermath of a world-shattering betrayal. As one of the last surviving Guardians of Aetherhold, you must battle through ever-changing corrupted realms, face powerful enemies, and gather the strength to restore balance to the world.

Each realm is a fragment of the world’s heart—shards of the Aether Crystal reshaped by corrupted power. To heal the world, you must face those who broke it.

games.name: Mineral Zone
games.summary: Mine resources, automate production, and defend your base from escalating alien attacks. Expand your power grid, unlock new technology, and survive alone or with friends in online co-op.

games.name: Expand TD
games.summary: Expand TD is a tower defense roguelite where you build and upgrade towers and traps while gradually uncovering an expanding map between waves. As you explore new locations and terrain, you'll discover resources, rewards, and unexpected threats that can shift your strategy. When your base falls, the run ends, but you earn Technology Points to unlock permanent upgrades for future attempts across four distinct biomes.

games.name: Nightbrats
games.summary: A 4-player co-op physics horror-comedy where clumsy characters fumble every dare, grab, and monster you drag to the van. You and three friends break into the one house nobody talks about, cameras rolling.

games.name: Ashen
games.summary: Top-down pixel art action RPG in a world shattered by fire and ash. Fight creatures born from the Cinder, forge your build with armor sets, then fish, cook and farm to rebuild Braseval.

games.name: Odin's Fate
games.summary: Discover Norse mythology in a story-driven Tower Defense game. Defeat hordes of enemies, develop your abilities, unlock new heroes, recruit Einherjar, manipulate time, and change your fate, Odin, son of Bor! Will you manage to stop the impending Ragnarök?

games.name: Asterium
games.summary: Real-Time Multiplayer Space Strategy & Combat Command a fleet, manage your empire, and dominate the galaxy in Asterium. Colonize new settlements, trade resources, expand your influence, and lead your ships into real-time tactical battles against rival factions.

games.name: Sky Homestead
games.summary: Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on floating islands. Rebuild a shattered sky-kingdom: raise crops, chain machines into production lines, hire a crew who work while you explore, and sail cargo balloons between the isles you bring back to life.

games.name: Nekolpos: Colossal Cat Care Simulation
games.summary: Nekolpos is a single-player communication simulation game in which the player shrinks to five centimeters tall and lives with their former pet cat, now a giant nekomata. Players can enter their own words to talk with her, interact with her, and record their shared life in a diary. Conversations are written by hand rather than generated by AI.
